sentences.en: Proves Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ with good reduction: specialized Hodge classes pair rationally with complementary divisor products, independently of cohomology theory.
sentences.zh: 证明了具有良约化的 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 上阿贝尔簇的 Milne 有理性猜想：特化后的 Hodge 类与互补维数的除子乘积配对所得为有理数，且与所选的上同调理论无关。

sentences.en: Together with result 032, every specialized Hodge class is represented by a single rational algebraic cycle simultaneously in all prime-to-$p$ and crystalline realizations, for every residue characteristic $p$.
sentences.zh: 结合第 032 组的结果，对每个剩余特征 $p$，每个特化后的 Hodge 类都可由同一个有理系数代数闭链同时在所有素于 $p$ 的实现及晶体实现中表示。

sentences.en: Proves the full Birch--Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over $\mathbb Q$ whose full $q$-power Selmer group has corank zero or one for some prime $q$, including finiteness of the Tate--Shafarevich group.
sentences.zh: 对于 $\mathbb Q$ 上的任意椭圆曲线，若存在素数 $q$，使其完整的 $q$ 幂 Selmer 群的余秩为零或一，则证明完整的 Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer 首项公式成立，其中包括 Tate–Shafarevich 群的有限性。

sentences.en: With result 006, this gives full BSD for a density-one set of quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over $\mathbb Q$.
sentences.zh: 结合第 006 组的结果，可得 $\mathbb Q$ 上每条椭圆曲线都有密度为一的二次扭曲满足完整的 BSD 公式。

sentences.en: Proves that every Dirichlet $L$-function, including $\zeta(s)$, is zero-free in $\Re s>7/8$, resolving the quasi-Riemann hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个 Dirichlet $L$ 函数（包括 $\zeta(s)$）在 $\Re s>7/8$ 内无零点，从而解决准 Riemann 猜想。

sentences.en: The same half-plane is zero-free for every finite-order Hecke $L$-function over $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$.
sentences.zh: $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$ 上的每个有限阶 Hecke $L$ 函数在同一个半平面内也无零点。

sentences.en: A companion gives a different proof of the zero-free half-plane $\Re s>11/12$.
sentences.zh: 其中一篇配套论文给出了无零点半平面 $\Re s>11/12$ 的另一证明。

sentences.en: Proves that no algorithm decides whether an integer-coefficient polynomial in an arbitrary number of variables has a rational zero, resolving Hilbert's tenth problem over $\mathbb Q$ negatively.
sentences.zh: 证明了不存在能够判定任意变量个数的整系数多项式是否有有理零点的算法，从而否定地解决了 $\mathbb Q$ 上的 Hilbert 第十问题。

sentences.en: Proves that Catalan's constant $G=\sum_{j\ge0}(-1)^j/(2j+1)^2$ is irrational.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Catalan 常数 $G=\sum_{j\ge0}(-1)^j/(2j+1)^2$ 是无理数。

sentences.en: Proves Goldfeld's conjecture for quadratic twists of every elliptic curve over $\mathbb Q$: analytic ranks zero and one each have density $1/2$, and the mean analytic rank tends to $1/2$.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\mathbb Q$ 上每条椭圆曲线的二次扭曲所满足的 Goldfeld 猜想：解析秩为零和一的扭曲各自的密度均为 $1/2$，平均解析秩趋于 $1/2$。

sentences.en: Both statements order signed squarefree twist parameters by absolute value.
sentences.zh: 这两个结论都将带符号的无平方因子扭曲参数按绝对值排序。

sentences.en: Proves the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture, with a bound $O(X/(\log X)^c)$ for Liouville correlation sums along fixed nonproportional affine forms, where $c>0$ is absolute.
sentences.zh: 证明了普通平均意义下的二点 Chowla 猜想：沿固定且不成比例的仿射形式，Liouville 相关和满足界 $O(X/(\log X)^c)$，其中 $c>0$ 为绝对常数。

sentences.en: More generally, proves the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for complex multiplicative functions bounded by one when one factor is uniformly nonpretentious against each fixed Dirichlet character times $n^{it}$ for $|t|\le X$.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于模不超过一的复值乘法函数，若其中一个因子相对于每个固定 Dirichlet 特征与 $n^{it}$ 的乘积，在 $|t|\le X$ 范围内一致满足非伪装条件，则证明修正后的二元 Elliott 猜想成立。

sentences.en: Proves that the rational Grothendieck--Teichm\"uller Lie algebra, with the Ihara bracket, is freely generated by one element in each odd weight $3,5,7,\ldots$, resolving the Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture.
sentences.zh: 证明了带 Ihara 括号的有理 Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie 代数由每个奇数权重 $3,5,7,\ldots$ 中的一个元素自由生成，从而解决 Deligne–Drinfeld 猜想。

sentences.en: Reconstructs function fields of transcendence degree at least two over algebraically closed constants from $K^{\mathrm M}_1/\ell$, $K^{\mathrm M}_2/\ell$, and their product.
sentences.zh: 从 $K^{\mathrm M}_1/\ell$、$K^{\mathrm M}_2/\ell$ 及其乘法结构重构代数闭常数域上超越次数至少为二的函数域。

sentences.en: These data recover the perfect closure and constants when $\ell$ differs from the characteristic, and the original field and its named base in equal characteristic.
sentences.zh: 当 $\ell$ 与特征不同时，这些数据恢复其完美闭包及常数域；在等特征情形下，则恢复原函数域及指定的基域。

sentences.en: Also proves Bogomolov--Pop reconstruction from abelian-by-central pro-$\ell$ Galois data away from the characteristic.
sentences.zh: 还证明了在特征以外的情形中，由abelian-by-central 型 pro-$\ell$ Galois 数据实现的 Bogomolov–Pop 重构。

sentences.en: Every continuous odd absolutely irreducible two-dimensional $2$-adic representation of $G_{\mathbb Q}$ unramified outside finitely many primes occurs in a completed Hecke algebra at some odd tame level.
sentences.zh: $G_{\mathbb Q}$ 的每个连续、奇、绝对不可约的二维 $2$ 进表示，若仅在有限多个素数处可能分歧，则都出现在某个奇数驯水平的完备 Hecke 代数中。

sentences.en: Also proves classical modularity up to Tate twist for irreducible odd representations with these finiteness conditions that are de Rham at $2$ with distinct Hodge--Tate weights, resolving the dyadic Fontaine--Mazur case without residual restrictions.
sentences.zh: 还证明了满足上述有限性条件、在 $2$ 处为 de Rham 且 Hodge–Tate 权互异的不可约奇表示，在相差 Tate 扭曲的意义下具有经典模性，从而在不附加剩余表示限制的情况下解决 Fontaine–Mazur 猜想的二进情形。

sentences.en: Proves that the normalized ordered logarithms of the prime factors of $p-1$, counted with multiplicity, converge jointly to the Poisson--Dirichlet law $\mathrm{PD}(1)$ as $p$ ranges uniformly over primes up to $x$ and $x\to\infty$.
sentences.zh: 当 $p$ 在不超过 $x$ 的素数中均匀取值且 $x\to\infty$ 时，证明将 $p-1$ 的素因子按重数计入、排序后，其归一化对数联合收敛于 Poisson–Dirichlet 分布 $\mathrm{PD}(1)$。

sentences.en: This resolves the Ford--Konyagin--Luca conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Ford–Konyagin–Luca 猜想。

sentences.en: It also proves that infinitely many integers $n$ have more than $n^{1-\varepsilon}$ totient preimages, for every $\varepsilon>0$.
sentences.zh: 还证明，对每个 $\varepsilon>0$，都有无穷多个整数 $n$ 在 Euler 函数下有超过 $n^{1-\varepsilon}$ 个原像。

sentences.en: Resolves the Erd\H{o}s--Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture: the logarithmic sizes of the largest prime factors of $n$ and $n+1$ are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Erdős–Pomerance 联合 Dickman 猜想：在普通自然密度意义下，$n$ 与 $n+1$ 的最大素因子的对数大小渐近独立。

sentences.en: In particular, the integers satisfying $P^+(n)<P^+(n+1)$ have density $1/2$.
sentences.zh: 特别地，满足 $P^+(n)<P^+(n+1)$ 的整数的密度为 $1/2$。

sentences.en: Proves that no finite modification of the primes can be written as $A+B$ with $A,B\subseteq\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ each containing at least two elements.
sentences.zh: 证明了对素数集作任何有限修改后，都不能将其写成 $A+B$，其中 $A,B\subseteq\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ 各至少含两个元素。

sentences.en: This resolves Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture on additive indecomposability.
sentences.zh: 这解决了关于加法不可分解性的 Ostmann 逆 Goldbach 猜想。

sentences.en: Proves the restricted geometric Langlands equivalence for connected reductive groups on smooth projective connected curves over $\overline{\mathbb F}_q$ under the four stated Lie-theoretic characteristic hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 在所列的四个 Lie 理论特征假设下，证明了 $\overline{\mathbb F}_q$ 上光滑射影连通曲线的连通约化群所对应的受限几何 Langlands 等价。

sentences.en: Over arbitrary algebraically closed fields of characteristic $p>0$, the same conclusion holds assuming additionally that $p$ is very good for the group and $p\nmid |W_G|$.
sentences.zh: 在任意特征为 $p>0$ 的代数闭域上，若另假设 $p$ 对该群是非常好的素数且 $p\nmid |W_G|$，则同样的结论成立。

sentences.en: Over global function fields, proves Ramanujan at every place for globally generic cuspidal representations of split adjoint absolutely simple exceptional groups, without characteristic or ramification-depth restrictions, and at every unramified place for cuspidal representations of split adjoint absolutely simple groups with a generic unramified component.
sentences.zh: 在整体函数域上，对于分裂、伴随型、绝对单的例外群的整体 generic 尖点表示，证明其在每个地方都满足 Ramanujan 猜想，不限制特征或分歧深度；对于具有 generic 非分歧分量的分裂、伴随型、绝对单群的尖点表示，则证明其在每个非分歧地方都满足该猜想。

sentences.en: Assuming the finite-level Ramanujan--Arthur decomposition, constructs global Arthur enhancements of occurring cuspidal excursion parameters for split connected semisimple groups at full finite level, recovering the given parameters by diagonal specialization on the entire Weil group, including inertia.
sentences.zh: 假设有限水平的 Ramanujan–Arthur 分解成立，则对分裂连通半单群，在有限全水平下构造实际出现的尖点 excursion 参数的整体 Arthur 增强；在整个 Weil 群（包括惯性群）上作对角特化，即恢复给定参数。

sentences.en: Proves Haar equidistribution without escape of mass for complete volume-weighted torus packets from totally real fields: arbitrary lattices and prescribed local types in fixed prime degree at least five, arbitrary-order Picard packets in primitive quartic fields, and maximal-order ideal-class packets in primitive sextic fields.
sentences.zh: 证明了来自全实数域、按体积加权的完整环面包按 Haar 测度等分布，且不发生质量逃逸：范围包括固定为至少五的素数次数时的任意格及指定局部类型，本原四次数域中任意整序的 Picard 包，以及本原六次数域中极大整序的理想类包。

sentences.en: Here primitive means having no proper intermediate field; the relevant order or field discriminant tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 这里“本原”指不存在真中间域；相关整序或数域的判别式趋于无穷。

sentences.en: Proves the abelian Zilber--Pink conjecture over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$: every irreducible subvariety has finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties relative to its smallest containing torsion coset.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 上的阿贝尔 Zilber–Pink 猜想：相对于包含给定不可约子簇的最小挠陪集，该子簇仅有有限多个极大异常子簇。

sentences.en: It also proves the full curve case in the Siegel threefold $\mathcal A_2$ for Hodge-generic curves defined over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$, without boundary or reduction assumptions.
sentences.zh: 还证明了 Siegel 三维簇 $\mathcal A_2$ 中定义在 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 上的 Hodge 一般曲线所满足的完整曲线情形，不附加边界或约化假设。

sentences.en: Proves that the irrationality exponent of $\pi$ is exactly $2$: for every $\varepsilon>0$ and all sufficiently large denominators $q$, every rational $p/q$ satisfies $|\pi-p/q|\ge q^{-2-\varepsilon}$.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\pi$ 的无理性指数恰为 $2$：对每个 $\varepsilon>0$ 及所有充分大的分母 $q$，每个有理数 $p/q$ 都满足 $|\pi-p/q|\ge q^{-2-\varepsilon}$。

sentences.en: This also proves convergence of the Flint--Hills series $\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)$, with angles in radians.
sentences.zh: 由此还证明了 Flint–Hills 级数 $\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)$ 收敛，其中角度以弧度计。

sentences.en: Proves the Margulis--Platonov conjecture over every global field, including function fields of characteristic two.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个整体域上的 Margulis–Platonov 猜想，包括特征为二的函数域。

sentences.en: For an absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic group $G$ over $k$, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of $G(k)$ is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup in the finite product of its anisotropic nonarchimedean local groups.
sentences.zh: 对于 $k$ 上的绝对几乎单、单连通代数群 $G$，$G(k)$ 的每个非中心抽象正规子群，都是其各向异性非 Archimedean 局部群的有限乘积中某个开正规子群的原像。

sentences.en: Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of $\mathbb Q_p$ correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic \'etale fundamental group.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\mathbb Q_p$ 的有限扩张上每条亏格至少为二的光滑、固有、几何连通曲线，其有理点与完整算术 étale 基本群的截面的共轭类一一对应。

sentences.en: It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over $\mathbb Q$ for the modular curves $X_0(N)$ and $X_1(N)$ of genus at least two.
sentences.zh: 还证明了 $\mathbb Q$ 上亏格至少为二的模曲线 $X_0(N)$ 和 $X_1(N)$ 的 Grothendieck 截面猜想。

sentences.en: Proves the squarefree-values conjecture for irreducible integer quartics with no fixed prime-square divisor: squarefree values on positive integers have the predicted positive Euler-product density.
sentences.zh: 证明了没有固定素数平方因子的不可约整系数四次多项式的无平方因子值猜想：其在正整数上取无平方因子值的密度，是预期的正 Euler 乘积。

sentences.en: More generally, establishes the $(d-2)$-power-free density for irreducible integer polynomials of degrees four through eight under the necessary local condition; together with Browning's higher-degree theorem, this covers every $d\ge4$.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，在必要的局部条件下，对次数从四到八的不可约整系数多项式建立无 $(d-2)$ 次幂因子值的密度公式；结合 Browning 的高次定理，这涵盖了每个 $d\ge4$。

sentences.en: Answers Jacobsthal's quadratic-bound question: every interval of $Ck^2$ consecutive integers contains an integer coprime to any prescribed positive integer with at most $k$ distinct prime divisors, for an absolute constant $C$.
sentences.zh: 回答了 Jacobsthal 的二次界问题：存在绝对常数 $C$，使对任意指定的至多含 $k$ 个不同素因子的正整数，每个由 $Ck^2$ 个连续整数组成的区间内，都存在与之互素的整数。

sentences.en: The bound is uniform over prime sets and interval positions and removes the classical logarithmic loss.
sentences.zh: 此界对于素数集合及区间位置是一致的，并消除了经典结果中的对数损失。

sentences.en: Proves that for every real shift $\gamma$ and finite-valued $\psi:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty)$, divergence of $\sum_q\phi(q)\psi(q)/q$ implies $\|qx-\gamma\|<\psi(q)$ for infinitely many $q$, for almost every $x$.
sentences.zh: 证明了对每个实平移 $\gamma$ 及各点取值均有限的函数 $\psi:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty)$，若 $\sum_q\phi(q)\psi(q)/q$ 发散，则对几乎处处的 $x$，有无穷多个 $q$ 满足 $\|qx-\gamma\|<\psi(q)$。

sentences.en: Here $\phi$ is Euler's totient and the norm is distance to the nearest integer.
sentences.zh: 其中 $\phi$ 为 Euler 函数，双竖线表示到最近整数的距离。

sentences.en: Numerators are unrestricted; no monotonicity or Diophantine condition on $\gamma$ is needed.
sentences.zh: 分子不受限制；不要求单调性，也不要求 $\gamma$ 满足丢番图条件。

sentences.en: Proves unconditionally the all-primary-prime form of Patterson’s first-moment asymptotic: normalized cubic Gauss sums over primary Eisenstein primes of norm at most $X$, including both conjugates, have an explicit positive main term of order $X^{5/6}/\log X$.
sentences.zh: 无条件地证明了 Patterson 一阶矩渐近式对所有初级素数成立的版本：对范数不超过 $X$ 的初级 Eisenstein 素数（包括两个共轭元）求和，归一化三次 Gauss 和具有一个显式的、数量级为 $X^{5/6}/\log X$ 的正主项。

sentences.en: Every fixed nonzero prime-angle Fourier mode has smaller order.
sentences.zh: 每个固定的非零素数辐角 Fourier 模式都具有更小的数量级。

sentences.en: Gives an asymptotic equivalent for the number $V(x)$ of distinct totient values up to $x$, with a positive bounded phase-dependent factor determined by convergent arithmetic approximations.
sentences.zh: 给出了不超过 $x$ 的不同 Euler 函数值个数 $V(x)$ 的渐近等价式，其中含有一个依赖相位的正有界因子，由收敛的算术逼近确定。

sentences.en: In particular, $V(cx)/V(x)\to c$ for every fixed $c>0$, answering Erd\H{o}s and Hall’s scaling question.
sentences.zh: 特别地，对每个固定的 $c>0$，都有 $V(cx)/V(x)\to c$，从而回答 Erdős 和 Hall 的尺度变换问题。

sentences.en: Every rational $a/b$ with $1\le a<b$ is a sum of $O(\log\log b)$ distinct positive unit fractions.
sentences.zh: 每个满足 $1\le a<b$ 的有理数 $a/b$ 都可表示为 $O(\log\log b)$ 个互不相同的正单位分数之和。

sentences.en: The worst-case minimum number of terms has the same order, resolving Erd\H{o}s’s conjecture on short Egyptian fractions.
sentences.zh: 最坏情形下所需的最少项数也具有同一数量级，从而解决 Erdős 的短埃及分数猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed $C>0$, a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $C\log p_n$, throughout every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定的 $C>0$，在每个充分大的素数初始区段中，都有正比例的相邻素数间隙超过 $C\log p_n$。

sentences.en: The proportion may depend on $C$.
sentences.zh: 该比例可以依赖于 $C$。

sentences.en: Consequently, the indices where $p_n/n$ increases have positive lower density, answering Erd\H{o}s and Prachar.
sentences.zh: 因此，使 $p_n/n$ 增大的下标集合具有正下密度，从而回答 Erdős 和 Prachar 的问题。

sentences.en: Resolves the determinant-one curve case of Litt's integral-density question.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Litt 的整点稠密性问题在曲线上行列式为一的情形。

sentences.en: For every smooth connected complex algebraic curve and every rank, integral points become Zariski dense in every component of its $\mathrm{SL}_r$ character variety over the full ring of integers of one number field.
sentences.zh: 对于每条光滑连通复代数曲线及每个秩，都存在一个数域，使该曲线的 $\mathrm{SL}_r$ 特征标簇在此数域的完整整数环上的整点，在其每个分支中 Zariski 稠密。

sentences.en: Prescribed quasi-unipotent boundary conjugacy classes are allowed, including nonsemisimple classes.
sentences.zh: 允许指定拟幺幂的边界共轭类，包括非半单的共轭类。

sentences.en: Proves the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes can have uniformly bounded steps.
sentences.zh: 证明了高斯壕沟猜想：不存在经过互不相同的高斯素数、且步长一致有界的无穷游走。

sentences.en: More strongly, for every distance bound $D$, the graph joining Gaussian primes at distance at most $D$ has uniformly bounded finite component sizes, depending only on $D$, including primes on the coordinate axes.
sentences.zh: 更强地，对每个距离界 $D$，将距离不超过 $D$ 的高斯素数相连所得的图，其连通分支的大小均为有限且有仅依赖于 $D$ 的一致上界，其中也包括坐标轴上的素数。

sentences.en: Proves the infinitude assertion in Artin's primitive root conjecture for every integer $a$ that is neither $-1$ nor a square.
sentences.zh: 对每个既非 $-1$ 又非平方数的整数 $a$，证明了 Artin 原根猜想中的无穷性断言。

sentences.en: For each such base, at least $c_a x/(\log x)^2$ primes in every sufficiently large interval $(x,2x)$ have primitive root $a$, with $c_a>0$.
sentences.zh: 对每个这样的底数，在每个充分大的区间 $(x,2x)$ 中，都至少有 $c_a x/(\log x)^2$ 个以 $a$ 为原根的素数，其中 $c_a>0$。

sentences.en: Proves the modularity conjecture for elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields: every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.
sentences.zh: 证明了虚二次数域上椭圆曲线的模性猜想：每个虚二次数域上的每条椭圆曲线都具有模性，且在每个地方的局部参数都相匹配。

sentences.en: Proves Uchida's conjecture: every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of possibly infinite solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields comes from a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Uchida 猜想：数域的两个可解闭 Galois 扩张（允许为无限扩张）的 Galois 群之间，每个连续开同态都来自唯一的反向等变域嵌入。

sentences.en: No restriction on the kernel or separate cyclotomic-compatibility assumption is needed.
sentences.zh: 不需要对核作限制，也不需要另加分圆相容性假设。

sentences.en: Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for every complex CM abelian variety, in every dimension and codimension.
sentences.zh: 在每个维数和余维数下，证明了所有复 CM 阿贝尔簇的有理 Hodge 猜想。

sentences.en: Through Milne's theorems, this also gives the Tate conjecture for all abelian varieties over finite fields and the Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in every characteristic.
sentences.zh: 由 Milne 的定理，这还给出有限域上所有阿贝尔簇的 Tate 猜想，以及任意特征下阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 标准猜想。

sentences.en: Companion results prove rational Hodge for arbitrary products of projective complex K3 surfaces and algebraicity of the Kuga--Satake correspondence for every such surface.
sentences.zh: 配套结果证明了射影复 K3 曲面的任意乘积的有理 Hodge 猜想，以及每个此类曲面的 Kuga–Satake 对应的代数性。

sentences.en: Proves Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for smooth Fujiki-class-$\mathcal C$ manifolds with rational simple-normal-crossing boundaries.
sentences.zh: 证明了带有有理简单正规交叉边界的光滑 Fujiki $\mathcal C$ 类流形的 Campana 轨形 Iitaka 次可加性猜想。

sentences.en: For projective fibrations $f:U\to V$ of smooth complex quasi-projective varieties with connected fibers, general fiber $F$, and $\bar\kappa(V)\ge0$, proves Popa's inequality $\bar\kappa(U)\ge\kappa(F)+\max\{\bar\kappa(V),\operatorname{Var}(f)\}$, where variation measures the whole geometric generic fiber.
sentences.zh: 对于光滑复拟射影簇之间的射影纤维化 $f:U\to V$，若其纤维连通、一般纤维为 $F$ 且 $\bar\kappa(V)\ge0$，则证明 Popa 不等式 $\bar\kappa(U)\ge\kappa(F)+\max\{\bar\kappa(V),\operatorname{Var}(f)\}$，其中变异度衡量的是整个几何泛纤维的变化。

sentences.en: Using logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity, proves log abundance in every dimension for normal compact K\"ahler log canonical pairs with effective rational boundary: an analytically nef $\mathbb Q$-Cartier adjoint is semiample.
sentences.zh: 利用对数 Iitaka 次可加性，证明了任意维数、带有效有理边界的正规紧 Kähler 对数典范对的对数丰沛性：解析意义下 nef 的 $\mathbb Q$-Cartier 伴随除子是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: It also proves projective log abundance over every algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and the effective Iitaka fibration conjecture for smooth projective varieties of nonnegative Kodaira dimension in that setting.
sentences.zh: 还证明了每个特征零代数闭域上的射影对数丰沛性，以及该情形下 Kodaira 维数非负的光滑射影簇的有效 Iitaka 纤维化猜想。

sentences.en: A further result resolves the finite-rational-coefficient index conjecture for connected projective semi-log-canonical log Calabi--Yau pairs over such fields in each fixed dimension and for each fixed finite set of rational boundary coefficients, with a uniform index independent of the number of components.
sentences.zh: 进一步的结果解决了这些域上连通射影半对数典范对数 Calabi–Yau 对的有限有理系数指标猜想：固定维数及边界系数所属的有限有理数集后，存在不依赖于分支个数的一致指标。

sentences.en: Proves log abundance for projective log canonical threefold pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic $p>3$ when the effective boundary is rational and the $\mathbb Q$-Cartier adjoint is nef of numerical dimension one.
sentences.zh: 对于特征为 $p>3$ 的代数闭域上的射影对数典范三维对，若边界为有效有理除子，且 $\mathbb Q$-Cartier 伴随除子为 nef、数值维数为一，则证明对数丰沛性成立。

sentences.en: The adjoint is semiample, without requiring the original variety to be terminal or $\mathbb Q$-factorial.
sentences.zh: 该伴随除子是半丰沛的，无须要求原簇具有终端奇点或为 $\mathbb Q$-factorial。

sentences.en: Proves numerical semiampleness for nef adjoints $K_X+B+M$ with $K_X+B$ pseudo-effective and $M$ nef rational, for projective klt rational pairs over algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields and smooth compact K\"ahler rational klt simple-normal-crossing pairs, using Bott--Chern cohomology in the latter case.
sentences.zh: 对于特征零代数闭域上的射影有理 klt 对，以及光滑紧 Kähler 有理 klt 简单正规交叉对，证明当 $K_X+B$ 伪有效、$M$ 为有理 nef 除子时，nef 伴随除子 $K_X+B+M$ 数值半丰沛；在后一情形中使用 Bott–Chern 上同调。

sentences.en: Separately, projective generalized log canonical rational pairs over such fields admit minimal models for pseudo-effective adjoints and Mori fiber spaces otherwise, with nef b-data fixed.
sentences.zh: 另外，在这些域上的射影广义对数典范有理对，固定 nef 的 b-数据后，当伴随除子伪有效时存在极小模型，否则存在 Mori 纤维空间。

sentences.en: Proves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture: every singular complex algebraic klt germ of dimension $n\ge2$, with zero boundary, has normalized volume at most $2(n-1)^n$.
sentences.zh: 证明了普通二重点的体积间隙猜想：每个维数为 $n\ge2$、边界为零的奇异复代数 klt 芽，其归一化体积至多为 $2(n-1)^n$。

sentences.en: Equality holds precisely for an analytic ordinary double point.
sentences.zh: 等号成立当且仅当该芽解析同构于普通二重点。

sentences.en: Proves Fujita's freeness conjecture at its sharp bound in every dimension: for a smooth projective complex variety $X$ of dimension $n$ and an ample line bundle $L$, the adjoint $K_X+mL$ is globally generated for every integer $m\ge n+1$.
sentences.zh: 在任意维数下，以最优的界证明了 Fujita 自由性猜想：对于维数为 $n$ 的光滑复射影簇 $X$ 及丰沛线丛 $L$，每个满足 $m\ge n+1$ 的整数都使伴随线丛 $K_X+mL$ 整体生成。

sentences.en: Proves Nagata's strict inequality $\sum_i m_i<d\sqrt r$ for every nonzero effective plane curve of degree $d$ through $r\ge10$ very general complex points, with arbitrary multiplicities $m_i$.
sentences.zh: 对每条次数为 $d$ 的非零有效平面曲线，若其经过 $r\ge10$ 个非常一般的复点、在这些点的重数分别为任意给定的 $m_i$，则证明 Nagata 严格不等式 $\sum_i m_i<d\sqrt r$ 成立。

sentences.en: It also proves maximal multipoint Seshadri constants $(L^n/r)^{1/n}$ for every smooth polarized projective variety of dimension $n\ge2$ and all sufficiently large $r$: at very general points over $\mathbb C$, and at the geometric generic tuple over any algebraically closed field of positive characteristic.
sentences.zh: 还证明，对于每个维数为 $n\ge2$ 的光滑极化射影簇及所有充分大的 $r$，多点 Seshadri 常数都达到最大值 $(L^n/r)^{1/n}$：在 $\mathbb C$ 上取非常一般的点，在任意正特征代数闭域上则取几何一般点组。

sentences.en: Proves Bloch's conjecture: for every smooth connected projective complex surface $S$ with $p_g(S)=0$, the Albanese map $\mathrm{CH}_0(S)^0\to\mathrm{Alb}(S)(\mathbb C)$ on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Bloch 猜想：对于每个满足 $p_g(S)=0$ 的光滑连通复射影曲面 $S$，整系数、次数为零的零维闭链上的 Albanese 映射 $\mathrm{CH}_0(S)^0\to\mathrm{Alb}(S)(\mathbb C)$ 为同构。

sentences.en: This combines the new $p_g=q=0$ theorem with the classical theorem of Bloch, Kas, and Lieberman.
sentences.zh: 该结论结合了新的 $p_g=q=0$ 定理与 Bloch、Kas 和 Lieberman 的经典定理。

sentences.en: Proves the strong hyperk\"ahler SYZ conjecture: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic K\"ahler manifold is semiample.
sentences.zh: 证明了强形式的超 Kähler SYZ 猜想：在紧不可约全纯辛 Kähler 流形上，每个第一 Chern 类非零、nef 且各向同性的全纯线丛都是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: It also proves that every projective Lagrangian fibration with normal projective base has projective space as its base, in every dimension and deformation type.
sentences.zh: 还证明，在任意维数和形变类型下，每个底为正规射影簇的射影 Lagrangian 纤维化，其底都是射影空间。

sentences.en: Proves that every complex K3 surface is Oka, including nonprojective surfaces.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个复 K3 曲面都具有 Oka 性质，包括非射影曲面。

sentences.en: More generally, every connected minimal compact complex surface of Kodaira dimension zero is Oka; a connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII is Oka exactly when it is a Hopf or Enoki surface.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，每个 Kodaira 维数为零的连通极小紧复曲面都具有 Oka 性质；VII 类连通极小紧复曲面具有 Oka 性质，当且仅当它是 Hopf 曲面或 Enoki 曲面。

sentences.en: Proves $P_k=W_{2k}=W_{2k+1}$ on the full rational cohomology of smooth coprime fixed-determinant, trace-free Higgs moduli spaces and their character varieties for composite ranks over smooth projective complex curves of genus at least two.
sentences.zh: 对于亏格至少为二的光滑复射影曲线上的光滑、互素、固定行列式、迹为零的 Higgs 模空间及其特征标簇，证明在合数秩情形下，其全部有理上同调满足 $P_k=W_{2k}=W_{2k+1}$。

sentences.en: This includes variant cohomology and, together with the known prime-rank theorems, establishes the fixed-determinant $P=W$ conjecture in every coprime rank.
sentences.zh: 这包括变异上同调；结合已知的素数秩定理，便在每个互素秩下建立固定行列式的 $P=W$ 猜想。

sentences.en: Proves the equivariant cohomological Hikita correspondence for every finite quiver, including loops and multiple arrows, with arbitrary dimension and framing vectors and commuting flavor torus.
sentences.zh: 对每个有限箭图，包括含环及重箭的情形，在维数向量、框架向量及其作用与规范群作用可交换的 flavor 环面任意给定时，证明等变上同调 Hikita 对应成立。

sentences.en: When every semistable point is stable and the gauge action is free, the equivariant cohomology of the Nakajima variety is canonically the coordinate ring of the scheme-theoretic cocharacter-fixed locus of its flavor-deformed Coulomb branch.
sentences.zh: 当每个半稳定点都稳定、且规范群的作用自由时，Nakajima 簇的等变上同调典范同构于其 flavor 形变 Coulomb 分支的余特征不动点子概形的坐标环。

sentences.en: Constructs a smooth projective complex fourfold with large fundamental group whose universal cover contains no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety but is neither Stein nor holomorphically convex.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个具有大基本群的光滑复射影四维簇，其万有覆盖不含正维紧解析子簇，却既不是 Stein 的，也不全纯凸。

sentences.en: A separate smooth projective complex surface already disproves unrestricted Shafarevich holomorphic convexity in dimension two.
sentences.zh: 另一个光滑复射影曲面的例子已在二维否定了不附加限制的 Shafarevich 全纯凸性猜想。

sentences.en: Constructs an integral complex affine fourfold $X\not\cong\mathbb A^4$ with $X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5$, disproving affine-space cancellation over $\mathbb C$ in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 构造了整的复仿射四维簇 $X\not\cong\mathbb A^4$，使其满足 $X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5$，从而在四维否定 $\mathbb C$ 上的仿射空间消去猜想。

sentences.en: It also disproves the Dolgachev--Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture: smooth surjections $X\to\mathbb A^1$ and $\mathbb A^5\to\mathbb A^2$ have every residue-field fiber isomorphic to affine three-space but are not Zariski-locally trivial.
sentences.zh: 还否定了 Dolgachev–Weisfeiler 仿射纤维化猜想：光滑满射 $X\to\mathbb A^1$ 和 $\mathbb A^5\to\mathbb A^2$ 在每个剩余域上的纤维均同构于仿射三维空间，却不在 Zariski 拓扑下局部平凡。

sentences.en: Constructs a singular normal affine complex surface with free rank-two tangent sheaf, disproving the characteristic-zero Lipman--Zariski conjecture.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个奇异正规复仿射曲面，其切层是秩二自由层，从而否定特征零的 Lipman–Zariski 猜想。

sentences.en: Constructs a polynomial in four complex variables that is not a coordinate but becomes one after adjoining a single variable, disproving the Stable Coordinate conjecture in four variables.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个四元复多项式，它本身不是坐标，但添入一个变量后成为坐标，从而否定四变量的稳定坐标猜想。

sentences.en: Every fiber is affine three-space, yet none of its embeddings is rectifiable, also disproving the Abhyankar--Sathaye conjecture even when all fibers are affine spaces.
sentences.zh: 每个纤维都是仿射三维空间，但这些嵌入均不可拉直，从而即使在所有纤维都是仿射空间的情形下，也否定了 Abhyankar–Sathaye 猜想。

sentences.en: Constructs ample rank-two bundles on $\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1$ with no smooth Hermitian metric of strictly Griffiths-positive curvature, disproving Griffiths' positivity conjecture already on the quadric surface.
sentences.zh: 在 $\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1$ 上构造丰沛秩二向量丛，使其不容许曲率严格 Griffiths 正的光滑 Hermitian 度量，从而已在二次曲面上否定 Griffiths 正性猜想。

sentences.en: Every compact connected K\"ahler manifold of positive complex dimension with no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is therefore projective.
sentences.zh: 每个正复维的紧连通 Kähler 流形，若不含非常值整曲线，则其典范丛丰沛，因而该流形是射影的。

sentences.en: This proves Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact K\"ahler setting.
sentences.zh: 这证明了光滑紧 Kähler 情形下的 Kobayashi 典范丰沛性猜想。

sentences.en: A splitting of the tangent bundle of a compact K\"ahler manifold into two integrable holomorphic subbundles induces a compatible product decomposition of its universal cover, proving the two-summand form of Beauville's splitting conjecture.
sentences.zh: 紧 Kähler 流形的切丛分裂为两个可积全纯子丛时，诱导其万有覆盖的相容乘积分解，从而证明 Beauville 分裂猜想的两个直和项情形。

sentences.en: On smooth rationally connected projective manifolds, both summands are automatically integrable, establishing H\"oring's conjecture and the corresponding product decomposition.
sentences.zh: 在光滑有理连通射影流形上，两个直和项自动可积，从而建立 Höring 猜想及相应的乘积分解。

sentences.en: Constructs a tautological relation on a moduli space of stable pointed curves that vanishes in rational Chow, hence in rational cohomology, but lies outside Pixton's original relation span.
sentences.zh: 在稳定带点曲线的模空间上构造一个重言式关系，它在有理 Chow 群中为零，因而在有理上同调中也为零，却不在 Pixton 原始关系的张成空间中。

sentences.en: This disproves the Chow and rational-cohomological forms of his original completeness conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了其原始完备性猜想的 Chow 形式及有理上同调形式。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant, a very general smooth complex cubic fourfold is irrational despite having both an untwisted geometric K3 category and an integral Hodge-theoretic K3 association.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分大的允许 Hassett 判别式，非常一般的光滑复三次四维簇，即使同时具有无扭曲的几何 K3 范畴及整 Hodge 理论意义下的关联 K3 曲面，也不是有理的。

sentences.en: This disproves Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture and the sufficiency of the associated-K3 criterion for rationality; the discriminant threshold is ineffective.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Kuznetsov 有理性猜想，以及关联 K3 判据作为有理性充分条件的断言；判别式阈值是非有效的。

sentences.en: Proves Toda's Gepner conjecture for every smooth complex quintic threefold, constructing a numerical Bridgeland stability condition with the prescribed phase shift $2/5$.
sentences.zh: 对每个光滑复五次三维簇，构造具有指定相位平移 $2/5$ 的数值 Bridgeland 稳定性条件，从而证明 Toda 的 Gepner 猜想。

sentences.en: Also constructs numerical Bridgeland stability conditions at every sufficiently large volume on all smooth projective complex threefolds with trivial canonical bundle, with the exact ordinary and square-root-Todd central charges.
sentences.zh: 还在典范丛平凡的所有光滑复射影三维簇上，对每个充分大的体积构造数值 Bridgeland 稳定性条件，并给出精确的普通中心荷及含 Todd 类平方根的中心荷。

sentences.en: Proves termination of every existing generalized log canonical flip sequence on globally Weil $\mathbb Q$-factorial compact K\"ahler fourfolds, with rational boundary, fixed rational analytically nef b-data, and projective small flip diagrams with the prescribed ample signs.
sentences.zh: 对于整体 Weil $\mathbb Q$-factorial 的紧 Kähler 四维簇，在边界有理、有理且解析 nef 的 b-数据固定、翻转图为射影小双有理图且满足指定丰沛性符号条件时，证明每个存在的广义对数典范翻转序列都终止。

sentences.en: Also proves termination of arbitrary permitted minimal model programs for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary in characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 还证明了特征零、带有理边界的射影对数典范四维对的任意允许的极小模型程序均终止。

sentences.en: Proves Campana's abelianity conjecture: special compact K\"ahler manifolds have virtually abelian fundamental groups.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Campana 阿贝尔性猜想：特殊紧 Kähler 流形的基本群是虚阿贝尔群。

sentences.en: Using this theorem, establishes the same conclusion for order-two root orbifolds of smooth projective complex fourfolds along one nonempty smooth connected divisor, when special in the stated differential-line sense.
sentences.zh: 利用这一定理，对光滑复射影四维簇沿一个非空、光滑、连通除子构造的二阶根轨形，若它在所述微分线丛意义下是特殊的，则建立相同结论。

sentences.en: For smooth special complex quasi-projective varieties, proves that every finite-dimensional complex linear representation of the fundamental group has virtually nilpotent image of class at most two.
sentences.zh: 对光滑特殊复拟射影簇，证明其基本群的每个有限维复线性表示的像都含有一个有限指数的幂零子群，且该子群的幂零类至多为二。

sentences.en: Proves the Koll\'ar--Pardon conjecture: the semialgebraic universal covers of connected normal projective complex varieties are exactly products $D\times\mathbb C^m\times F$, with $D$ bounded symmetric and $F$ simply connected, normal, and projective.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Kollár–Pardon 猜想：连通正规复射影簇的半代数万有覆盖恰为乘积 $D\times\mathbb C^m\times F$，其中 $D$ 是有界对称域，$F$ 单连通、正规且射影。

sentences.en: A universal cover is quasi-projective exactly when the bounded symmetric factor is absent.
sentences.zh: 万有覆盖是拟射影的，当且仅当其中没有有界对称域因子。

sentences.en: In particular, a smooth projective variety covered by $\mathbb C^n$ has a finite \textnormal{étale} cover by an abelian variety.
sentences.zh: 特别地，若光滑射影簇由 $\mathbb C^n$ 覆盖，则它具有一个为阿贝尔簇的有限 étale 覆盖。

sentences.en: Disproves Zariski's multiplicity conjecture by constructing reduced holomorphic hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have different multiplicities.
sentences.zh: 通过构造在环境空间中同胚、但重数不同的约化全纯超曲面芽，否定 Zariski 重数猜想。

sentences.en: The examples include hypersurfaces in $\mathbb C^4$ with isolated critical points and multiplicities four and five.
sentences.zh: 这些例子包括 $\mathbb C^4$ 中具有孤立临界点、重数分别为四和五的超曲面。

sentences.en: Every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with $b_2>0$ contains a global spherical shell, proving the positive-$b_2$ Global Spherical Shell conjecture.
sentences.zh: 每个满足 $b_2>0$ 的 VII 类连通极小紧复曲面都含有整体球壳，从而证明了正 $b_2$ 情形下的整体球壳猜想。

sentences.en: Such a shell is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}$ whose complement is connected.
sentences.zh: 这样的球壳是 $\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}$ 中标准三维球面的一个邻域在该曲面中的全纯嵌入像，且其补集连通。

sentences.en: Proves the LeBrun--Salamon conjecture: every closed connected positive quaternionic-K\"ahler manifold of real dimension at least eight is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space.
sentences.zh: 证明了 LeBrun–Salamon 猜想：每个实维至少为八的闭连通正 quaternionic-Kähler 流形，都与紧对称 Wolf 空间位似。

sentences.en: It also proves contact-Fano homogeneity and classifies smooth connected complex projective contact manifolds of complex dimension at least three: those with $b_2=1$ are adjoint varieties with their canonical contact structures, while those with $b_2\ge2$ have underlying manifold $\mathbb P(T^*Z)$ for a smooth projective variety $Z$.
sentences.zh: 还证明了接触 Fano 流形的齐性，并分类复维至少为三的光滑连通复射影接触流形：当 $b_2=1$ 时，它是带典范接触结构的伴随簇；当 $b_2\ge2$ 时，其底层流形为 $\mathbb P(T^*Z)$，其中 $Z$ 是光滑射影簇。

sentences.en: Proves the generalized Mukai conjecture: every positive-dimensional smooth complex projective Fano manifold of dimension $n$, Picard number $\rho$ and pseudoindex $\iota$ satisfies $\rho(\iota-1)\le n$, with equality exactly for $(\mathbb P^{\iota-1})^\rho$.
sentences.zh: 证明了广义 Mukai 猜想：每个维数为正的光滑复射影 Fano 流形，若维数为 $n$、Picard 数为 $\rho$、伪指数为 $\iota$，则满足 $\rho(\iota-1)\le n$，且等号恰在 $(\mathbb P^{\iota-1})^\rho$ 时成立。

sentences.en: Here the pseudoindex is the least anticanonical degree of a rational curve.
sentences.zh: 这里伪指数是有理曲线的最小反典范次数。

sentences.en: Proves topological right-triviality for every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in $\mathbb C^3$ with constant Milnor number, resolving the surface case of the $\mu$-constant problem.
sentences.zh: 对于 $\mathbb C^3$ 中每个 Milnor 数恒定的孤立超曲面奇点的全纯单参数族，证明其拓扑右平凡性，从而解决 $\mu$ 常数问题的曲面情形。

sentences.en: After shrinking the parameter disk and representatives, ambient homeomorphisms vary jointly continuously, fix the origin section and preserve the defining functions.
sentences.zh: 缩小参数圆盘和代表元后，环境同胚关于参数与空间变量联合连续，固定原点截面，并保持定义函数。

sentences.en: Proves the full ordinary unreduced descendant Virasoro conjecture for smooth complete intersections in complex projective space, in every genus and curve class with arbitrary cohomology insertions.
sentences.zh: 对于复射影空间中的光滑完全交，在任意亏格、曲线类及任意上同调插入下，证明完整的普通非约化后裔 Virasoro 猜想。

sentences.en: The constraints also pass from any smooth projective complex base satisfying them to the projectivization of every algebraic vector bundle of rank at least two, and hence to projective-bundle towers.
sentences.zh: 若一个光滑复射影底簇满足这些约束，则其上每个秩至少为二的代数向量丛的射影化也满足这些约束，因而射影丛塔亦然。

sentences.en: Proves the finite-rational-coefficient form of Shokurov’s bounded-klt-complement conjecture for $\epsilon$-lc complex Fano-type pairs with nef anti-log-canonical divisor.
sentences.zh: 对于反对数典范除子为 nef 的复 Fano 型 $\epsilon$-lc 对，证明了 Shokurov 有界 klt 补猜想的有限有理系数形式。

sentences.en: For $\epsilon$-lc Fano contractions over any algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, it gives klt complements near every base point, with index bounded only by dimension and positive rational $\epsilon$.
sentences.zh: 对于任意特征零代数闭域上的 $\epsilon$-lc Fano 收缩，在每个底点附近给出 klt 补，其指标仅由维数及正有理数 $\epsilon$ 控制。

sentences.en: Proves the Campana--Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six: every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.
sentences.zh: 证明了复六维的 Campana–Peternell 猜想：每个切丛为 nef 的光滑连通复射影 Fano 六维簇都是有理齐性空间。

sentences.en: If $X$ is a smooth connected complex projective variety and $-K_X$ admits a smooth Hermitian metric with nonnegative curvature, then $H^0(X,-mK_X)\ne0$ for some $m>0$.
sentences.zh: 若 $X$ 是光滑连通复射影簇，且 $-K_X$ 具有曲率非负的光滑 Hermitian 度量，则存在某个 $m>0$，使得 $H^0(X,-mK_X)\ne0$。

sentences.en: Thus smooth semipositivity forces a nonzero section of a positive tensor power of the anticanonical bundle in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 因此，在任意维数下，光滑半正性都保证反典范丛的某个正张量幂具有非零截面。

sentences.en: Proves the unramified de Rham quantum geometric Langlands equivalence for every connected simple complex algebraic group on every smooth projective connected complex curve, at every shifted level $c\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q$.
sentences.zh: 对每个连通单复代数群、每条光滑射影连通复曲线以及每个平移后的水平 $c\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q$，证明了非分歧 de Rham 量子几何 Langlands 等价。

sentences.en: It identifies the full derived categories of twisted $D$-modules for the group and its Langlands dual, retaining all global forms and connected components.
sentences.zh: 它将该群及其 Langlands 对偶的扭曲 $D$-模的整个导出范畴等同起来，并保留所有全局形式和连通分支。

sentences.en: Resolves the existence part of Koebe's circle-domain conjecture: every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a domain whose complementary components are round disks or points.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Koebe 圆域猜想的存在性部分：Riemann 球面上的每个域都共形等价于一个域，其补集的连通分支为圆盘或点。

sentences.en: It also proves that circle domains with conformally removable boundary are rigid, meaning every conformal equivalence to another circle domain is M\"obius, establishing this direction of the He--Schramm conjecture.
sentences.zh: 还证明了边界共形可去的圆域具有刚性，即从这样的圆域到另一个圆域的每个共形等价都是 M\"obius 变换，从而确立了 He--Schramm 猜想的这一方向。

sentences.en: Proves Brennan's conjecture: for every conformal bijection $\phi$ from a simply connected plane domain onto the disk, $|\phi'|^s$ is area-integrable for $4/3<s<4$.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Brennan 猜想：对从一个单连通平面域到圆盘的每个共形双射 $\phi$，当 $4/3<s<4$ 时，$|\phi'|^s$ 关于面积测度可积。

sentences.en: The sharp universal integral-means identity is $B_{\mathcal S}(t)=|t|-1$ for $t\le-2$.
sentences.zh: 最优的普适积分平均恒等式为：当 $t\le-2$ 时，$B_{\mathcal S}(t)=|t|-1$。

sentences.en: A strict bound $B_b(-1)<1/4$ for bounded univalent functions disproves Kraetzer's prediction at that parameter.
sentences.zh: 有界单叶函数的严格界 $B_b(-1)<1/4$ 否定了 Kraetzer 在该参数处的预言。

sentences.en: Resolves the Falconer distance conjecture in every dimension $d\ge2$: every compact set $E\subset\mathbb R^d$ with Hausdorff dimension greater than $d/2$ determines a set of Euclidean distances of positive Lebesgue measure.
sentences.zh: 解决了每个维数 $d\ge2$ 下的 Falconer 距离猜想：每个 Hausdorff 维数大于 $d/2$ 的紧集 $E\subset\mathbb R^d$ 所确定的欧氏距离集合都具有正的 Lebesgue 测度。

sentences.en: Resolves the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions and the Hausdorff-dimension conjecture in four.
sentences.zh: 解决了三维 Kakeya 极大猜想和四维 Kakeya Hausdorff 维数猜想。

sentences.en: In three dimensions, the radius-$\delta$ tube maximal operator maps $L^3(\mathbb R^3)$ to $L^3(S^2)$ with norm $O_\varepsilon(\delta^{-\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$.
sentences.zh: 在三维情形中，半径为 $\delta$ 的管极大算子将 $L^3(\mathbb R^3)$ 映到 $L^3(S^2)$，且对每个 $\varepsilon>0$，其范数为 $O_\varepsilon(\delta^{-\varepsilon})$。

sentences.en: In four dimensions, every set containing a unit segment in every direction has Hausdorff dimension four.
sentences.zh: 在四维情形中，每个在所有方向上都包含单位线段的集合，其 Hausdorff 维数均为四。

sentences.en: Proves that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in $L\log L(\mathbb T)$ converge almost everywhere along the full sequence.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $L\log L(\mathbb T)$ 中每个复值函数的普通对称 Fourier 部分和沿整个序列几乎处处收敛。

sentences.en: This resolves the classical sufficiency conjecture at the $L\log L$ scale.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 $L\log L$ 尺度上的经典充分性猜想。

sentences.en: Constructs polynomials with $N$ consecutive coefficients in $\{-1,1\}$ whose modulus is $(1+o(1))\sqrt N$ uniformly on the entire unit circle, for every sufficiently large integer length $N$.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分大的整数长度 $N$，构造了具有 $N$ 个取值于 $\{-1,1\}$ 的连续系数的多项式，其模在整个单位圆上一致地为 $(1+o(1))\sqrt N$。

sentences.en: Thus real Littlewood polynomials are ultraflat, including at the real endpoints.
sentences.zh: 因此，实 Littlewood 多项式是超平坦的，包括在实端点处。

sentences.en: Their binary merit factors tend to infinity, disproving Turyn's bounded-merit-factor conjecture.
sentences.zh: 它们的二元 merit factor 趋于无穷，从而否定了 Turyn 的 merit factor 有界性猜想。

sentences.en: Proves the diagonal Fourier extension conjecture for positively curved surfaces in three dimensions.
sentences.zh: 证明了三维空间中正曲率曲面的对角 Fourier 延拓猜想。

sentences.en: For every compact smooth positively curved surface $\Sigma\subset\mathbb R^3$, including surfaces with boundary, the extension operator is bounded from $L^p(\Sigma)$ to $L^p(\mathbb R^3)$ for every $p>3$.
sentences.zh: 对每个紧致光滑正曲率曲面 $\Sigma\subset\mathbb R^3$，包括有边界的曲面，延拓算子对每个 $p>3$ 都是从 $L^p(\Sigma)$ 到 $L^p(\mathbb R^3)$ 的有界算子。

sentences.en: Resolves the three-dimensional Bochner--Riesz conjecture in its strict range: the Bochner--Riesz multipliers of order $\delta$ are bounded on $L^p(\mathbb R^3)$ for every $1\le p\le\infty$ whenever $\delta>\max\{3|1/p-1/2|-1/2,0\}$.
sentences.zh: 在严格范围内解决了三维 Bochner--Riesz 猜想：只要 $\delta>\max\{3|1/p-1/2|-1/2,0\}$，$\delta$ 阶 Bochner--Riesz 乘子对每个 $1\le p\le\infty$ 都在 $L^p(\mathbb R^3)$ 上有界。

sentences.en: Resolves Sogge's local smoothing conjecture for the Euclidean wave equation in three spatial dimensions.
sentences.zh: 解决了三个空间维数下欧氏波动方程的 Sogge 局部光滑化猜想。

sentences.en: The estimate holds throughout the full strict range $2<p<\infty$, with Sobolev regularity above $\max\{0,1-3/p\}$.
sentences.zh: 该估计在整个严格范围 $2<p<\infty$ 内成立，所需 Sobolev 正则性高于 $\max\{0,1-3/p\}$。

sentences.en: In particular, the critical $L^3$ estimate holds with every positive Sobolev loss.
sentences.zh: 特别地，允许任意正的 Sobolev 损失时，临界 $L^3$ 估计成立。

sentences.en: Proves almost-everywhere convergence $e^{it\Delta}f\to f$ as $t\downarrow0$ for every $f\in H^{n/(2(n+1))}(\mathbb R^n)$ and every dimension $n\ge2$.
sentences.zh: 证明了对每个 $f\in H^{n/(2(n+1))}(\mathbb R^n)$ 和每个维数 $n\ge2$，当 $t\downarrow0$ 时，$e^{it\Delta}f\to f$ 几乎处处成立。

sentences.en: This attains the sharp Sobolev equality case of Carleson's Schr\"odinger convergence problem, including the planar endpoint $H^{1/3}$.
sentences.zh: 这达到了 Carleson 的 Schr\"odinger 收敛问题中最优 Sobolev 指数的等号情形，包括平面端点 $H^{1/3}$。

sentences.en: Resolves the remaining higher-codimension Riesz-transform rectifiability problem: for $d\ge4$ and $2\le n\le d-2$, an $n$-Ahlfors--David regular Radon measure on $\mathbb R^d$ is uniformly $n$-rectifiable whenever its $n$-dimensional Riesz transform is uniformly $L^2$-bounded over all positive hard truncations.
sentences.zh: 解决了剩余的高余维 Riesz 变换可求长性问题：对 $d\ge4$ 和 $2\le n\le d-2$，若 $\mathbb R^d$ 上一个 $n$-Ahlfors--David 正则 Radon 测度的 $n$ 维 Riesz 变换在所有正尺度的硬截断下均一致 $L^2$-有界，则该测度一致 $n$-可求长。

sentences.en: The rectifiability bounds depend only on dimension, regularity and operator bounds.
sentences.zh: 可求长性的界只依赖于维数、正则性和算子界。

sentences.en: Proves maximal and annular $r$-variation bounds, for every $r>2$, from complex $L^3(\mathbb R^2)\times L^3(\mathbb R^2)$ to $L^{3/2}(\mathbb R^2)$.
sentences.zh: 在复值函数情形下，对每个 $r>2$，证明了从 $L^3(\mathbb R^2)\times L^3(\mathbb R^2)$ 到 $L^{3/2}(\mathbb R^2)$ 的极大估计和环状 $r$-变差估计。

sentences.en: The maximal estimate controls both hard truncation endpoints and gives almost-everywhere and norm convergence.
sentences.zh: 极大估计控制硬截断的两个端点，并给出几乎处处收敛和范数收敛。

sentences.en: Pairing with a third input settles the triangular Hilbert transform estimate at the symmetric $L^3\times L^3\times L^3$ point.
sentences.zh: 与第三个输入配对，便解决了对称 $L^3\times L^3\times L^3$ 点处的三角 Hilbert 变换估计。

sentences.en: Proves a uniform strong $L^2$ bound for the planar Hilbert transform along any Lipschitz unit vector field, at integration lengths bounded by an absolute multiple of its reciprocal Lipschitz constant.
sentences.zh: 证明了沿任意 Lipschitz 单位向量场的平面 Hilbert 变换的一致强 $L^2$ 界，其中积分长度不超过该向量场 Lipschitz 常数倒数的某个绝对倍数。

sentences.en: The estimate is uniform over inner truncations and yields an $L^2$-bounded principal-value operator, establishing Stein's weak-type conjecture at this short scale.
sentences.zh: 该估计对内截断一致，并给出一个 $L^2$-有界的主值算子，从而确立了这一短尺度上的 Stein 弱型猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed $q\in(0,1)$, constructs compact subsets of $[0,1]$ with measure arbitrarily close to one containing no translated and nontrivially dilated copy of $\{q^n:n\ge1\}$, with dilations of either sign.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定的 $q\in(0,1)$，构造了 $[0,1]$ 的紧子集，其测度任意接近一，并且不含 $\{q^n:n\ge1\}$ 经平移和非平凡伸缩得到的任何副本，伸缩因子可为正或负。

sentences.en: This resolves the geometric-progression case of the Erd\H{o}s similarity conjecture for every ratio.
sentences.zh: 这对每个公比都解决了 Erd\H{o}s 相似性猜想的等比数列情形。

sentences.en: Resolves the planar centered-disk case of the Haj{\l}asz--Onninen maximal-function regularity problem.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Haj{\l}asz--Onninen 极大函数正则性问题的平面中心圆盘情形。

sentences.en: For every real $f\in W^{1,1}(\mathbb R^2)$, the centered disk maximal function satisfies $\|\nabla Mf\|_1\le C\|\nabla f\|_1$ with an absolute constant.
sentences.zh: 对每个实值的 $f\in W^{1,1}(\mathbb R^2)$，中心圆盘极大函数满足 $\|\nabla Mf\|_1\le C\|\nabla f\|_1$，其中常数为绝对常数。

sentences.en: It belongs locally to $W^{1,1}$ and has a globally integrable weak gradient.
sentences.zh: 它局部属于 $W^{1,1}$，且其弱梯度全局可积。

sentences.en: Proves that the principal-value trilinear Hilbert transform with shifts $x-t$, $x-2t$, $x-3t$ is bounded from $L^3(\mathbb R)^3$ to $L^1(\mathbb R)$.
sentences.zh: 证明了以 $x-t$、$x-2t$、$x-3t$ 为平移项的主值三线性 Hilbert 变换是从 $L^3(\mathbb R)^3$ 到 $L^1(\mathbb R)$ 的有界算子。

sentences.en: This resolves the $L^3$ exponent case of the standard conjecture for slopes $1,2,3$.
sentences.zh: 这解决了斜率为 $1,2,3$ 时标准猜想的 $L^3$ 指数情形。

sentences.en: Resolves the symmetric and nonsymmetric geometric Mahler conjectures in every dimension, with Hanner polytopes and simplices as the respective volume-product minimizers and all equality cases classified.
sentences.zh: 在任意维数下解决了对称和非对称几何 Mahler 猜想，相应的体积乘积极小者分别为 Hanner 多胞体和单纯形，并分类了全部等号情形。

sentences.en: The corresponding sharp functional Mahler inequalities also hold.
sentences.zh: 相应的最优函数型 Mahler 不等式也成立。

sentences.en: For $n\ge2$, every symmetric polar product $K\times K^\circ$ in dimension $2n$ has Gromov width $4$.
sentences.zh: 对 $n\ge2$，维数为 $2n$ 的每个对称极体乘积 $K\times K^\circ$ 的 Gromov 宽度均为 $4$。

sentences.en: Proves Petty's projection-volume conjecture in the remaining dimensions $n\ge4$: ellipsoids uniquely minimize projection-body volume at fixed body volume.
sentences.zh: 在剩余维数 $n\ge4$ 下证明了 Petty 投影体体积猜想：在凸体体积固定时，椭球是投影体体积的唯一极小者。

sentences.en: Also establishes the full Lutwak--Petty projection inequalities.
sentences.zh: 还确立了完整的 Lutwak--Petty 投影不等式。

sentences.en: In contrast, products of simplices exceed Brannen's proposed simplex maximum for normalized projection-body volume by an exponential factor in every sufficiently large dimension.
sentences.zh: 与之相反，在每个充分大的维数下，单纯形的乘积所具有的归一化投影体体积，比 Brannen 所提出的单纯形最大值大一个指数因子。

sentences.en: Resolves the planar and bounded-treewidth cases of the Gupta--Newman--Rabinovich--Sinclair conjecture.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Gupta--Newman--Rabinovich--Sinclair 猜想的平面图和有界树宽图情形。

sentences.en: Shortest-path metrics of finite connected graphs with arbitrary positive edge lengths embed into real $L_1$ with universal distortion for planar graphs, and distortion depending only on treewidth for bounded-treewidth graphs.
sentences.zh: 任意正边长的有限连通图的最短路度量都可嵌入实 $L_1$，其中平面图的畸变具有普适界，有界树宽图的畸变则只依赖于树宽。

sentences.en: The corresponding multicommodity flow--cut gaps are uniformly bounded.
sentences.zh: 相应的多商品流与割之间的间隙一致有界。

sentences.en: Proves that the triangular lattice minimizes the lower limit of energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone potential of squared distance among locally finite planar configurations of centered-disk density one.
sentences.zh: 证明了在中心圆盘密度为一的局部有限平面配置中，对每个以距离平方为自变量的非负完全单调势，三角格都使每粒子能量的下极限达到最小。

sentences.en: It also minimizes unit-background renormalized Riesz energies for $0<s<2$ and Coulomb energy, resolving Sandier--Serfaty and the two-dimensional Brauchart--Hardin--Saff conjecture on the linear term of optimal spherical logarithmic energy.
sentences.zh: 它还使 $0<s<2$ 时单位背景下的重整化 Riesz 能量以及 Coulomb 能量达到最小，从而解决了 Sandier--Serfaty 猜想，以及二维 Brauchart--Hardin--Saff 关于最优球面对数能量线性项的猜想。

sentences.en: Proves the logarithmic Brunn--Minkowski inequality for origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension, and the scalar-dilation B-conjecture for all even log-concave Radon measures.
sentences.zh: 证明了任意维数下关于原点对称的凸体的对数 Brunn--Minkowski 不等式，以及所有偶对数凹 Radon 测度的标量伸缩 B-猜想。

sentences.en: For Lebesgue volume it also proves the additive $L_p$ Brunn--Minkowski inequality for full-dimensional origin-symmetric convex bodies throughout $0<p<1$.
sentences.zh: 对于 Lebesgue 体积，还在整个 $0<p<1$ 范围内证明了满维、关于原点对称的凸体的加性 $L_p$ Brunn--Minkowski 不等式。

sentences.en: Determines the optimal worst-case covering density as $\Theta(n\log n)$, for both lattice and unrestricted translative coverings.
sentences.zh: 确定了格覆盖和不受限制的平移覆盖在最坏情形下的最优覆盖密度均为 $\Theta(n\log n)$。

sentences.en: Every convex body in $\mathbb R^n$, $n\ge2$, admits a lattice covering of density at most $Cn\log n$; centrally symmetric examples in every sufficiently large dimension require at least $cn\log n$ even without the lattice restriction, for absolute $c,C>0$.
sentences.zh: 对 $n\ge2$，$\mathbb R^n$ 中每个凸体都具有密度至多为 $Cn\log n$ 的格覆盖；在每个充分大的维数下，都存在中心对称的例子，即使不要求覆盖为格覆盖，其密度也至少为 $cn\log n$，其中 $c,C>0$ 为绝对常数。

sentences.en: Proves a dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for centered log-concave densities with uniformly subgaussian linear marginals, with constant bounded by a universal multiple of the squared linear subgaussian parameter.
sentences.zh: 对线性边缘分布一致次高斯的中心化对数凹密度，证明了不依赖维数的对数 Sobolev 不等式，其中常数不超过线性次高斯参数平方的一个普适倍数。

sentences.en: For every fixed $1<p<\infty$ and distortion $D>1$, every $n$-point subset of real $L_p$ embeds into $\ell_p^d$ with distortion at most $D$ and dimension $d=n^{o(1)}$, answering Naor's sublinear-dimension question for $p\ne2$.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定的 $1<p<\infty$ 和畸变 $D>1$，实 $L_p$ 的每个 $n$ 点子集都可嵌入 $\ell_p^d$，畸变至多为 $D$，维数为 $d=n^{o(1)}$，从而回答了 Naor 在 $p\ne2$ 时提出的次线性维数问题。

sentences.en: In contrast, exact embeddings require worst-case dimension $\Theta(n^2)$ when $p\ne2$.
sentences.zh: 与之相反，当 $p\ne2$ 时，精确嵌入在最坏情形下需要维数 $\Theta(n^2)$。

sentences.en: Disproves the Projected Lax conjecture: some hyperbolicity cones are not spectrahedral shadows.
sentences.zh: 否定了投影 Lax 猜想：存在不是 spectrahedral shadow 的双曲锥。

sentences.en: The examples admit no exact finite affine semidefinite lift, regardless of the number of auxiliary variables or the real coefficients used.
sentences.zh: 无论使用多少辅助变量或何种实系数，这些例子都不具有精确的有限仿射半正定提升。

sentences.en: This also disproves the generalized Lax conjecture that every hyperbolicity cone is spectrahedral.
sentences.zh: 这也否定了声称每个双曲锥都是 spectrahedral 的广义 Lax 猜想。

sentences.en: Proves that the sum of squared Gaussian first moments of any finite measurable partition is at most $9/(8\pi)$.
sentences.zh: 证明了任意有限可测分割的高斯一阶矩的平方和至多为 $9/(8\pi)$。

sentences.en: In dimension at least two, three planar sectors of angle $2\pi/3$, extended orthogonally, attain the bound.
sentences.zh: 在至少二维的空间中，将三个角度为 $2\pi/3$ 的平面扇形沿正交方向延伸，即可达到该界。

sentences.en: Combined with the separate Unique Games theorem, this proves NP-hardness of improving the loss factor $(8\pi/9)(1-1/k)$ for identity-target kernel clustering with fixed $k\ge3$ on rational centered positive semidefinite inputs.
sentences.zh: 结合单独的唯一博弈定理，这证明了对固定的 $k\ge3$，在有理、中心化的半正定输入上，以单位矩阵为目标的核聚类若要改进损失因子 $(8\pi/9)(1-1/k)$，则是 NP-难的。

sentences.en: Proves that any finite sequence in the Euclidean unit ball of $\mathbb R^d$ admits signs keeping every partial sum within $C\sqrt d$, independently of length.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\mathbb R^d$ 的欧氏单位球中的任意有限序列都可赋予正负号，使每个部分和的范数不超过 $C\sqrt d$，且该界与序列长度无关。

sentences.en: Consequently every zero-sum family can be reordered with the same bound on unsigned partial sums.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个零和族都可重新排序，使不附加正负号的部分和满足同一个界。

sentences.en: A matching lower bound gives the optimal order $S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)$.
sentences.zh: 一个匹配的下界给出了最优阶 $S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)$。

sentences.en: Every infinite-dimensional real Banach space contains a compact doubling set that admits no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional normed space.
sentences.zh: 每个无限维实 Banach 空间都包含一个紧致倍增集，它不能双 Lipschitz 嵌入任何有限维赋范空间。

sentences.en: The doubling constant is universal.
sentences.zh: 倍增常数是普适的。

sentences.en: This answers the Lang--Plaut problem negatively, even for compact subsets of Hilbert space.
sentences.zh: 这对 Lang--Plaut 问题给出了否定回答，甚至对于 Hilbert 空间的紧子集也是如此。

sentences.en: Determines the least distortion of embedding edit distance on words of length at most $d$ into real $\ell_1$: it is $\exp(\Theta(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))$.
sentences.zh: 确定了将长度至多为 $d$ 的字符串上的编辑距离嵌入实 $\ell_1$ 所需的最小畸变：其为 $\exp(\Theta(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))$。

sentences.en: Insertions, deletions and substitutions have unit cost.
sentences.zh: 插入、删除和替换的代价均为一。

sentences.en: The constants are uniform over all finite alphabets with at least two symbols, even when the alphabet grows with $d$; binary words already force the lower bound.
sentences.zh: 这些常数对所有至少含两个符号的有限字母表都是一致的，即使字母表随 $d$ 增长也是如此；仅二元字符串就已迫使该下界成立。

sentences.en: Covers the entire closed regular tetrahedron by finitely many cylinders with compact triangular perpendicular bases whose total area is less than half its smallest orthogonal projection area.
sentences.zh: 用有限多个底面为与柱轴垂直的紧三角形的柱体覆盖整个闭正四面体，且这些底面的总面积小于该四面体最小正交投影面积的一半。

sentences.en: This disproves Bang's half-area cylinder-covering bound and the stronger directionwise normalized conjecture in dimension three.
sentences.zh: 这否定了三维情形下 Bang 的半面积柱体覆盖界，以及更强的逐方向归一化猜想。

sentences.en: Proves that simplices uniquely maximize the isotropic constant among convex bodies in every dimension, resolving the strong isotropic constant conjecture.
sentences.zh: 证明了在任意维数的凸体中，单纯形是迷向常数的唯一极大者，从而解决了强迷向常数猜想。

sentences.en: Also establishes the sharp entropy lower bound for log-concave probability densities, with equality precisely for invertible affine images of products of one-sided exponential laws.
sentences.zh: 还确立了对数凹概率密度的最优熵下界，且恰在单侧指数分布之乘积的可逆仿射像处取等号。

sentences.en: Proves Khot's Unique Games Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Khot 的唯一博弈猜想。

sentences.en: Independent direct reductions also establish NP-hardness, on unweighted graphs, of approximation beyond the Goemans--Williamson ratio for Max-Cut, below factor two for Vertex Cover, and within any fixed constant factor for Min-UnCut and directed feedback vertex set.
sentences.zh: 独立的直接归约还确立了在无权图上以下近似任务的 NP-难性：以超过 Goemans--Williamson 比率的比率近似 Max-Cut，以低于二的因子近似 Vertex Cover，以及以任意固定常数因子近似 Min-UnCut 和有向反馈顶点集问题。

sentences.en: These direct proofs use established PCP and Label Cover hardness results.
sentences.zh: 这些直接证明使用了已有的 PCP 和 Label Cover 难性结果。

sentences.en: Proves $\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}$, resolving derandomization for bounded-error logarithmic-space computation.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}$，从而解决了有界误差对数空间计算的去随机化问题。

sentences.en: An effective compiler converts each randomized polynomial-time logarithmic-space machine deciding a language with one-sided or two-sided error into a deterministic logarithmic-space decider with explicit polynomial running-time bounds.
sentences.zh: 一个可有效执行的编译器将每台以单侧或双侧误差判定某个语言的随机化多项式时间、对数空间机器，转换为一个确定性对数空间判定器，并给出明确的多项式运行时间界。

sentences.en: Gives deterministic algorithms using $2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}$ bit operations, for complete binary input length $L$, for ordinary mean-payoff games and two separate extensions.
sentences.zh: 对于普通平均收益博弈及其两个独立的推广，给出了使用 $2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}$ 次位运算的确定性算法，其中 $L$ 为完整的二进制输入长度。

sentences.en: They compute exact values and optimal positional strategies in ordinary games, the nonnegative expectation-of-liminf value set in turn-based stochastic games, and the winning set for nonnegative liminf mean payoff conjoined with parity.
sentences.zh: 这些算法计算普通博弈中的精确值和最优位置策略、轮流行动的随机博弈中以“下极限的期望”定义的值非负的集合，以及下极限平均收益非负且同时满足奇偶条件时的获胜集。

sentences.en: Signed rewards, rational chance probabilities, and parity priorities are unrestricted and binary-encoded.
sentences.zh: 带符号奖励、有理的随机转移概率和奇偶优先级都不受限制，并以二进制编码。

sentences.en: Proves Khot's 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness: for every fixed rational $\delta\in(0,1)$, it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable games from games whose optimum is at most $\delta$, on explicit unweighted instances.
sentences.zh: 证明了具有完美完备性的 Khot 2-to-1 Games 猜想：对每个固定的有理数 $\delta\in(0,1)$，在显式无权实例上，区分可满足的博弈与最优值至多为 $\delta$ 的博弈是 NP-难的。

sentences.en: The alphabet depends only on $\delta$, and every right-hand label has exactly two preimages under each constraint map.
sentences.zh: 字母表只依赖于 $\delta$，且在每个约束映射下，每个右侧标签都恰有两个原像。

sentences.en: It is NP-hard to color a three-colorable graph using any fixed number $c\ge3$ of colors.
sentences.zh: 对可三着色图使用任意固定的 $c\ge3$ 种颜色着色是 NP-难的。

sentences.en: More strongly, for every fixed $0<\delta<1/3$, a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from $3$SAT produces simple unweighted graphs that are three-colorable in the satisfiable case and have no independent set of size $\delta n$ otherwise, where $n$ is the number of vertices.
sentences.zh: 更强地，对每个固定的 $0<\delta<1/3$，存在从 $3$SAT 出发的确定性多项式时间归约，生成简单无权图，使其在可满足情形下可三着色，否则不含大小为 $\delta n$ 的独立集，其中 $n$ 为顶点数。

sentences.en: Proves $\omega\le9/4$ over $\mathbb C$, giving $O_\varepsilon(n^{9/4+\varepsilon})$ arithmetic operations for square matrix multiplication.
sentences.zh: 在 $\mathbb C$ 上证明了 $\omega\le9/4$，从而给出使用 $O_\varepsilon(n^{9/4+\varepsilon})$ 次算术运算的方阵乘法。

sentences.en: In characteristic zero, some inner dimension $n^a$ with $a>0.465$ permits $n^{2+o(1)}$ rectangular multiplication.
sentences.zh: 在特征零的情形下，存在某个内维数 $n^a$，满足 $a>0.465$，使得矩形矩阵乘法可用 $n^{2+o(1)}$ 次运算完成。

sentences.en: Further square bounds give $\omega<2.258$ outside finitely many positive characteristics and $\omega<2.371054886006746$ over every fixed field.
sentences.zh: 进一步的方阵界给出：除有限多个正特征之外均有 $\omega<2.258$，且在每个固定域上都有 $\omega<2.371054886006746$。

sentences.en: Proves an $\Omega(n^3)$ lower bound for the border determinantal complexity of the $n\times n$ permanent over $\mathbb C$.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $\mathbb C$ 上 $n\times n$ 积和式的边界行列式复杂度具有 $\Omega(n^3)$ 下界。

sentences.en: Even coefficientwise limits of determinants of affine-linear matrices require matrix size at least $cn^3$, for an absolute $c>0$ and all sufficiently large $n$; the same bound therefore holds for exact representations.
sentences.zh: 即使允许取仿射线性矩阵之行列式的逐系数极限，矩阵大小也必须至少为 $cn^3$，其中 $c>0$ 为绝对常数，且这对所有充分大的 $n$ 都成立；因此，同一个界也适用于精确表示。

sentences.en: Multiplies two $n$-bit integers exactly at every input length in deterministic worst-case time $O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa})$, with $\kappa=2^{-182}$, on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with finitely many one-dimensional tapes.
sentences.zh: 在一台固定的、字母表有限且仅有有限条一维纸带的 Turing 机上，对每个输入长度，都能在确定性最坏情形时间 $O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa})$ 内精确计算两个 $n$ 位整数的乘积，其中 $\kappa=2^{-182}$。

sentences.en: This disproves the Sch\"onhage--Strassen $n\log n$ optimality conjecture in the ordinary multitape bit model.
sentences.zh: 这否定了普通多纸带位模型中的 Sch\"onhage--Strassen $n\log n$ 最优性猜想。

sentences.en: Establishes a randomized competitive ratio $O(\log^2(k+1))$ for $k$-server on every metric space, matching the worst-case lower-bound order.
sentences.zh: 在每个度量空间上，为 $k$-服务器问题确立了随机化竞争比 $O(\log^2(k+1))$，与最坏情形下界的阶相匹配。

sentences.en: One policy serves every finite oblivious request sequence, including on infinite unbounded metrics.
sentences.zh: 同一个策略可服务于每个有限的 oblivious 请求序列，包括无限且无界的度量空间上的此类序列。

sentences.en: On finite rational metrics, a uniform implementation has polynomial preprocessing and per-request bit cost in the input length and $\log(t+1)$ at request $t$, with a finite instance-dependent additive movement constant.
sentences.zh: 在有限有理度量空间上，存在一种统一实现，其预处理及在第 $t$ 个请求处的逐请求位运算代价，均为输入长度和 $\log(t+1)$ 的多项式，并且其加性移动常数有限且可依赖于实例。

sentences.en: For every finite matroid known in advance, gives a distribution-independent online rule using one independent sample per element and earning a universal constant fraction of the expected offline optimum.
sentences.zh: 对每个预先已知的有限拟阵，给出了一种不依赖分布的在线规则：每个元素使用一个独立样本，即可获得期望离线最优值的一个普适常数比例。

sentences.en: Values are independent and nonnegative, with finite expected optimum.
sentences.zh: 各个值相互独立且非负，最优值的期望有限。

sentences.en: The guarantee holds even when the arrival-order adversary sees all samples, values, and the rule's entire random seed; no polynomial-time implementation is asserted.
sentences.zh: 即使控制到达顺序的对手能看到所有样本、所有值以及该规则的完整随机种子，这一保证仍然成立；这里并未断言存在多项式时间实现。

sentences.en: Constructs a single language in deterministic polynomial time whose $n$-bit membership function requires $2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}$ total gates in unbounded-fan-in OR--AND--OR circuits, at every sufficiently large input length.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个可在确定性多项式时间内判定的语言，其 $n$ 位成员判定函数在无界扇入的 OR--AND--OR 电路中总共需要 $2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}$ 个门，而且这对每个充分大的输入长度都成立。

sentences.en: This crosses the square-root-exponent threshold for explicit depth-three Boolean circuit lower bounds.
sentences.zh: 这突破了显式深度三布尔电路下界的平方根指数门槛。

sentences.en: Gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting perfect matchings in arbitrary finite simple graphs, with exact detection of zero counts.
sentences.zh: 给出了对任意有限简单图中的完美匹配进行计数的完全多项式随机近似方案，并可精确检测计数为零的情形。

sentences.en: Also proves the perfect-matching entropy conjecture of Anari, Oveis Gharan, and Vinzant, bounding the maximum entropy of a matching law at every feasible edge-marginal vector in a loopless labelled multigraph, including boundary points.
sentences.zh: 还证明了 Anari、Oveis Gharan 和 Vinzant 的完美匹配熵猜想，对无自环的有标号多重图中每个可行的各边边缘概率向量，包括边界点，给出匹配分布的最大熵的界。

sentences.en: Gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting common integer bases of two integral polymatroids of equal total rank, supplied by exact rank-value oracles.
sentences.zh: 给出了一个完全多项式随机近似方案，用于对两个总秩相同、由精确秩值预言机给定的整多拟阵的公共整数基进行计数。

sentences.en: Capacities are binary-encoded, each integer vector counts once, and oracle calls and bit operations outside the oracles are polynomial on every execution.
sentences.zh: 容量以二进制编码，每个整数向量只计数一次，而且每次执行中的预言机调用次数以及预言机之外的位运算次数均为多项式。

sentences.en: For matroids presented by independence oracles, the results also cover common independent sets of prescribed, unrestricted, or maximum cardinality, even when the ranks differ.
sentences.zh: 对于由独立性预言机给出的拟阵，这些结果还涵盖基数指定、基数不受限制或基数最大的公共独立集，即使两个拟阵的秩不同也成立。

sentences.en: For nonnegative integer matrices with prescribed row and column sums, gives exact uniform sampling in expected polynomial bit time and almost-uniform sampling in worst-case polynomial bit time.
sentences.zh: 对于行和、列和给定的非负整数矩阵，给出了期望位运算时间为多项式的精确均匀采样，以及最坏情形位运算时间为多项式的近乎均匀采样。

sentences.en: The dimensions and binary-encoded margins are unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 维数以及以二进制编码的行和、列和均不受限制。

sentences.en: Also gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting such tables with arbitrary individual cell bounds, including structural zeros, with polynomial cost on every execution.
sentences.zh: 还给出了对此类表进行计数的完全多项式随机近似方案，允许对各个单元格设置任意界约束，包括结构性零，并且每次执行的代价均为多项式。

sentences.en: For each characteristic, constructs in deterministic polynomial bit time a polynomial-dimensional matrix tuple detecting every nonzero division-free noncommutative formula of bounded size over any field of that characteristic.
sentences.zh: 对每种特征，都在确定性多项式位运算时间内构造了一个具有多项式维数的矩阵元组，它能检测该特征的任意域上每个大小有界、不含除法的非交换非零公式。

sentences.en: Rational formulas over $\mathbb Q$ also admit polynomial-size hitting lists whenever they have a defined rational-matrix evaluation.
sentences.zh: $\mathbb Q$ 上的有理公式，只要存在一个有定义的有理矩阵代入取值，也具有多项式大小的命中列表。

sentences.en: Proves that approximating Uniform Sparsest Cut within any fixed constant factor is NP-hard, even with nonnegative rational capacities and unit demands.
sentences.zh: 证明了以任意固定常数因子近似 Uniform Sparsest Cut 是 NP-难的，即使容量为非负有理数且需求均为一也成立。

sentences.en: The Goemans--Linial semidefinite relaxation also has integrality gaps of order at least $\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3$, approaching the square-root-logarithmic upper bound.
sentences.zh: Goemans--Linial 半正定松弛也具有阶至少为 $\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3$ 的整数性间隙，接近对数平方根阶的上界。

sentences.en: Disproves the modified integer round-up conjecture of Scheithauer and Terno: the integral bin-packing optimum can exceed its configuration linear-programming value by an arbitrarily large additive constant.
sentences.zh: 否定了 Scheithauer 和 Terno 的修正整数向上取整猜想：装箱问题的整数最优值可以比其构型线性规划值大任意大的加法常数。

sentences.en: Approximating the optimum within any fixed additive constant is also NP-hard, even when every item exceeds $1/6$ and each bin holds at most five items.
sentences.zh: 即使每件物品的大小都超过 $1/6$，且每个箱子最多容纳五件物品，将最优值近似到任意固定的加法常数误差之内仍是 NP-困难的。

sentences.en: Proves the Courtade--Kumar conjecture: among Boolean functions of independent uniform bits, a single coordinate retains the most mutual information after independent bit-flip noise.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Courtade--Kumar 猜想：在独立均匀比特的所有布尔函数中，单个坐标在经过独立比特翻转噪声后保留的互信息最多。

sentences.en: A stronger theorem treats randomized binary summaries at fixed initial information.
sentences.zh: 一个更强的定理处理了初始信息量固定时的随机化二元摘要（randomized binary summaries）。

sentences.en: The Hellinger conjecture is also proved for every Boolean output bias and noise correlation.
sentences.zh: 还对每一种布尔输出偏置和噪声相关性证明了 Hellinger 猜想。

sentences.en: Gives a randomized algorithm finding an exact maximum-cardinality matching in any simple undirected graph in $(n+m)^{1+o(1)}$ word time, with success probability at least $2/3$.
sentences.zh: 给出了一种随机化算法，能在 $(n+m)^{1+o(1)}$ 字操作时间内找出任意简单无向图的精确最大基数匹配，成功概率至少为 $2/3$。

sentences.en: The time bound holds on every computation path.
sentences.zh: 这一时间界在每一条计算路径上都成立。

sentences.en: The same guarantees apply to finding a spanning subgraph with prescribed admissible vertex degrees, or deciding that none exists.
sentences.zh: 同样的保证也适用于寻找具有预先指定的容许顶点度数的生成子图，或判定这样的子图不存在。

sentences.en: For every fixed rational $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, gives a randomized $(1+\varepsilon)$ approximation to unit-cost edit distance in worst-case expected time $N^{1+o(1)}$, with success probability at least $2/3$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的有理数 $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$，给出单位代价编辑距离的随机化 $(1+\varepsilon)$ 近似算法，其最坏情形期望时间为 $N^{1+o(1)}$，成功概率至少为 $2/3$。

sentences.en: The strings have total length $N$ and polynomially bounded integer symbols.
sentences.zh: 这些字符串的总长度为 $N$，符号为取值受多项式界约束的整数。

sentences.en: This is an asymptotic guarantee at fixed accuracy.
sentences.zh: 这是在精度固定时的渐近保证。

sentences.en: At every fixed deletion probability in $(0,1)$, reconstructing an arbitrary length-$n$ binary string requires $n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}$ independent traces, ruling out polynomial-sample reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 对于 $(0,1)$ 中每个固定的删除概率，要能重建任意长度为 $n$ 的二进制串，需要 $n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}$ 条独立删除轨迹，从而排除了多项式样本量的重建。

sentences.en: A uniform decoder achieves quasipolynomial sample and running-time bounds for known fixed rational retention probabilities.
sentences.zh: 对于已知且固定的有理数保留概率，一个一致解码器实现了准多项式的样本量界和运行时间界。

sentences.en: When the deletion probability is at most $n^{-\varepsilon}$ for fixed $\varepsilon>0$, both bounds become polynomial in the input and parameter encoding.
sentences.zh: 当删除概率至多为 $n^{-\varepsilon}$，且 $\varepsilon>0$ 固定时，这两个界都成为关于输入与参数编码长度的多项式界。

sentences.en: Resolves the three-processor unit-job scheduling problem of Garey and Johnson: a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm minimizes makespan for nonpreemptive unit-length jobs with arbitrary precedence constraints on three identical parallel machines.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Garey 和 Johnson 的三处理器单位作业调度问题：一种确定性多项式时间算法在三台相同的并行机器上，对具有任意先后约束、不可抢占的单位长度作业，使最晚完工时间最小。

sentences.en: For an explicitly given precedence graph, it decides deadline feasibility exactly and constructs a feasible schedule.
sentences.zh: 对于显式给定的先后约束图，该算法精确判定能否在截止时间前完成，并构造一个可行调度。

sentences.en: Gives a deterministic polynomial-time $(1+2/e+\varepsilon)$-approximation for finite rational metric $k$-median with specified candidate facilities, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $\varepsilon>0$，针对指定了候选设施的有限有理度量 $k$-中位数问题，给出一种确定性多项式时间的 $(1+2/e+\varepsilon)$ 近似算法。

sentences.en: Assuming $P\ne NP$, the optimal infimum approximation factor is $1+2/e$.
sentences.zh: 在假设 $P\ne NP$ 的条件下，可达到的近似因子的下确界为 $1+2/e$。

sentences.en: Proves that every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size, answering Rothvoss's polynomial-size lift question negatively.
sentences.zh: 证明了完美匹配多胞体的每个精确半正定提升都具有指数规模，从而对 Rothvoss 关于多项式规模提升的问题给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: The bound holds even for the positive semidefinite rank of its odd-cut slack matrix after any fixed shift $0<\rho<1$, allowing arbitrary real positive semidefinite factors.
sentences.zh: 即使对其奇割松弛矩阵作任意固定的平移 $0<\rho<1$，这一界仍对所得矩阵的半正定秩成立，且允许任意实半正定因子。

sentences.en: Proves that a degree-at-most-$d$ polynomial threshold function on the uniform $n$-dimensional Boolean cube has average sensitivity at most $8d\sqrt n$, uniformly for $1\le d\le n$.
sentences.zh: 证明了均匀 $n$ 维布尔立方体上次数至多为 $d$ 的多项式阈值函数，其平均敏感度至多为 $8d\sqrt n$，且这一界对 $1\le d\le n$ 一致成立。

sentences.en: Average sensitivity counts expected output changes under single-bit flips.
sentences.zh: 平均敏感度计数的是单比特翻转所引起的输出变化的期望次数。

sentences.en: This establishes the asymptotic Gotsman--Linial conjecture, allowing polynomial zeros with $\operatorname{sign}(0)=1$.
sentences.zh: 这确立了渐近 Gotsman--Linial 猜想，并允许多项式取零值，约定 $\operatorname{sign}(0)=1$。

sentences.en: Gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm constructing a common superstring of length at most twice the optimum for every finite family of explicitly represented strings.
sentences.zh: 给出了一种确定性多项式时间算法，为每个显式表示的有限字符串族构造长度至多为最优值两倍的公共超串。

sentences.en: The running time is polynomial in the full encoded input length, including symbol labels.
sentences.zh: 运行时间关于完整的输入编码长度是多项式的，其中包括符号标签的编码。

sentences.en: Proves exponential lower bounds both for complementing two-way nondeterministic finite automata and for simulating one-way nondeterministic automata by two-way deterministic ones.
sentences.zh: 分别证明了对双向非确定性有限自动机取补，以及用双向确定性自动机模拟单向非确定性自动机时所需状态数的指数下界。

sentences.en: The latter resolves the Sakoda--Sipser state-succinctness conjecture over growing finite alphabets; both results rule out polynomial state bounds independent of alphabet size.
sentences.zh: 后一结果解决了有限字母表规模不断增长时的 Sakoda--Sipser 状态简洁性猜想；这两个结果都排除了与字母表大小无关的多项式状态数界。

sentences.en: Gives a deterministic length-$n$ discrete Fourier transform algorithm using $O(n(\log n)^{1-\delta})$ operations for every $n$, with explicit $\delta=10^{-13}$.
sentences.zh: 给出了一种长度为 $n$ 的确定性离散 Fourier 变换算法，对每个 $n$ 都使用 $O(n(\log n)^{1-\delta})$ 次运算，其中明确取 $\delta=10^{-13}$。

sentences.en: The model uses exact complex arithmetic, unrestricted coefficients and a supplied root of unity, and counts scalar preparation and logarithmic-word indexing.
sentences.zh: 该模型使用精确复数算术、不受限制的系数以及给定的单位根，并将标量准备和使用对数量级字长的索引操作计入代价。

sentences.en: Resolves the simple-undirected Kannan--Tetali--Vempala conjecture: the lazy edge-switch chain mixes in $O(n^8)$ time for every graphical labeled degree sequence.
sentences.zh: 解决了简单无向图情形的 Kannan--Tetali--Vempala 猜想：对于每个可由图实现的带标签度数序列，惰性换边链都在 $O(n^8)$ 时间内混合。

sentences.en: The same degree-constrained graphs can also be sampled exactly uniformly by an almost-surely terminating algorithm with expected polynomial bit running time.
sentences.zh: 对于这些具有相同度数约束的图，还可以用一个几乎必然终止、期望比特运行时间为多项式的算法进行精确均匀采样。

sentences.en: Constructs total Boolean functions with block sensitivity $\operatorname{bs}(f)\ge s(f)^\alpha$ for a fixed $\alpha>2$, disproving the quadratic strengthening of the Sensitivity Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 对于某个固定的 $\alpha>2$，构造了块敏感度满足 $\operatorname{bs}(f)\ge s(f)^\alpha$ 的全定义布尔函数，从而否定了敏感度猜想的二次加强版本。

sentences.en: Here $s(f)$ counts influential individual-bit flips, while block sensitivity allows disjoint groups of bits to change together.
sentences.zh: 这里，$s(f)$ 计数的是会影响输出的单个比特翻转，而块敏感度允许按互不相交的比特组作整体翻转。

sentences.en: Proves unconditional $n^{\Omega(k)}$ deterministic time lower bounds for joint and separate $k$-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman equivalence, for sufficiently large fixed $k$ in the specified sequential adjacency-matrix models.
sentences.zh: 在指定的顺序邻接矩阵模型中，对于足够大且固定的 $k$，证明了 joint 和 separate 两种 $k$ 维 Weisfeiler--Leman 等价判定的无条件确定性时间下界 $n^{\Omega(k)}$。

sentences.en: With dimension as input, joint equivalence is EXPTIME-complete even on subcubic graphs; deciding whether refinement identifies a graph is also EXPTIME-complete.
sentences.zh: 当维数作为输入的一部分时，即使在最大度至多为三的图上，联合等价判定也是 EXPTIME-完全的；判定细化过程能否识别一个图也同样是 EXPTIME-完全的。

sentences.en: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has a generalized regular expression with at most three nested Kleene stars, allowing union, concatenation and complement over the same alphabet.
sentences.zh: 有限字母表上的每个正则语言都有一个至多含三层嵌套 Kleene 星号的广义正则表达式，其中允许在同一字母表上作并、连接和取补运算。

sentences.en: This establishes an absolute bound independent of automaton size, resolving the uniform-boundedness version of the generalized star-height problem.
sentences.zh: 这给出了一个与自动机规模无关的绝对界，解决了广义星高问题的一致有界版本。

sentences.en: Over every characteristic-zero field, the $(1,1)$ entry of a product of $n$ independent $n\times n$ variable matrices requires $n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}$ gates in homogeneous depth-five sum--product circuits.
sentences.zh: 在每个特征为零的域上，$n$ 个相互独立的 $n\times n$ 变量矩阵的乘积的 $(1,1)$ 元，在齐次五层和积电路中需要 $n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}$ 个门。

sentences.en: This sharp bound allows shared gates and bottom linear forms involving all variables.
sentences.zh: 这一精确量级的界允许共享门，也允许底层线性形式涉及所有变量。

sentences.en: Resolves the quasilinear PCP-for-PPAD conjecture.
sentences.zh: 解决了准线性 PCP-for-PPAD 猜想。

sentences.en: An End-of-Line instance of length $N$ reduces to numerical circuit constraints of total length $N(\log N)^{O(1)}$ such that any polynomially encoded rational assignment satisfying all but a fixed fraction to fixed accuracy yields an endpoint solution.
sentences.zh: 一个长度为 $N$ 的 End-of-Line 实例可归约为总长度为 $N(\log N)^{O(1)}$ 的数值电路约束，使得任何具有多项式长度编码的有理赋值，只要以固定精度满足除固定比例之外的全部约束，就能给出一个端点解。

sentences.en: Such assignments always exist, giving robust local verification with only quasilinear size overhead.
sentences.zh: 这样的赋值总是存在，因此只需准线性的规模开销，就能实现稳健的局部验证。

sentences.en: Determines the halting and finite-control outcome of a fixed deterministic one-writable-tape machine up to time $T$ using $O(T^{2/5}\log^C(T+2))$ space, improving the square-root exponent.
sentences.zh: 使用 $O(T^{2/5}\log^C(T+2))$ 空间，确定一台固定的确定性单可写带机器截至时间 $T$ 的停机情况和有限控制状态，从而改进了平方根指数。

sentences.en: Heads move at most one cell per step; finitely many read-only input heads are allowed.
sentences.zh: 每个磁头每步至多移动一个格子；允许有有限多个只读输入头。

sentences.en: Initial contents are independent of $T$, and contents and input symbols have polylogarithmic-space access.
sentences.zh: 初始内容与 $T$ 无关，且带上内容和输入符号均可在多对数空间内访问。

sentences.en: Simulation time is unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 模拟时间不受限制。

sentences.en: Gives a uniform randomized classical algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum in ordinary $O(2^{0.49n})$ word-RAM time on polynomial-bit inputs, where $n$ counts the integers.
sentences.zh: 针对最坏情形的子集和问题，给出一种一致的随机化经典算法；对于比特长度为多项式的输入，它在通常的 $O(2^{0.49n})$ word-RAM 时间内运行，其中 $n$ 是整数的个数。

sentences.en: The time bound holds on every execution and success probability is at least $2/3$ on every input.
sentences.zh: 这一时间界在每次执行中都成立，且对于每个输入，成功概率都至少为 $2/3$。

sentences.en: Inputs may repeat positive integers; words have $O(n+b)$ bits for maximum input bit length $b$.
sentences.zh: 输入中的正整数可以重复；若输入整数的最大比特长度为 $b$，则字长为 $O(n+b)$ 比特。

sentences.en: For $C^2$ potentials with a supplied minimizer and $I\preceq\nabla^2V\preceq2I$, proves that sampling within total variation $1/10$ requires only $C_\varepsilon d^\varepsilon$ exact value-and-gradient queries for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$.
sentences.zh: 对于给定了最小值点且满足 $I\preceq\nabla^2V\preceq2I$ 的 $C^2$ 势函数，证明了对每个固定的 $\varepsilon>0$，要将采样的全变差误差控制在 $1/10$ 以内，只需 $C_\varepsilon d^\varepsilon$ 次精确函数值与梯度查询。

sentences.en: The bound holds on every run, with unrestricted computation between queries.
sentences.zh: 这一界在每次运行中都成立，且查询之间的计算不受限制。

sentences.en: A logarithmic lower bound also holds, so the optimal power-law exponent in this oracle model is zero.
sentences.zh: 同时还存在一个对数下界，因此在这一预言机模型中，最优的幂律指数为零。

sentences.en: For fixed $A>0$, a one-pass learner with $Ad^2$ persistent bits needs $\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))$ noiseless Gaussian samples to recover a unit vector to angular error $0<\epsilon\le1/10$ with probability $2/3$, uniformly in accuracy for large $d$.
sentences.zh: 对于固定的 $A>0$，一个具有 $Ad^2$ 个持久存储比特的单遍学习器，需要 $\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))$ 个无噪声高斯样本，才能以概率 $2/3$ 将一个单位向量恢复到角度误差 $0<\epsilon\le1/10$；当 $d$ 足够大时，这一结论对精度一致成立。

sentences.en: Computation and randomized updates are unrestricted, but output uses only the terminal state, stopping index and fresh randomness.
sentences.zh: 计算和随机化更新不受限制，但输出只能使用终止状态、停止索引和新的随机性。

sentences.en: Proves that the existential theory of the reals lies in the counting hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 证明了实数存在理论属于计数层级。

sentences.en: More generally, truth of existential--universal real sentences can be decided at one fixed level of that hierarchy, even when their integer polynomials are specified by arithmetic circuits.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，实数上的存在—全称语句的真值可在该层级的某个固定层次内判定，即使其中的整系数多项式由算术电路给出也成立。

sentences.en: Gives a uniform deterministic algorithm that completely factors every nonzero dense degree-$n$ polynomial over a prime field $\mathbb F_p$, including multiplicities, in bit complexity polynomial in $(n+1)\log p$.
sentences.zh: 给出了一种一致的确定性算法，它能将素域 $\mathbb F_p$ 上每个以稠密形式表示的非零 $n$ 次多项式完全分解，包括各因子的重数，所需比特复杂度为关于 $(n+1)\log p$ 的多项式。

sentences.en: The prime is supplied in binary.
sentences.zh: 素数以二进制形式给定。

sentences.en: No randomness, integer-factorization or primitive-root oracle, or GRH assumption is required.
sentences.zh: 不需要随机性、整数分解预言机、原根预言机或 GRH 假设。

sentences.en: Resolves the uniform boundedness assertion in Hilbert's sixteenth problem: the number of isolated periodic orbits of a real planar polynomial vector field is bounded by a finite constant depending only on its degree.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Hilbert 第十六问题中的一致有界性断言：实平面多项式向量场的孤立周期轨道数有一个仅依赖于其次数的有限常数上界。

sentences.en: For classical quintic Li\'enard systems, the exact maximum is two limit cycles.
sentences.zh: 对于经典五次 Li\'enard 系统，极限环数的精确最大值为二。

sentences.en: Resolves the probability-preserving form of Banach's simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem within smooth dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在光滑动力系统范围内，解决了 Banach 单重 Lebesgue 谱问题的保概率版本。

sentences.en: A smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of the standard-volume three-torus has simple Lebesgue spectrum on its entire complex mean-zero $L^2$ space: the bilateral iterates of one real observable form an orthonormal basis of that space.
