sentences.en: Here $R$ and $Q$ are randomized and quantum worst-case bit-query complexities with error at most $1/3$; computation between queries is unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 这里 $R$ 和 $Q$ 分别是错误概率至多为 $1/3$ 的随机化与量子最坏情形比特查询复杂度；查询之间的计算不受限制。

sentences.en: Disproves the coefficient-free reduced Baum--Connes conjecture through a failure of rational injectivity and a separate failure of surjectivity of assembly.
sentences.zh: 通过装配映射的有理单射性失效，以及另一个满射性失效的结果，否定了无系数的约化 Baum--Connes 猜想。

sentences.en: A finitely generated torsion-free example witnesses the injectivity failure.
sentences.zh: 一个有限生成的无挠例子体现了单射性的失效。

sentences.en: Separately, a torsion-free group has a nontrivial projection in its reduced group $C^*$-algebra, disproving the Kadison--Kaplansky conjecture.
sentences.zh: 另外，一个无挠群的约化群 $C^*$ 代数中存在非平凡投影，从而否定了 Kadison--Kaplansky 猜想。

sentences.en: Classifies finite-index bimodules between scalar-twisted group factors of ICC groups commensurable with property-$(T)$ lattices over characteristic-zero local fields and arbitrary ICC group factors.
sentences.zh: 分类了以下两类因子之间的有限指标双模：一类是与特征零局部域上具有性质 $(T)$ 的格可公度的 ICC 群的标量扭曲群因子，另一类是任意 ICC 群因子。

sentences.en: Every such bimodule is a summand of finite sums of models arising from finite-index subgroup isomorphisms and finite-dimensional projective representations.
sentences.zh: 每个这样的双模都是若干模型的有限直和的一个直和项，这些模型来自有限指数子群之间的同构及有限维射影表示。

sentences.en: The classification also recovers the group, scalar cocycle and amplification scale up to the stated stable equivalence.
sentences.zh: 该分类还在所述稳定等价意义下恢复了群、标量上闭链及放大尺度。

sentences.en: Resolves the free group factor isomorphism problem: $L(\mathbb F_2)\cong L(\mathbb F_3)$, and hence all interpolated free group factors, including $L(\mathbb F_\infty)$, are isomorphic.
sentences.zh: 解决了自由群因子同构问题：$L(\mathbb F_2)\cong L(\mathbb F_3)$，因此所有插值自由群因子（包括 $L(\mathbb F_\infty)$）都同构。

sentences.en: Their common factor has fundamental group $\mathbb R_{>0}$.
sentences.zh: 它们共同的因子的基本群为 $\mathbb R_{>0}$。

sentences.en: Proves Kadison's similarity conjecture: every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex $C^*$-algebra to operators on a Hilbert space becomes a $*$-homomorphism after conjugation by a bounded invertible operator.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Kadison 相似性猜想：从含幺复 $C^*$ 代数到 Hilbert 空间上算子代数的每个有界、复线性、保幺代数同态，经一个有界可逆算子共轭后都成为 $*$ 同态。

sentences.en: Proves that sufficiently close unital von Neumann algebras on the same Hilbert space are conjugate by a unitary arbitrarily close to the identity, with a universal tolerance in the operator-norm distance between unit balls.
sentences.zh: 证明了同一 Hilbert 空间上充分接近的含幺 von Neumann 代数可由任意接近恒等算子的酉算子共轭，且单位球之间算子范数距离的容许阈值是普适的。

sentences.en: Counterexamples show that near-identity conjugacy fails for one-sided near inclusions, and that arbitrarily close norm-separable $C^*$-algebras need not be ambiently unitarily conjugate.
sentences.zh: 反例表明，对单侧近包含，接近恒等的共轭结论不成立，而且任意接近的范数可分 $C^*$ 代数也未必在环境算子代数中酉共轭。

sentences.en: Proves Connes' bicentralizer conjecture for every type $\mathrm{III}_1$ factor with separable predual and every faithful normal state.
sentences.zh: 对每个具有可分预对偶的 $\mathrm{III}_1$ 型因子及每个忠实正规态，证明了 Connes 双中心化子猜想。

sentences.en: More generally, for every inclusion $N\subset M$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals admitting a faithful normal conditional expectation, constructs an amenable expected subalgebra $P\subset N$ with $P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)$, resolving the relative bicentralizer conjecture.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于每个具有可分预对偶且容许忠实正规条件期望的 von Neumann 代数包含 $N\subset M$，构造了一个容许条件期望的 可均子代数 $P\subset N$，满足 $P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)$，从而解决了相对双中心化子猜想。

sentences.en: Proves equivariant Jiang--Su stability for every countable discrete amenable group action on a simple separable unital infinite-dimensional nuclear stably finite Jiang--Su-stable $C^*$-algebra, resolving this case of Szab\'o's conjecture without restrictions on trace dynamics.
sentences.zh: 对每个可数离散 可均群在单、可分、含幺、无限维、核、稳定有限且 Jiang--Su 稳定的 $C^*$ 代数上的作用，证明了等变 Jiang--Su 稳定性，从而在不限制迹上的动力学的情况下解决了 Szab\'o 猜想的这一情形。

sentences.en: The family also proves the unital Toms--Winter conjecture, equating strict comparison, finite nuclear dimension and Jiang--Su stability in the simple separable unital infinite-dimensional nuclear setting.
sentences.zh: 这一系列论文还证明了含幺 Toms--Winter 猜想：在单、可分、含幺、无限维核代数的情形下，严格比较性、有限核维数与 Jiang--Su 稳定性等价。

sentences.en: Constructs an explicit separable unital full group $C^*$-algebra that cannot embed unitally into the norm ultrapower of any fixed nonzero unital nuclear $C^*$-algebra, for any free ultrafilter on the natural numbers.
sentences.zh: 显式构造了一个可分含幺全群 $C^*$ 代数，对于自然数上的任意自由超滤，它都不能保幺嵌入任意固定的非零含幺核 $C^*$ 代数的范数超幂。

sentences.en: Taking the target to be $\mathcal O_2$ answers Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding problem negatively.
sentences.zh: 取目标为 $\mathcal O_2$，就对 Kirchberg 的范数超幂嵌入问题给出了否定答案。

sentences.en: Constructs a nonzero norm-quasinilpotent operator on every infinite-dimensional separable complex Hilbert space with no nonzero proper closed subspace invariant under every commuting operator.
sentences.zh: 在每个无限维可分复 Hilbert 空间上，构造了一个非零的范数拟幂零算子，使得不存在非零真闭子空间在每个与该算子交换的算子下都不变。

sentences.en: The construction also gives operators with no nontrivial invariant projection in the hyperfinite type $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor.
sentences.zh: 该构造还给出了超有限 $\mathrm{II}_1$ 型因子中没有非平凡不变投影的算子。

sentences.en: Disproves Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture by constructing a separable unital complex $C^*$-algebra admitting normalized $2$-quasitraces, all of which are nonadditive.
sentences.zh: 通过构造一个可分含幺复 $C^*$ 代数，容许归一化的 $2$ 拟迹但所有这些拟迹均不可加，否定了 Kaplansky 拟迹猜想。

sentences.en: As a consequence, two unital simple stably finite $C^*$-algebras can have a properly infinite minimal tensor product, with one factor $C_r^*(\mathbb F_2)$.
sentences.zh: 由此可知，两个含幺、单且稳定有限的 $C^*$ 代数的最小张量积可以是 properly infinite 的，其中一个因子为 $C_r^*(\mathbb F_2)$。

sentences.en: Proves that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with coefficients in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive.
sentences.zh: 证明了复 von Neumann 代数上每个以该代数自身为系数、次数至少为二的有界 Hochschild 上闭链，都可写成某个有界上链的上边界。

sentences.en: Equivalently, all higher bounded Hochschild cohomology groups vanish, resolving the Kadison--Ringrose conjecture.
sentences.zh: 等价地，所有高次有界 Hochschild 上同调群都为零，从而解决了 Kadison--Ringrose 猜想。

sentences.en: Proves that every type $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with separable predual is generated by a single operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators, resolving the generator problem.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个具有可分预对偶的 $\mathrm{II}_1$ 型因子都由单个算子生成，等价地由两个自伴算子生成，从而解决了生成元问题。

sentences.en: More strongly, for every irreducible inclusion $P\subset M$ of such factors, the unitaries $u$ with $M=W^*(P,u)$ form a dense $G_\delta$ subset in the trace $2$-norm topology.
sentences.zh: 更强地，对于这类因子的每个不可约包含 $P\subset M$，满足 $M=W^*(P,u)$ 的酉元 $u$ 在迹 $2$ 范数拓扑中构成一个稠密的 $G_\delta$ 子集。

sentences.en: Gives an alternative to \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26930v1}{Tanaka's ZFC construction} of a unital infinite-dimensional simple complex $C^*$-algebra with a faithful tracial state and exactly one nonzero irreducible representation up to unitary equivalence.
sentences.zh: 给出了不同于 \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26930v1}{Tanaka 的 ZFC 构造}的另一种构造，所得含幺、无限维、单复 $C^*$ 代数具有忠实迹态，而且在酉等价意义下恰有一个非零不可约表示。

sentences.en: Thus the unrestricted compact-operator characterization fails without additional set-theoretic assumptions; the counterexample is nonseparable.
sentences.zh: 因此，不附加额外集合论假设时，不受限制的紧算子刻画不成立；该反例是不可分的。

sentences.en: Constructs a bounded self-adjoint tuple in a tracial von Neumann algebra whose microstates and nonmicrostates free entropies satisfy $-\infty<\chi<\chi^*<\infty$.
sentences.zh: 在一个带迹 von Neumann 代数中构造了一个有界自伴算子组，其微态自由熵和非微态自由熵满足 $-\infty<\chi<\chi^*<\infty$。

sentences.en: This answers Voiculescu’s finite-entropy equality question negatively: the matrix-approximation and free-Fisher-information definitions differ even when both are finite.
sentences.zh: 这对 Voiculescu 的有限熵相等问题给出了否定答案：由矩阵逼近与自由 Fisher 信息给出的两个定义，即使都取有限值也不相同。

sentences.en: A nonzero unital separable complex $C^*$-algebra is Jiang--Su stable exactly when its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters, for every free ultrafilter.
sentences.zh: 对每个自由超滤，一个非零含幺可分复 $C^*$ 代数是 Jiang--Su 稳定的，当且仅当其范数中心序列代数没有特征标。

sentences.en: This answers the Kirchberg--R\o rdam character question.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Kirchberg--R\o rdam 的特征标问题。

sentences.en: Also, the infinite minimal tensor power of every such algebra without characters is Jiang--Su stable, answering the Dadarlat--Toms question.
sentences.zh: 此外，每个这样的无特征标代数的无限最小张量幂都是 Jiang--Su 稳定的，从而回答了 Dadarlat--Toms 的问题。

sentences.en: Proves that every self-adjoint element of a complex von Neumann algebra admits strong-operator paving relative to any maximal abelian subalgebra with $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ blocks.
sentences.zh: 证明了复 von Neumann 代数中的每个自伴元，相对于任意极大交换子代数都容许具有 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 个块的强算子铺砌。

sentences.en: The norm bound holds after compression by a projection arbitrarily close to the identity in the strong topology, resolving the Popa--Vaes quadratic paving conjecture.
sentences.zh: 用一个在强拓扑中任意接近恒等元的投影进行压缩后，该范数界成立，从而解决了 Popa--Vaes 二次铺砌猜想。

sentences.en: Classifies separable nuclear complex $C^*$-algebras after tensoring with the Razak--Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, using their full topological cones of extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weights.
sentences.zh: 利用全体扩展下半连续迹权所构成的拓扑锥，对与 Razak--Jacelon 代数及紧算子代数取张量积后的可分核复 $C^*$ 代数进行了分类。

sentences.en: This answers Robert’s trace-cone question, including algebras with arbitrary ideal structure and both finite and infinite subquotients.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Robert 的迹锥问题，其中包括具有任意理想结构以及有限和无限子商的代数。

sentences.en: For every minimal homeomorphism $h$ of an infinite compact metrizable space $X$, the radius of comparison of $C(X)\rtimes_h\mathbb Z$ equals $\tfrac12\mathrm{mdim}(X,h)$, including infinite values.
sentences.zh: 对于无限紧致可度量空间 $X$ 的每个极小同胚 $h$，$C(X)\rtimes_h\mathbb Z$ 的比较半径等于 $\tfrac12\mathrm{mdim}(X,h)$，也包括取无限值的情形。

sentences.en: Zero mean dimension is equivalent to the small boundary property, Jiang--Su stability and finite nuclear dimension; in this case nuclear dimension is at most one.
sentences.zh: 平均维数为零与小边界性质、Jiang--Su 稳定性及有限核维数等价；在这种情况下，核维数至多为一。

sentences.en: Resolves the ordinary-to-strong pure-infiniteness question of Kirchberg and R{\o}rdam for complex $C^*$-algebras.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Kirchberg 和 R{\o}rdam 关于复 $C^*$ 代数从普通纯无限性到强纯无限性的问题。

sentences.en: For exact algebras, proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element also suffices.
sentences.zh: 对于正合代数，对所有正元素取同一个固定的有限放大后均具有 proper infiniteness，这一条件也已足够。

sentences.en: Consequently, every separable nuclear algebra with this property absorbs $\mathcal O_\infty$, without unitality or simplicity assumptions.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个具有这一性质的可分核代数都吸收 $\mathcal O_\infty$，无需含幺性或单性假设。

sentences.en: Every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected finite-dimensional topological manifold is a Lie group.
sentences.zh: 每个在连通有限维拓扑流形上忠实且联合连续作用的局部紧、第二可数 Hausdorff 群都是 Lie 群。

sentences.en: This proves the Hilbert--Smith conjecture in all finite dimensions, for Hausdorff second-countable manifolds without boundary.
sentences.zh: 这对无边界的 Hausdorff 第二可数流形证明了所有有限维数下的 Hilbert--Smith 猜想。

sentences.en: The unrestricted four-dimensional disk-embedding conjecture fails: framed algebraic dual spheres do not suffice to obtain disjoint locally flat spanning disks.
sentences.zh: 不受限制的四维圆盘嵌入猜想不成立：带标架的代数对偶球面不足以保证得到彼此不交、局部平坦的张成圆盘。

sentences.en: In particular, the free group $F_2$ is not good in the sense of Freedman--Quinn.
sentences.zh: 特别地，自由群 $F_2$ 在 Freedman--Quinn 意义下不是好群。

sentences.en: Also constructs a finitely presented integral Poincaré duality group of dimension four with a finite classifying space but no realization as the fundamental group of a closed aspherical topological four-manifold, disproving Wall's conjecture.
sentences.zh: 还构造了一个有限展示的四维整系数 Poincaré 对偶群，它具有有限分类空间，却不能实现为闭的非球面拓扑四维流形的基本群，从而否定了 Wall 猜想。

sentences.en: Distinct Dehn surgery slopes on a nontrivial smooth knot in $S^3$ never produce orientation-preservingly homeomorphic manifolds, proving the purely cosmetic surgery conjecture.
sentences.zh: 对 $S^3$ 中的非平凡光滑纽结，沿不同斜率进行 Dehn 手术永远不会得到保定向同胚的流形，从而证明了 purely cosmetic Dehn 手术猜想。

sentences.en: The statement includes the meridional slope.
sentences.zh: 该陈述包括子午斜率。

sentences.en: Constructs a uniformly discrete bounded-geometry space whose maximal coarse assembly map is not rationally injective.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个一致离散的有界几何空间，其极大粗装配映射不是有理单射。

sentences.en: The example is a coarse disjoint union of finite connected graphs of uniformly bounded degree, with an infinite-order kernel class.
sentences.zh: 该例子是一族度数一致有界的有限连通图的粗不交并，且其核中存在一个无限阶类。

sentences.en: A companion gives the analogous failure for reduced coarse assembly, disproving the rational coarse Novikov conjecture.
sentences.zh: 配套论文对约化粗装配给出了类似的失效结果，从而否定了有理粗 Novikov 猜想。

sentences.en: For every $n\ge0$, constructs a finite Smith--Toda spectrum at a prime $p$ depending on $n$, with Brown--Peterson homology $BP_*/(p,v_1,\ldots,v_n)$ and the canonical comodule structure.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $n\ge0$，在一个依赖于 $n$ 的素数 $p$ 处构造了有限 Smith--Toda 谱，其 Brown--Peterson 同调为 $BP_*/(p,v_1,\ldots,v_n)$，并带有典范余模结构。

sentences.en: Thus Smith--Toda complexes exist at every height when the prime may vary; an explicit example realizes $V(4)$ at $p=1009$.
sentences.zh: 因此，当素数允许变化时，每个高度上都存在 Smith--Toda 复形；一个显式例子在 $p=1009$ 处实现了 $V(4)$。

sentences.en: Resolves the odd-primary Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three: exactly the standard classes with indices $0$, $2$, and $3$ survive in the mod-three Adams spectral sequence, in stems $10$, $106$, and $322$.
sentences.zh: 解决了素数三处的奇素数 Kervaire 不变量问题：在模三 Adams 谱序列中，恰好是指标为 $0$、$2$ 和 $3$ 的标准类存活，分别位于 stem $10$、$106$ 和 $322$。

sentences.en: Each surviving detection coset contains an element of exact additive order three.
sentences.zh: 每个存活的检测陪集中都含有一个加法阶恰为三的元素。

sentences.en: Proves the rational-homology form of Quillen's conjecture for every finite group and every prime.
sentences.zh: 对每个有限群和每个素数，证明了 Quillen 猜想的有理同调形式。

sentences.en: If the largest normal $p$-subgroup of $G$ is trivial, the poset of nontrivial elementary abelian $p$-subgroups has nonzero augmented reduced rational homology and is therefore not contractible.
sentences.zh: 如果 $G$ 的最大正规 $p$ 子群是平凡的，那么非平凡初等交换 $p$ 子群构成的偏序集具有非零的增广约化有理同调，因此不可缩。

sentences.en: Proves Chai's invariant-ideal conjecture for Lubin--Tate deformation rings over finite residue fields, at every prime and positive height $n$.
sentences.zh: 对于有限剩余域上的 Lubin--Tate 形变环，在每个素数与每个正高度 $n$ 处证明了 Chai 不变理想猜想。

sentences.en: Through the implication of Barthel--Heard--Naumann, this proves the Hovey--Strickland conjecture: dualizable $K(n)$-local spectra have exactly $n+2$ thick tensor ideals, and their Balmer spectrum is a chain of $n+1$ points.
sentences.zh: 通过 Barthel--Heard--Naumann 给出的蕴含关系，这证明了 Hovey--Strickland 猜想：可对偶的 $K(n)$ 局部谱恰有 $n+2$ 个厚张量理想，其 Balmer 谱是一条由 $n+1$ 个点组成的链。

sentences.en: Proves the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for $\infty$-groupoids associated with every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara--Henry convention: these algebraic objects recover the homotopy theory of spaces.
sentences.zh: 在 Ara--Henry 的约定下，对与每个 Grothendieck coherator 相关联的 $\infty$ 群胚，证明了 Grothendieck 同伦假说：这些代数对象恢复了空间的同伦理论。

sentences.en: Answers the degreewise finiteness question of Hovey and Hovey--Strickland: every homotopy group of the $K(n)$-local sphere is a finitely generated $\mathbb Z_p$-module, for every prime, positive height and integer degree.
sentences.zh: 回答了 Hovey 及 Hovey--Strickland 关于各次数的有限性问题：对每个素数、每个正高度及每个整数次数，$K(n)$ 局部球谱的每个同伦群都是有限生成的 $\mathbb Z_p$ 模。

sentences.en: The same conclusion holds after $K(n)$-localizing any finite $p$-local spectrum.
sentences.zh: 将任意有限的 $p$ 局部谱进行 $K(n)$ 局部化后，同样的结论成立。

sentences.en: Determines the optimal chromatic loss from geometric $H$-fixed points to geometric $G$-fixed points for every subgroup $H$ of a finite $p$-group $G$.
sentences.zh: 对于有限 $p$ 群 $G$ 的每个子群 $H$，确定了从几何 $H$ 不动点到几何 $G$ 不动点的最优 chromatic 损失。

sentences.en: At every nonnegative height, the loss equals the shortest subnormal-chain length from $H$ to $G$ with cyclic quotients.
sentences.zh: 在每个非负高度，该损失等于从 $H$ 到 $G$、各商均为循环群的最短次正规链的长度。

sentences.en: Each quotient counts once regardless of order, and finite spectra witness sharpness.
sentences.zh: 每个商无论其阶数是多少都只计一次，而且有限谱体现了这一界的最优性。

sentences.en: Proves that the $L^2$-Betti numbers of the universal cover of every closed connected aspherical topological four-manifold vanish outside degree two.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个闭、连通、非球面拓扑四维流形的万有覆盖，其 $L^2$ Betti 数在二次以外均为零。

sentences.en: More generally, the same conclusion holds for every finite connected aspherical integral Poincar\'e complex of formal dimension four, proving the four-dimensional Singer conjecture in this wider class.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于每个形式维数为四的有限、连通、非球面整系数 Poincar\'e 复形，同样的结论成立，从而在这一更广的类别中证明了四维 Singer 猜想。

sentences.en: Proves Curtis’s conjecture: the positive-degree mod-two stable Hurewicz image of the sphere is spanned by the images of the Hopf-invariant-one classes $\eta,\nu,\sigma$ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes that exist.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Curtis 猜想：球谱的正次数模二稳定 Hurewicz 像由 Hopf 不变量为一的类 $\eta,\nu,\sigma$ 以及确实存在的 Kervaire 不变量为一的类的像张成。

sentences.en: Resolves the Ara--Maltsiniotis conjecture: for every $n\ge1$ and $n=\omega$, small strict globular $n$-categories admit proper combinatorial Thomason model structures Quillen equivalent to simplicial sets.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Ara--Maltsiniotis 猜想：对于每个 $n\ge1$ 以及 $n=\omega$，小的严格 globular $n$ 范畴都容许与单纯集 Quillen 等价的固有组合 Thomason 模型结构。

sentences.en: Thus strict higher categories model the homotopy theory of spaces in every stated dimension.
sentences.zh: 因此，在每个所述维数下，严格高阶范畴都为空间的同伦理论提供模型。

sentences.en: Disproves strong chromatic splitting at height three for primes $p\ge5$, and weak splitting for the derived $p$-completed sphere at heights $p$ ($p\ge5$) and $p+1$ ($p\ge7$).
sentences.zh: 否定了素数 $p\ge5$ 时高度三处的强 chromatic 分裂，以及导出 $p$-完备化球谱在高度 $p$（$p\ge5$）和高度 $p+1$（$p\ge7$）处的弱分裂。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, for $n\ge1$ and $p>n+1$, the overlap $L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge$ admits a $2^n$-stage filtration by the predicted localized-sphere pieces.
sentences.zh: 不过，当 $n\ge1$ 且 $p>n+1$ 时，重叠部分 $L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge$ 具有一个由所预测的局部化球谱块组成的 $2^n$ 阶滤过。

sentences.en: At height three and prime three, even finite assembly from such pieces fails in the category of $E(2)$-local modules over the derived completed sphere.
sentences.zh: 在高度三、素数三处，在导出完备化球谱上的 $E(2)$-局部模范畴中，甚至无法由这样的块进行有限拼装。

sentences.en: Refutes the Hahn--Wilson conjecture at chromatic height two.
sentences.zh: 否定了 chromatic 高度二处的 Hahn--Wilson 猜想。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large prime $p$, constructs a connective $p$-complete spectrum of exact fp-type two that cannot be built from completed $\mathrm{BP}\langle2\rangle$ by finitely many sums, shifts, cones and retracts.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分大的素数 $p$，构造了一个 fp-型恰为二的 connective $p$-完备谱，它不能从完备化的 $\mathrm{BP}\langle2\rangle$ 出发，经有限次取和、移位、取锥及取缩回对象构造得到。

sentences.en: The examples nevertheless satisfy the finite and telescopic localization comparisons.
sentences.zh: 不过，这些例子仍满足有限局部化与望远镜局部化的比较关系。

sentences.en: Constructs closed connected aspherical topological four-manifolds that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, with a common word-hyperbolic fundamental group.
sentences.zh: 构造了同伦等价但不同胚的闭连通非球面拓扑四维流形，它们具有同一个字双曲基本群。

sentences.en: This disproves even the homeomorphism-existence formulation of the Borel conjecture in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 这甚至否定了四维 Borel 猜想中仅断言同胚存在的表述。

sentences.en: Constructs a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex whose universal cover has no integral homology above degree two and whose third cohomology vanishes for every local coefficient module, but which has no finite two-dimensional homotopy model.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个有限连通三维 CW 复形，其万有覆盖在次数高于二时的整系数同调均为零，且对每个局部系数模，其三次上同调均为零，但它没有有限二维同伦模型。

sentences.en: This disproves Wall's finite D(2) conjecture; the example has infinite fundamental group.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Wall 的有限 D(2) 猜想；该例子的基本群是无限群。

sentences.en: Resolves Tingley's problem: every surjective isometry between the unit spheres of nonzero real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry of the whole spaces.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Tingley 问题：非零实 Banach 空间的单位球面之间的每个满射等距映射，都唯一地延拓为整个空间之间的满射实线性等距映射。

sentences.en: No dimension restriction is imposed, so the metric geometry of the unit sphere determines the Banach space up to linear isometry.
sentences.zh: 这里没有维数限制，因此单位球面的度量几何在线性等距意义下确定了该 Banach 空间。

sentences.en: Establishes, relative to the consistency of a measurable cardinal, that the separable quotient problem is independent of ZFC.
sentences.zh: 在可测基数存在的一致性假设下，确立了可分商问题相对于 ZFC 的独立性。

sentences.en: The assertion that every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a separable infinite-dimensional quotient can hold for all real and complex Banach spaces, whereas the continuum hypothesis yields counterexamples over both fields.
sentences.zh: “每个无限维 Banach 空间都有可分的无限维商空间”这一断言可以对所有实和复 Banach 空间成立，而连续统假设则在这两个域上均给出反例。

sentences.en: Constructs separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic, resolving the separable Lipschitz-isomorphism problem negatively.
sentences.zh: 构造了整体双 Lipschitz 等价但不线性同构的可分实 Banach 空间，从而否定地解决了可分 Lipschitz 同构问题。

sentences.en: Thus even the complete metric structure up to bi-Lipschitz equivalence does not determine a separable Banach space's linear isomorphism class.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使知道双 Lipschitz 等价意义下的完整度量结构，也不能确定可分 Banach 空间的线性同构类。

sentences.en: Resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture: for every bounded operator $A$ on a complex Hilbert space and every finite matrix-valued polynomial $P$, one has $\lVert P[A]\rVert\le2\sup_{z\in W(A)}\lVert P(z)\rVert$, where $W(A)$ is the numerical range.
sentences.zh: 解决了完全 Crouzeix 猜想：对复 Hilbert 空间上的每个有界算子 $A$ 及每个有限矩阵值多项式 $P$，都有 $\lVert P[A]\rVert\le2\sup_{z\in W(A)}\lVert P(z)\rVert$，其中 $W(A)$ 为数值域。

sentences.en: The constant $2$ is sharp, independent of the matrix size, and valid in infinite dimensions.
sentences.zh: 常数 $2$ 是最优的，与矩阵大小无关，且在无限维情形下也成立。

sentences.en: Resolves the cotype--cotype conjecture for real Banach spaces with the approximation property.
sentences.zh: 对具有逼近性质的实 Banach 空间，解决了余型—余型猜想。

sentences.en: Such a nonzero space is $K$-convex if and only if both it and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, with possibly different exponents.
sentences.zh: 这样的非零空间是 $K$-凸的，当且仅当它及其对偶都具有有限 Rademacher 余型，两者的指数可以不同。

sentences.en: Equivalently, these cotype assumptions force nontrivial Rademacher type.
sentences.zh: 等价地，这些余型假设必然推出非平凡的 Rademacher 型。

sentences.en: Proves that every real Banach space with Markov type $p$ for some $p>1$ admits an equivalent uniformly convex norm, answering Naor's renorming question.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个对某个 $p>1$ 具有 Markov 型 $p$ 的实 Banach 空间都容许一个等价的一致凸范数，从而回答了 Naor 的重新赋范问题。

sentences.en: Together with the known converse, this characterizes superreflexivity by nontrivial Markov type.
sentences.zh: 结合已知的逆命题，这以非平凡的 Markov 型刻画了超自反性。

sentences.en: Resolves Kirk's reflexive-space fixed-point problem: every nonexpansive selfmap of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a real reflexive Banach space has a fixed point.
sentences.zh: 解决了 Kirk 的自反空间不动点问题：实自反 Banach 空间的非空闭有界凸子集上的每个非扩张自映射都有不动点。

sentences.en: The result uses the original norm, without assuming uniform convexity.
sentences.zh: 该结果使用原有范数，不假设一致凸性。

sentences.en: Disproves Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy.
sentences.zh: 否定了 Pietsch 关于度量熵的无维数依赖对偶猜想。

sentences.en: Origin-symmetric convex bodies violate every proposed choice of universal constants in the conjectured comparison between covering numbers and those of the polar bodies, even when the covering body is a cube.
sentences.zh: 即使覆盖体是立方体，关于覆盖数与极体覆盖数之间比较关系的猜想中，无论如何选取所提出的普适常数，都有原点对称凸体违反这一关系。

sentences.en: Constructs a countable uniformly discrete metric space whose real Lipschitz-free Banach space has the approximation property but not the bounded approximation property, answering Kalton's question negatively.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个可数的一致离散度量空间，其实 Lipschitz-free Banach 空间具有逼近性质却不具有有界逼近性质，从而否定地回答了 Kalton 的问题。

sentences.en: Finite-rank operators approximate the identity on every compact set, but their norms cannot share a finite bound.
sentences.zh: 有限秩算子能够在每个紧集上逼近恒等算子，但其范数不可能具有共同的有限上界。

sentences.en: Constructs a real reflexive Banach space with an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm but no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm, extending Baudier's separation to reflexive spaces.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个具有渐近中点一致凸范数、却没有等价的渐近一致凸范数的实自反 Banach 空间，将 Baudier 的区分结果推广到了自反空间。

sentences.en: In the same space, depth-$k$ countably branching diamonds require distortion at least $\sqrt{1+k/12}$, so midpoint uniform convexity does not force uniformly bounded diamond distortion even under reflexivity.
sentences.zh: 在同一空间中，深度为 $k$ 的可数分支菱形图所需的畸变至少为 $\sqrt{1+k/12}$，因此，即使在自反性假设下，中点一致凸性也不保证菱形图的畸变一致有界。

sentences.en: Proves that real $\ell_1$ has metric Markov cotype two, answering Mendel and Naor's question.
sentences.zh: 证明了实 $\ell_1$ 具有度量 Markov 余型二，从而回答了 Mendel 和 Naor 的问题。

sentences.en: Consequently, every Lipschitz map from an arbitrary subset of a real Hilbert space into $\ell_1$ extends to the whole space with a universal multiplicative loss in its Lipschitz constant, resolving Ball's extension problem for this target.
sentences.zh: 因此，从实 Hilbert 空间的任意子集到 $\ell_1$ 的每个 Lipschitz 映射都可以延拓到整个空间，其 Lipschitz 常数只损失一个普适的乘性因子，从而解决了以该空间为目标的 Ball 延拓问题。

sentences.en: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into $\mathbb R^4$, resolving the closed-surface form of the four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem.
sentences.zh: 每个闭光滑 Riemann 度量曲面都容许一个到 $\mathbb R^4$ 的光滑等距浸入，从而解决了四维等距浸入问题的闭曲面版本。

sentences.en: This includes nonorientable surfaces and metrics of arbitrary Gaussian curvature.
sentences.zh: 这包括不可定向曲面以及具有任意高斯曲率的度量。

sentences.en: Constructs a smooth positive-definite metric on $(-1,1)^2$ for which no neighborhood of the origin admits a smooth isometric immersion into $\mathbb R^3$.
sentences.zh: 在 $(-1,1)^2$ 上构造了一个光滑正定度量，使得原点的任何邻域都不容许到 $\mathbb R^3$ 的光滑等距浸入。

sentences.en: This answers the unrestricted smooth local isometric realization problem for surfaces negatively, even after shrinking the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了曲面在不加限制时的光滑局部等距实现问题，即使缩小邻域也无济于事。

sentences.en: Proves $\int_M(\mathrm{Scal}_g^-)^{n/2}\,dV_g\ge a_n\lVert M\rVert$ for every closed connected oriented smooth $n$-manifold, $n\ge3$, and every smooth metric, with $a_n>0$ depending only on dimension.
sentences.zh: 对每个闭连通定向光滑 $n$ 维流形（$n\ge3$）及其上的每个光滑度量，证明了 $\int_M(\mathrm{Scal}_g^-)^{n/2}\,dV_g\ge a_n\lVert M\rVert$，其中 $a_n>0$ 仅依赖于维数。

sentences.en: Here $\mathrm{Scal}_g^-=\max\{0,-\mathrm{Scal}_g\}$ and $\lVert M\rVert$ is real simplicial volume.
sentences.zh: 这里 $\mathrm{Scal}_g^-=\max\{0,-\mathrm{Scal}_g\}$，而 $\lVert M\rVert$ 为实单纯体积。

sentences.en: Also proves rational inessentiality under positive scalar curvature, resolving the Gromov--Lawson conjecture; every nonnegative-scalar-curvature metric on a closed aspherical manifold is flat.
sentences.zh: 还证明了正标量曲率下的有理非本质性，解决了 Gromov--Lawson 猜想；闭非球面流形上的每个非负标量曲率度量都是平坦的。

sentences.en: Every complete connected smooth boundaryless $n$-manifold, $n\ge3$, satisfying $-4\Delta+\mathrm{Scal}\ge1$ as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most $n-2$ whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only by $n$ in the original metric.
sentences.zh: 每个完备连通光滑无边界的 $n$ 维流形，在 $n\ge3$ 且以二次型不等式的意义满足 $-4\Delta+\mathrm{Scal}\ge1$ 时，都容许一个到维数至多为 $n-2$ 的单纯复形的连续映射，其每个完整纤维在原有度量下的直径都有仅依赖于 $n$ 的上界。

sentences.en: This strengthens Gromov's width conclusion to spectral scalar curvature.
sentences.zh: 这将 Gromov 的宽度结论加强到了谱标量曲率情形。

sentences.en: Universal covers of closed positive-scalar-curvature manifolds also have continuous macroscopic dimension at most $n-2$ for every $n\ge2$.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $n\ge2$，闭正标量曲率流形的万有覆盖的连续宏观维数也至多为 $n-2$。

sentences.en: Proves generalized Cartan--Hadamard isoperimetry in every dimension: in a complete simply connected manifold with sectional curvature at most $\kappa\le0$, every finite-volume finite-perimeter set satisfies the sharp comparison with the equal-volume model ball.
sentences.zh: 在每个维数上证明了广义 Cartan--Hadamard 等周不等式：在截面曲率至多为 $\kappa\le0$ 的完备单连通流形中，每个具有有限体积和有限周长的集合都满足与同体积模型球之间的最优比较不等式。

sentences.en: Bounded positive-volume equality regions for $\kappa=0$ are Euclidean balls.
sentences.zh: 当 $\kappa=0$ 时，有界、正体积且达到等号的区域都是欧氏球。

sentences.en: Also proves sharp Euclidean filling bounds for compactly supported integral $n$-cycles, $n\ge2$, in arbitrary proper CAT$(0)$ spaces.
sentences.zh: 还证明了任意固有 CAT$(0)$ 空间中紧支撑整系数 $n$ 维闭链（$n\ge2$）的最优欧氏填充界。

sentences.en: Proves Yau's uniformization conjecture: every complete connected noncompact K\"ahler manifold with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to $\mathbb C^n$.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Yau 的单值化猜想：每个具有严格正的全纯双截曲率的完备连通非紧 Kähler 流形都与 $\mathbb C^n$ 双全纯等价。

sentences.en: Proves Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture for closed connected Riemannian manifolds of dimension at least three with strictly negative sectional curvature: normalized Liouville measure maximizes entropy for the geodesic flow if and only if the metric is locally symmetric.
sentences.zh: 对维数至少为三、截面曲率严格为负的闭连通 Riemann 流形，证明了 Katok 的熵刚性猜想：归一化的 Liouville 测度使测地流的熵达到最大，当且仅当该度量局部对称。

sentences.en: Disproves the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture.
sentences.zh: 否定了不加限制的邻近 Lagrangian 猜想。

sentences.en: For some sufficiently large even $N$, constructs a closed exact embedded Lagrangian in $T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1})$ that is diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to its zero section.
sentences.zh: 对某个充分大的偶数 $N$，在 $T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1})$ 中构造了一个闭的正合嵌入 Lagrangian 子流形，它与底流形微分同胚，但与零截面不 Hamiltonian 同痕。

sentences.en: Proves Donaldson's hypersymplectic deformation conjecture in a cohomology-preserving form.
sentences.zh: 以保持上同调的形式证明了 Donaldson 的 hypersymplectic 形变猜想。

sentences.en: Every positive triple of smooth closed two-forms on a closed connected oriented four-manifold, normalized by $\int\omega_i\wedge\omega_j=\delta_{ij}$, deforms through positive closed triples to a hyperk\"ahler triple while preserving all three cohomology classes.
sentences.zh: 闭连通定向四维流形上每个由光滑闭二形式组成、并经 $\int\omega_i\wedge\omega_j=\delta_{ij}$ 归一化的正三元组，都能通过正的闭三元组形变为一个超 Kähler 三元组，同时保持全部三个上同调类。

sentences.en: Any positive triple can first be normalized by a constant linear change.
sentences.zh: 任意正三元组都可以先通过常系数线性变换归一化。

sentences.en: Proves Donaldson's tamed-to-compatible conjecture: every smooth almost complex structure on a closed four-manifold that is tamed by a symplectic form admits a compatible symplectic form.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Donaldson 从驯服到相容的猜想：闭四维流形上每个被某个辛形式驯服的光滑殆复结构，都容许一个与之相容的辛形式。

sentences.en: The almost complex structure stays fixed; the form's cohomology class may change.
sentences.zh: 殆复结构保持固定；该形式的上同调类可以改变。

sentences.en: Resolves the Siegel--Yao conjecture for arbitrary capacities in every dimension $2n\ge6$.
sentences.zh: 在每个维数 $2n\ge6$ 上，对任意容量解决了 Siegel--Yao 猜想。

sentences.en: Finitely many closed symplectic balls of capacities $R_1,\ldots,R_k$ embed disjointly into an open ball of capacity $R$ exactly when $\sum_iR_i^n<R^n$ and $R_i+R_j<R$ for every distinct pair $i,j$.
sentences.zh: 容量为 $R_1,\ldots,R_k$ 的有限多个闭辛球能够互不相交地嵌入容量为 $R$ 的开球，当且仅当 $\sum_iR_i^n<R^n$，且对每一对不同的 $i,j$ 都有 $R_i+R_j<R$。

sentences.en: Proves the metric Blaschke conjecture: every closed connected Riemannian manifold of positive dimension whose injectivity radius equals its diameter is, up to scaling, a standard compact rank-one symmetric space.
sentences.zh: 证明了度量 Blaschke 猜想：每个正维数的闭连通 Riemann 流形，若其单射半径等于直径，则在相差一个尺度因子的意义下，是标准的紧秩一对称空间。

sentences.en: Proves that every smooth Riemannian metric on $S^n$, $n\ge2$, has infinitely many prime closed geodesics with pairwise distinct images.
sentences.zh: 证明了 $S^n$ 上的每个光滑 Riemann 度量，在 $n\ge2$ 时，都有无穷多条像两两不同的素闭测地线。

sentences.en: The same conclusion holds on every closed manifold admitting a finite smooth spherical cover and on every closed three-manifold, without orientability or nondegeneracy restrictions.
sentences.zh: 同一结论也对每个容许有限光滑球面覆盖的闭流形，以及每个闭三维流形成立，无须定向性或非退化性限制。

sentences.en: Proves that every stationary integral $m$-varifold in a Euclidean open set has singular set of Hausdorff dimension at most $m-1$, a sharp bound in every positive dimension and codimension.
sentences.zh: 证明了欧氏开集中每个平稳整 $m$ 维 varifold 的奇异集的 Hausdorff 维数至多为 $m-1$，且在每个正维数和余维数中，这一界都是最优的。

sentences.en: On round spheres, the family also proves almost-everywhere regularity: the singular set has zero $m$-dimensional Hausdorff measure.
sentences.zh: 在圆球面上，这组结果还证明了几乎处处正则性：奇异集的 $m$ 维 Hausdorff 测度为零。

sentences.en: Disproves stable-Morse lower bounds for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points: on simply connected closed K\"ahler manifolds of real dimension $22$, the deficit below the stable Morse number is unbounded.
sentences.zh: 否定了非退化 Hamiltonian 不动点数的稳定 Morse 下界：在实维数为 $22$ 的单连通闭 Kähler 流形上，不动点数低于稳定 Morse 数的差额可以无界。

sentences.en: A separate Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold has exactly three fixed points, fewer than the four critical points required of every smooth function.
sentences.zh: 另有一个复三维二次超曲面上的 Hamiltonian 微分同胚恰有三个不动点，而其上每个光滑函数都必须至少具有四个临界点。

sentences.en: Classifies closed connected Einstein four-manifolds with positive Einstein constant and nonnegative sectional curvature: up to scaling, their universal Riemannian covers are the round $S^4$, Fubini--Study $\mathbb{CP}^2$, or a product of equal round two-spheres.
sentences.zh: 分类了 Einstein 常数为正、截面曲率非负的闭连通 Einstein 四维流形：在相差一个尺度因子的意义下，它们的万有 Riemann 覆盖是圆 $S^4$、带 Fubini--Study 度量的 $\mathbb{CP}^2$，或两个相同圆二球面的乘积。

sentences.en: A closed simply connected nonnegatively curved four-manifold is diffeomorphic to one of these whenever the scale-invariant $L^2$ norm of its trace-free Ricci curvature lies below a universal positive constant.
sentences.zh: 若一个闭单连通非负曲率四维流形的无迹 Ricci 曲率的尺度不变 $L^2$ 范数低于某个普适的正常数，则它与上述流形之一微分同胚。

sentences.en: Proves the Solomon--Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of round spheres.
sentences.zh: 对圆球面的极小超曲面，证明了 Solomon--Yau 最小体积猜想。

sentences.en: For every $m\ge2$, a closed connected minimal immersion into the unit sphere $S^{m+1}$ with non-totally-geodesic image has volume at least that of the smallest minimal Clifford product, counting covering multiplicity.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $m\ge2$，一个到单位球面 $S^{m+1}$ 的闭连通极小浸入，若其像不是全测地的，则计入覆盖重数后的体积至少为体积最小的极小 Clifford 乘积的体积。

sentences.en: Proves the sharp $C\sqrt\lambda$ upper bound for nodal length on every fixed smooth closed surface, completing Yau's conjecture there.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个固定的光滑闭曲面上结点集长度的最优上界 $C\sqrt\lambda$，从而完成了该情形下的 Yau 猜想。

sentences.en: The upper bound fails for fixed smooth metrics in dimensions three and four, including metrics on $S^3$ arbitrarily close to round.
sentences.zh: 在三维和四维中，存在使这一上界失效的固定光滑度量，其中包括 $S^3$ 上任意接近圆度量的度量。

sentences.en: In dimension five, nodal measure can grow faster than $\lambda^{1/2+\varepsilon_0}$ for some fixed $\varepsilon_0>0$, ruling out even arbitrarily small power losses.
sentences.zh: 在五维中，对某个固定的 $\varepsilon_0>0$，结点集测度的增长可以快于 $\lambda^{1/2+\varepsilon_0}$，从而甚至排除了任意小的幂次损失。

sentences.en: Proves that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed four-manifold extends past any finite time at which scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded.
sentences.zh: 证明了闭四维流形上的光滑 Ricci 流，只要标量曲率在趋近某个有限时刻时保持一致有界，就能延拓越过该时刻。

sentences.en: A higher-dimensional counterexample has bounded scalar curvature but unbounded full curvature at its finite maximal time, disproving the unrestricted scalar-curvature extension conjecture.
sentences.zh: 一个更高维的反例在其有限的最大存在时刻具有有界的标量曲率，但完整曲率无界，从而否定了不加限制的标量曲率延拓猜想。

sentences.en: Disproves Chen's smooth long-time existence conjecture for Calabi flow by constructing a smooth $U(10)$-invariant K\"ahler metric on $\mathbb{CP}^{10}$ whose flow develops a finite-time singularity.
sentences.zh: 通过在 $\mathbb{CP}^{10}$ 上构造一个光滑的 $U(10)$-不变 Kähler 度量，其 Calabi 流在有限时间内形成奇点，否定了 Chen 关于 Calabi 流光滑长时间存在性的猜想。

sentences.en: The metric lies in the Fubini--Study class, so the failure occurs even in a class containing a constant-scalar-curvature metric.
sentences.zh: 该度量属于 Fubini--Study 类，因此，即使在包含常标量曲率度量的类中，也会出现这一失败现象。

sentences.en: Proves that every smooth locally uniformly convex affine-maximal graph of dimension three through nine, complete for its induced Euclidean metric, is an elliptic paraboloid.
sentences.zh: 证明了每个维数为三至九、对诱导的欧氏度量完备的光滑局部一致凸仿射极大图像，都是椭圆抛物面。

sentences.en: A smooth entire nonquadratic example in dimension ten makes this range sharp.
sentences.zh: 十维中的一个在全空间上定义的光滑非二次例子表明这一维数范围是最优的。

sentences.en: In dimensions three through nine, the paraboloid classification also holds for connected open locally uniformly convex affine-maximal hypersurfaces complete for the affine Berwald--Blaschke metric.
sentences.zh: 在三至九维中，抛物面分类还适用于对仿射 Berwald--Blaschke 度量完备的连通开局部一致凸仿射极大超曲面。

sentences.en: Determines the isoperimetric profile of the unit cubic flat three-torus and classifies every finite-perimeter minimizer: balls, circular tubes around shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements.
sentences.zh: 确定了单位立方平坦三维环面的等周轮廓，并分类了每个有限周长极小化子：球、最短闭测地线周围的圆形管状区域、坐标板层及其补集。

sentences.en: The transition volumes are $4\pi/81$ and $1/\pi$, with exactly the adjacent two types minimizing at each transition.
sentences.zh: 转变体积为 $4\pi/81$ 和 $1/\pi$，在每个转变体积处，恰好是相邻的两类达到极小值。

sentences.en: Proves the first-singular-time case of tangent-flow uniqueness for smooth compact connected embedded surfaces without boundary in $\mathbb R^3$.
sentences.zh: 对 $\mathbb R^3$ 中光滑紧连通、无边界的嵌入曲面，证明了首次奇异时刻的切流唯一性。

sentences.en: At every singular point, all fixed-center backward tangent flows agree as area measures at every negative time in the original ambient coordinates, without mean-convexity or a prescribed tangent model.
sentences.zh: 在每个奇点处，所有固定中心的向后切流，在原有环境坐标中、每个负时间处作为面积测度都相同，无须平均曲率凸性，也无须预先指定切模型。

sentences.en: Proves Gigli's conjecture: in every integer dimension $n\ge2$, Alexandrov curvature at least $\kappa$ is characterized by the full-support $\operatorname{RCD}((n-1)\kappa,n)$ condition with reference measure $\mathcal H^n$ and distributional sectional curvature at least $\kappa$ in the original global test classes.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Gigli 猜想：在每个整数维数 $n\ge2$ 中，Alexandrov 曲率至少为 $\kappa$，当且仅当以 $\mathcal H^n$ 为参照测度的满支撑 $\operatorname{RCD}((n-1)\kappa,n)$ 条件成立，并且在原有的全局测试类中，分布意义下的截面曲率至少为 $\kappa$。

sentences.en: The RCD condition is unreduced.
sentences.zh: 这里的 RCD 条件是未约化的。

sentences.en: Proves that every regular point of a noncollapsed $\operatorname{RCD}(K,n)$ space, for $K\in\mathbb R$ and integer $n\ge2$, has an open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz to an open subset of $\mathbb R^n$.
sentences.zh: 证明了对 $K\in\mathbb R$ 和整数 $n\ge2$，非塌缩 $\operatorname{RCD}(K,n)$ 空间的每个正则点都有一个与 $\mathbb R^n$ 的开子集双 Lipschitz 等价的开邻域。

sentences.en: Regularity requires all pointed tangents to be Euclidean, the reference measure is exactly $\mathcal H^n$, and the chart compares ambient distances with a point-dependent finite constant.
sentences.zh: 正则性要求所有带基点的切空间都是欧氏的，参照测度恰为 $\mathcal H^n$，且该坐标图以一个依赖于该点的有限常数比较环境距离。

sentences.en: Constructs a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold that admits a metric without conjugate points but no metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
sentences.zh: 构造了一个闭连通可定向光滑三维流形，它容许一个没有共轭点的度量，却不容许任何截面曲率非正的度量。

sentences.en: This answers negatively, already in dimension three, whether the first metric-existence property implies the second.
sentences.zh: 这已经在三维中否定地回答了第一个度量存在性质是否蕴含第二个的问题。

sentences.en: Constructs a contractible domain in $\mathbb C^3$ with a complete negatively pinched K\"ahler metric but no bounded holomorphic coordinates, disproving bounded-domain uniformization in this setting.
sentences.zh: 在 $\mathbb C^3$ 中构造了一个可缩域，它具有负夹逼曲率的完备 Kähler 度量，却没有有界全纯坐标，从而否定了这一情形下的有界域单值化。

sentences.en: A higher-dimensional example has sectional curvature at most $-1$ and only constant bounded holomorphic functions; its curvature is not bounded below.
sentences.zh: 一个更高维的例子具有至多为 $-1$ 的截面曲率，且有界全纯函数只有常函数；其曲率没有下界。

sentences.en: On every closed connected Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two satisfying weak Ma--Trudinger--Wang curvature, all tangent injectivity domains are convex, resolving Villani’s conjecture in this setting.
sentences.zh: 在每个维数至少为二、满足弱 Ma--Trudinger--Wang 曲率条件的闭连通 Riemann 流形上，所有切空间中的单射域都是凸的，从而解决了这一情形下的 Villani 猜想。

sentences.en: For squared-distance transport between measurable probability densities bounded above and away from zero, the optimal map and its inverse are H\"older continuous.
sentences.zh: 对于有上界且有正下界的可测概率密度之间的距离平方输运，最优映射及其逆映射都是 Hölder 连续的。

sentences.en: Disproves Yau's proposed Euclidean dimension bound for harmonic functions of integer growth on manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature.
sentences.zh: 否定了 Yau 对非负 Ricci 曲率流形上具有整数阶增长的调和函数所提出的欧氏维数界。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large integer $k$, a complete smooth metric on $\mathbb R^3$ has at least $(k+2)^2$ independent harmonic functions of growth at most $k$, exceeding the Euclidean count $(k+1)^2$.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分大的整数 $k$，$\mathbb R^3$ 上存在一个完备光滑度量，其上至少有 $(k+2)^2$ 个增长阶至多为 $k$ 的线性无关调和函数，超过了欧氏情形的数目 $(k+1)^2$。

sentences.en: The metric may depend on $k$.
sentences.zh: 该度量可以依赖于 $k$。

sentences.en: Proves large-data global existence and uniqueness for the three-dimensional, one-species relativistic Vlasov--Maxwell system.
sentences.zh: 证明了三维单物种相对论性 Vlasov--Maxwell 系统对大初始数据的整体存在唯一性。

sentences.en: Smooth admissible initial data may be arbitrary provided the particle density is compactly supported and the electromagnetic fields have finite energy and bounded derivatives of every order; the solution remains smooth on every finite time interval.
sentences.zh: 光滑可容许的初始数据可以任意选取，只要粒子密度具有紧支撑，电磁场具有有限能量且任意阶导数均有界；解在每个有限时间区间上都保持光滑。

sentences.en: Constructs two distinct global entropy solutions of the three-dimensional periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation from the same nonnegative initial density, with bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy and absolute entropy.
sentences.zh: 从同一个速度支撑有界、质量、能量及绝对熵均有限的非负初始密度出发，为三维周期硬球 Boltzmann 方程构造了两个不同的整体熵解。

sentences.en: Both are strongly continuous in $L^1$ and satisfy exact local conservation of mass, momentum and kinetic energy.
sentences.zh: 两者在 $L^1$ 中都强连续，并且满足质量、动量及动能的精确局部守恒。

sentences.en: Derives the nonlinear Boltzmann equation from three-dimensional grand-canonical Newtonian gases throughout every regular kinetic interval with uniform Gaussian decay.
sentences.zh: 在具有一致高斯衰减的每个正则动理学时间区间内，从三维巨正则 Newton 气体推导出非线性 Boltzmann 方程。

sentences.en: Stable finite-range radial potentials may have attractive wells and a singular repulsive core; initial pair exclusion and spatially summable Gaussian density and gradient bounds are assumed.
sentences.zh: 稳定的有限程径向势可以具有吸引势阱和奇异排斥核心；假设满足初始粒子对排除条件，并具有空间上可求和的高斯密度界与梯度界。

sentences.en: A companion gives finite-dimensional hard-sphere Gaussian fluctuations, centered at the exact microscopic expectation and governed by the linear fluctuating Boltzmann equation.
sentences.zh: 一篇配套工作给出了有限维的硬球高斯涨落，其中心为精确的微观期望，并由线性涨落 Boltzmann 方程支配。

sentences.en: Zero-frequency measurements on any nonempty open boundary patch determine a smooth metric and smooth unitary connection on a trivial Hermitian rank-two bundle over a compact connected manifold of dimension at least three, up to diffeomorphism and gauge fixed on that patch.
sentences.zh: 在维数至少为三的紧连通流形上，任意非空开边界片上的零频测量都能确定一个光滑度量以及平凡 Hermitian 秩二丛上的一个光滑酉联络，精确到在该边界片上固定的微分同胚与规范变换。

sentences.en: Inputs and observations use the same patch.
sentences.zh: 输入与观测使用同一个边界片。

sentences.en: In contrast, distinct uniformly positive bounded measurable scalar conductivities on a three-dimensional ball can have identical full-boundary data.
sentences.zh: 相反，在三维球上，不同的一致正、有界可测的标量电导率可以具有完全相同的全边界数据。

sentences.en: Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford--Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data.
sentences.zh: 解决了具有有界保真项数据的平面 Mumford--Shah 约化绝对极小化子的内部正则性猜想。

sentences.en: Locally, the closed discontinuity set is a $C^{1,\alpha}$ arc, a regular crack tip, or three arcs meeting at $120^\circ$; only finitely many global connected components meet any compact interior region.
sentences.zh: 局部而言，闭不连续集是一条 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 弧、一个正则裂纹尖端，或以 $120^\circ$ 相交的三条弧；只有有限多个全局连通分支与任意给定的紧内部区域相交。

sentences.en: Establishes seven as the first dimension admitting a nonflat, one-homogeneous global minimizer of the one-phase Bernoulli energy.
sentences.zh: 确立了七是容许单相 Bernoulli 能量的非平坦一次齐次整体极小化子的最小维数。

sentences.en: Consequently, minimizing free boundaries are smooth through dimension six, and their singular sets have dimension at most $n-7$ in higher dimensions.
sentences.zh: 因此，在维数不超过六时，极小化自由边界是光滑的，而在更高维数中，其奇异集的维数至多为 $n-7$。

sentences.en: Resolves the three-dimensional Ball--Evans approximation problem: every $W^{1,p}$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in $\mathbb R^3$, for $1\le p<\infty$, is a strong $W^{1,p}$ limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
sentences.zh: 解决了三维 Ball--Evans 逼近问题：对 $1\le p<\infty$，$\mathbb R^3$ 中任意有界域之间的每个 $W^{1,p}$ 同胚，都是一列到同一目标域上的光滑微分同胚在 $W^{1,p}$ 中的强极限。

sentences.en: Proves a strict form of Burdzy's simply connected hot spots conjecture.
sentences.zh: 证明了 Burdzy 的单连通热点猜想的严格形式。

sentences.en: On every smooth bounded simply connected planar domain, each nonzero eigenfunction for the first positive Neumann eigenvalue has no interior critical point, so all global extrema lie on the boundary.
sentences.zh: 在每个光滑有界单连通平面域上，对应于第一个正 Neumann 特征值的每个非零特征函数都没有内部临界点，因此所有整体极值都在边界上取得。

sentences.en: Eigenvalue multiplicity is allowed.
sentences.zh: 允许特征值具有重数。

sentences.en: Resolves the subcritical Lane--Emden conjecture and its weighted H\'enon extension.
sentences.zh: 解决了次临界 Lane--Emden 猜想及其加权 Hénon 推广。

sentences.en: For $n\ge2$, $p,q>0$ and real $A,B$, the system $-\Delta u=|x|^A v^p$, $-\Delta v=|x|^B u^q$ has no positive entire solution when $(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)>n-2$, with solutions continuous at the origin and classical elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 对于 $n\ge2$、$p,q>0$ 及实数 $A,B$，当 $(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)>n-2$ 时，方程组 $-\Delta u=|x|^A v^p$、$-\Delta v=|x|^B u^q$ 不存在在原点连续、在其余地方为经典解的正整解。

sentences.en: No symmetry or growth assumption is needed.
sentences.zh: 不需要对称性或增长假设。

sentences.en: Known radial existence gives the exact existence criterion for $n\ge3$ and $A,B>-2$.
sentences.zh: 已知的径向存在性给出了 $n\ge3$ 且 $A,B>-2$ 时的精确存在性判据。

sentences.en: For a sufficiently large odd nonlinearity power, constructs a nonempty open set of initial data in $H^k(\mathbb T^{12})$, with $k>8$, whose solutions of the scalar defocusing nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation blow up in finite time.
sentences.zh: 对某个充分大的奇数非线性幂次，构造了 $H^k(\mathbb T^{12})$ 中一个非空的初始数据开集，其中 $k>8$，这些初始数据对应的标量散焦非线性 Schrödinger 方程的解在有限时间内爆破。

sentences.en: Thus finite-time blowup is stable under Sobolev perturbations in this supercritical regime.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这一超临界情形下，有限时间爆破在 Sobolev 扰动下是稳定的。

sentences.en: Proves that full static boundary displacement-to-traction data determine both smooth real Lam\'e moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in $\mathbb R^3$, provided $\mu>0$ and $3\lambda+2\mu>0$ on the closure.
sentences.zh: 证明了在 $\mathbb R^3$ 中每个有界连通光滑域上，只要在闭包上满足 $\mu>0$ 和 $3\lambda+2\mu>0$，完整的静态边界位移到面力数据就能确定两个光滑实值 Lamé 模量。

sentences.en: Neither analyticity, proximity to constant coefficients nor prior knowledge near the boundary is required.
sentences.zh: 无须解析性、接近常系数的假设，也无须预先知道边界附近的系数。

sentences.en: An optimal three-particle Coulomb configuration need not be a deterministic function of the first particle, even for smooth identical spatial densities.
sentences.zh: 即使空间密度光滑且相同，最优三粒子 Coulomb 构型也未必是第一个粒子的确定性函数。

sentences.en: The Monge and Kantorovich infima agree, but the Monge infimum is not attained.
sentences.zh: Monge 与 Kantorovich 下确界相同，但 Monge 下确界不能达到。

sentences.en: The same phenomenon occurs for every inverse-power Riesz exponent in each dimension at least two, with a suitable density in each case.
sentences.zh: 在每个至少为二的维数中，对每个反幂 Riesz 指数，选取相应的适当密度后都会出现同样的现象。

sentences.en: For uniform source measure $\rho$ on a compact convex body with interior in dimension at least two, quadratic optimal transport maps satisfy $\|T_\mu-T_\nu\|_{L^2(\rho)}\le C W_2(\mu,\nu)^{1/3}$ uniformly over targets in a fixed compact set.
sentences.zh: 对维数至少为二、有内点的紧凸体上的均匀源测度 $\rho$，二次最优输运映射满足 $\|T_\mu-T_\nu\|_{L^2(\rho)}\le C W_2(\mu,\nu)^{1/3}$，且此估计对支撑位于某个固定紧集中的所有目标测度一致成立。

sentences.en: The exponent is sharp, even for three-atom targets, disproving Letrouit's conjectured square-root bound.
sentences.zh: 即使对三个原子的目标测度，该指数也是最优的，从而否定了 Letrouit 所猜想的平方根界。

sentences.en: Proves De Giorgi's conjecture at its sharp dimension-eight endpoint: every entire $C^2$ solution $u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)$ of $\Delta u=u^3-u$ that is strictly increasing in one direction depends on only one linear coordinate.
sentences.zh: 在最优的八维端点证明了 De Giorgi 猜想：方程 $\Delta u=u^3-u$ 的每个沿某个方向严格递增的整 $C^2$ 解 $u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)$，都只依赖于一个线性坐标。

sentences.en: A stronger theorem classifies all stable entire solutions $v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]$ as constant wells or planar transitions, without an energy-growth assumption.
sentences.zh: 一个更强的定理将所有稳定整解 $v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]$ 分类为常值势阱解或平面过渡解，无须能量增长假设。

sentences.en: Constructs viscous incompressible flows starting from rest on a fixed flat three-dimensional domain that perform universal computation under smooth external forcing.
sentences.zh: 构造了固定平坦三维区域上从静止状态出发的黏性不可压缩流，在光滑外力作用下实现通用计算。

sentences.en: A terminating compiler turns a Turing machine and input into a finite program for the force, so a designated particle reaches a fixed region exactly when the machine halts.
sentences.zh: 一个会终止的编译器将 Turing 机及其输入转换为描述外力的有限程序，使得某个指定粒子到达一个固定区域，当且仅当该机器停机。

sentences.en: The viscosity is fixed, positive and computable.
sentences.zh: 黏性系数固定、为正且可计算。

sentences.en: Proves uniform interior $C^{1,\alpha_d}$ regularity for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension $d\ge3$, for a positive exponent depending only on dimension.
sentences.zh: 在每个维数 $d\ge3$ 中，对有界无穷调和函数，证明了具有仅依赖于维数的正指数的一致内部 $C^{1,\alpha_d}$ 正则性。

sentences.en: The gradient's supremum norm and H\"older seminorm on the half unit ball are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on the unit ball.
sentences.zh: 梯度在半单位球上的上确界范数和 Hölder 半范数，都以一个依赖于维数的常数乘以函数在单位球上的振幅为上界。

sentences.en: The exponent is not explicit.
sentences.zh: 该指数不是显式的。

sentences.en: We prove Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties, including residue characteristic 2.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了阿贝尔簇的 Milne 有理性猜想，包括剩余特征为 2 的情形。

sentences.en: After good reduction, the pairing of a rational Hodge class with any complementary product of divisor classes on the reduction is the same rational number in every prime-to-p realization and in crystalline cohomology.
sentences.zh: 经过良约化后，一个有理 Hodge 类与约化上任意互补维数的除子类乘积的配对，在每个素于 p 的实现以及晶体上同调中都是同一个有理数。

sentences.en: Using the Hodge theorem for CM abelian varieties, we also show that every such specialized Hodge class is represented by a single rational algebraic cycle in all these realizations.
sentences.zh: 利用 CM 阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 定理，我们还证明，每个这样的特化 Hodge 类在所有这些实现中都由同一个有理系数代数闭链表示。

sentences.en: We prove the full Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over ℚ whose full q-power Selmer group has corank zero or one at some prime q.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℚ 上的每条椭圆曲线，只要其完整的 q 幂 Selmer 群在某个素数 q 处的余秩为零或一，我们就证明了完整的 Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer 首项公式。

sentences.en: The analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks equal that corank, and the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite.
sentences.zh: 解析秩和 Mordell–Weil 秩都等于该余秩，且 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限。

sentences.en: The formula includes all prime factors and requires no additional hypotheses on reduction, rational torsion, isogenies, complex multiplication, or residual Galois representations.
sentences.zh: 该公式包含所有素因子，无须对约化、有理挠点、同源、复乘或剩余 Galois 表示施加额外假设。

sentences.en: We prove the Selmer converse in coranks zero and one for every elliptic curve over ℚ and every prime p: if the full p-power Selmer group has ℤp-corank $`r\in\{0,1\}`$, then the analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks both equal r, and the entire Tate–Shafarevich group is finite.
sentences.zh: 我们对 ℚ 上的每条椭圆曲线和每个素数 p 证明了余秩为零和一时的 Selmer 逆命题：若完整的 p 幂 Selmer 群的 ℤp 余秩为 $`r\in\{0,1\}`$，则解析秩和 Mordell–Weil 秩都等于 r，且整个 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限。

sentences.en: As an application at the additive prime 3, we prove that for every prime $`\ell\equiv4,7,8\pmod9`$, the cubic $`X^3+Y^3=\ell Z^3`$ has analytic and Mordell–Weil rank one and finite Tate–Shafarevich group.
sentences.zh: 作为在加性约化素数 3 处的应用，我们证明，对于每个素数 $`\ell\equiv4,7,8\pmod9`$，三次曲线 $`X^3+Y^3=\ell Z^3`$ 的解析秩和 Mordell–Weil 秩均为一，且 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限。

sentences.en: In particular, every such ℓ is a sum of two rational cubes.
sentences.zh: 特别地，每个这样的 ℓ 都是两个有理数的立方之和。

sentences.en: We prove the two-primary Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer leading-term formula for every elliptic curve over the rationals whose two-power Selmer group has corank at most one.
sentences.zh: 对于有理数域上的每条椭圆曲线，只要其二幂 Selmer 群的余秩至多为一，我们就证明了 Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer 首项公式的二主部分。

sentences.en: In this range, the algebraic rank, analytic rank, and Selmer corank are equal, and the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite.
sentences.zh: 在这一范围内，代数秩、解析秩和 Selmer 余秩相等，且 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限。

sentences.en: Combined with the quadratic-twist Selmer distribution, this gives the exact two-primary formula for a density-one set of signed squarefree twists of each fixed curve, ordered by absolute value; the common rank is zero or one, with each value having density one half.
sentences.zh: 结合二次扭曲的 Selmer 分布，这对每条固定曲线的带符号无平方因子扭曲中按绝对值排序、密度为一的集合给出了精确的二主部分公式；共同的秩为零或一，且每个值的密度都是二分之一。

sentences.en: We prove that all finite-order Hecke L-functions over $`\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$ and all Dirichlet L-functions are zero-free in the half-plane $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$, with the principal pole at s = 1 allowed.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$ 上所有有限阶 Hecke L 函数以及所有 Dirichlet L 函数在半平面 $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$ 内均无零点，同时允许 s = 1 处的主极点。

sentences.en: In particular, the Riemann zeta function is zero-free in this half-plane, proving the quasi-Riemann hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 特别地，Riemann zeta 函数在该半平面内无零点，从而证明了准 Riemann 猜想。

sentences.en: We establish the quasi-Riemann hypothesis by proving that every Dirichlet L-function, including Riemann's zeta function, has no zeros in the half-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{Re}}\nolimits s\gt 11/12`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明每个 Dirichlet L 函数，包括 Riemann zeta 函数，在半平面 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Re}}\nolimits s\gt 11/12`$ 内都没有零点，由此确立了准 Riemann 猜想。

sentences.en: More generally, we prove the same zero-free half-plane for every finite-order Hecke L-function over $`K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，我们证明，$`K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$ 上每个有限阶 Hecke L 函数都具有相同的无零点半平面。

sentences.en: In particular, this rules out the existence of Landau–Siegel zeros.
sentences.zh: 特别地，这排除了 Landau–Siegel 零点的存在。

sentences.en: We prove the uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了对 Landau–Siegel 零点的一致排除结论。

sentences.en: There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero $`\beta\in(0,1)`$ of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L-function of conductor q ≥ 3 satisfies $`(1-\beta)\log q\ge c`$.
sentences.zh: 存在一个绝对常数 c > 0，使得导子为 q ≥ 3 的每个本原、非主、实 Dirichlet L 函数的每个实零点 $`\beta\in(0,1)`$ 都满足 $`(1-\beta)\log q\ge c`$。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to Hilbert's tenth problem over the rational numbers: no algorithm decides whether a polynomial with integer coefficients has a rational zero.
sentences.zh: 我们对有理数域上的 Hilbert 第十问题给出了否定回答：不存在判定一个整系数多项式是否有有理零点的算法。

sentences.en: The number of variables is part of the input.
sentences.zh: 变量个数是输入的一部分。

sentences.en: We prove a pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves over $`\mathbf Q`$ with nonzero rational two-torsion: if the $`2^\infty`$-Selmer corank is zero or one, then the analytic rank and Mordell–Weil rank equal that corank, and the Shafarevich–Tate group is finite.
sentences.zh: 我们对 $`\mathbf Q`$ 上具有非零有理二阶挠点的椭圆曲线证明了逐条曲线成立的 2-逆命题：若 $`2^\infty`$-Selmer 余秩为零或一，则解析秩和 Mordell–Weil 秩等于该余秩，且 Shafarevich–Tate 群有限。

sentences.en: The result allows arbitrary reduction at 2.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许在 2 处有任意约化类型。

sentences.en: We prove that Catalan's constant $`G=\sum_{j\geq0}(-1)^j/(2j+1)^2`$ is irrational.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Catalan 常数 $`G=\sum_{j\geq0}(-1)^j/(2j+1)^2`$ 是无理数。

sentences.en: We prove Goldfeld's analytic density conjecture: for every elliptic curve E over ℚ, the quadratic twists of E with analytic rank zero and one each have density 1/2 among signed squarefree twist parameters ordered by absolute value.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Goldfeld 的解析秩密度猜想：对于 ℚ 上的每条椭圆曲线 E，在按绝对值排序的带符号无平方因子扭曲参数中，E 的解析秩为零和一的二次扭曲各具有密度 1/2。

sentences.en: We also prove the low-corank 2-converse: if the $`2^\infty`$-Selmer corank of E is zero or one, then it equals the analytic and Mordell–Weil ranks, and the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了低余秩的 2-逆命题：若 E 的 $`2^\infty`$-Selmer 余秩为零或一，则它等于解析秩和 Mordell–Weil 秩，且 Tate–Shafarevich 群有限。

sentences.en: For every elliptic curve over ℚ, we prove that the average analytic rank of its quadratic twists tends to 1/2 when signed squarefree twist parameters are ordered by absolute value.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℚ 上的每条椭圆曲线，我们证明，当带符号的无平方因子扭曲参数按绝对值排序时，其二次扭曲的平均解析秩趋于 1/2。

sentences.en: This resolves Goldfeld's mean analytic-rank conjecture in this counting convention.
sentences.zh: 这解决了这一计数约定下的 Goldfeld 平均解析秩猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the ordinary two-point Chowla conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了普通平均下的二点 Chowla 猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed pair of nonproportional affine forms, the Liouville correlation has a power-of-logarithm saving at every cutoff, with an absolute exponent.
sentences.zh: 对于每对固定的不成比例的仿射形式，Liouville 相关和在每个截断位置都有一个对数幂量级的节省，且指数为绝对常数。

sentences.en: We also prove the binary corrected Elliott conjecture for ordinary averages of complex multiplicative functions of modulus at most one, under uniform nonpretentiousness of at least one original factor.
sentences.zh: 对于模至多为一的复值乘法函数的普通平均，在至少一个原始因子满足一致 nonpretentiousness 条件的假设下，我们还证明了二元修正版 Elliott 猜想。

sentences.en: This qualitative conclusion holds in fixed residue classes and for fixed nonproportional affine forms.
sentences.zh: 这一定性结论在固定剩余类中以及对固定的不成比例的仿射形式均成立。

sentences.en: We prove the Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture: the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is freely generated by one element in every odd weight at least three, with the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Deligne–Drinfeld 猜想：有理 Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie 代数由每个至少为三的奇权中的一个元素自由生成，并且在按权完备化后有相应的同构。

sentences.en: We prove a mod-ℓ Bogomolov–Pop reconstruction theorem for function fields of transcendence degree at least two over arbitrary algebraically closed fields of characteristic different from ℓ.
sentences.zh: 我们对特征不等于 ℓ 的任意代数闭域上超越次数至少为二的函数域证明了模 ℓ 的 Bogomolov–Pop 重构定理。

sentences.en: The groups $`K^{\mathrm M}_1/\ell`$ and $`K^{\mathrm M}_2/\ell`$, together with their full bilinear product, determine the perfect closure and its constant field.
sentences.zh: 群 $`K^{\mathrm M}_1/\ell`$ 和 $`K^{\mathrm M}_2/\ell`$ 连同它们的完整双线性乘积，决定了完美闭包及其常数域。

sentences.en: Every compatible isomorphism of these data is induced by a field isomorphism up to a single scalar in $`\mathbb F_\ell^\times`$, with only Frobenius ambiguity in the field isomorphism in positive characteristic.
sentences.zh: 这些数据之间的每个相容同构，在相差 $`\mathbb F_\ell^\times`$ 中的一个统一标量的意义下，均由一个域同构诱导；在正特征情形，该域同构仅有 Frobenius 歧义。

sentences.en: Let K and L be finitely generated extensions of transcendence degree at least two over algebraically closed fields of characteristic p.
sentences.zh: 设 K 和 L 是特征为 p 的代数闭域上超越次数至少为二的有限生成扩张。

sentences.en: We prove that every isomorphism of their first Milnor K-groups modulo p preserving the degree-two Steinberg relations is a nonzero scalar multiple of the map induced by a unique field isomorphism.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，它们的第一 Milnor K 群模 p 后，保持二次 Steinberg 关系的每个同构都是由唯一域同构诱导的映射的一个非零标量倍。

sentences.en: The proof recovers projective lines over the subfields of pth powers by an elementary calculation with derivations.
sentences.zh: 该证明通过关于导子的初等计算，恢复了以 p 次幂组成的子域上的射影直线。

sentences.en: We prove the Bogomolov–Pop reconstruction conjecture for function fields of transcendence degree at least two over arbitrary algebraically closed fields of characteristic different from ℓ.
sentences.zh: 我们对特征不等于 ℓ 的任意代数闭域上超越次数至少为二的函数域证明了 Bogomolov–Pop 重构猜想。

sentences.en: The pro-ℓ abelian-by-central datum determines the perfect closure and its constant field, with precisely the Frobenius and ℓ-adic unit ambiguities.
sentences.zh: pro-ℓ abelian-by-central 数据决定了完美闭包及其常数域，且歧义恰好为 Frobenius 歧义和 ℓ 进单位歧义。

sentences.en: Every continuous, odd, absolutely irreducible two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$ that is unramified outside finitely many finite primes occurs in the full completed Hecke algebra at some odd tame level.
sentences.zh: $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$ 的每个连续、奇、绝对不可约的二维 2 进表示，只要在有限多个有限素点之外非分歧，就在某个奇的驯水平下的完整完备 Hecke 代数中出现。

sentences.en: The level may contain auxiliary tame primes, and scalar and reducible residual representations are included.
sentences.zh: 该水平可以包含辅助的驯素数，且该结果涵盖标量及可约的剩余表示。

sentences.en: This is a completed-Hecke occurrence result, with no de Rham hypothesis; it does not assert classical modularity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于在完备 Hecke 代数中出现的结果，无须 de Rham 假设；它并不声称经典模性。

sentences.en: For every odd positive integer N, every irreducible component of the full two-adic Hecke algebra of level $`\Gamma_1(N)`$ has Krull dimension four.
sentences.zh: 对于每个奇正整数 N，水平为 $`\Gamma_1(N)`$ 的完整二进 Hecke 代数的每个不可约分支的 Krull 维数均为四。

sentences.en: This proves the p = 2 case of Emerton's dimension conjecture, including all residual components.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Emerton 维数猜想中 p = 2 的情形，包括所有剩余分支。

sentences.en: We prove that every continuous, irreducible, odd two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$, unramified outside finitely many primes and de Rham at 2 with distinct Hodge–Tate weights, is modular up to Tate twist.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`G_{\mathbb Q}`$ 的每个连续、不可约、奇的二维 2 进表示，只要在有限多个素数之外非分歧，且在 2 处为 de Rham 并具有互异的 Hodge–Tate 权，就在相差 Tate 扭曲的意义下具有模性。

sentences.en: This resolves the odd, regular two-dimensional Fontaine–Mazur conjecture over ℚ at 2, including all residual representations.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 ℚ 上在 2 处的奇、正则二维 Fontaine–Mazur 猜想，包括所有剩余表示。

sentences.en: We prove Erdős's conjecture on the largest fibers of Euler's totient function: for every ε > 0, infinitely many positive integers n have more than $`n^{1-\varepsilon }`$ preimages.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Erdős 关于 Euler 函数最大纤维的猜想：对于每个 ε > 0，都有无穷多个正整数 n 具有多于 $`n^{1-\varepsilon }`$ 个原像。

sentences.en: We also show that, for every fixed δ > 0, there are at least $`x^{1-o(1)}`$ primes p in $`2x\lt p\le5x`$ whose predecessors have no prime factor exceeding xδ.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，对于每个固定的 δ > 0，$`2x\lt p\le5x`$ 中至少有 $`x^{1-o(1)}`$ 个素数 p，其前驱数没有超过 xδ 的素因子。

sentences.en: For a prime p chosen uniformly from $`3\le p\le x`$, list the prime factors of $`p-1`$ in decreasing order, with multiplicity.
sentences.zh: 对于从 $`3\le p\le x`$ 中均匀选取的素数 p，将 $`p-1`$ 的素因子计重数按降序排列。

sentences.en: As $`x\to\infty`$, their logarithms, divided by $`\log(p-1)`$, converge in every finite joint distribution to the Poisson–Dirichlet distribution with parameter one.
sentences.zh: 当 $`x\to\infty`$ 时，它们的对数除以 $`\log(p-1)`$ 后，在每个有限维联合分布意义下都收敛于参数为一的 Poisson–Dirichlet 分布。

sentences.en: This proves the conjecture of Ford, Konyagin and Luca.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Ford、Konyagin 和 Luca 的猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that there are infinitely many primes p for which $`p-1`$ is squarefree and has an even number of prime factors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，存在无穷多个素数 p，使得 $`p-1`$ 无平方因子且具有偶数个素因子。

sentences.en: Equivalently, there are infinitely many primes p with $`\mu(p-1)=1`$.
sentences.zh: 等价地，存在无穷多个满足 $`\mu(p-1)=1`$ 的素数 p。

sentences.en: Let $`P^+(n)`$ denote the largest prime factor of n.
sentences.zh: 设 $`P^+(n)`$ 表示 n 的最大素因子。

sentences.en: We prove that $`\log P^+(n)/\log n`$ and $`\log P^+(n+1)/\log n`$ are asymptotically independent in ordinary natural density, with Dickman marginals.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`\log P^+(n)/\log n`$ 和 $`\log P^+(n+1)/\log n`$ 在普通自然密度意义下渐近独立，且边缘分布为 Dickman 分布。

sentences.en: This resolves the Erdős–Pomerance joint Dickman conjecture positively and implies that the ordering $`P^+(n)\lt P^+(n+1)`$ has natural density 1/2.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Erdős–Pomerance 联合 Dickman 猜想，并推出次序关系 $`P^+(n)\lt P^+(n+1)`$ 的自然密度为 1/2。

sentences.en: We prove Ostmann's inverse Goldbach conjecture: no set differing from the primes by finitely many elements can be written as $`A+B`$, where A and B are sets of nonnegative integers with at least two elements each.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Ostmann 的逆 Goldbach 猜想：任何与素数集仅相差有限多个元素的集合都不能写成 $`A+B`$，其中 A 和 B 是各自至少含两个元素的非负整数集合。

sentences.en: Under the finite-level Ramanujan–Arthur decomposition stated in Theorem 1.1, we construct a global Arthur enhancement for every occurring cuspidal excursion parameter at a specified full finite level for a split connected semisimple group over a global function field.
sentences.zh: 在定理 1.1 所述有限水平 Ramanujan–Arthur 分解的假设下，对于整体函数域上的分裂连通半单群，我们为在指定有限全水平上出现的每个尖点 excursion 参数构造一个整体 Arthur 增强。

sentences.en: A single algebraic SL<sub>2</sub> and a commuting Weil centralizer map recover the given parameter by diagonal specialization on the entire Weil group, including inertia.
sentences.zh: 一个代数 SL<sub>2</sub> 与一个和它交换的 Weil 中心化子映射，通过在整个 Weil 群上作对角特化恢复给定参数，其中包括惯性群。

sentences.en: The result does not assert ellipticity, Arthur-packet classification, or a multiplicity formula.
sentences.zh: 该结果并不声称椭圆性、Arthur 包分类或重数公式。

sentences.en: Under the characteristic hypotheses of restricted geometric Langlands theory, we prove that the canonical Arthur filtration on finitely supported unramified automorphic functions is defined over ℚ for split connected semisimple groups.
sentences.zh: 在受限几何 Langlands 理论的特征假设下，我们证明，对于分裂连通半单群，有限支撑非分歧自守函数上的典范 Arthur 滤过在 ℚ 上有定义。

sentences.en: The result includes the noncuspidal part and every closed invariant nilpotent support, establishing the rationality conjecture of Gaitsgory–Lafforgue–Raskin in this setting.
sentences.zh: 该结果涵盖非尖点部分和每个闭的不变幂零支撑，从而确立了这一情形下 Gaitsgory–Lafforgue–Raskin 的有理性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove rational and $`\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell`$ decompositions of cuspidal automorphic functions for split semisimple groups over global function fields into subspaces indexed by nilpotent orbits of the dual group.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，整体函数域上的分裂半单群的尖点自守函数具有有理分解和 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell`$ 分解，其分量为由对偶群的幂零轨道索引的子空间。

sentences.en: The decompositions hold at every full finite level, with arbitrary divisor multiplicities.
sentences.zh: 这些分解在每个有限全水平上都成立，并允许任意除子重数。

sentences.en: Each summand is governed by the same orbit at every unramified place and every complex embedding.
sentences.zh: 每个直和项在每个非分歧地方和每个复嵌入处都由同一个轨道控制。

sentences.en: At trivial level this proves Conjectures 3.4.5 and 3.4.6 of Gaitsgory–Lafforgue–Raskin.
sentences.zh: 在平凡水平下，这证明了 Gaitsgory–Lafforgue–Raskin 的猜想 3.4.5 和 3.4.6。

sentences.en: For split connected adjoint absolutely simple groups, we also prove that a cuspidal automorphic representation with one generic unramified local component is tempered at every unramified place.
sentences.zh: 对于分裂、连通、伴随、绝对单群，我们还证明，若一个尖点自守表示有一个 generic 的非分歧局部分量，则它在每个非分歧地方都是缓增的。

sentences.en: Thus globally generic cuspidal representations in this scope satisfy the unramified part of the generalized Ramanujan conjecture.
sentences.zh: 因此，这一范围内的整体 generic 尖点表示满足广义 Ramanujan 猜想的非分歧部分。

sentences.en: We prove the generalized Ramanujan conjecture for globally generic cuspidal automorphic representations of split connected adjoint exceptional groups over global function fields.
sentences.zh: 我们对整体函数域上的分裂连通伴随例外群的整体 generic 尖点自守表示证明了广义 Ramanujan 猜想。

sentences.en: Every local component is tempered, without restrictions on characteristic or ramification depth.
sentences.zh: 每个局部分量都是缓增的，且对特征或分歧深度没有限制。

sentences.en: The proof extends the unramified Ramanujan theorem of a companion paper to all ramified places.
sentences.zh: 该证明将配套论文中的非分歧 Ramanujan 定理推广到了所有分歧地方。

sentences.en: We prove the $`\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell`$-linear restricted geometric Langlands equivalence for smooth projective connected curves and connected reductive groups in characteristic p > 0, with ℓ ≠ p, in two regimes.
sentences.zh: 对于特征 p > 0 下的光滑射影连通曲线及连通约化群，在 ℓ ≠ p 时，我们在两种情形下证明了 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}_\ell`$ 线性的受限几何 Langlands 等价。

sentences.en: Over $`\overline{\mathbb F}_q`$, we assume the four characteristic conditions of the restricted theory stated below.
sentences.zh: 在 $`\overline{\mathbb F}_q`$ 上，我们假设下文所述受限理论的四个特征条件成立。

sentences.en: Over arbitrary algebraically closed fields, we assume these conditions and additionally that p is very good and does not divide the Weyl-group order.
sentences.zh: 在任意代数闭域上，我们假设这些条件成立，并进一步假设 p 是 very good 素数且不整除 Weyl 群的阶。

sentences.en: This proves Gaitsgory–Raskin's full-support conjecture [[12, Conjecture 1.3.10]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02237v1) in these regimes.
sentences.zh: 这证明了这些情形下 Gaitsgory–Raskin 的全支撑猜想 [[12, Conjecture 1.3.10]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02237v1)。

sentences.en: We construct nonzero locally constructible perverse Hecke eigensheaves with Borel level at one marked point on a smooth projective curve of genus at least two over an algebraic closure of a finite field.
sentences.zh: 在有限域的代数闭包上一条亏格至少为二的光滑射影曲线上，我们构造了非零的局部可构造反常 Hecke 特征层，并在一个标记点处带有 Borel 水平结构。

sentences.en: The parameter is a Zariski-dense geometric ℓ-adic local system with tame regular-unipotent monodromy.
sentences.zh: 其参数是一个 Zariski 稠密的几何 ℓ 进局部系统，具有驯的正则幺幂单值性。

sentences.en: The group is simple and simply connected and satisfies four explicit Lie-theoretic characteristic hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 该群为单且单连通的，并满足四个明确的 Lie 理论特征假设。

sentences.en: The eigensheaves have parabolic nilpotent singular support, and their eigenisomorphisms are compatible with tensor products, permutations, and fusion.
sentences.zh: 这些特征层具有抛物幂零奇异支撑，其特征同构与张量积、置换和融合相容。

sentences.en: For SLn in characteristic p > n, we construct nonzero locally constructible perverse Hecke eigensheaves with Borel level at two or more marked points on a smooth projective curve of genus at least two over an algebraic closure of a finite field.
sentences.zh: 对于特征为 p > n 的 SLn，在有限域的代数闭包上一条亏格至少为二的光滑射影曲线上，我们构造了非零的局部可构造反常 Hecke 特征层，并在两个或更多标记点处带有 Borel 水平结构。

sentences.en: The parameter is a Zariski-dense geometric ℓ-adic PGLn-local system with unipotent tame monodromy; its nilpotent logarithms may have any Jordan type, including zero.
sentences.zh: 其参数是一个 Zariski 稠密的几何 ℓ 进 PGLn 局部系统，具有幺幂驯单值性；其幂零对数可以具有任意 Jordan 型，包括零。

sentences.en: The eigensheaves have parabolic nilpotent singular support, and their eigenisomorphisms retain the full tensor and fusion structure.
sentences.zh: 这些特征层具有抛物幂零奇异支撑，且其特征同构保留完整的张量和融合结构。

sentences.en: We construct nonzero perverse Weil Hecke eigensheaves for SLn with Borel level at one marked point, after a finite extension of the field of constants.
sentences.zh: 经过常数域的一个有限扩张后，我们为 SLn 构造了非零的反常 Weil Hecke 特征层，并在一个标记点处带有 Borel 水平结构。

sentences.en: The parameter is a geometrically dense arithmetic PGLn-local system with tame regular-unipotent monodromy on a once-punctured curve of genus at least two over a finite field of characteristic p > n.
sentences.zh: 其参数是特征为 p > n 的有限域上一条亏格至少为二、去掉一个点的曲线上的算术 PGLn 局部系统，该局部系统几何稠密，并具有驯的正则幺幂单值性。

sentences.en: The full multi-leg eigenstructure is Frobenius compatible with the prescribed arithmetic eigenvalue, and the geometric sheaf has parabolic nilpotent singular support.
sentences.zh: 完整的多腿特征结构与 Frobenius 相容，并具有指定的算术特征值，且几何层具有抛物幂零奇异支撑。

sentences.en: We prove the packet form of the higher-dimensional Duke equidistribution problem for totally real fields of any fixed prime degree at least five, allowing arbitrary local homothety types of full lattices.
sentences.zh: 对于任意固定的至少为五的素数次数的全实域，我们证明了高维 Duke 等分布问题的包形式，允许满格具有任意局部位似类型。

sentences.en: As the multiplier-order discriminant tends to infinity, the volume-weighted packet measures converge to Haar probability measure, with no escape of mass.
sentences.zh: 当乘子整序的判别式趋于无穷时，以体积加权的包测度收敛到 Haar 概率测度，且没有质量逃逸。

sentences.en: Let K range over totally real quartic fields with no proper intermediate field, and let $`\mathcal O`$ be any order in K.
sentences.zh: 设 K 遍历没有真中间域的全实四次域，并设 $`\mathcal O`$ 是 K 中的任意整序。

sentences.en: We prove that the packets of periodic diagonal orbits attached to invertible $`\mathcal O`$-ideal classes, weighted by orbit volume, equidistribute with no escape of mass as $`|\mathop{\mathrm{Disc}}\nolimits (\mathcal O)|`$ tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，当 $`|\mathop{\mathrm{Disc}}\nolimits (\mathcal O)|`$ 趋于无穷时，与可逆 $`\mathcal O`$ 理想类对应的周期对角轨道包在按轨道体积加权后趋于等分布，且没有质量逃逸。

sentences.en: The proof combines measure rigidity with a cubic-resolvent estimate that remains uniform at primes dividing the order index.
sentences.zh: 该证明结合了测度刚性与一个三次预解式估计，后者在整除整序指数的素数处仍保持一致性。

sentences.en: We prove that the complete ideal-class packets of maximal orders in totally real sextic fields with no proper intermediate fields become equidistributed, with no escape of mass, in the space of unimodular lattices as their field discriminants tend to infinity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，当域判别式趋于无穷时，没有真中间域的全实六次域的极大整序所对应的完整理想类包，在幺模格空间中趋于等分布，且没有质量逃逸。

sentences.en: The limit is Haar probability measure.
sentences.zh: 其极限是 Haar 概率测度。

sentences.en: Each packet includes all coordinate-sign translates and is weighted by diagonal-orbit volume.
sentences.zh: 每个包都包含在所有坐标符号变换作用下的像，并以对角轨道的体积加权。

sentences.en: We prove the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ 上的阿贝尔 Zilber–Pink 猜想。

sentences.en: Every irreducible subvariety of an abelian variety has only finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties, where atypicality is measured inside its smallest containing torsion coset.
sentences.zh: 阿贝尔簇的每个不可约子簇都只有有限多个极大非典型子簇，其中非典型性是在包含原不可约子簇的最小挠陪集中衡量的。

sentences.en: We prove the $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ component of Zilber–Pink for Hodge-generic algebraic curves in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们对 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ 上 $`\mathcal A_2`$ 中的 Hodge-generic 代数曲线证明了 Zilber–Pink 猜想的 $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ 部分。

sentences.en: Each such curve contains only finitely many points whose abelian surface is isogenous to a product of elliptic curves with at least one factor having complex multiplication.
sentences.zh: 每条这样的曲线都只包含有限多个点，使得其对应的阿贝尔曲面同源于两个椭圆曲线的乘积，且至少一个因子具有复乘。

sentences.en: We prove the quaternionic-division component of Zilber–Pink for curves in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们对 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ 上 $`\mathcal A_2`$ 中的曲线证明了 Zilber–Pink 猜想的四元数除代数部分。

sentences.en: A Hodge-generic algebraic curve contains only finitely many points whose full geometric rational endomorphism algebra is an indefinite quaternion division algebra over ℚ.
sentences.zh: 一条 Hodge-generic 代数曲线只包含有限多个点，使得其完整的几何有理自同态代数是 ℚ 上的不定四元数除代数。

sentences.en: No boundary or reduction hypothesis is required.
sentences.zh: 无须任何边界或约化假设。

sentences.en: We prove that every Hodge-generic algebraic curve in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ contains only finitely many points whose abelian surface is isogenous to the square of an elliptic curve without complex multiplication (CM).
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ 上 $`\mathcal A_2`$ 中每条 Hodge-generic 代数曲线都只包含有限多个点，使得其对应的阿贝尔曲面同源于一条无复乘（CM）椭圆曲线的平方。

sentences.en: Combining this result with the companion $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ and quaternionic-division finiteness theorems, we prove the curve case of Zilber–Pink in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$, without a boundary hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 将该结果与配套的 $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ 及四元数除代数有限性定理相结合，我们证明了 $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ 上 $`\mathcal A_2`$ 中曲线情形的 Zilber–Pink 猜想，而无须边界假设。

sentences.en: We prove the conjecture that the irrationality exponent of π is 2.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 π 的无理性指数为 2 的猜想。

sentences.en: As a consequence, the classical Flint–Hills series $`\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)`$ converges, with angles in radians.
sentences.zh: 由此可知，经典的 Flint–Hills 级数 $`\sum_{n\ge1}1/(n^3\sin^2 n)`$ 收敛，其中角度以弧度计。

sentences.en: We prove the Margulis–Platonov conjecture over every global function field, including characteristic two.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个整体函数域上的 Margulis–Platonov 猜想，包括特征为二的情形。

sentences.en: For an absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic group, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of its rational points is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the finite product of its anisotropic local groups.
sentences.zh: 对于一个绝对殆单且单连通的代数群，其有理点群的每个非中心抽象正规子群，都是其各向异性局部群的有限乘积中一个开正规子群的原像。

sentences.en: We prove the Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了数域上的 Margulis–Platonov 猜想。

sentences.en: For an absolutely almost simple simply connected group, every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of its rational points is the inverse image of an open normal subgroup of the product of its anisotropic nonarchimedean local groups.
sentences.zh: 对于一个绝对殆单且单连通的群，其有理点群的每个非中心抽象正规子群，都是其各向异性非阿基米德局部群的乘积中一个开正规子群的原像。

sentences.en: Let X be a smooth proper hyperbolic curve over an algebraic closure of a p-adic local field.
sentences.zh: 设 X 是一个 p 进局部域的代数闭包上的光滑固有双曲曲线。

sentences.en: Given finitely many disjoint small open disks, we construct one connected finite étale cover with a sheet isomorphic to their entire exterior and with degree divisible by p on every connected component above each disk.
sentences.zh: 给定有限多个互不相交的小开圆盘，我们构造一个连通的有限 étale 覆盖，其中有一层同构于这些圆盘的整个外部，并且在每个圆盘上方的每个连通分支上，覆盖次数都能被 p 整除。

sentences.en: We prove the local p-adic section conjecture for smooth proper geometrically connected curves of genus at least two, over every finite extension of ℚp.
sentences.zh: 在 ℚp 的每个有限扩张上，我们对亏格至少为二的光滑固有几何连通曲线证明了局部 p 进截面猜想。

sentences.en: Combined with established finite-descent theorems, this also yields the global section conjecture for smooth proper geometrically connected curves of genus at least two over number fields when their finite-cover descent locus equals their rational points; this includes $`X_0(N)`$ and $`X_1(N)`$ of genus at least two over ℚ.
sentences.zh: 结合已有的有限下降定理，对于数域上亏格至少为二的光滑固有几何连通曲线，当其有限覆盖下降点集等于其有理点集时，这也给出了整体截面猜想；这包括 ℚ 上亏格至少为二的 $`X_0(N)`$ 和 $`X_1(N)`$。

sentences.en: We prove that every irreducible integer quartic with no fixed prime-square divisor takes squarefree values with the predicted positive Euler-product density.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个没有固定素数平方因子的不可约四次整系数多项式，都以所预期的正 Euler 乘积密度取到无平方因子的值。

sentences.en: More generally, we obtain the corresponding $`(d-2)`$-power-free density in degrees $`4\le d\le8`$.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，我们在次数 $`4\le d\le8`$ 下得到了相应的无 $`(d-2)`$ 次幂因子值的密度。

sentences.en: The proof combines number-field factorization, determinant estimates with adaptive auxiliary primes, and explicit low-degree geometry.
sentences.zh: 该证明结合了数域分解、使用自适应辅助素数的行列式估计，以及明确的低次数几何。

sentences.en: Together with Browning's theorem for higher degrees, this gives the $`(d-2)`$-power-free density for every d ≥ 4.
sentences.zh: 结合 Browning 对更高次数的定理，这给出了每个 d ≥ 4 下无 $`(d-2)`$ 次幂因子值的密度。
