sentences.en: Let $`h(k)`$ be the least integer such that every interval of $`h(k)`$ consecutive integers contains an integer coprime to any prescribed positive integer having at most k distinct prime divisors.
sentences.zh: 设 $`h(k)`$ 是满足如下性质的最小整数：对于任意指定的、至多具有 k 个不同素因子的正整数，每个包含 $`h(k)`$ 个连续整数的区间都含有一个与之互素的整数。

sentences.en: We prove $`h(k)\ll k^2/(\log\log(3k))^2`$, giving an affirmative answer to Jacobsthal's quadratic-bound question.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 $`h(k)\ll k^2/(\log\log(3k))^2`$，从而肯定地回答了 Jacobsthal 的二次界问题。

sentences.en: We prove the weak inhomogeneous Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了弱非齐次 Duffin–Schaeffer 猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed γ ∈ ℝ and finite-valued $`\psi:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty)`$, divergence of $`\sum_{q\ge1}\phi(q)\psi(q)/q`$ implies $`\|qx-\gamma\|\lt \psi(q)`$ for infinitely many q, for almost every x.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 γ ∈ ℝ 及取有限值的 $`\psi:\mathbb N\to[0,\infty)`$，$`\sum_{q\ge1}\phi(q)\psi(q)/q`$ 发散蕴含：对几乎每个 x，都有无穷多个 q 使 $`\|qx-\gamma\|\lt \psi(q)`$ 成立。

sentences.en: Here ϕ is Euler's totient and $`\|\cdot\|`$ is distance to the nearest integer.
sentences.zh: 这里，ϕ 是 Euler 函数，而 $`\|\cdot\|`$ 是到最近整数的距离。

sentences.en: Numerators need not be reduced, and the shift satisfies no Diophantine restriction.
sentences.zh: 分子不必与分母互素，且平移量无须满足任何丢番图限制。

sentences.en: We prove Patterson's first-moment conjecture for normalized cubic Gauss sums over all primary Eisenstein primes, unconditionally.
sentences.zh: 我们无条件地证明了 Patterson 关于所有 primary Eisenstein 素数上的归一化三次 Gauss 和的一阶矩猜想。

sentences.en: The sharp-cutoff main term is $`(6/5)c_*X^{5/6}/\log X`$, where $`c_*=(2\pi)^{2/3}/(3\Gamma(2/3))`$.
For every fixed nonzero angular Fourier mode of the prime argument, we also prove cancellation at the first-moment scale.
sentences.zh: 对于这些素数辐角的每个固定非零角向 Fourier 模式，我们还证明了在一阶矩尺度上的抵消。

sentences.en: Let $`V(x)`$ count the distinct values of Euler's totient function up to x.
sentences.zh: 设 $`V(x)`$ 计数 Euler 函数不超过 x 的不同取值。

sentences.en: We give an explicit asymptotic equivalent for $`V(x)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了 $`V(x)`$ 的一个明确的渐近等价式。

sentences.en: Its coefficient is a uniform limit of functions defined from finite arithmetic data.
sentences.zh: 其系数是由有限算术数据定义的函数的一致极限。

sentences.en: We also prove that $`V(cx)/V(x)\to c`$ as $`x\to\infty`$ for every fixed c > 0, answering a question of Erdős and Hall.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，对于每个固定的 c > 0，当 $`x\to\infty`$ 时有 $`V(cx)/V(x)\to c`$，从而回答了 Erdős 和 Hall 的一个问题。

sentences.en: We prove a conjecture of Erdős: for every sufficiently large integer b, every rational number $`a/b`$ with $`1\le a\lt b`$ is a sum of $`O(\log\log b)`$ distinct positive unit fractions, with an absolute implied constant.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Erdős 的一个猜想：对于每个充分大的整数 b，每个满足 $`1\le a\lt b`$ 的有理数 $`a/b`$ 都是 $`O(\log\log b)`$ 个不同的正单位分数之和，其中隐含常数为绝对常数。

sentences.en: This order is best possible when the numerator varies.
sentences.zh: 当分子变化时，这一量级是最优的。

sentences.en: We also show that both the number of expansions of 1 with exactly k distinct terms and the least integer at least 2 that never occurs as a denominator in such an expansion grow doubly exponentially in k: their double logarithms have order k.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，1 的恰含 k 个不同项的展开的数量，以及从不出现在这种展开中作为分母的、至少为 2 的最小整数，都随 k 双指数增长：它们的双重对数的量级为 k。

sentences.en: For every fixed C > 0, we prove that a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $`C\log p`$, where p is the smaller prime.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 C > 0，我们证明，有正比例的相邻素数间隙超过 $`C\log p`$，其中 p 是较小的素数。

sentences.en: The proportion is bounded below for every sufficiently large initial segment of the prime sequence, with a constant depending on C.
sentences.zh: 对于素数序列的每个充分长的初始段，该比例都有一个下界，其常数依赖于 C。

sentences.en: It follows that the indices at which $`p_n/n`$ increases have positive lower asymptotic density, answering a question of Erdős and Prachar.
sentences.zh: 由此可知，$`p_n/n`$ 增大的那些指标具有正的下渐近密度，从而回答了 Erdős 和 Prachar 的一个问题。

sentences.en: We prove potential Zariski density of integral points on SLr-character varieties of smooth complex curves in every rank.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了光滑复曲线在每个秩下的 SLr 特征标簇上整点的潜在 Zariski 稠密性。

sentences.en: The result allows prescribed quasi-unipotent boundary monodromy, including exact nonsemisimple conjugacy classes, and holds on every component over the full ring of integers of one finite extension.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许指定拟幺幂边界单值性，包括精确指定的非半单共轭类，并且在同一个有限扩张的完整整数环上，对每个分支都成立。

sentences.en: Here integrality is measured in the ambient character variety, while the exact boundary conditions are imposed on the complex representation.
sentences.zh: 这里，整性是在所在的特征标簇中衡量的，而精确的边界条件则施加于复表示。

sentences.en: We prove the Gaussian moat conjecture: no infinite walk through distinct Gaussian primes can have bounded steps.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了高斯壕沟猜想：经过互不相同的高斯素数的任何无限游走都不可能具有有界步长。

sentences.en: More strongly, for each fixed finite step bound, the connected components of the Gaussian-prime graph have uniformly bounded size.
sentences.zh: 更强地，对于每个固定的有限步长上界，高斯素数图的连通分支大小都具有一致上界。

sentences.en: This bound applies to every starting prime, including primes on the coordinate axes, and is nonexplicit.
sentences.zh: 这个上界适用于每个起始素数，包括坐标轴上的素数，且不是显式的。

sentences.en: The proof constructs a finite periodic sieve obstruction using geometric sampling and information-theoretic estimates.
sentences.zh: 该证明利用几何采样和信息论估计，构造了一个有限的周期性筛法障碍。

sentences.en: We prove the infinitude assertion in Artin's primitive root conjecture: for every integer a that is neither −1 nor a square, there are at least $`c_a x/(\log x)^2`$ primes in $`(x,2x)`$ with primitive root a, for some $`c_a\gt 0`$ and every sufficiently large x.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Artin 原根猜想中的无穷性断言：对于每个既不是 −1 也不是平方数的整数 a，存在某个 $`c_a\gt 0`$，使得对每个充分大的 x，$`(x,2x)`$ 中至少有 $`c_a x/(\log x)^2`$ 个素数以 a 为原根。

sentences.en: For every fixed finite set of distinct positive primes, we prove that at least $`cx/(\log x)^2`$ primes in $`(x,2x)`$ have every member of the set as a primitive root, for some c > 0 and all sufficiently large x.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的、由互不相同的正素数组成的有限集合，我们证明，存在某个 c > 0，使得对所有充分大的 x，$`(x,2x)`$ 中至少有 $`cx/(\log x)^2`$ 个素数以该集合的每个元素为原根。

sentences.en: The result assumes four explicitly stated analytic and sieve inputs from the companion paper on primitive roots for admissible integer bases.
sentences.zh: 该结果以配套的关于容许整数底数的原根论文中明确陈述的四个解析及筛法输入为假设。

sentences.en: We prove the modularity conjecture for elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields: every such curve is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了虚二次域上椭圆曲线的模性猜想：每条这样的曲线都具有模性，且在每个位点的局部参数均匹配。

sentences.en: We prove Uchida's conjecture on open homomorphisms of Galois groups.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Uchida 关于 Galois 群的开同态的猜想。

sentences.en: Every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 数域的可解闭 Galois 扩张的 Galois 群之间，每个连续开同态都由反方向上唯一的等变域嵌入诱导。

sentences.en: No restriction on the kernel or additional compatibility hypothesis is required.
sentences.zh: 无须对核施加限制，也无须额外的相容性假设。

sentences.en: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for every finite product of projective complex K3 surfaces: every rational Hodge class is algebraic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了任意有限个射影复 K3 曲面的乘积的有理 Hodge 猜想：每个有理 Hodge 类都是代数的。

sentences.en: The factors may be distinct or repeated, with no restrictions on their Picard numbers, periods, or endomorphism fields.
sentences.zh: 各因子可以互不相同，也可以重复，且对它们的 Picard 数、周期或自同态域没有限制。

sentences.en: We prove that the Kuga–Satake correspondence is algebraic for every smooth projective complex K3 surface.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个光滑射影复 K3 曲面的 Kuga–Satake 对应都是代数的。

sentences.en: More precisely, the prescribed embedding of its transcendental cohomology into the cohomology of its Kuga–Satake abelian variety is induced by a rational algebraic cycle, with the fixed normalization and full even-Clifford target.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，其超越上同调到其 Kuga–Satake 阿贝尔簇的上同调中的指定嵌入，在固定的归一化及完整偶 Clifford 目标下，由一个有理系数代数闭链诱导。

sentences.en: The result also holds for isogenous Kuga–Satake models with the transported embedding.
sentences.zh: 该结果也适用于同源的 Kuga–Satake 模型及经传递得到的嵌入。

sentences.en: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for complex abelian varieties with complex multiplication: every rational Hodge class on such a variety is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycle classes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有复乘的复阿贝尔簇的有理 Hodge 猜想：这种簇上的每个有理 Hodge 类都是代数闭链类的有理线性组合。

sentences.en: As consequences, we obtain the generalized Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties, the Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields, and the Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in arbitrary characteristic.
sentences.zh: 由此，我们得到了 CM 阿贝尔簇的广义 Hodge 猜想、有限域上阿贝尔簇的 Tate 猜想，以及任意特征下阿贝尔簇的 Hodge 标准猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the rational Hodge and generalized Hodge conjectures in every cohomological degree of every self-power of a projective complex K3 surface whose transcendental quadratic space, with its cup-product form, admits a rational isometric embedding in $`\mathbb U_{\mathbb Q}^{\oplus2}\perp\langle-1\rangle^4`$.
sentences.zh: 对于超越二次空间连同其杯积形式能够有理等距嵌入 $`\mathbb U_{\mathbb Q}^{\oplus2}\perp\langle-1\rangle^4`$ 的射影复 K3 曲面，我们证明了其每个自身幂在每个上同调次数上的有理 Hodge 猜想及广义 Hodge 猜想。

sentences.en: This includes every ample P-polarized K3 surface, including all Picard jumps, for $`P=\mathbb U\oplus D_8(-1)\oplus D_4(-1)`$.
sentences.zh: 这包括 $`P=\mathbb U\oplus D_8(-1)\oplus D_4(-1)`$ 时每个丰沛 P 极化的 K3 曲面，并涵盖所有 Picard 数跳跃。

sentences.en: On this locus we construct algebraic correspondences inducing every prescribed standard even-Clifford Kuga–Satake tensor.
sentences.zh: 在这一点集上，我们构造了代数对应，诱导每个指定的标准偶 Clifford Kuga–Satake 张量。

sentences.en: More generally, for any projective complex K3 surface, algebraicity of one exact standard even-Clifford Kuga–Satake tensor implies both conjectures for every self-power.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于任意射影复 K3 曲面，一个精确的标准偶 Clifford Kuga–Satake 张量的代数性，就能推出其每个自身幂上的这两个猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture in every codimension on every self-power of a complex abelian sixfold with an imaginary-quadratic action and a compatible polarization whose rational homological Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature $`(3,3)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于带有虚二次域作用及相容极化、且其有理同调 Hermitian 形式为符号为 $`(3,3)`$ 的双曲形式的复六维阿贝尔簇，我们证明了其每个自身幂在每个余维上的有理 Hodge 猜想。

sentences.en: We also prove it in every codimension on every self-power of a complex abelian variety of dimension at most five admitting an imaginary-quadratic action.
sentences.zh: 对于每个允许虚二次域作用、维数至多为五的复阿贝尔簇，我们也证明了其每个自身幂在每个余维上的有理 Hodge 猜想。

sentences.en: Both results include nonsimple varieties and special periods with additional endomorphisms.
sentences.zh: 这两个结果都涵盖非单簇以及具有额外自同态的特殊周期。

sentences.en: The proof uses the companion theorem on the rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties.
sentences.zh: 该证明使用了配套的关于 CM 阿贝尔簇有理 Hodge 猜想的定理。

sentences.en: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture on every self-power of the Jacobian at each tensor Hodge-generic point of the full marked variation of a connected abelian cover of curves.
sentences.zh: 对于曲线的一个连通阿贝尔覆盖的完整带标记变分中的每个张量 Hodge-generic 点，我们证明了其 Jacobian 的每个自身幂上的有理 Hodge 猜想。

sentences.en: This holds in every base genus and for every compatible branching pattern.
sentences.zh: 这对基曲线的每个亏格及每种相容的分歧模式都成立。

sentences.en: For any CM abelian variety, the conclusion also holds for every self-power of its product with the Jacobian, on the same Hodge-generic locus.
sentences.zh: 对于任意 CM 阿贝尔簇，在相同的 Hodge-generic 点集上，结论也适用于它与该 Jacobian 的乘积的每个自身幂。

sentences.en: We also prove the conjecture on every self-power of a very general member of the full smooth labelled family of diagonal complete intersections cut out by at most two equations of a common degree, in every dimension and every degree at least two.
sentences.zh: 对于至多由两个相同次数的方程截出的对角完全交的完整光滑带标号族，我们还证明了其甚一般成员的每个自身幂上的该猜想，这对每个维数及每个至少为二的次数都成立。

sentences.en: We prove that every rational Weil class on a split abelian eightfold of Weil type is algebraic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，Weil 型的分裂八维阿贝尔簇上的每个有理 Weil 类都是代数的。

sentences.en: The result holds for every imaginary quadratic field, every compatible polarization type, and every member of the split family, including those with additional endomorphisms.
sentences.zh: 该结果对每个虚二次域、每种相容极化类型，以及该分裂族的每个成员都成立，包括具有额外自同态的成员。

sentences.en: Thus the full two-dimensional rational Weil space in codimension four is generated by algebraic cycle classes.
sentences.zh: 因此，余维为四的完整二维有理 Weil 空间由代数闭链类生成。

sentences.en: For a polarized K3 surface whose primitive cohomology has full orthogonal Hodge group, one algebraic correspondence inducing a nonzero map from that cohomology to the second cohomology of an abelian variety suffices to recover the prescribed full Kuga–Satake correspondence.
sentences.zh: 对于本原上同调的 Hodge 群为完整正交群的极化 K3 曲面，只要一个代数对应诱导了从该上同调到某个阿贝尔簇第二上同调的非零映射，就足以恢复指定的完整 Kuga–Satake 对应。

sentences.en: We give an equivalent condition using holomorphic one-forms on a generically finite surface cover.
sentences.zh: 我们利用一个泛有限的曲面覆盖上的全纯一形式，给出了一个等价条件。

sentences.en: If this input holds very generally in a polarized component, the prescribed correspondence is algebraic throughout that component, for every choice of standard data on the transcendental part.
sentences.zh: 若这一输入在某个极化分支上甚一般地成立，则对于超越部分上标准数据的每种选择，指定的对应在该分支处处都是代数的。

sentences.en: The existence of the initial correspondence remains a hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 初始对应的存在性仍是一项假设。

sentences.en: We prove Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for rational simple normal crossing boundaries on compact manifolds in Fujiki class $`\mathcal C`$, including coefficient one.
sentences.zh: 对于 Fujiki 类 $`\mathcal C`$ 中的紧流形上的有理简单正规交叉边界，我们证明了 Campana 的轨形 Iitaka 次可加性猜想，包括系数为一的情形。

sentences.en: Ordinary and logarithmic subadditivity follow.
sentences.zh: 普通次可加性和对数次可加性随之成立。

sentences.en: We prove the logarithmic Iitaka–Viehweg inequality for projective surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth complex quasi-projective varieties whose base has nonnegative logarithmic Kodaira dimension.
sentences.zh: 对于光滑复拟射影簇之间纤维连通的射影满态射，当基底的对数 Kodaira 维数非负时，我们证明了对数 Iitaka–Viehweg 不等式。

sentences.en: The variation measures the birational field of definition of the whole geometric generic fiber.
sentences.zh: 变异度衡量的是整个几何泛纤维的双有理定义域。

sentences.en: This resolves Popa's logarithmic variation conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Popa 的对数变异度猜想。

sentences.en: Together with logarithmic subadditivity, the inequality gives additivity, including both negative-infinity cases.
sentences.zh: 结合对数次可加性，该不等式给出了可加性，包括两种负无穷情形。

sentences.en: This resolves Popa's logarithmic additivity conjecture positively in the projective reduced-SNC, stratum-smooth setting.
sentences.zh: 这在射影、约化 SNC、各层光滑的情形下肯定地解决了 Popa 的对数可加性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the ordinary Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for surjective projective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth connected projective varieties over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 对于特征为零的代数闭域上光滑连通射影簇之间纤维连通的射影满态射，我们证明了普通 Iitaka 次可加性猜想。

sentences.en: If F is the geometric generic fiber of $`f:X\to Z`$, then $`\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(F)+\kappa(Z)`$.
sentences.zh: 若 F 是 $`f:X\to Z`$ 的几何泛纤维，则 $`\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(F)+\kappa(Z)`$。

sentences.en: We prove the compact log-smooth Kähler case of b-semiampleness.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 b-半丰沛性在紧致对数光滑 Kähler 情形下成立。

sentences.en: Let $`f:Y\to X`$ be a surjective holomorphic map with connected fibers between smooth compact connected Kähler manifolds, and let Δ be an effective rational divisor with simple normal crossing support and coefficients in $`[0,1]`$, with $`K_Y+\Delta\sim_{\mathbb Q}f^*L`$ for $`L\in\mathop{\mathrm{Pic}}\nolimits (X)_{\mathbb Q}`$.
sentences.zh: 设 $`f:Y\to X`$ 是光滑紧致连通 Kähler 流形之间纤维连通的全纯满映射，且 Δ 是支撑具有简单正规交叉、系数属于 $`[0,1]`$ 的有效有理除子，并且对某个 $`L\in\mathop{\mathrm{Pic}}\nolimits (X)_{\mathbb Q}`$ 有 $`K_Y+\Delta\sim_{\mathbb Q}f^*L`$。

sentences.en: There is a smooth compact Kähler modification $`S o X`$ for which the threshold-moduli line satisfies $`M_{S_1}= u^*M_S`$ in $`\mathop{\mathrm{Pic}} olimits (S_1)_{\mathbb Q}`$ for every smooth compact Kähler modification $` u:S_1 o S`$, and some positive multiple of MS is represented by a holomorphic line bundle generated by global sections.
sentences.zh: 存在一个光滑紧致 Kähler 修正 $`S o X`$，使得对于每个光滑紧致 Kähler 修正 $` u:S_1 o S`$，阈值模线在 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Pic}} olimits (S_1)_{\mathbb Q}`$ 中满足 $`M_{S_1}= u^*M_S`$，且 MS 的某个正倍数可由一个被整体截面生成的全纯线丛表示。

sentences.en: Horizontal components of coefficient one are allowed; neither projectivity nor a Campana orbifold Iitaka hypothesis is assumed.
sentences.zh: 允许系数为一的水平分支；既不假设射影性，也不假设 Campana 轨形 Iitaka 猜想。

sentences.en: Assume logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth projective complex varieties with compatible reduced simple normal crossing boundaries.
sentences.zh: 假设对光滑射影复簇之间纤维连通、带有相容的约化简单正规交叉边界的满态射，对数 Iitaka 次可加性成立。

sentences.en: We prove log abundance for normal irreducible compact Kähler spaces in every dimension: for a log canonical pair $`(X,\Delta)`$ with effective rational boundary and $`K_X+\Delta`$ ℚ-Cartier, analytic nefness of $`K_X+\Delta`$ implies semiampleness.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个维数下正规不可约紧致 Kähler 空间的对数丰沛性：对于具有有效有理边界且 $`K_X+\Delta`$ 为 ℚ-Cartier 的对数典范对 $`(X,\Delta)`$，$`K_X+\Delta`$ 的解析 nef 性蕴含半丰沛性。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform index theorem for connected projective semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs in every fixed dimension at least four over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 在特征为零的代数闭域上，对于每个固定的至少为四的维数，我们证明了连通射影半对数典范的对数 Calabi–Yau 对的一致指标定理。

sentences.en: For boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set, a single multiple of the log canonical divisor is Cartier and linearly trivial.
sentences.zh: 当边界系数属于一个固定的有限有理数集时，对数典范除子的同一个倍数是 Cartier 的且线性平凡。

sentences.en: The multiple depends only on the dimension and coefficient set, not on the number of irreducible components.
sentences.zh: 这个倍数只依赖于维数和系数集，不依赖于不可约分支的数量。

sentences.en: Together with the established theorem in dimensions at most three, this resolves the finite-rational-coefficient semi-log-canonical index conjecture.
sentences.zh: 结合维数至多为三时已有的定理，这解决了有限有理系数的半对数典范指标猜想。

sentences.en: Assuming orbifold Iitaka subadditivity, the specified pseudo-effective fourfold minimal model program, and abundance for nef fourfold adjoints of nonnegative Kodaira dimension, we prove the existence of good minimal models for globally strongly ℚ-factorial compact Kähler klt fourfold pairs with effective rational boundary and analytically pseudo-effective actual ℚ-Cartier adjoint.
sentences.zh: 假设轨形 Iitaka 次可加性、指定的伪有效四维极小模型纲领，以及 Kodaira 维数非负的 nef 四维伴随除子的丰沛性成立，我们证明了整体强 ℚ-factorial 的紧致 Kähler klt 四维对的良极小模型存在性，其中边界为有效有理边界，实际的 ℚ-Cartier 伴随除子在解析意义下伪有效。

sentences.en: The additional step is nonvanishing.
sentences.zh: 额外的一步是非消失性。

sentences.en: We prove it by fibration arguments and, in algebraic dimension zero, by singular metrics, holomorphic foliations, and extension from a reduced boundary.
sentences.zh: 我们通过纤维化论证证明它；在代数维数为零时，则通过奇异度量、全纯叶状结构和从约化边界作延拓来证明。

sentences.en: The projective abundance argument used in the proof is included in full.
sentences.zh: 证明中使用的射影丰沛性论证已完整收入文中。

sentences.en: We prove the rational-boundary log abundance conjecture in every dimension over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero: every nef ℚ-Cartier log canonical divisor on a projective log canonical pair with effective rational boundary is semiample.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了特征为零的代数闭域上每个维数下有理边界的对数丰沛性猜想：具有有效有理边界的射影对数典范对上的每个 nef ℚ-Cartier 对数典范除子都是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: Over ℂ, the proof also establishes canonical nonvanishing for smooth projective varieties in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 在 ℂ 上，该证明还确立了每个维数下光滑射影簇的典范非消失性。

sentences.en: Let $`(H,\Theta)`$ be a projective complex klt pair with effective rational boundary and nef ℚ-Cartier adjoint.
sentences.zh: 设 $`(H,\Theta)`$ 是一个射影复 klt 对，具有有效有理边界和 nef ℚ-Cartier 伴随除子。

sentences.en: On any projective log resolution, minimal semipositive metrics on the pulled-back adjoint exist and have zero Lelong numbers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在任意射影对数消解上，拉回的伴随除子存在极小半正度量，且这些度量处处具有零 Lelong 数。

sentences.en: On smooth projective complex varieties, we also prove an H1-injectivity theorem for rational interior boundaries with simple-normal-crossing support when both endpoint bundles carry zero-Lelong semipositive metrics.
sentences.zh: 在光滑射影复簇上，当两个端点线丛都带有零 Lelong 数的半正度量时，我们还对具有简单正规交叉支撑的有理内部边界证明了一个 H1 单射性定理。

sentences.en: We prove canonical nonvanishing for smooth connected projective complex fourfolds: if KX is pseudo-effective, then $`H^0(X,mK_X)\ne0`$ for some positive integer m.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了光滑连通射影复四维簇的典范非消失性：若 KX 伪有效，则存在某个正整数 m 使得 $`H^0(X,mK_X)\ne0`$。

sentences.en: For a projective ℚ-factorial dlt pair with effective rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, we prove that the adjoint has positive Iitaka dimension whenever a nonzero effective Cartier multiple is supported on the coefficient-one boundary and restricts to a semiample line bundle on its whole reduced support.
sentences.zh: 对于特征为零的代数闭域上具有有效有理边界的射影 ℚ-factorial dlt 对，我们证明，只要伴随除子的一个非零有效 Cartier 倍数支撑在系数为一的边界上，并且限制到其整个约化支撑上是半丰沛线丛，则该伴随除子的 Iitaka 维数为正。

sentences.en: This gives log abundance after nonvanishing in dimension at most four over ℂ.
sentences.zh: 这给出了 ℂ 上维数至多为四时非消失性成立之后的对数丰沛性。

sentences.en: We prove the Campana–Peternell inequality $`\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(D)`$ for a smooth connected projective complex variety X and an effective Cartier divisor D whenever $`m_0K_X-D`$ is pseudo-effective for some positive integer m0.
sentences.zh: 对于光滑连通射影复簇 X 和有效 Cartier 除子 D，只要存在某个正整数 m0 使得 $`m_0K_X-D`$ 伪有效，我们就证明了 Campana–Peternell 不等式 $`\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(D)`$。

sentences.en: For an algebraic fiber space $`f\colon X\to Y`$ between smooth connected projective complex varieties, the hypothesis that $`m_0K_X-f^*H`$ is pseudo-effective with H ample Cartier gives $`\kappa(X)=\kappa(F)+\dim Y`$ for a very general smooth fiber F, as well as nonzero sections of $`mK_X-f^*H`$ for all sufficiently large divisible m.
sentences.zh: 对于光滑连通射影复簇之间的代数纤维空间 $`f\colon X\to Y`$，若 H 是丰沛 Cartier 除子且 $`m_0K_X-f^*H`$ 伪有效，则对甚一般的光滑纤维 F 有 $`\kappa(X)=\kappa(F)+\dim Y`$，并且对于所有充分大且充分可除的 m，$`mK_X-f^*H`$ 都有非零截面。

sentences.en: For normal projective log canonical pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero, of fixed dimension d ≥ 5 and with effective boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set, we prove that one complete rounded pluricanonical system generates the full Iitaka field whenever the ℚ-Cartier log canonical divisor has nonnegative Kodaira dimension.
sentences.zh: 对于特征为零的代数闭域上固定维数为 d ≥ 5 的正规射影对数典范对，若有效边界的系数属于一个固定的有限有理数集，我们证明，只要 ℚ-Cartier 对数典范除子的 Kodaira 维数非负，同一个完全取整多重典范线性系就生成完整的 Iitaka 域。

sentences.en: Its degree depends only on the dimension and coefficient set.
sentences.zh: 其次数只依赖于维数和系数集。

sentences.en: For the paper's normalized canonical bundle formulae over ℂ, we also bound the Cartier denominators of the moduli divisors on smooth projective determining models in terms of the dimension and coefficient set.
sentences.zh: 对于本文在 ℂ 上的归一化典范丛公式，我们还用维数和系数集，给出了光滑射影确定模型上模除子的 Cartier 分母的界。

sentences.en: We prove the effective Iitaka fibration conjecture in characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了特征为零时的有效 Iitaka 纤维化猜想。

sentences.en: For each dimension, one pluricanonical degree defines the Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective variety of that dimension and nonnegative Kodaira dimension over an algebraically closed field.
sentences.zh: 对于每个维数，都存在同一个多重典范次数，定义代数闭域上该维数且 Kodaira 维数非负的每个光滑整射影簇的 Iitaka 纤维化。

sentences.en: The associated sections generate the full Iitaka function field.
sentences.zh: 相应截面生成完整的 Iitaka 函数域。

sentences.en: We prove uniform denominator and effective-system bounds for log Calabi-Yau fibrations from projective log canonical complex pairs of dimension at most four onto positive-dimensional bases, with boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set.
sentences.zh: 对于从维数至多为四的射影对数典范复对到正维基底的对数 Calabi–Yau 纤维化，若边界系数属于一个固定的有限有理数集，我们证明了分母及有效线性系的一致界。

sentences.en: The bounds give a uniform trivializing degree and a uniform b-Cartier multiple of the moduli b-divisor.
sentences.zh: 这些界给出了统一的平凡化次数和模 b-除子的统一 b-Cartier 倍数。

sentences.en: When the base divisor is big, a uniform complete rounded adjoint system has section ratios generating the full base function field.
sentences.zh: 当基底除子为大除子时，一个统一的完全取整伴随线性系的截面之比生成完整的基底函数域。

sentences.en: Fix d ≥ 1 and t > 0.
sentences.zh: 固定 d ≥ 1 和 t > 0。

sentences.en: Let $`(X,B)`$ be an ordinary projective log canonical ℚ-pair of dimension d over a characteristic-zero field k, with X normal and integral, $`H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=k`$, B effective, and $`K_X+B\sim_{\mathbb Q}0`$.
sentences.zh: 设 $`(X,B)`$ 是特征为零的域 k 上维数为 d 的普通射影对数典范 ℚ-对，其中 X 正规且整，$`H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=k`$，B 有效，且 $`K_X+B\sim_{\mathbb Q}0`$。

sentences.en: We prove that every prime component S of B with coefficient at least t satisfies $`[k_S:k]\leq N(d,t)`$, where kS is the relative algebraic closure of k in $`k(S)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，B 的每个系数至少为 t 的素分支 S 都满足 $`[k_S:k]\leq N(d,t)`$，其中 kS 是 k 在 $`k(S)`$ 中的相对代数闭包。

sentences.en: This also bounds the Stein degree of S over k, proving the contraction-to-a-point formulation of Birkar's Stein-degree conjecture for ordinary ℚ-pairs.
sentences.zh: 这也给出了 S 在 k 上的 Stein 次数的界，从而证明了 Birkar 的 Stein 次数猜想对普通 ℚ-对的收缩到一点表述。

sentences.en: We prove the finite-rational-coefficient case of the effective log Iitaka conjecture in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了四维有效对数 Iitaka 猜想的有限有理系数情形。

sentences.en: For normal projective log canonical complex fourfolds with boundary coefficients in a fixed finite rational set and pseudo-effective rational Cartier adjoint, one uniform degree makes the complete rounded reflexive system nonempty and its section ratios generate the full Iitaka field.
sentences.zh: 对于正规射影对数典范复四维簇，若边界系数属于一个固定的有限有理数集，且有理 Cartier 伴随除子伪有效，则一个统一次数使得完全取整自反线性系非空，且其截面之比生成完整的 Iitaka 域。

sentences.en: We also prove a uniform canonical index bound for projective klt complex fourfolds with rationally trivial canonical divisor.
sentences.zh: 对于典范除子有理平凡的射影 klt 复四维簇，我们还证明了典范指标的一致界。

sentences.en: We prove semiampleness of the actual ℚ-Cartier adjoint $`K_X+\Delta`$ of a normal connected compact Kähler klt fourfold whenever it is analytically nef and some positive Cartier multiple has a nonzero section.
sentences.zh: 对于正规连通紧致 Kähler klt 四维簇，我们证明，只要其实际的 ℚ-Cartier 伴随除子 $`K_X+\Delta`$ 在解析意义下为 nef，且某个正 Cartier 倍数具有非零截面，则该伴随除子是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: The boundary is effective and rational; the fourfold need not be projective or ℚ-factorial.
sentences.zh: 边界有效且有理；该四维簇无须是射影的或 ℚ-factorial 的。

sentences.en: In Iitaka dimension zero, a positive Cartier multiple is the trivial holomorphic line bundle.
sentences.zh: 在 Iitaka 维数为零时，一个正 Cartier 倍数是平凡的全纯线丛。

sentences.en: We prove the numerical-dimension-one case of log abundance for threefolds over algebraically closed fields of characteristic p > 3.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了特征为 p > 3 的代数闭域上三维簇的对数丰沛性中数值维数为一的情形。

sentences.en: If $`(X,B)`$ is a projective log canonical threefold pair with effective rational boundary, and $`K_X+B`$ is ℚ-Cartier, nef, and of numerical dimension one, then $`K_X+B`$ is semiample.
sentences.zh: 若 $`(X,B)`$ 是一个具有有效有理边界的射影对数典范三维对，且 $`K_X+B`$ 为 ℚ-Cartier、nef、数值维数为一，则 $`K_X+B`$ 是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: Neither terminality nor ℚ-factoriality of X is required.
sentences.zh: 既不要求 X 具有终端奇点，也不要求其为 ℚ-factorial。

sentences.en: Let X be a projective ℚ-factorial terminal threefold over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 3.
sentences.zh: 设 X 是特征为 p > 3 的代数闭域上具有终端奇点的射影 ℚ-factorial 三维簇。

sentences.en: We prove the numerical-dimension-one case of abundance: if KX is nef with $`\nu(K_X)=1`$, then KX is semiample and $`\kappa(X,K_X)=1`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了丰沛性中数值维数为一的情形：若 KX 为 nef 且满足 $`\nu(K_X)=1`$，则 KX 半丰沛，并且 $`\kappa(X,K_X)=1`$。

sentences.en: Let X be a smooth connected compact Kähler manifold, let B be an effective rational simple normal crossing divisor with coefficients less than one, and let M be a nef rational holomorphic line bundle on X.
sentences.zh: 设 X 是一个光滑连通紧致 Kähler 流形，B 是系数小于一的有效有理简单正规交叉除子，M 是 X 上的 nef 有理全纯线丛。

sentences.en: If $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, we prove that its first Chern class in real Bott–Chern cohomology is represented by a semiample rational line bundle.
sentences.zh: 若 $`K_X+B`$ 伪有效且 $`K_X+B+M`$ 为 nef，我们证明，后者在实 Bott–Chern 上同调中的第一 Chern 类由一个半丰沛有理线丛表示。

sentences.en: This numerical statement allows a flat change of line bundle; it does not assert semiampleness of the original adjoint.
sentences.zh: 这一数值陈述允许线丛相差一个平坦线丛；它并不声称原伴随除子的半丰沛性。

sentences.en: We prove the Generalised Abundance Conjecture: if $`(X,B)`$ is a projective klt ℚ-pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective, M is a nef ℚ-Cartier divisor on X, and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, then $`K_X+B+M`$ is numerically equivalent to a semiample ℚ-Cartier divisor on X.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了广义丰沛性猜想：若 $`(X,B)`$ 是特征为零的代数闭域上的射影 klt ℚ-对，$`K_X+B`$ 伪有效，M 是 X 上的 nef ℚ-Cartier 除子，且 $`K_X+B+M`$ 为 nef，则 $`K_X+B+M`$ 数值等价于 X 上的一个半丰沛 ℚ-Cartier 除子。

sentences.en: We resolve the existence form of the minimal-model conjecture for projective generalized log canonical ℚ-pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了特征为零的代数闭域上射影广义对数典范 ℚ-对的极小模型猜想的存在性形式。

sentences.en: Such a pair admits a minimal model when its adjoint divisor is pseudo-effective, and a Mori fibre space otherwise, while keeping the nef ℚ-Cartier b-divisor fixed.
sentences.zh: 当这样的对的伴随除子伪有效时，它具有极小模型，否则具有 Mori 纤维空间，并且 nef ℚ-Cartier b-除子保持固定。

sentences.en: Taking the nef part to be zero gives the corresponding result for ordinary log canonical ℚ-pairs.
sentences.zh: 取 nef 部分为零，就得到普通对数典范 ℚ-对的相应结果。

sentences.en: We resolve the numerical-dimension-one case of the minimal-model conjecture for smooth connected complex projective varieties of dimension at least three.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了维数至少为三的光滑连通复射影簇的极小模型猜想中数值维数为一的情形。

sentences.en: If KX is pseudo-effective and $`\kappa_\sigma(X,K_X)=1`$, with κσ defined by section growth with a fixed ample twist, then X admits a projective ℚ-factorial terminal minimal model.
sentences.zh: 若 KX 伪有效且 $`\kappa_\sigma(X,K_X)=1`$，其中 κσ 由施加固定丰沛扭转后的截面增长定义，则 X 存在具有终端奇点的射影 ℚ-factorial 极小模型。

sentences.en: We prove the ordinary-double-point gap conjecture for boundary-zero complex algebraic klt germs in every dimension: a singular n-dimensional germ has normalized volume at most $`2(n-1)^n`$, with equality precisely at an analytic ordinary double point.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了所有维数中边界为零的复代数 klt 芽的普通二重点间隙猜想：奇异的 n 维芽的归一化体积至多为 $`2(n-1)^n`$，且等号成立当且仅当它在解析意义下是普通二重点。

sentences.en: We prove that every singular complex algebraic klt fourfold germ with zero boundary has normalized volume at most 162, with equality precisely for an analytic ordinary double point.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个边界为零的奇异复代数 klt 四维芽的归一化体积至多为 162，且等号成立当且仅当它在解析意义下是普通二重点。

sentences.en: This resolves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 这解决了四维情形的普通二重点体积间隙猜想。

sentences.en: We prove Fujita's freeness conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Fujita 的自由性猜想。

sentences.en: If X is a smooth complex projective variety of dimension n and L is an ample line bundle, then $`K_X+mL`$ is globally generated for every integer $`m\geq n+1`$.
sentences.zh: 若 X 是维数为 n 的光滑复射影簇，L 是丰沛线丛，则对每个整数 $`m\geq n+1`$，$`K_X+mL`$ 都是整体生成的。

sentences.en: We prove that a nonzero effective plane curve of degree d at r ≥ 10 very general complex points has total multiplicity strictly less than $`d\sqrt r`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，次数为 d 的非零有效平面曲线在 r ≥ 10 个很一般的复点处的总重数严格小于 $`d\sqrt r`$。

sentences.en: The inequality holds simultaneously for all curves, including reducible and nonreduced curves, and establishes Nagata's conjecture in its strict, nonhomogeneous form.
sentences.zh: 该不等式对所有曲线同时成立，包括可约曲线和非约化曲线，并由此确立了 Nagata 猜想的严格、非齐次形式。

sentences.en: We prove that, for every smooth integral complex projective surface S and every ample line bundle L, the multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals $`\sqrt{L^2/r}`$ for every sufficiently large integer r.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对每个光滑整的复射影曲面 S 和每个丰沛线丛 L，对于每个充分大的整数 r，在 r 个很一般的点处的多点 Seshadri 常数等于 $`\sqrt{L^2/r}`$。

sentences.en: This resolves positively the qualitative Nagata–Biran conjecture for surfaces.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了曲面的定性 Nagata–Biran 猜想。

sentences.en: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral complex projective variety X of dimension n ≥ 3.
sentences.zh: 设 L 是维数为 n ≥ 3 的光滑整的复射影簇 X 上的丰沛线丛。

sentences.en: We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，存在阈值 $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$，使得对每个整数 $`r\ge r_0`$，在 r 个很一般的点处的通常多点 Seshadri 常数等于体积界 $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$。

sentences.en: This establishes the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion in these dimensions.
sentences.zh: 这确立了这些维数中的定性 Nagata–Biran–Szemberg 断言。

sentences.en: Let L be an ample line bundle on a smooth integral projective variety X over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, with $`\dim X=n\ge3`$.
sentences.zh: 设 L 是正特征代数闭域上的光滑整射影簇 X 上的丰沛线丛，且 $`\dim X=n\ge3`$。

sentences.en: We prove that there is a threshold $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$ such that for every integer $`r\ge r_0`$, the ordinary multipoint Seshadri constant at the geometric generic tuple of r points equals the volume bound $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，存在阈值 $`r_0=r_0(X,L)`$，使得对每个整数 $`r\ge r_0`$，在由 r 个点组成的几何泛点组处的通常多点 Seshadri 常数等于体积界 $`(L^n/r)^{1/n}`$。

sentences.en: The same conclusion holds in dimension two.
sentences.zh: 同一结论在二维情形中也成立。

sentences.en: This establishes the positive-characteristic form of the qualitative Nagata–Biran–Szemberg assertion at geometric generic tuples.
sentences.zh: 这确立了定性 Nagata–Biran–Szemberg 断言在几何泛点组处的正特征形式。

sentences.en: We prove Bloch's conjecture for smooth connected projective complex surfaces with $`p_g=0`$: the Albanese homomorphism on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了满足 $`p_g=0`$ 的光滑连通复射影曲面的 Bloch 猜想：整数系数、次数为零的零维闭链上的 Albanese 同态是同构。

sentences.en: We prove that the normal projective base of a projective Lagrangian fibration from a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is projective space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，从紧不可约全纯辛 Kähler 流形出发的射影 Lagrangian 纤维化的正规射影底空间是射影空间。

sentences.en: This resolves the projective-space base conjecture for such fibrations in every dimension and deformation type.
sentences.zh: 这解决了所有维数和形变类型中此类纤维化的射影空间底空间猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is semiample.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了强超 Kähler SYZ 猜想：紧不可约全纯辛 Kähler 流形上，每个第一 Chern 类非零、nef 且各向同性的全纯线丛都是半丰沛的。

sentences.en: We prove that every complex K3 surface X is Oka, resolving the K3 Oka conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个复 K3 曲面 X 都是 Oka 的，从而解决了 K3 Oka 猜想。

sentences.en: Equivalently, for every m ≥ 1, every holomorphic map to X from a neighborhood of a compact convex set in ℂm can be approximated uniformly on that set by entire maps $`\mathbb C^m\to X`$.
sentences.zh: 等价地，对每个 m ≥ 1，从 ℂm 中紧凸集的某个邻域到 X 的每个全纯映射，都可由整映射 $`\mathbb C^m\to X`$ 在该紧凸集上一致逼近。

sentences.en: We prove the P = W conjecture on the full rational cohomology of fixed-determinant, trace-free Higgs moduli spaces in composite rank and coprime degree, for smooth projective complex curves of genus at least two.
sentences.zh: 对于亏格至少为二的光滑复射影曲线，我们证明了秩为合数、次数与秩互素的固定行列式无迹 Higgs 模空间的全部有理上同调上的 P = W 猜想。

sentences.en: Together with the established prime-rank cases, this gives the equality in every coprime rank.
sentences.zh: 结合已确立的素数秩情形，这给出了所有秩与次数互素情形下的这一等式。

sentences.en: We prove the equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary finite quivers, including loops and multiple arrows.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了任意有限箭图的等变上同调 Hikita 猜想，包括带环和重箭头的箭图。

sentences.en: For any dimension and framing vectors, any commuting flavor torus, and a stability character whose semistable locus is stable and has free gauge action, the equivariant cohomology of the Nakajima variety is canonically isomorphic to the coordinate ring of the scheme-theoretic fixed locus of the stability cocharacter on the flavor-deformed Coulomb branch.
sentences.zh: 对于任意维数向量和标架向量、任意其作用与规范作用可交换的 flavor 环面，以及半稳定点集均为稳定点且其上规范作用自由的稳定性特征，Nakajima 簇的等变上同调典范同构于 flavor 形变 Coulomb 分支上稳定性余特征的不动点子概形的坐标环。

sentences.en: This is an isomorphism of graded algebras over the common coefficient ring, retaining nilpotents and including the empty case.
sentences.zh: 这是公共系数环上的分次代数同构，保留了幂零元，也包括空的情形。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth projective complex fourfold with large fundamental group whose universal cover is not Stein.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个具有大基本群的光滑复射影四维簇，其万有覆盖不是 Stein 的。

sentences.en: The universal cover contains no positive-dimensional compact complex-analytic subvariety, so this disproves Shafarevich's holomorphic-convexity conjecture even under the large-fundamental-group hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 该万有覆盖不含正维紧复解析子簇，因此即使在大基本群假设下，这也否定了 Shafarevich 的全纯凸性猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth connected projective complex surface whose universal cover is not holomorphically convex.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个光滑连通复射影曲面，其万有覆盖不是全纯凸的。

sentences.en: This disproves the Shafarevich conjecture on holomorphic convexity in complex dimension two.
sentences.zh: 这否定了复维数为二时的 Shafarevich 全纯凸性猜想。

sentences.en: We construct an explicit integral complex affine fourfold X with $`X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5`$ but $`X\not\cong\mathbb A^4`$.
sentences.zh: 我们显式构造了一个整复仿射四维簇 X，满足 $`X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5`$，但 $`X\not\cong\mathbb A^4`$。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to Zariski's affine-space cancellation problem over ℂ in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 这对 ℂ 上四维情形的 Zariski 仿射空间消去问题给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: The same construction disproves the Stable Coordinate Conjecture in ambient dimension five and yields smooth 𝔸<sup>3</sup>-fibrations over 𝔸<sup>1</sup> and 𝔸<sup>2</sup> that are not Zariski-locally trivial.
sentences.zh: 同一构造否定了环境维数为五时的稳定坐标猜想，并给出了以 𝔸<sup>1</sup> 和 𝔸<sup>2</sup> 为底空间、并非 Zariski 局部平凡的光滑 𝔸<sup>3</sup> 纤维化。

sentences.en: These fibrations disprove the Dolgachev–Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture over these bases.
sentences.zh: 这些纤维化否定了以这些空间为底空间的 Dolgachev–Weisfeiler 仿射纤维化猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a singular normal affine complex surface whose tangent sheaf is free of rank two.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个奇异正规复仿射曲面，其切层是秩二的自由层。

sentences.en: This disproves the Lipman–Zariski conjecture in characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 这否定了特征零时的 Lipman–Zariski 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct an explicit degree-five polynomial over $`\mathbf C`$ that is not a coordinate in four variables but becomes one after adjoining a single variable.
sentences.zh: 我们显式构造了 $`\mathbf C`$ 上的一个五次多项式，它在四个变量中不是坐标，但添加一个变量后就成为坐标。

sentences.en: This gives a counterexample to the stable coordinate conjecture in four variables.
sentences.zh: 这给出了四变量稳定坐标猜想的一个反例。

sentences.en: Every fiber is isomorphic to affine three-space, yet its embedding in affine four-space is not rectifiable.
sentences.zh: 每条纤维都同构于仿射三维空间，但它在仿射四维空间中的嵌入不可拉直。

sentences.en: Thus the example also disproves the Abhyankar–Sathaye embedding conjecture in ambient dimension four.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个例子也否定了环境维数为四时的 Abhyankar–Sathaye 嵌入猜想。

sentences.en: We construct an explicit counterexample to the Abhyankar–Sathaye conjecture: a noncoordinate polynomial in four complex variables whose zero fibre is affine three-space.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了 Abhyankar–Sathaye 猜想的一个显式反例：一个四个复变量的非坐标多项式，其零纤维是仿射三维空间。

sentences.en: Adjoining variables gives counterexamples in every ambient dimension at least four.
sentences.zh: 添加变量可在每个至少为四的环境维数中得到反例。

sentences.en: We give counterexamples to Griffiths' conjecture in rank two on the quadric surface $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$.
sentences.zh: 我们在二次曲面 $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$ 上给出了秩二情形的 Griffiths 猜想的反例。

sentences.en: We construct an explicit bundle G whose coordinatewise power pullbacks, tensored with $`\mathcal O(1,1)`$, are ample for every positive power, but admit no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric for all sufficiently large powers.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个显式向量丛 G，它沿逐坐标幂映射的拉回与 $`\mathcal O(1,1)`$ 的张量积对于每个正幂都是丰沛的，但对于所有充分大的幂都不存在光滑严格 Griffiths 正 Hermitian 度量。

sentences.en: We prove that every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension containing no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is projective.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个复维数为正且不含非常值整曲线的紧连通 Kähler 流形都具有丰沛的典范丛，并且是射影的。

sentences.en: This resolves positively Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler category.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了光滑紧 Kähler 范畴中的 Kobayashi 典范丰沛性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the two-summand form of Beauville's compatible splitting conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Beauville 相容分裂猜想的两个直和项形式。

sentences.en: If the tangent bundle of a compact connected Kähler manifold decomposes into two integrable holomorphic subbundles of positive rank, then its ordinary universal cover admits a product decomposition whose factor tangent bundles are the lifted specified summands.
sentences.zh: 若紧连通 Kähler 流形的切丛分解为两个正秩可积全纯子丛，则其通常的万有覆盖存在一个乘积分解，使得各因子的切丛恰为指定直和项的提升。

sentences.en: We prove that both summands of every specified holomorphic splitting of the tangent bundle of a smooth rationally connected projective complex manifold into two positive-rank subbundles are integrable.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，光滑有理连通复射影流形的切丛的每个指定全纯分裂，若分裂为两个正秩子丛，则这两个直和项都可积。

sentences.en: This proves Höring's conjecture on rationally connected projective manifolds.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Höring 关于有理连通射影流形的猜想。

sentences.en: Höring's product theorem then gives a product decomposition compatible with the specified splitting.
sentences.zh: Höring 的乘积定理随后给出与指定分裂相容的乘积分解。

sentences.en: We disprove the Chow and rational-cohomological forms of Pixton's completeness conjecture for his original relation system.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了针对 Pixton 原始关系系统的 Pixton 完备性猜想的 Chow 形式和有理上同调形式。

sentences.en: We construct a formal tautological class outside the original Pixton relation span whose image is zero in the Chow ring and in rational cohomology.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个不属于原始 Pixton 关系所张成空间的形式重言类，其在 Chow 环和有理上同调中的像均为零。

sentences.en: The example has genus $`10^{60}`$ and $`3\binom{10^{60}}3`$ markings.

For every sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant, we prove that a very general cubic fourfold of that discriminant is irrational, although its Kuznetsov component is equivalent to the ordinary derived category of a projective K3 surface.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的可容许 Hassett 判别式，我们证明，具有该判别式的很一般的三次四维簇是非有理的，尽管其 Kuznetsov 分量等价于一个射影 K3 曲面的通常导出范畴。

sentences.en: The discriminant threshold is ineffective.
sentences.zh: 这一判别式阈值是非有效的。

sentences.en: This disproves Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Kuznetsov 的有理性猜想。

sentences.en: The same cubics have associated untwisted polarized K3 surfaces in the Hodge-theoretic sense, so they also disprove the sufficiency direction of the associated-K3 rationality prediction.
sentences.zh: 这些三次四维簇在 Hodge 理论意义下也有关联的非扭曲极化 K3 曲面，因此它们还否定了关联 K3 有理性预测的充分性方向。

sentences.en: We prove Toda's normalized quintic Gepner conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Toda 的归一化五次 Gepner 猜想。

sentences.en: On every smooth complex quintic threefold, we construct a numerical Bridgeland stability condition for which tensoring by the hyperplane bundle, followed by the spherical twist at the structure sheaf, increases phase by 2/5.
sentences.zh: 在每个光滑复五次三维簇上，我们构造了一个数值 Bridgeland 稳定性条件，使得先与超平面线丛作张量积、再在结构层处作球面扭转的操作将相位增加 2/5。

sentences.en: Let X be a smooth projective complex threefold with trivial canonical bundle.
sentences.zh: 设 X 是典范丛平凡的光滑复射影三维簇。

sentences.en: We construct numerical Bridgeland stability conditions with the exact ordinary and square-root-Todd central charges at every sufficiently large volume.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个充分大的体积处构造了数值 Bridgeland 稳定性条件，其中心荷精确为通常中心荷及Todd 平方根中心荷。

sentences.en: One volume threshold works on an open set of real twists and ample directions.
sentences.zh: 同一个体积阈值适用于实扭转和丰沛方向的一个开集。

sentences.en: The resulting stability conditions have the support property on the full numerical Grothendieck group and stable point sheaves.
sentences.zh: 所得稳定性条件在完整的数值 Grothendieck 群上具有支撑性质，并且点层是稳定的。

sentences.en: Separately, on every smooth projective complex threefold we prove a strong tilt inequality above a volume threshold uniform in the object and twist along a fixed polarization.
sentences.zh: 此外，在每个光滑复射影三维簇上，我们证明了沿固定极化、超过一个对对象和扭转都一致的体积阈值时成立的强 tilt 不等式。

sentences.en: Every sequence of generalized log canonical flips on a normal irreducible globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfold terminates, provided the flips are projective small diagrams with the stated opposite ample signs.
sentences.zh: 在正规不可约、整体 Weil ℚ-factorial 的紧 Kähler 四维簇上，每个广义对数典范翻转序列都会终止，只要这些翻转是具有所述相反丰沛符号的射影小态射图。

sentences.en: The boundary is rational, and the nef b-divisor is fixed and represented by an analytically nef ℚ-Cartier divisor on a projective modification.
sentences.zh: 边界是有理的，nef b-除子固定，并由某个射影修正上的解析 nef ℚ-Cartier 除子表示。

sentences.en: No scaling rule or pseudo-effectivity assumption is required.
sentences.zh: 无需缩放规则或伪有效性假设。

sentences.en: The theorem concerns existing flip sequences; it does not assert the existence of all contractions or flips.
sentences.zh: 该定理讨论已有的翻转序列；它并不声称所有收缩或翻转都存在。

sentences.en: Every sequence of generalized-canonical flips on compact Kähler fourfolds with rational boundary and fixed rational analytically nef b-divisor terminates when the small morphisms are projective.
sentences.zh: 在具有有理边界以及固定的有理解析 nef b-除子的紧 Kähler 四维簇上，当小态射是射影态射时，每个广义典范翻转序列都会终止。

sentences.en: We prove this for normal globally Weil ℚ-factorial models with boundary coefficients less than one, allowing exceptional log discrepancies equal to one.
sentences.zh: 我们对于边界系数小于一的正规、整体 Weil ℚ-factorial 模型证明这一结论，并允许例外除子的对数差异数等于一。

sentences.en: No scaling rule or pseudo-effectivity assumption is required.
sentences.zh: 无需缩放规则或伪有效性假设。

sentences.en: The theorem applies to existing projective small diagrams with the specified opposite ample signs.
sentences.zh: 该定理适用于具有指定相反丰沛符号的已有射影小态射图。

sentences.en: We prove that every permitted minimal model program for a projective log canonical fourfold with rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero terminates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，特征零代数闭域上具有有理边界的射影对数典范四维簇的每个允许的极小模型纲领都会终止。

sentences.en: The result allows arbitrary negative extremal rays and mixed birational steps on the given models, without pseudo-effectivity or initial ℚ-factoriality.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许在给定模型上选取任意负极端射线并混合进行双有理步骤，不要求伪有效性或初始模型的 ℚ-factorial 性。

sentences.en: We prove that every maximal ordinary negative-ray program starting from a compact Kähler klt fourfold pair with effective rational boundary in the global Weil-divisor ℚ-factorial category terminates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在整体 Weil 除子 ℚ-factorial 范畴中，从带有有效有理边界的紧 Kähler klt 四维对出发的每个极大通常负射线纲领都会终止。

sentences.en: It ends at a nef model when the adjoint is pseudo-effective and at a projective Mori fibre space otherwise.
sentences.zh: 当伴随除子伪有效时，它终止于 nef 模型，否则终止于射影 Mori 纤维空间。

sentences.en: We prove that a globally Weil-ℚ-factorial compact Kähler klt fourfold pair with effective rational boundary and canonical rational line bundle admits a finite ordinary minimal model program starting on the given pair.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，带有有效有理边界和典范有理线丛、整体 Weil-ℚ-factorial 的紧 Kähler klt 四维对存在从该给定对出发的有限通常极小模型纲领。

sentences.en: It ends at a nef model when the adjoint class is pseudo-effective and at a Mori fibre space otherwise.
sentences.zh: 当伴随类伪有效时，它终止于 nef 模型，否则终止于 Mori 纤维空间。

sentences.en: We prove that the fundamental group of every special compact Kähler manifold is virtually abelian, resolving Campana's abelianity conjecture in all dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个特殊紧 Kähler 流形的基本群都是虚阿贝尔群，从而解决了所有维数中的 Campana 阿贝尔性猜想。

sentences.en: In particular, every smooth compact connected Kähler manifold of Kodaira dimension zero has virtually abelian ordinary fundamental group.
sentences.zh: 特别地，每个 Kodaira 维数为零的光滑紧连通 Kähler 流形的通常基本群都是虚阿贝尔群。

sentences.en: We give an independent proof that every complex linear representation of the ordinary fundamental group of a connected smooth special complex quasi-projective variety has virtually nilpotent image of class at most two.
sentences.zh: 我们独立证明了：连通光滑特殊复拟射影簇的通常基本群的每个复线性表示，其像都含有幂零类至多为二的有限指数幂零子群。

sentences.en: This conclusion was previously announced by Cao–Deng–Hacon–Păun.
sentences.zh: 这一结论此前由 Cao–Deng–Hacon–Păun 宣布。

sentences.en: We also construct special open surfaces whose general quasi-Albanese fibres are not special.
sentences.zh: 我们还构造了一些特殊开曲面，其一般的拟 Albanese 纤维并非特殊的。

sentences.en: Using the abelianity theorem for special compact Kähler manifolds in every dimension, we prove virtual abelianity of the entire orbifold fundamental group of the special order-two root orbifold associated with a pair $`(X,\tfrac12D)`$, where X is a smooth projective fourfold and D is a nonempty smooth connected divisor.
sentences.zh: 利用所有维数中特殊紧 Kähler 流形的阿贝尔性定理，我们证明了与对 $`(X,\tfrac12D)`$ 关联的特殊二阶根轨形的整个轨形基本群是虚阿贝尔群，其中 X 是光滑射影四维簇，D 是非空光滑连通除子。

sentences.en: We construct a special smooth projective eightfold whose fundamental group surjects onto the required group.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个特殊光滑射影八维簇，其基本群满射到所需的群。

sentences.en: We prove the Kollár–Pardon conjecture: the universal cover of a connected normal projective complex variety is biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety if and only if it is a product of a bounded symmetric domain, a complex affine space, and a simply connected normal projective variety.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Kollár–Pardon 猜想：连通正规复射影簇的万有覆盖双全纯同构于某个射影簇的半代数开子集，当且仅当它是有界对称域、复仿射空间和单连通正规射影簇的乘积。

sentences.en: Every nonempty connected semialgebraic bounded open subset of a complex affine variety admitting a properly discontinuous cocompact group of biholomorphisms is smooth and biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain.
sentences.zh: 复仿射簇的每个非空连通半代数有界开子集，若容许一个正常不连续且余紧地作用的双全纯变换群，则它是光滑的，并且双全纯同构于一个有界对称域。

sentences.en: This answers the bounded-domain question of Kollár and Pardon affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地回答了 Kollár 和 Pardon 的有界域问题。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to the embedded Zariski multiplicity conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们对嵌入 Zariski 重数猜想给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct two reduced hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have multiplicities two and three.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了两个在环境空间中同胚的约化超曲面芽，但其重数分别为二和三。

sentences.en: Both have isolated singularities and lie in a common complex affine space of dimension divisible by eight.
sentences.zh: 二者都具有孤立奇点，并位于同一个维数为八的倍数的复仿射空间中。

sentences.en: Their defining function germs are also topologically right equivalent, and the same examples answer Arnold's corank problem negatively for ambient topological equivalence.
sentences.zh: 它们的定义函数芽也拓扑右等价，而且这些相同的例子也对环境拓扑等价意义下的 Arnold 余秩问题给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to Zariski's multiplicity question in four complex variables.
sentences.zh: 我们对四个复变量情形的 Zariski 重数问题给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct two reduced convergent holomorphic function germs with isolated critical points and multiplicities four and five whose zero-set germs are ambiently homeomorphic.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了两个约化的收敛全纯函数芽，它们具有孤立临界点，重数分别为四和五，而其零点集芽在环境空间中同胚。

sentences.en: We prove the Global Spherical Shell conjecture: every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with positive second Betti number contains a global spherical shell.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了整体球壳猜想：每个第二 Betti 数为正的 VII 类连通极小紧复曲面都包含一个整体球壳。

sentences.en: This is a holomorphically embedded neighborhood of the standard three-sphere in $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ whose complement is connected.
sentences.zh: 这是 $`\mathbb C^2\setminus\{0\}`$ 中标准三维球面的一个全纯嵌入的邻域，其补集连通。

sentences.en: We resolve the contact-Fano homogeneity conjecture and the Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定地解决了接触 Fano 齐性猜想和 Riemann 几何中的 LeBrun–Salamon 猜想。

sentences.en: Every smooth connected complex projective contact Fano manifold of complex dimension at least three, with its given contact distribution, is contact-isomorphic to the adjoint variety of a simple complex Lie algebra.
sentences.zh: 每个复维数至少为三的光滑连通复射影接触 Fano 流形，连同其给定的接触分布，都接触同构于某个复单 Lie 代数的伴随簇。

sentences.en: Consequently, every closed connected smooth positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold of real dimension $`4m\geq8`$ is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个实维数为 $`4m\geq8`$ 的闭连通光滑正四元数 Kähler 流形都与一个紧对称 Wolf 空间位似。

sentences.en: We prove the generalized Mukai conjecture: every positive-dimensional smooth complex Fano manifold of dimension n, Picard number ρ, and pseudoindex ι satisfies $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了广义 Mukai 猜想：每个维数为 n、Picard 数为 ρ、伪指数为 ι 的正维光滑复 Fano 流形都满足 $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$。

sentences.en: Equality holds precisely for the product of ρ copies of $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$.
sentences.zh: 等号成立当且仅当它是 ρ 个 $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$ 的乘积。

sentences.en: We prove that every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in ℂ<sup>3</sup> with constant Milnor number is topologically right-trivial.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，ℂ<sup>3</sup> 中 Milnor 数不变的每个孤立超曲面奇点的全纯单参数族都拓扑右平凡。

sentences.en: This gives a positive answer to the surface case of the μ-constant problem.
sentences.zh: 这对 μ 不变问题的曲面情形给出了肯定回答。

sentences.en: The trivialization fixes the parameter and the origin section, and preserves the defining functions.
sentences.zh: 该平凡化固定参数和原点截面，并保持定义函数。

sentences.en: We prove that full ordinary descendant Virasoro constraints pass from a smooth projective complex base to the projectivization of any algebraic vector bundle of rank at least two.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，完整的通常后裔 Virasoro 约束可从光滑复射影底空间传递到其上任意秩至少为二的代数向量丛的射影化。

sentences.en: The bundle need not split and satisfies no positivity requirement.
sentences.zh: 该向量丛无需分裂，也无须满足任何正性要求。

sentences.en: Assuming the full constraints on the base, the conclusion includes every genus, each individual integral curve class, and all cohomology insertions, including primitive and odd classes.
sentences.zh: 假设底空间上的完整约束成立，则结论涵盖每个亏格、每个单独的整数系数曲线类以及所有上同调插入，包括本原类和奇数次类。

sentences.en: The result also applies successively to towers of projective bundles.
sentences.zh: 该结果也可依次应用于射影丛塔。

sentences.en: We prove the Virasoro conjecture for the ordinary descendant Gromov–Witten theory of smooth complete intersections in projective space, in every genus and curve class and with arbitrary cohomology insertions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了射影空间中光滑完全交的通常后裔 Gromov–Witten 理论的 Virasoro 猜想，涵盖每个亏格和曲线类，并允许任意上同调插入。

sentences.en: This includes primitive and odd cohomology classes, with no semisimplicity assumption.
sentences.zh: 这包括本原上同调类和奇数次上同调类，且不作半单性假设。

sentences.en: For fixed dimension d and positive rational ϵ, we prove that every ϵ-log-canonical Fano contraction over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero admits, near each closed base point, a klt complement of index bounded only by d and ϵ.
sentences.zh: 对于固定的维数 d 和正有理数 ϵ，我们证明，特征零代数闭域上的每个 ϵ-对数典范 Fano 收缩，在底空间的每个闭点附近都存在一个 klt 补，其指标仅由 d 和 ϵ 控制。

sentences.en: Over ℂ, we also obtain monotone klt complements for Fano type pairs with nef anti-log-canonical divisor and coefficients in a fixed finite rational set.
sentences.zh: 在 ℂ 上，我们还对于反对数典范除子为 nef、系数属于某个固定有限有理数集的 Fano 型对，得到了单调 klt 补。

sentences.en: This proves the finite-rational-coefficient form of Shokurov's bounded-klt-complement conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Shokurov 有界 klt 补猜想的有限有理系数形式。

sentences.en: We prove the Cartier-divisor conjecture of Birkar and Shokurov for rational boundaries in characteristic zero and for real boundaries over ℂ.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Birkar 和 Shokurov 的 Cartier 除子猜想，分别涵盖特征零时的有理边界和 ℂ 上的实边界。

sentences.en: For an ϵ-lc Fano type contraction with positive-dimensional base and nef negative log canonical class, a Cartier divisor through any prescribed base point can be chosen with pullback log canonical threshold bounded below in terms of the dimension and ϵ alone.
sentences.zh: 对于底空间为正维、负对数典范类为 nef 的 ϵ-lc Fano 型收缩，可以选取一个经过任意指定底空间点的 Cartier 除子，使其拉回的对数典范阈值具有仅依赖于维数和 ϵ 的下界。

sentences.en: We prove that every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous, resolving the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个切丛为 nef 的光滑连通复射影 Fano 六维簇都是有理齐性的，从而解决了复维数为六时的 Campana–Peternell 猜想。

sentences.en: As a consequence, a connected compact Kähler manifold X with nef holomorphic tangent bundle and $`\dim_{\mathbb C}X-\widetilde q(X)\leq6`$ has ordinary universal cover $`F\times\mathbb C^{\widetilde q(X)}`$, where F is a rational homogeneous manifold and $`\widetilde q(X)`$ is the maximal irregularity of a connected finite étale cover.
sentences.zh: 由此，若连通紧 Kähler 流形 X 的全纯切丛为 nef 且 $`\dim_{\mathbb C}X-\widetilde q(X)\leq6`$，则其通常的万有覆盖为 $`F\times\mathbb C^{\widetilde q(X)}`$，其中 F 是有理齐性流形，$`\widetilde q(X)`$ 是连通有限 étale 覆盖的最大不规则度。

sentences.en: Every smooth connected projective complex variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle has a nonzero section of some positive anticanonical power.
sentences.zh: 每个反典范丛光滑半正的光滑连通复射影簇，其反典范丛的某个正次幂都存在非零截面。

sentences.en: For a holomorphic action of a compact torus on a compact complex manifold, we prove that the invariant Euler characteristic of naturally linearized anticanonical powers is polynomial on a divisible progression, with its actual value at exponent zero.
sentences.zh: 对于紧环面在紧复流形上的全纯作用，我们证明，自然线性化的反典范幂的不变 Euler 特征在一个 divisible progression 上是多项式，并在指数为零处取其实际值。

sentences.en: Independently, on a smooth projective variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, we remove a fixed pseudoeffective error from an unbounded sequence of effective twists.
sentences.zh: 独立地，在反典范丛光滑半正的光滑射影簇上，我们从一个无界的有效扭转序列中去掉一个固定的伪有效误差项。

sentences.en: These results convert invariant cohomology into twisted differential forms and prove anticanonical nonvanishing on smooth projective varieties with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, by descending the forms before conversion.
sentences.zh: 这些结果将不变上同调转化为扭曲微分形式，并通过在转化前将这些形式下降，证明了反典范丛光滑半正的光滑射影簇上的反典范非消失性。

sentences.en: Let $`(W,D)`$ be a projective ℚ-factorial klt pair with effective rational boundary.
sentences.zh: 设 $`(W,D)`$ 是带有有效有理边界的射影 ℚ-factorial klt 对。

sentences.en: We prove that a positive Cartier multiple of $`-(K_W+D)`$ has a nonzero section if this divisor is nef, its pullback to a resolution admits a semipositive metric with locally bounded weights, and the resolution has nonzero structure-sheaf Euler characteristic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，若除子 $`-(K_W+D)`$ 为 nef，其到某个解消的拉回具有权重局部有界的半正度量，且该解消的结构层 Euler 特征非零，则该除子的某个正 Cartier 倍数具有非零截面。

sentences.en: Consequently a smooth rationally connected projective variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle has a nonzero naturally invariant anticanonical plurisection for every algebraic torus action.
sentences.zh: 因此，反典范丛光滑半正的光滑有理连通射影簇，对每个代数环面作用都有一个非零的自然不变反典范多重截面。

sentences.en: Let X be a smooth projective complex variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle.
sentences.zh: 设 X 是反典范丛光滑半正的光滑复射影簇。

sentences.en: For any torus linearization of that bundle, we show that invariant sections in unbounded degrees with one fixed negative pseudoeffective error yield an invariant section in a positive untwisted degree.
sentences.zh: 对于该线丛的任意环面线性化，我们表明，在无界的一列次数中，减去同一个固定的伪有效误差项后存在不变截面，可以推出在某个正的无扭曲次数中存在不变截面。

sentences.en: Combining the natural invariant index with compact-monodromy structure, we deduce that every such X has a nonzero section of some positive anticanonical power.
sentences.zh: 结合自然不变指标和compact-monodromy 结构，我们推出，每个这样的 X 的反典范丛的某个正次幂都存在非零截面。

sentences.en: From a smooth semipositive anticanonical metric on a smooth projective complex variety, we construct an unweighted integrable semipositive metric on a corrected anticanonical line of a smooth base, using a normal equidimensional toroidal model and full generic adjoint rank one at exponent zero.
sentences.zh: 从光滑复射影簇上的光滑半正反典范度量出发，我们利用正规等维环面型模型，以及指数为零处 full generic adjoint rank 为一这一条件，在光滑底空间的修正反典范线丛上构造无权可积半正度量。

sentences.en: The explicit rational boundary correction pulls back to an exceptional divisor.
sentences.zh: 显式的有理边界修正拉回后是一个例外除子。

sentences.en: On varieties without positive-degree holomorphic forms, two-metric transfer gives sections with prescribed boundary poles from a finite-volume log-anticanonical metric and a target line with bounded semipositive weights.
sentences.zh: 在没有正次数全纯形式的簇上，双度量传递从有限体积的对数反典范度量以及具有有界半正权重的目标线丛，给出带有指定边界极点的截面。

sentences.en: In particular, a smooth projective complex variety with a smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle and no such forms has a nonzero invariant section of a positive anticanonical multiple for every torus action with its natural linearization.
sentences.zh: 特别地，对于反典范丛光滑半正且没有上述形式的光滑复射影簇，每个配备自然线性化的环面作用都使某个正反典范倍数具有非零不变截面。

sentences.en: On this class of varieties, generic section and adjoint-rank hypotheses give contractions of invariant fibrations that preserve both conditions unless an invariant global section already exists.
sentences.zh: 在这类簇上，一般截面和伴随秩假设给出了不变纤维化的收缩，并保持这两个条件，除非已经存在不变整体截面。

sentences.en: Let Y be smooth projective and let C be an effective integral divisor.
sentences.zh: 设 Y 光滑且射影，C 是有效整数系数除子。

sentences.en: If $`-K_Y+C`$ admits a metric with a global strict curvature lower bound for which the canonical section of C is locally square integrable, every pseudoeffective rational divisor becomes rationally effective after an effective correction supported on C.
sentences.zh: 若 $`-K_Y+C`$ 存在具有整体严格曲率下界的度量，且 C 的典范截面对该度量局部平方可积，则每个伪有效有理除子在添加支撑于 C 上的有效修正后都变成有理有效的。

sentences.en: For a smooth projective X with smoothly semipositive $`L=-K_X`$, sections of $`m_jL-P`$ at unbounded positive exponents, with any fixed pseudoeffective Cartier error P, yield a section of a positive multiple of L.
sentences.zh: 对于具有光滑半正的 $`L=-K_X`$ 的光滑射影 X，如果在无界的正指数处存在 $`m_jL-P`$ 的截面，其中 P 是任意固定的伪有效 Cartier 误差项，则可得到 L 的某个正倍数的截面。

sentences.en: On a smooth connected projective complex variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, we prove that asymptotically zero valuation on the curvature-null face is attained by an effective rational anticanonical divisor.
sentences.zh: 在反典范丛光滑半正的光滑连通复射影簇上，我们证明，曲率零面上渐近为零的赋值可由一个有效有理反典范除子达到。

sentences.en: The fixed auxiliary line bundle is arbitrary.
sentences.zh: 固定的辅助线丛可以任意选取。

sentences.en: We prove the unramified quantum geometric Langlands equivalence for every connected simple complex algebraic group G and every level $`c\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q`$, including non-real levels.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个连通复单代数群 G 和每个水平 $`c\in\mathbb C\setminus\mathbb Q`$ 的非分歧量子几何 Langlands 等价，包括非实水平。

sentences.en: For every smooth projective connected complex curve X, it identifies the full twisted D-module categories on $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _G(X)`$ and $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _{G^\vee}(X)`$ at the dual shifted levels c and $`-1/(rc)`$, where r is the lacing number.
sentences.zh: 对于每条光滑射影连通复曲线 X，它将 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _G(X)`$ 和 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Bun}}\nolimits _{G^\vee}(X)`$ 上分别处于对偶平移水平 c 和 $`-1/(rc)`$ 的完整扭曲 D-模范畴对应起来，其中 r 是 lacing number。

sentences.en: The equivalence uses the given global forms and includes all connected components.
sentences.zh: 该等价采用给定的整体形式，并包含所有连通分支。

sentences.en: We prove that a circle domain with conformally removable boundary is conformally rigid, with no restriction on the number of complementary components.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，边界共形可去的圆域具有共形刚性，且对补集的连通分支数不作限制。

sentences.en: This establishes the removability-to-rigidity direction of the He–Schramm Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这确立了 He–Schramm 猜想中从可去性到刚性的方向。

sentences.en: We prove that every domain in the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a circle domain, resolving Koebe's circle-domain conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，Riemann 球面中的每个域都共形等价于一个圆域，从而肯定地解决了 Koebe 的圆域猜想。

sentences.en: We prove Brennan's conjecture: if a simply connected plane domain admits a conformal bijection φ onto the unit disk, then $`|\varphi'|^s`$ is area-integrable for every $`4/3\lt s\lt 4`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Brennan 猜想：若某个单连通平面域存在到单位圆盘的共形双射 φ，则对每个 $`4/3\lt s\lt 4`$，$`|\varphi'|^s`$ 都关于面积可积。

sentences.en: We also prove the sharp inverse-square integral-means exponent $`B_{\mathcal S}(-2)=1`$ for the normalized schlicht class $`\mathcal S`$.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了归一化单叶函数类 $`\mathcal S`$ 的最优平方倒数积分均值指数 $`B_{\mathcal S}(-2)=1`$。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform upper bound for inverse-first-power integral means of normalized univalent disk maps with exponent strictly below 1/4.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，归一化单叶圆盘映射的一次倒数积分均值具有一致上界，其指数严格小于 1/4。

sentences.en: Consequently, the bounded universal integral-means spectrum satisfies $`B_b(-1)\lt 1/4`$, disproving Kraetzer's conjectured spectrum at p = −1.
sentences.zh: 因此，有界普适积分均值谱满足 $`B_b(-1)\lt 1/4`$，从而否定了 Kraetzer 猜测的谱在 p = −1 处的取值。

sentences.en: We resolve the Falconer distance conjecture in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了所有维数中的 Falconer 距离猜想。

sentences.en: For every integer d ≥ 2, a compact subset of ℝd with Hausdorff dimension greater than $`d/2`$ determines a set of Euclidean distances of positive Lebesgue measure.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 d ≥ 2，ℝd 中 Hausdorff 维数大于 $`d/2`$ 的紧子集所确定的欧氏距离集合具有正 Lebesgue 测度。

sentences.en: We prove the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维 Kakeya 极大猜想。

sentences.en: For every ε > 0, the maximal average over unit tubes of radius δ maps $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ to $`L^3(S^2)`$ with norm at most $`C_\varepsilon\delta^{-\varepsilon}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 ε > 0，半径为 δ 的单位长度管上的极大平均将 $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ 映到 $`L^3(S^2)`$，范数至多为 $`C_\varepsilon\delta^{-\varepsilon}`$。

sentences.en: We prove the four-dimensional Hausdorff-dimension Kakeya conjecture: every subset of ℝ<sup>4</sup> containing a unit line segment in every direction has Hausdorff dimension four.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了四维 Hausdorff 维数 Kakeya 猜想：ℝ<sup>4</sup> 中每个在所有方向上都包含单位线段的子集，其 Hausdorff 维数均为四。

sentences.en: No compactness or regularity assumption is imposed on the set or its witnessing line family.
sentences.zh: 对该集合以及见证这一性质的线段族，均不施加紧性或正则性假设。

sentences.en: We prove that the ordinary symmetric Fourier partial sums of every complex-valued function in $`L\log L`$ on the circle converge almost everywhere to the function along the full sequence.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，圆周上 $`L\log L`$ 中每个复值函数的通常对称 Fourier 部分和，沿完整序列几乎处处收敛到该函数。

sentences.en: This establishes the classical $`L\log L`$ sufficiency conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这确立了经典的 $`L\log L`$ 充分性猜想。

sentences.en: For every $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$ and every sufficiently large integer N, there is a polynomial of length N with coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ and $`(1+\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$ 和每个充分大的整数 N，都存在长度为 N、系数属于 $`\{-1,1\}`$ 的多项式，其模在单位圆周上处处介于 $`(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ 和 $`(1+\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ 之间。

sentences.en: Thus real Littlewood polynomials can be ultraflat through every sufficiently large integer length.
sentences.zh: 因此，实 Littlewood 多项式可以在每个充分大的整数长度上达到超平坦。

sentences.en: The signs may be chosen separately at each length.
sentences.zh: 可以对每个长度分别选取符号。

sentences.en: For every η > 0 and every sufficiently large integer N, there is a polynomial with N consecutive coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`\sqrt N/16`$ and $`(1+\eta)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 η > 0 和每个充分大的整数 N，都存在一个连续幂次的 N 个系数均取值于 $`\{-1,1\}`$ 的多项式，其模在单位圆周上处处介于 $`\sqrt N/16`$ 和 $`(1+\eta)\sqrt N`$ 之间。

sentences.en: We prove that the minimum possible maximum modulus on the unit circle of a polynomial with N consecutive real coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ is $`(1+o(1))\sqrt N`$, as N tends to infinity through all integers.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，当 N 遍历所有整数趋于无穷时，连续幂次的 N 个实系数均取值于 $`\{-1,1\}`$ 的多项式，在单位圆周上的最大模的最小可能值为 $`(1+o(1))\sqrt N`$。

sentences.en: This disproves the real-sign analogue of Erdős's fixed relative-gap conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Erdős 的固定相对间隙猜想的实符号版本。

sentences.en: As a consequence, the largest binary merit factor at length N tends to infinity through all integer lengths, disproving Turyn's conjecture.
sentences.zh: 由此，当长度遍历所有整数趋于无穷时，长度为 N 的最大二元 merit factor 也趋于无穷，从而否定了 Turyn 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the bounded-data Fourier restriction conjecture for the sphere in three dimensions: the Fourier extension operator maps $`L^\infty(S^2)`$ boundedly into $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every p > 3.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维空间中球面的有界数据 Fourier 限制猜想：对于每个 p > 3，Fourier 延拓算子都从 $`L^\infty(S^2)`$ 有界映入 $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$。

sentences.en: This is the full conjectured open range, and the threshold p = 3 is sharp.
sentences.zh: 这涵盖了猜想的完整开范围，且阈值 p = 3 不能改进。

sentences.en: We prove the diagonal Fourier extension conjecture for compact smooth positively curved surfaces $`\Sigma\subset\mathbb R^3`$, including surfaces with smooth boundary.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了紧光滑正曲率曲面 $`\Sigma\subset\mathbb R^3`$ 的对角 Fourier 延拓猜想，包括具有光滑边界的曲面。

sentences.en: For every $`3\lt p\lt \infty`$, the extension operator maps $`L^p(\Sigma)`$ boundedly into $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 $`3\lt p\lt \infty`$，延拓算子都从 $`L^p(\Sigma)`$ 有界映入 $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$。

sentences.en: The compact paraboloid case also yields free Schrödinger local smoothing in two spatial dimensions for every $`3\lt p\lt \infty`$ and Sobolev order $`s\gt 2-6/p`$.
sentences.zh: 紧抛物面情形还给出了两个空间维数中自由 Schrödinger 方程的局部光滑化，适用于每个 $`3\lt p\lt \infty`$ 和 Sobolev 阶数 $`s\gt 2-6/p`$。

sentences.en: We prove the three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture in its strict-order formulation.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维 Bochner–Riesz 猜想的严格阶数形式。

sentences.en: The main result is boundedness of the Bochner–Riesz multipliers on $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every positive order.
sentences.zh: 主要结果是每个正阶数的 Bochner–Riesz 乘子在 $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ 上的有界性。

sentences.en: Interpolation and duality then give the full conjectured strict range.
sentences.zh: 随后由插值和对偶性得到猜想的完整严格范围。

sentences.en: We prove the critical L3 local smoothing estimate for the wave equation in three spatial dimensions, with every positive Sobolev loss.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维空间中波动方程的临界 L3 局部光滑化估计，允许任意正的 Sobolev 损失。

sentences.en: This resolves Sogge's Euclidean local smoothing conjecture in dimension three.
sentences.zh: 这解决了三维情形的 Sogge 欧氏局部光滑化猜想。

sentences.en: We resolve the planar Sobolev endpoint of Carleson's convergence problem: for initial data in $`H^{1/3}(\mathbb R^2)`$, the Schrödinger evolution converges almost everywhere to the initial data as $`t\downarrow0`$.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了 Carleson 收敛问题的平面 Sobolev 端点情形：对于属于 $`H^{1/3}(\mathbb R^2)`$ 的初始数据，当 $`t\downarrow0`$ 时，Schrödinger 演化几乎处处收敛到初始数据。

sentences.en: The evolution is defined by taking the Gaussian regularization limit first; on one full-measure spatial set, this limit exists for every $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, and the resulting evolution is continuous at t = 0.
sentences.zh: 该演化通过先取高斯正则化极限来定义；在同一个满测度空间点集上，对每个 $`0\lt t\lt 1`$，该极限都存在，且所得演化在 t = 0 处连续。

sentences.en: We resolve the Sobolev endpoint of Carleson's pointwise convergence problem in every dimension n ≥ 3.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了每个维数 n ≥ 3 中 Carleson 逐点收敛问题的 Sobolev 端点情形。

sentences.en: For initial data in $`H^{n/(2(n+1))}(\mathbb R^n)`$, the free Schrödinger evolution converges almost everywhere to the initial data as $`t\downarrow0`$.
sentences.zh: 对于属于 $`H^{n/(2(n+1))}(\mathbb R^n)`$ 的初始数据，当 $`t\downarrow0`$ 时，自由 Schrödinger 演化几乎处处收敛到初始数据。

sentences.en: The evolution is defined by removing Gaussian regularization on one full-measure spatial set, uniformly over the interval $`0\lt t\lt 1`$.
sentences.zh: 该演化通过在同一个满测度空间点集上、对区间 $`0\lt t\lt 1`$ 一致地去掉高斯正则化来定义。

sentences.en: We prove that an n-Ahlfors–David regular Radon measure on ℝd is uniformly n-rectifiable if its n-dimensional Riesz transform is uniformly bounded from scalar $`L^2(\mu)`$ to vector-valued $`L^2(\mu)`$ over all positive hard truncations, for integers d ≥ 4 and $`2\le n\le d-2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于整数 d ≥ 4 和 $`2\le n\le d-2`$，若 ℝd 上的 n-Ahlfors–David 正则 Radon 测度的 n 维 Riesz 变换，对于所有正的硬截断都从标量值 $`L^2(\mu)`$ 到向量值 $`L^2(\mu)`$ 一致有界，则该测度一致 n-可求长。

sentences.en: This gives a positive answer to the David–Semmes Riesz-transform question in its remaining higher-codimension range.
sentences.zh: 这在 David–Semmes Riesz 变换问题尚余的高余维范围内给出了肯定回答。

sentences.en: The conclusion gives uniform big pieces of Lipschitz images of Euclidean balls.
sentences.zh: 该结论给出了欧氏球的 Lipschitz 像的一致大块性质。

sentences.en: We prove the annular r-variation estimate for the triangular Hilbert transform from complex $`L^3\times L^3`$ to L3/2 for every r > 2.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 r > 2，我们证明了三角 Hilbert 变换从复值 $`L^3\times L^3`$ 到 L3/2 的环形 r-变差估计。

sentences.en: The partitions may depend on the output point and range over all positive scales.
sentences.zh: 这些分割可以依赖于输出点，并遍历所有正尺度。

sentences.en: The estimate yields the two-endpoint maximal bound and joint almost-everywhere and norm principal values, and resolves the symmetric scalar triangular Hilbert transform problem.
sentences.zh: 该估计给出双端点极大界，以及在几乎处处和范数意义下的联合主值，并解决了对称标量三角 Hilbert 变换问题。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform $`L^3\times L^3\times L^3`$ estimate for the dyadic triangular Hilbert form with unrestricted real inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们对于不受限制的实值输入，证明了二进三角 Hilbert 形式的一致 $`L^3\times L^3\times L^3`$ 估计。

sentences.en: The sum of the absolute local contributions over any finite set of scales is bounded by forty times the product of the input norms.
sentences.zh: 在任意有限尺度集合上，各局部贡献的绝对值之和至多为输入范数乘积的四十倍。

sentences.en: In particular, the bound allows coefficients of modulus at most one to vary independently among admissible interval triples.
sentences.zh: 特别地，该界允许模至多为一的系数在各个可容许区间三元组之间独立变化。

sentences.en: For arbitrary complex inputs in $`L^3(\mathbb R^2)`$, we prove the pointwise maximal $`L^3\times L^3\to L^{3/2}`$ estimate for the triangular Hilbert transform, with the supremum over both hard truncation endpoints.
sentences.zh: 对于 $`L^3(\mathbb R^2)`$ 中任意复值输入，我们证明了三角 Hilbert 变换的逐点极大 $`L^3\times L^3\to L^{3/2}`$ 估计，其中上确界同时对两个硬截断端点取。

sentences.en: The estimate yields joint almost-everywhere and L3/2 convergence as the lower endpoint tends to zero and the upper endpoint tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 当下端点趋于零、上端点趋于无穷时，该估计给出了几乎处处意义和 L3/2 意义下的联合收敛。

sentences.en: This also proves the conjectured scalar estimate at the symmetric point.
sentences.zh: 这也证明了所猜测的对称点处标量估计。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform L2 bound for the Hilbert transform along a Lipschitz unit vector field in the plane, with integration restricted to a fixed absolute multiple of the reciprocal Lipschitz seminorm.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了沿平面中 Lipschitz 单位向量场的 Hilbert 变换的一致 L2 界，其中积分范围限制为 Lipschitz 半范数倒数的某个固定绝对常数倍。

sentences.en: The bound is uniform in the inner truncation and holds for fields depending on both coordinates.
sentences.zh: 该界对内截断一致，并适用于依赖两个坐标的向量场。

sentences.en: This gives an affirmative answer to Stein's weak-$`(2,2)`$ conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地回答了 Stein 的弱 $`(2,2)`$ 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the geometric-progression case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Erdős 相似性猜想的等比数列情形。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`q\in(0,1)`$ and every $`\eta\in(0,1)`$, we construct a compact set $`E_{q,\eta}\subseteq[0,1]`$ of measure greater than $`1-\eta`$ containing no nontrivial affine copy of $`\{q^n:n\ge1\}`$, for any translation and either sign of nonzero dilation.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`q\in(0,1)`$ 和每个 $`\eta\in(0,1)`$，我们构造了测度大于 $`1-\eta`$ 的紧集 $`E_{q,\eta}\subseteq[0,1]`$，其中不包含 $`\{q^n:n\ge1\}`$ 的任何非平凡仿射副本，无论采用何种平移以及正负何种符号的非零伸缩。

sentences.en: The set may depend on q; the result makes no simultaneous assertion for different ratios.
sentences.zh: 该集合可以依赖于 q；这一结果并不对不同公比作同时成立的断言。

sentences.en: We construct a compact subset of the unit interval, of measure arbitrarily close to one, that contains no affine copy of the dyadic sequence $`\{2^{-n}:n\ge1\}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了单位区间的一个紧子集，其测度可任意接近一，且不含二进序列 $`\{2^{-n}:n\ge1\}`$ 的任何仿射副本。

sentences.en: The conclusion holds for every translation and every nonzero real dilation, of either sign, proving the dyadic case of the Erdős similarity conjecture.
sentences.zh: 该结论对每种平移以及正负任一符号的每个非零实伸缩均成立，从而证明了 Erdős 相似性猜想的二进情形。

sentences.en: We prove the endpoint gradient bound $`\|\nabla Mf\|_1\le C\|\nabla f\|_1`$ for every real-valued $`f\in W^{1,1}(\mathbb R^2)`$, where $`Mf(x)`$ is the supremum of the averages of $`|f|`$ over disks centered at x, and C is an absolute constant.
sentences.zh: 我们对于每个实值 $`f\in W^{1,1}(\mathbb R^2)`$ 证明了端点梯度界 $`\|\nabla Mf\|_1\le C\|\nabla f\|_1`$，其中 $`Mf(x)`$ 是 $`|f|`$ 在以 x 为中心的圆盘上的平均值的上确界，C 是绝对常数。

sentences.en: The maximal function belongs to $`W^{1,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb R^2)`$ and has a globally integrable weak gradient.
sentences.zh: 该极大函数属于 $`W^{1,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb R^2)`$，并具有整体可积的弱梯度。

sentences.en: This gives a positive resolution of the planar centered-disk case of the endpoint question of Hajłasz and Onninen.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Hajłasz 和 Onninen 端点问题的平面中心圆盘情形。

sentences.en: We prove that the trilinear Hilbert transform with fixed slopes 1, 2, 3 maps $`L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)`$ to $`L^1(\mathbb R)`$, resolving this case of the trilinear Hilbert transform conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，固定斜率为 1、2、3 的三线性 Hilbert 变换将 $`L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)`$ 映到 $`L^1(\mathbb R)`$，从而解决了三线性 Hilbert 变换猜想的这一情形。

sentences.en: We resolve the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively, including its equality classification.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定地解决了对称 Mahler 猜想，包括等号情形的分类。

sentences.en: Every origin-symmetric convex body in ℝn has volume product at least $`4^n/n!`$, with equality exactly for invertible linear images of Hanner polytopes.
sentences.zh: ℝn 中每个关于原点对称的凸体的体积积至少为 $`4^n/n!`$，且等号成立当且仅当它是 Hanner 多胞形的可逆线性像。

sentences.en: We resolve the Mahler conjecture for general convex bodies positively.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定地解决了一般凸体的 Mahler 猜想。

sentences.en: For every convex body $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$, n ≥ 1, with Santaló point $`s(K)`$, $`|K|\,|(K-s(K))^\circ|\ge (n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2`$, with equality exactly for simplices.
sentences.zh: 对于每个凸体 $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$，其中 n ≥ 1，若其 Santaló 点为 $`s(K)`$，则 $`|K|\,|(K-s(K))^\circ|\ge (n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2`$，且等号成立当且仅当它是单纯形。

sentences.en: For every integer n ≥ 2 and every origin-symmetric convex body $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$, we prove that the Gromov width of $`\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K\times\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K^\circ`$ is 4.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 n ≥ 2 和每个关于原点对称的凸体 $`K\subset\mathbb R^n`$，我们证明 $`\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K\times\mathop{\mathrm{int}}\nolimits K^\circ`$ 的 Gromov 宽度为 4。

sentences.en: We construct smooth symplectic embeddings of standard balls of every capacity $`0\lt c\lt 4`$ into this polar product.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了每个容量 $`0\lt c\lt 4`$ 的标准球到这一极对偶乘积中的光滑辛嵌入。

sentences.en: Volume preservation then resolves the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 随后由体积保持性在所有维数中肯定地解决了对称 Mahler 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that ellipsoids uniquely minimize the volume of the projection body among convex bodies of fixed volume in every dimension at least four.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在每个至少为四的维数中，在体积固定的凸体之间，椭球唯一地使投影体的体积达到最小。

sentences.en: This proves Petty's projection-volume conjecture in these dimensions.
sentences.zh: 这证明了这些维数中的 Petty 投影体体积猜想。
