sentences.en: The product of two ten-dimensional simplices has larger normalized projection-body volume than a twenty-dimensional simplex.
sentences.zh: 两个十维单纯形的乘积，其归一化投影体体积大于二十维单纯形的归一化投影体体积。

sentences.en: This gives a counterexample to Brannen's proposed simplex maximum.
sentences.zh: 这给出了 Brannen 所提出的单纯形最大性断言的一个反例。

sentences.en: We prove that every finite connected planar graph with arbitrary positive real edge lengths embeds into real L1 with a universal distortion bound.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个边长为任意正实数的有限连通平面图都可以嵌入实 L1，且畸变具有普适上界。

sentences.en: This resolves the planar embedding conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了平面图嵌入猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed treewidth bound, the shortest-path metrics of finite connected graphs with arbitrary positive real edge lengths embed into real L1 with uniformly bounded distortion.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的树宽上界，满足该树宽上界且边长为任意正实数的有限连通图的最短路径度量均可嵌入实 L1，且畸变一致有界。

sentences.en: This resolves the bounded-treewidth case of the Gupta–Newman–Rabinovich–Sinclair conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Gupta–Newman–Rabinovich–Sinclair 猜想中树宽有界的情形。

sentences.en: We prove that the density-one triangular lattice minimizes the lower energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone function of squared distance, among all locally finite planar configurations of centered disk density one.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于距离平方的每个非负完全单调函数，在所有按中心圆盘计算的密度为一的局部有限平面构型中，密度为一的三角格使每粒子的下能量最小。

sentences.en: The comparison includes infinite energies.
sentences.zh: 这一比较也包括无穷能量。

sentences.en: The proof constructs sharp Gaussian Fourier minorants using an atomic interpolation certificate.
sentences.zh: 证明利用一个原子插值证书构造最优的高斯 Fourier 下界函数。

sentences.en: We prove universal energy minimality for the triangular lattice in the plane.
sentences.zh: 我们证明平面上三角格的普适能量极小性。

sentences.en: Among locally finite configurations of centered density one, it minimizes the lower limit of centered-ball energy averages for every nonnegative completely monotone function of squared distance, including when the energy is infinite.
sentences.zh: 在中心密度为一的局部有限构型中，对于距离平方的每个非负完全单调函数，三角格使中心球能量平均值的下极限最小，包括能量为无穷的情形。

sentences.en: We also prove triangular minimality for planar logarithmic and Riesz renormalized energies, with $`0\lt s\lt 2`$ in the Riesz case, and the corresponding jellium minima.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了三角格对于平面对数重整化能量和 Riesz 重整化能量的极小性，其中 Riesz 情形满足 $`0\lt s\lt 2`$，并证明了相应的 jellium 最小值。

sentences.en: The proof uses sharp Gaussian Fourier bounds, positive mixtures, and heat-kernel comparison.
sentences.zh: 证明使用最优的高斯 Fourier 界、正混合以及热核比较。

sentences.en: We resolve the planar Cohn–Elkies sharpness conjecture: the two-point Fourier bound attains the optimal circle-packing density $`\pi/(2\sqrt3)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们解决平面的 Cohn–Elkies 最优性猜想：两点 Fourier 界达到最优圆堆积密度 $`\pi/(2\sqrt3)`$。

sentences.en: We construct a radial Schwartz certificate and prove its global sign conditions using rigorous interval arithmetic and analytic estimates.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个径向 Schwartz 证书，并利用严格区间算术和解析估计证明其全局符号条件。

sentences.en: The same certificate recovers the classical uniqueness of the triangular packing among periodic equality cases.
sentences.zh: 同一证书还重新得到三角堆积在周期性等号情形中的经典唯一性结论。

sentences.en: We prove the Sandier–Serfaty conjecture: the triangular lattice of covolume one minimizes planar Coulomb renormalized energy over all admissible curl-free fields with a unit uniform background.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Sandier–Serfaty 猜想：在具有单位均匀背景的所有容许无旋场中，余体积为一的三角格使平面 Coulomb 重整化能量最小。

sentences.en: Combined with Bétermin and Sandier's asymptotic formula, this also proves the Brauchart–Hardin–Saff conjecture for the linear term of optimal ordered-pair logarithmic energy on the unit two-sphere.
sentences.zh: 结合 Bétermin 和 Sandier 的渐近公式，这还证明了关于单位二维球面上最优有序对对数能量之线性项的 Brauchart–Hardin–Saff 猜想。

sentences.en: The proof uses a direct Voronoi-cell comparison with rigorous interval arithmetic.
sentences.zh: 证明使用直接的 Voronoi 胞腔比较和严格区间算术。

sentences.en: We prove the logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski conjecture for arbitrary origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们证明每一维中任意关于原点对称的凸体所满足的对数 Brunn–Minkowski 猜想。

sentences.en: The theorem also gives the symmetric Lp Brunn–Minkowski inequality for every $`0\lt p\lt 1`$.
sentences.zh: 该定理还给出每个 $`0\lt p\lt 1`$ 下的对称 Lp Brunn–Minkowski 不等式。

sentences.en: Combined with Saroglou's transfer theorem and a support-subspace reduction, it yields the logarithmic inequality for every even log-concave Radon measure and the scalar-dilation $`(B)`$-conjecture.
sentences.zh: 结合 Saroglou 的转移定理和支撑子空间约化，该定理给出每个偶对数凹 Radon 测度的对数不等式，以及标量伸缩 $`(B)`$ 猜想。

sentences.en: Every convex body in ℝn, n ≥ 2, admits a covering by translates along one full-rank lattice with density at most $`Cn\log n`$, for an absolute constant C.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℝn 中的每个凸体，其中 n ≥ 2，都存在沿一个满秩格的平移覆盖，其密度至多为 $`Cn\log n`$，其中 C 为绝对常数。

sentences.en: No symmetry or boundary regularity is assumed.
sentences.zh: 这里不假设对称性或边界正则性。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large dimension n, we construct a centrally symmetric convex body whose translative covering density exceeds $`c n\log n`$, where c > 0 is absolute.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的维数 n，我们构造一个中心对称凸体，其平移覆盖密度超过 $`c n\log n`$，其中 c > 0 为绝对常数。

sentences.en: This disproves the existence of a universal linear upper bound and matches the order of Rogers' upper bound.
sentences.zh: 这否定了普适线性上界的存在性，并与 Rogers 上界的阶相匹配。

sentences.en: We prove that every centered log-concave probability measure with a Lebesgue density on ℝn and linear subgaussian parameter a satisfies $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ent}}\nolimits _\mu(f^2)\le Ca^2\int|Df|^2\,d\mu`$ for compactly supported smooth f, with one universal constant C.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，ℝn 上每个具有 Lebesgue 密度、中心在原点且线性次高斯参数为 a 的对数凹概率测度，对于紧支撑光滑函数 f 都满足 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ent}}\nolimits _\mu(f^2)\le Ca^2\int|Df|^2\,d\mu`$，其中 C 是同一个普适常数。

sentences.en: This resolves positively the dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev conjecture for subgaussian log-concave measures.
sentences.zh: 这正面解决了次高斯对数凹测度的无维数依赖对数 Sobolev 猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`1\lt p\lt \infty`$ and D > 1, every n-point subset of a real Lp space embeds into $`\ell_p^d`$ with distortion at most D and subpolynomial dimension $`d=n^{o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`1\lt p\lt \infty`$ 和 D > 1，实 Lp 空间的每个 n 点子集都可嵌入 $`\ell_p^d`$，其畸变至多为 D，维数为次多项式量级 $`d=n^{o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: The target has the same exponent p, and the embedding need not be linear.
sentences.zh: 目标空间具有相同的指数 p，且嵌入不必是线性的。

sentences.en: We prove that not every hyperbolicity cone is a spectrahedral shadow: some closed hyperbolicity cones admit no finite affine semidefinite lift, even with arbitrary real coefficients and any finite number of auxiliary variables.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，并非每个双曲锥都是 spectrahedral shadow：某些闭双曲锥不存在有限仿射半正定提升，即使允许任意实系数和任意有限多个辅助变量也不例外。

sentences.en: This disproves the Projected Lax Conjecture and hence the generalized Lax conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了投影 Lax 猜想，因而也否定了广义 Lax 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a homogeneous polynomial of degree 16 in 23 real variables whose hyperbolicity cone has no representation by a finite homogeneous real symmetric linear matrix inequality.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个具有 23 个实变量的 16 次齐次多项式，其双曲锥不能由有限齐次实对称线性矩阵不等式表示。

sentences.en: This disproves the geometric Generalized Lax conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了几何形式的广义 Lax 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct an exact semidefinite lift of the explicit nonspectrahedral hyperbolicity cone in twenty-three variables defined in the companion paper.
sentences.zh: 我们为配套论文中定义的那个显式的、具有二十三个变量的非谱面体双曲锥构造一个精确半正定提升。

sentences.en: The lift is a homogeneous real symmetric pencil of size 100 with 307 auxiliary variables and represents the entire closed cone, including every point with singular X.
sentences.zh: 该提升是一个大小为 100、带有 307 个辅助变量的齐次实对称矩阵束，表示整个闭锥，包括 X 奇异的每一点。

sentences.en: Thus, although this cone has no semidefinite representation in its original coordinates, it admits one when auxiliary variables are allowed.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管该锥在其原坐标中没有半正定表示，但允许辅助变量时就存在这样的表示。

sentences.en: The stated sizes are not claimed to be minimal.
sentences.zh: 我们不声称所给出的大小是最小的。

sentences.en: We prove the Gaussian propeller conjecture: for every finite measurable partition of a Euclidean space, the sum of the squared lengths of its Gaussian first moments is at most $`9/(8\pi)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明高斯螺旋桨猜想：对于欧氏空间的每个有限可测划分，其各部分的高斯一阶矩的长度平方之和至多为 $`9/(8\pi)`$。

sentences.en: For dimension at least two and at least three cells, three planar sectors of angle $`2\pi/3`$, extended by an orthogonal Euclidean factor, attain the bound.
sentences.zh: 当维数至少为二且划分至少有三个部分时，将三个角度为 $`2\pi/3`$ 的平面扇形沿正交的欧氏因子延拓，便可达到该界。

sentences.en: Every prescribed-order finite sequence of vectors in the Euclidean unit ball of ℝd has one signing for which every signed prefix has norm at most $`C\sqrt d`$, with C absolute and independent of the sequence length.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℝd 的欧氏单位球中按指定顺序排列的每个有限向量序列，都存在一种符号赋值，使每个带符号前缀和的范数至多为 $`C\sqrt d`$，其中 C 是与序列长度无关的绝对常数。

sentences.en: Consequently, every indexed zero-sum family of unit-ball vectors admits an ordering with the same bound for its unsigned partial sums.
sentences.zh: 因此，单位球中每个带指标的零和向量族，都存在一种排序，使其不带符号的部分和满足同样的界。

sentences.en: This determines the Euclidean Steinitz constant up to absolute factors, $`S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)`$, and resolves the Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这在相差绝对常数因子的意义下确定了欧氏 Steinitz 常数，即 $`S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)`$，并解决了欧氏 Steinitz–Bergström 猜想。

sentences.en: Every infinite-dimensional real Banach space contains a compact doubling subset that admits no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional real normed space.
sentences.zh: 每个无限维实 Banach 空间都包含一个紧的倍增子集，该子集不能双 Lipschitz 嵌入任何有限维实赋范空间。

sentences.en: The doubling constant has a universal bound, independent of the ambient Banach space.
sentences.zh: 倍增常数具有与所在 Banach 空间无关的普适界。

sentences.en: This answers the Lang–Plaut problem negatively, even for compact subsets of Hilbert space.
sentences.zh: 这对 Lang–Plaut 问题给出否定回答，即使对于 Hilbert 空间的紧子集也是如此。

sentences.en: We determine the exponential scale of the least ℓ1 distortion of unit-cost edit distance on all strings of length at most d.
sentences.zh: 我们确定了长度至多为 d 的所有字符串上单位代价编辑距离的最小 ℓ1 畸变的指数尺度。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large d, uniformly over finite alphabets of size at least two, the distortion lies between $`\exp(c\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ and $`\exp(C\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ for absolute constants $`c,C\gt 0`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的 d，在大小至少为二的所有有限字母表上一致地，该畸变介于 $`\exp(c\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ 与 $`\exp(C\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ 之间，其中 $`c,C\gt 0`$ 是绝对常数。

sentences.en: The lower bound already holds on binary strings of one common length.
sentences.zh: 该下界在具有同一长度的二元字符串上就已成立。

sentences.en: Thus the order of logarithmic distortion is sharp up to absolute constants.
sentences.zh: 因此，畸变的对数的阶在相差绝对常数的意义下是最优的。

sentences.en: We give two finite-circle constructions of binary strings whose least ℓ1 distortion is $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$, where d bounds their length.
sentences.zh: 我们给出二元字符串的两种 finite-circle 构造，其最小 ℓ1 畸变为 $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$，其中 d 是其长度上界。

sentences.en: Both constructions supply words of one common length for every sufficiently large cap.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的长度上限，两种构造都给出具有同一长度的词。

sentences.en: Two direct binary coding arguments transfer the constructions with absolute distortion and logarithmic block width.
sentences.zh: 两个直接的二元编码论证以绝对常数畸变和对数级分块宽度转移这些构造。

sentences.en: We also develop the overlapping-substring method of Ostrovsky and Rabani into a complete finite histogram embedding at the same exponential scale, uniformly over all finite alphabets and all words of length at most d, including the empty word.
sentences.zh: 我们还将 Ostrovsky 和 Rabani 的重叠子串方法发展为同一指数尺度下的完整有限直方图嵌入，在所有有限字母表和所有长度至多为 d 的词上一致成立，其中包括空词。

sentences.en: We give two independent constructions of binary words of one length at most d whose ordinary edit-distance metrics require ℓ1 distortion $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$ for every sufficiently large d.
sentences.zh: 我们给出两种独立构造，得到具有同一长度且该长度至多为 d 的二元词；对于每个充分大的 d，它们的普通编辑距离度量需要 $`\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d}))`$ 的 ℓ1 畸变。

sentences.en: We also prove a constant-distortion binary conversion for one prescribed input length.
sentences.zh: 我们还对一个指定的输入长度证明了常数畸变的二元转换。

sentences.en: Together with the companion upper embedding theorem, these lower bounds determine the order of logarithmic distortion uniformly over finite alphabets with at least two symbols.
sentences.zh: 结合配套的上界嵌入定理，这些下界在至少含两个符号的有限字母表上一致地确定了畸变的对数的阶。

sentences.en: A regular tetrahedron admits a finite cylinder covering with compact triangular perpendicular bases whose total area is less than half its minimum orthogonal projection area.
sentences.zh: 正四面体存在一个有限柱体覆盖，其垂直底面为紧三角形，且底面总面积小于该四面体最小正交投影面积的一半。

sentences.en: This disproves the half-area cylinder-covering conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了半面积柱体覆盖猜想。

sentences.en: By affine invariance, the same construction gives a counterexample to the directionwise normalized half-bound for every nondegenerate tetrahedron.
sentences.zh: 由仿射不变性，同一构造为每个非退化四面体给出了逐方向归一化半界的反例。

sentences.en: We approximate compact ruled families of segments by finitely many cylinders with square intercept tiles and perpendicular-base area at most their integral projection cost plus any positive error.
sentences.zh: 我们用有限多个带有正方形截距片（square intercept tiles）的柱体来逼近由线段组成的紧直纹族，使垂直底面面积至多为其积分投影代价加上任意正误差。

sentences.en: The velocity field is C1, and its differential has opposite real eigenvalues whose magnitudes are strictly below the inverse segment half-length; both eigenvalues may vanish.
sentences.zh: 速度场为 C1，其微分具有互为相反数的实特征值，且这些特征值的绝对值严格小于线段半长的倒数；两个特征值都可以为零。

sentences.en: The result includes square-zero differentials with unrestricted shear and fields that pass between the two regimes.
sentences.zh: 这一结果涵盖剪切不受限制的平方为零的微分，以及在这两种情形之间过渡的场。

sentences.en: It holds for arbitrary compact label sets.
sentences.zh: 它对任意紧的标号集成立。

sentences.en: The two-cylinder covering of a regular tetrahedron can be perturbed to give finite covers with total perpendicular base area strictly below half its minimum projection area.
sentences.zh: 正四面体的双柱体覆盖可以经过扰动而得到有限覆盖，其垂直底面的总面积严格小于该四面体最小投影面积的一半。

sentences.en: These covers give negative answers to both the half-area question and the directionwise normalized half-bound conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这些覆盖对半面积问题和逐方向归一化半界猜想都给出否定回答。

sentences.en: By affine invariance, the directionwise conclusion holds for every nondegenerate tetrahedron.
sentences.zh: 由仿射不变性，逐方向的结论对每个非退化四面体都成立。

sentences.en: We prove that radially aligned segment sweeps admit finite cylinder covers with one triangular base for each interval of any tagged partition.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，沿径向排列的线段扫掠集存在有限柱体覆盖，对任意带标记分割的每个区间各使用一个三角形底面。

sentences.en: As the mesh tends to zero, the total perpendicular base area converges to a weighted parameter area.
sentences.zh: 当网格大小趋于零时，垂直底面的总面积收敛于一个加权参数面积。

sentences.en: An explicit application covers every regular tetrahedron with total base area below half its minimum projection area, giving negative answers to the half-area question and the directionwise normalized 1-Codimensional Cylinder Covering Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 一个显式应用以总底面面积小于最小投影面积一半的柱体覆盖每个正四面体，从而对半面积问题和逐方向归一化的 1-余维柱体覆盖猜想给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We prove the strong isotropic constant conjecture: in each dimension, simplices are the unique maximizers of the isotropic constant among convex bodies.
sentences.zh: 我们证明强迷向常数猜想：在每一维中，单纯形是所有凸体中迷向常数的唯一极大者。

sentences.en: We also prove the sharp entropy bound $`h(f)\ge m+\tfrac12\log\det\mathop{\mathrm{Cov}}\nolimits (f)`$ for every log-concave probability density on ℝm, with equality precisely for invertible affine images of products of one-sided exponential laws.
sentences.zh: 我们还对 ℝm 上的每个对数凹概率密度证明最优熵界 $`h(f)\ge m+\tfrac12\log\det\mathop{\mathrm{Cov}}\nolimits (f)`$，且等号恰在单侧指数分布的乘积的可逆仿射像处取得。

sentences.en: We prove the Unique Games Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明唯一博弈猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1/2)`$, we give a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3SAT to Unique Games over a fixed finite alphabet, with completeness at least $`1-\varepsilon`$ and soundness at most δ.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1/2)`$，我们给出从 3SAT 到固定有限字母表上唯一博弈的确定性多项式时间归约，其完备性至少为 $`1-\varepsilon`$，可靠性至多为 δ。

sentences.en: We prove that approximating Max-Cut on simple unweighted graphs within any fixed factor greater than the Goemans–Williamson constant is NP-hard.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，即使在简单无权图上，以任意固定的大于 Goemans–Williamson 常数的因子近似最大割也是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: We prove that minimum Vertex Cover is NP-hard to approximate within every fixed factor below two, even on simple unweighted graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，以任意固定的小于二的因子近似最小顶点覆盖是 NP-hard 的，即使在简单无权图上也是如此。

sentences.en: For every fixed C > 1, approximating Min-UnCut within factor C is NP-hard, even on simple undirected unweighted graphs.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 C > 1，以因子 C 近似 Min-UnCut 是 NP-hard 的，即使在简单无向无权图上也是如此。

sentences.en: Approximating minimum directed feedback vertex set within any fixed constant factor is NP-hard, even on unweighted digraphs.
sentences.zh: 以任意固定常数因子近似最小有向反馈顶点集是 NP-hard 的，即使在无权有向图上也是如此。

sentences.en: We prove $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$, resolving the derandomization problem for polynomial-time randomized logarithmic space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 $`\mathsf L=\mathsf{RL}=\mathsf{BPL}`$，解决了多项式时间随机对数空间的去随机化问题。

sentences.en: We give a uniform deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm for finite turn-based stochastic mean-payoff games with signed integer rewards and rational chance-transition probabilities encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 对于奖励为有符号整数、随机转移概率为二进制编码有理数的有限轮流行动随机平均收益博弈，我们给出一个一致的确定性准多项式时间算法。

sentences.en: It computes exactly the vertices of nonnegative value, including value zero, for the expectation of the pathwise liminf mean payoff.
sentences.zh: 对于逐路径下极限平均收益的期望，该算法精确计算具有非负值的顶点，包括值为零的顶点。

sentences.en: The algorithm uses exact rational arithmetic and $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations, where L is the complete binary input length.
sentences.zh: 该算法使用精确有理数算术和 $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ 次位运算，其中 L 是完整的二进制输入长度。

sentences.en: We give a uniform deterministic quasipolynomial-time algorithm for mean-payoff parity games.
sentences.zh: 我们给出平均收益奇偶博弈的一个一致的确定性准多项式时间算法。

sentences.en: It computes all vertices from which a player can enforce both nonnegative liminf mean payoff and the parity condition, with arbitrary signed binary rewards and unrestricted binary priorities.
sentences.zh: 对于任意有符号二进制编码奖励和不受限制的二进制编码优先级，该算法计算所有满足如下条件的顶点：某位玩家从该顶点出发可以同时保证非负的下极限平均收益和奇偶条件。

sentences.en: The running time is $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations, where L is the complete input length.
sentences.zh: 运行时间为 $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ 次位运算，其中 L 是完整输入长度。

sentences.en: We give a deterministic algorithm that computes the complete zero-threshold winning set of a finite mean-payoff game with arbitrary signed integer edge weights encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 对于边权为二进制编码的任意有符号整数的有限平均收益博弈，我们给出一个计算完整零阈值获胜集的确定性算法。

sentences.en: For total explicit input length L, it uses $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations.
sentences.zh: 当显式输入的总长度为 L 时，它使用 $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ 次位运算。

sentences.en: A reduction also computes the exact rational value at every vertex and globally optimal positional strategies for both players within the same quasipolynomial bound.
sentences.zh: 通过一个归约，还可以在同样的准多项式界内计算每个顶点的精确有理值，以及双方玩家的全局最优位置策略。

sentences.en: We give a randomized algorithm that computes the complete zero-threshold winning set of a finite mean-payoff game with arbitrary signed integer edge weights encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 对于边权为二进制编码的任意有符号整数的有限平均收益博弈，我们给出一个计算完整零阈值获胜集的随机算法。

sentences.en: For total explicit input length L, it uses $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations on every random tape and is correct with probability at least 7/8.
sentences.zh: 当显式输入的总长度为 L 时，它在每条随机带上都使用 $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ 次位运算，且正确概率至少为 7/8。

sentences.en: A polynomial-time check certifies the winning regions and positional strategies for both players or reports failure.
sentences.zh: 一个多项式时间检查能够认证双方玩家的获胜区域和位置策略，或报告失败。

sentences.en: Independent repetition therefore gives an always-correct algorithm with the same expected quasipolynomial bit bound.
sentences.zh: 因此，独立重复运行会给出一个始终正确的算法，其期望位运算次数满足同样的准多项式界。

sentences.en: We prove the 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness.
sentences.zh: 我们证明具有完美完备性的 2-to-1 博弈猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed rational $`\delta\in(0,1)`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable 2-to-1 games from games of value at most δ, with a fixed alphabet and an explicitly listed unweighted multiset of constraints.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的有理数 $`\delta\in(0,1)`$，在字母表固定且约束以无权多重集的形式显式列出的情形下，区分可满足的 2-to-1 博弈与值至多为 δ 的博弈是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: We prove that, for every fixed $`0\lt \delta\lt 1/3`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish three-colorable graphs from graphs in which every independent set has fewer than δ times the number of vertices.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于每个固定的 $`0\lt \delta\lt 1/3`$，区分可三着色图与其中每个独立集的大小都严格小于顶点数的 δ 倍的图，是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: Consequently, for every fixed integer c ≥ 3, finding a proper c-coloring of a three-colorable graph is NP-hard.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于每个固定整数 c ≥ 3，寻找可三着色图的一个正常 c 着色是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: We prove that the exponent of matrix multiplication over the complex numbers is at most 9/4.
sentences.zh: 我们证明复数域上的矩阵乘法指数至多为 9/4。

sentences.en: — secondary writeup Over every field of characteristic zero, we prove that the square matrix-multiplication exponent satisfies ω < 2.258, the dual exponent satisfies α > 0.465, and $`\omega(1,0.709,1)\lt 2.092`$.
sentences.zh: ——另一篇论述：在每个特征为零的域上，我们证明方阵乘法指数满足 ω < 2.258，对偶指数满足 α > 0.465，且 $`\omega(1,0.709,1)\lt 2.092`$。

sentences.en: The strict square and k = 0.709 rectangular bounds also hold over every field except possibly in one finite set of positive characteristics, in the arithmetic-operation model.
sentences.zh: 在算术运算模型下，严格的方阵界和 k = 0.709 的矩形矩阵界也在每个域上成立，可能的例外仅限于某个有限正特征集合中的特征。

sentences.en: We prove that the arithmetic exponent of square matrix multiplication over every fixed field satisfies ω < 2.371054886006746.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在每个固定域上，方阵乘法的算术指数都满足 ω < 2.371054886006746。

sentences.en: This includes every positive characteristic.
sentences.zh: 这包括每个正特征。

sentences.en: We prove that the complex border determinantal complexity of the $`m\times m`$ permanent is $`\Omega(m^3)`$, allowing arbitrary affine-linear determinant representations and coefficientwise limits.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`m\times m`$ 积和式在复数域上的边界行列式复杂度为 $`\Omega(m^3)`$，其中允许任意仿射线性行列式表示和逐系数极限。

sentences.en: It also gives cubic lower bounds for exact determinantal complexity and for the numbers of vertices and edges in affine-linear algebraic branching programs, including coefficientwise limits with a fixed vertex or edge budget.
sentences.zh: 该结果还给出精确行列式复杂度以及仿射线性代数分支程序中顶点数和边数的三次下界，其中包括在顶点数或边数预算固定时的逐系数极限。

sentences.en: We give a deterministic algorithm that multiplies two n-bit integers in $`O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})`$ worst-case time, with $`\kappa=2^{-182}`$, on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with a fixed finite number of one-dimensional tapes.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个确定性算法，在一台固定的、具有固定有限条一维带的有限字母表图灵机上，以 $`O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})`$ 的最坏情形时间将两个 n 位整数相乘，其中 $`\kappa=2^{-182}`$。

sentences.en: The algorithm is exact for every input length and disproves the $`n\log n`$ optimality conjecture of Schönhage and Strassen in this model.
sentences.zh: 该算法对每个输入长度都是精确的，并否定了 Schönhage 和 Strassen 在此模型下的 $`n\log n`$ 最优性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that randomized k-server has competitive ratio $`O((\log(k+1))^2)`$ on every metric space against oblivious request sequences, matching the known worst-case lower bound.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在每个度量空间上，随机 k 服务器问题针对非自适应请求序列具有 $`O((\log(k+1))^2)`$ 的竞争比，与已知的最坏情形下界匹配。

sentences.en: For each metric and initial configuration, one policy works for all finite request sequences, including on infinite and unbounded spaces.
sentences.zh: 对于每个度量和初始构型，存在同一个策略适用于所有有限请求序列，其中也包括无限和无界空间的情形。

sentences.en: When the initial server positions are distinct, no additive term is needed.
sentences.zh: 当服务器的初始位置两两不同时，不需要加法项。

sentences.en: We construct a uniform randomized k-server algorithm on finite rational metrics with competitive ratio $`O(\log^2(k+1))`$ against oblivious request sequences.
sentences.zh: 我们在有限有理度量空间上构造一个一致的随机 k 服务器算法，针对非自适应请求序列的竞争比为 $`O(\log^2(k+1))`$。

sentences.en: Preprocessing is polynomial in the input length, and per-request bit complexity is polynomial in that length and the binary request-counter length.
sentences.zh: 预处理时间关于输入长度是多项式的，而每个请求的位复杂度关于该长度和二进制请求计数器的长度是多项式的。

sentences.en: The additive movement constant is finite and instance-dependent, but may be enormous.
sentences.zh: 加法移动常数是有限的且依赖于实例，但可能极其巨大。

sentences.en: The construction uses the companion squared-logarithmic existence theorem.
sentences.zh: 该构造使用配套的对数平方存在性定理。

sentences.en: We prove that one independent sample per element suffices for a constant-competitive prophet inequality on every finite matroid.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于每个有限拟阵，每个元素的一个独立样本就足以得到具有常数竞争比的先知不等式。

sentences.en: The guarantee holds even when the arrival-order adversary observes all samples, all online values, and the algorithm's entire random seed.
sentences.zh: 即使决定到达顺序的对手能观察所有样本、所有在线值以及算法的整个随机种子，这一保证仍然成立。

sentences.en: The rule needs no description of the value distributions and achieves the absolute competitive ratio $`2^{-310}`$.
sentences.zh: 该规则不需要价值分布的描述，并达到绝对竞争比 $`2^{-310}`$。

sentences.en: We construct a language in deterministic polynomial time whose n-bit membership function requires $`2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}`$ gates in an unbounded-fan-in OR–AND–OR circuit.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个属于确定性多项式时间的语言，其 n 位成员判定函数在扇入无界的 OR–AND–OR 电路中需要 $`2^{\omega(\sqrt n)}`$ 个门。

sentences.en: The bound holds at every sufficiently large input length and counts all gates, including the bottom layer.
sentences.zh: 该界在每个充分大的输入长度上成立，并计入所有门，包括底层门。

sentences.en: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS) for counting perfect matchings in arbitrary finite simple undirected graphs, resolving the general-graph perfect-matching approximation problem.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个完全多项式随机近似方案（FPRAS），用于计算任意有限简单无向图中的完美匹配数，从而解决一般图完美匹配的近似计数问题。

sentences.en: The algorithm returns zero with certainty when no perfect matching exists.
sentences.zh: 不存在完美匹配时，该算法以概率一返回零。

sentences.en: Otherwise, it achieves relative error ε with failure probability at most δ in worst-case bit time polynomial in the input length, $`\varepsilon ^{-1}`$, and $`\log\delta^{-1}`$.
sentences.zh: 否则，它在关于输入长度、$`\varepsilon ^{-1}`$ 和 $`\log\delta^{-1}`$ 为多项式的最坏情形位运算时间内，实现相对误差 ε，失败概率至多为 δ。

sentences.en: We prove the perfect-matching entropy conjecture of Anari, Oveis Gharan, and Vinzant.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Anari、Oveis Gharan 和 Vinzant 的完美匹配熵猜想。

sentences.en: For every feasible vector x of perfect-matching edge marginals in a loopless labelled multigraph on $`2m\ge2`$ vertices, the maximum entropy $`H(x)`$ of a matching law with marginals x satisfies $`\displaystyle F(x)-(2-2/m)B(x)\le H(x)\le F(x),`$ where $`F(x)=-\sum_e x_e\log x_e`$ and $`B(x)=-\sum_e(1-x_e)\log(1-x_e)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于具有 $`2m\ge2`$ 个顶点的无自环带标号多重图中完美匹配中各条边入选概率的每个可行向量 x，各条边的入选概率为 x 的匹配分布的最大熵 $`H(x)`$ 满足 $`\displaystyle F(x)-(2-2/m)B(x)\le H(x)\le F(x),`$，其中 $`F(x)=-\sum_e x_e\log x_e`$ 且 $`B(x)=-\sum_e(1-x_e)\log(1-x_e)`$。

sentences.en: This bound holds throughout the polytope, including its boundary.
sentences.zh: 该界在整个多胞体上成立，包括其边界。

sentences.en: We also prove the sharp bound $`|\mathop{\mathrm{supp}}\nolimits x|-\dim F_x\le3m-2`$, where Fx is the minimal face of the perfect-matching polytope containing x.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明最优界 $`|\mathop{\mathrm{supp}}\nolimits x|-\dim F_x\le3m-2`$，其中 Fx 是完美匹配多胞体中包含 x 的最小面。

sentences.en: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting common integer bases of two polymatroids with the same total rank, supplied by exact rank-value oracles.
sentences.zh: 对于由精确秩值预言机给出的两个总秩相同的多拟阵，我们给出一个计算其公共整数基数目的完全多项式随机近似方案。

sentences.en: The total rank and capacities are encoded in binary, and each integer vector is counted once.
sentences.zh: 总秩和容量以二进制编码，且每个整数向量只计数一次。

sentences.en: On every execution, the number of oracle calls and the bit work outside the oracles are bounded by a fixed polynomial in the ground-set size, the binary input length, the inverse relative-error tolerance, and the logarithm of the inverse failure probability.
sentences.zh: 在每次执行中，预言机调用次数和预言机之外的位运算量，都由基集大小、二进制输入长度、相对误差容限的倒数以及失败概率倒数的对数的某个固定多项式所界定。

sentences.en: The algorithm handles binary capacities directly, without expanding them into labelled copies.
sentences.zh: 该算法直接处理二进制容量，而不将其展开为带标号的副本。

sentences.en: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting the common bases of two arbitrary matroids of the same rank, supplied by independence oracles.
sentences.zh: 对于由独立性预言机给出的两个任意同秩拟阵，我们给出一个计算其公共基数目的完全多项式随机近似方案。

sentences.en: The algorithm requires no explicit representation of either matroid and has polynomial bounds on both oracle calls and bit operations on every execution.
sentences.zh: 该算法不需要任一拟阵的显式表示，而且每次执行中的预言机调用次数和位运算次数均具有多项式界。

sentences.en: We give an exact uniform sampler for nonnegative integer contingency tables with arbitrary prescribed margins.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个精确均匀采样器，用于具有任意指定边际和的非负整数列联表。

sentences.en: It terminates almost surely and has expected bit complexity polynomial in both dimensions and the binary length of the margins.
sentences.zh: 它几乎必然终止，且期望位复杂度关于行列两个维数及边际和的二进制长度均为多项式。

sentences.en: No positivity, balance, sparsity, or fixed-dimension assumption is required.
sentences.zh: 不需要正性、平衡性、稀疏性或维数固定的假设。

sentences.en: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting nonnegative integer matrices with prescribed row sums, column sums, and individual entry bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个完全多项式随机近似方案，用于计算具有指定行和、列和以及各条目界的非负整数矩阵数目。

sentences.en: Both dimensions vary, all numerical data are encoded in binary, and zero bounds are allowed.
sentences.zh: 行列两个维数均可变化，所有数值数据均以二进制编码，并且允许条目的界为零。

sentences.en: The algorithm uses only unbiased random bits and has a polynomial bound on its bit operations on every execution.
sentences.zh: 该算法只使用无偏随机位，且每次执行中的位运算次数均具有多项式界。

sentences.en: We construct a single matrix substitution that detects every nonzero size-s division-free noncommutative formula in n variables over every field of a given positive characteristic.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个单一矩阵代入，它能在给定正特征的每个域上，检测 n 个变量中每个大小为 s 的非零无除法非交换公式。

sentences.en: One deterministic machine, given a promised prime p in binary and n, s in unary, outputs matrices over 𝔽p of dimension $`O(n^3s^6)`$ in polynomial bit time.
sentences.zh: 同一台确定性机器在给定承诺为素数且以二进制编码的 p，以及以一进制编码的 n、s 后，在多项式位运算时间内输出 𝔽p 上维数为 $`O(n^3s^6)`$ 的矩阵。

sentences.en: The same tuple works with arbitrary extension-field coefficients, including in characteristic two.
sentences.zh: 同一个元组对任意扩域系数都有效，包括特征为二的情形。

sentences.en: The construction also applies to the stated acyclic algebraic path programs.
sentences.zh: 该构造也适用于文中所述的无环代数路径程序。

sentences.en: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, one tuple of rational matrices that detects every nonzero polynomial computed by a noncommutative division-free formula of a prescribed size.
sentences.zh: 我们在确定性多项式位运算时间内构造一个有理矩阵元组，它能检测由指定大小的非交换无除法公式计算的每个非零多项式。

sentences.en: The matrices have dimension $`O(ns^2)`$ for n variables and formula size s, and the same tuple works over every field of characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 当变量数为 n、公式大小为 s 时，矩阵的维数为 $`O(ns^2)`$，且同一个元组在每个特征为零的域上都有效。

sentences.en: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, a polynomial-size list of rational matrix tuples for noncommutative rational formulas over ℚ of bounded tree size.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℚ 上树大小有界的非交换有理公式，我们在确定性多项式位运算时间内构造一个大小为多项式量级的有理矩阵元组列表。

sentences.en: Every nonzero admissible formula has a defined, invertible value at one tuple, with no separate bounds on inverse nesting or rational constant heights.
sentences.zh: 每个非零容许公式都在某个元组处有定义且取值可逆，而无须对求逆嵌套深度或有理常数的高度另设界。

sentences.en: Matrix dimensions, entry bit lengths, and total output length are polynomially bounded.
sentences.zh: 矩阵维数、条目的位长度以及总输出长度均有多项式界。

sentences.en: We prove that, for every fixed C > 1, approximating Uniform Sparsest Cut within factor C is NP-hard.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于每个固定的 C > 1，以因子 C 近似均匀最稀疏割是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: The output graphs have nonnegative rational capacities and unit demand between every pair of distinct vertices.
sentences.zh: 输出图具有非负有理容量，且每对不同顶点之间的需求均为一。

sentences.en: We construct uniform sparsest-cut instances whose Goemans–Linial semidefinite integrality gap is at least $`c\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3`$ along a sequence $`n\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 我们构造均匀最稀疏割实例，沿某个序列 $`n\to\infty`$，其 Goemans–Linial 半正定整数性间隙至少为 $`c\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3`$。

sentences.en: The demand is one between every pair of distinct vertices, and the capacities are nonnegative real numbers.
sentences.zh: 每对不同顶点之间的需求为一，容量为非负实数。

sentences.en: This matches the Arora–Rao–Vazirani upper bound up to a power of $`\log\log n`$.
sentences.zh: 这与 Arora–Rao–Vazirani 上界仅相差一个 $`\log\log n`$ 的幂次因子。

sentences.en: We disprove the Modified Integer Round-Up Conjecture for bin packing by constructing instances with arbitrarily large additive gaps between the configuration-LP value and the integral optimum.
sentences.zh: 我们构造装箱问题的实例，使配置线性规划的值与整数最优值之间的加法间隙任意大，从而否定修正整数向上取整猜想。

sentences.en: We also prove that, for every fixed nonnegative integer c, distinguishing instances that fit in B bins from those requiring more than $`B+c`$ bins is NP-hard.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，对于每个固定的非负整数 c，区分可装入 B 个箱子的实例与需要多于 $`B+c`$ 个箱子的实例，是 NP-hard 的。

sentences.en: Both results hold with rational item sizes greater than 1/6, so each bin contains at most five items.
sentences.zh: 这两个结果对物品大小为大于 1/6 的有理数的情形都成立，因此每个箱子至多容纳五件物品。

sentences.en: We prove sharp contraction of the information carried by a binary channel under independent symmetric noise on a uniform discrete cube.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在均匀离散立方体上的独立对称噪声下，二元信道所承载的信息满足最优收缩界。

sentences.en: At fixed initial information, a noisy coordinate retains the most information.
sentences.zh: 在初始信息固定时，带噪坐标保留的信息最多。

sentences.en: The Boolean specialization resolves the Courtade–Kumar conjecture and gives an output-entropy refinement.
sentences.zh: 布尔情形解决了 Courtade–Kumar 猜想，并给出一个关于输出熵的精细化结果。

sentences.en: We also establish a stronger mean-dependent entropy-production bound.
sentences.zh: 我们还建立了一个更强的依赖均值的熵产生界。

sentences.en: The proof combines an explicit three-point optimizer for the local joining problem, two entropy capacities, and a common-output thinning inequality, followed by dimension induction and integration along the noise semigroup.
sentences.zh: 证明结合局部 joining 问题的一个显式三点最优解、两个熵容量以及一个共同输出 thinning 不等式，随后沿维数归纳，并沿噪声半群积分。

sentences.en: We prove the Hellinger conjecture for Boolean functions on the uniform discrete cube, with arbitrary output bias.
sentences.zh: 我们证明均匀离散立方体上具有任意输出偏置的布尔函数的 Hellinger 猜想。

sentences.en: For a Boolean function of mean m and every $`\rho\in[-1,1]`$, the loss $`\sqrt{1-m^2}-\mathbb E\sqrt{1-(T_\rho f)^2}`$ is at most $`1-\sqrt{1-\rho^2}`$, with equality for signed coordinates.
sentences.zh: 对于均值为 m 的布尔函数以及每个 $`\rho\in[-1,1]`$，损失 $`\sqrt{1-m^2}-\mathbb E\sqrt{1-(T_\rho f)^2}`$ 至多为 $`1-\sqrt{1-\rho^2}`$，且带符号坐标取得等号。

sentences.en: The proof combines asymmetric dimension induction, a calibrated noise-semigroup energy estimate, and finite exact arithmetic certificates.
sentences.zh: 证明结合非对称的维数归纳、一个经过校准的噪声半群能量估计以及有限精确算术证书。

sentences.en: The Hellinger inequality also yields the Courtade–Kumar information bound.
sentences.zh: Hellinger 不等式还给出 Courtade–Kumar 信息界。

sentences.en: We prove that maximum-cardinality matching in a simple undirected graph with n vertices and m edges can be found by one uniform randomized algorithm in $`(n+m)^{1+o(1)}`$ time.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，具有 n 个顶点和 m 条边的简单无向图中的最大基数匹配，可以由同一个一致的随机算法在 $`(n+m)^{1+o(1)}`$ 时间内找到。

sentences.en: The bound holds on every computation path in a logarithmic-word model, and the algorithm returns an explicit maximum matching with probability at least 2/3.
sentences.zh: 该界在字长为对数级的模型中的每条计算路径上都成立，且算法以至少 2/3 的概率返回一个显式最大匹配。

sentences.en: An explicit reduction gives the same time and probability guarantees for deciding whether a simple host graph has a spanning subgraph with prescribed valid vertex degrees, and for finding one when it exists.
sentences.zh: 一个显式归约对下列任务给出相同的时间和概率保证：判断简单母图是否有一个顶点度数为指定合法值的生成子图，以及在其存在时找到一个这样的子图。

sentences.en: We give a uniform randomized approximation scheme for unit-cost edit distance.
sentences.zh: 我们给出单位代价编辑距离的一个一致的随机近似方案。

sentences.en: For every fixed rational $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$, it estimates the distance between arbitrary explicitly stored strings of total length N within a factor $`1+\varepsilon`$ with probability at least 2/3, in worst-case expected time $`N^{1+o(1)}`$ on a logarithmic-word RAM.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定有理数 $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$，它在字长为对数级的 RAM 上，以 $`N^{1+o(1)}`$ 的最坏情形期望时间估计任意显式存储、总长度为 N 的字符串之间的距离，并以至少 2/3 的概率达到 $`1+\varepsilon`$ 的近似因子。

sentences.en: The algorithm supports polynomially bounded integer alphabets and returns zero deterministically on equal strings.
sentences.zh: 该算法支持多项式有界的整数字母表，并对相同字符串确定性地返回零。

sentences.en: We give a uniform algorithm that reconstructs every binary string from independent deletion traces when its length and rational retention probability are known.
sentences.zh: 当字符串长度和有理保留概率已知时，我们给出一个从独立删除迹重构每个二元字符串的一致算法。

sentences.en: For each fixed retention probability, both the number of traces and the bit complexity are quasipolynomial in the string length.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定保留概率，所需迹的数目和位复杂度关于字符串长度均为准多项式。

sentences.en: More generally, we give an explicit sample bound uniform over all rational retention probabilities, with running time polynomial in the sample budget and the binary input length.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，我们给出一个对所有有理保留概率一致成立的显式样本界，运行时间关于样本预算和二进制输入长度为多项式。

sentences.en: If the deletion probability is at most $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$ for fixed ε > 0, the sample and running-time bounds are polynomial.
sentences.zh: 如果对于固定的 ε > 0，删除概率至多为 $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$，那么样本数和运行时间的界都是多项式。

sentences.en: Reconstruction succeeds with probability at least 2/3 for each input string.
sentences.zh: 对于每个输入字符串，重建成功的概率至少为 2/3。

sentences.en: We give an improved worst-case sample bound for reconstructing a string from independent deletion traces, with its length and retention probability known.
sentences.zh: 在字符串长度和保留概率已知时，我们给出一个从独立删除迹重构字符串的改进最坏情形样本界。

sentences.en: For each fixed retention probability, the number of traces is quasipolynomial: the logarithm of the sample budget is $`O((\log n)^3(1+\log\log(2n))^6)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定保留概率，迹的数目为准多项式量级：样本预算的对数为 $`O((\log n)^3(1+\log\log(2n))^6)`$。

sentences.en: If the deletion probability is at most $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$ for fixed ε > 0, polynomially many traces suffice.
sentences.zh: 如果对于固定的 ε > 0，删除概率至多为 $`n^{-\varepsilon}`$，那么多项式多个迹就足够。

sentences.en: These bounds apply to binary strings and to strings of general symbols observed exactly.
sentences.zh: 这些界适用于二元字符串，也适用于符号能够被精确观测的一般符号字符串。

sentences.en: They concern sample complexity and do not assert an efficient reconstruction algorithm or matching optimality.
sentences.zh: 这些结论涉及样本复杂度，并不声称存在高效重建算法，也不声称具有相匹配的最优性。

sentences.en: Exact worst-case reconstruction of a binary word from independent deletion traces requires $`n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}`$ samples for every fixed deletion probability $`q\in(0,1)`$, even with unrestricted computation and any fixed positive success probability.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定删除概率 $`q\in(0,1)`$，从独立删除迹精确重建二元词在最坏情形下需要 $`n^{\Omega(\log\log n)}`$ 个样本，即使计算不受限制且只要求任意固定的正成功概率也是如此。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the polynomial-sample question for binary trace reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 这对二元迹重构的多项式样本问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: More generally, when $`q^3\log n\to\infty`$, we prove a lower bound of $`n^{c\log(q^3\log n)}`$ samples for every fixed $`0\lt c\lt 1/(4\log2)`$.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，当 $`q^3\log n\to\infty`$ 时，我们对每个固定的 $`0\lt c\lt 1/(4\log2)`$ 证明了 $`n^{c\log(q^3\log n)}`$ 个样本的下界。

sentences.en: Here q is the known deletion probability, and all logarithms are natural.
sentences.zh: 这里 q 是已知的删除概率，且所有对数均为自然对数。

sentences.en: We give a uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for scheduling unit-length jobs with arbitrary precedence constraints on three identical parallel machines.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个一致的确定性多项式时间算法，用于在三台相同的并行机器上调度具有任意先后约束的单位时长作业。

sentences.en: The algorithm constructs a schedule of minimum makespan and decides exactly whether all jobs can finish by a specified deadline.
sentences.zh: 该算法构造工期最短的调度，并精确判定所有作业能否在指定截止时间之前完成。

sentences.en: The proof reorganizes feasible schedules into intervals whose job sets have descriptions of bounded size.
sentences.zh: 证明将可行调度重新组织为若干区间，每个区间的作业集都有大小有界的描述。

sentences.en: A dynamic program searches a family containing polynomially many such descriptions.
sentences.zh: 一个动态规划在包含多项式多个此类描述的族中搜索。

sentences.en: Global boundary conditions and simplification of inherited information keep the descriptions bounded throughout the decomposition.
sentences.zh: 全局边界条件以及对继承信息的简化，使这些描述在整个分解过程中保持有界。

sentences.en: We give an exact-budget recovery algorithm for metric k-median with single-exponential dependence on the number of comparison clusters without accurate, distinct proxies in a supplied anchor solution.
sentences.zh: 我们给出度量 k 中位数问题的一个精确预算恢复算法，其对如下比较簇数目的依赖为单指数：这些比较簇在给定锚点解中缺少准确且互不相同的代理。

sentences.en: On positive integral metrics of polynomially bounded diameter, a sufficiently small total proxy error and logarithmically many such clusters yield a $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$ approximation in polynomial time with arbitrarily high success probability.
sentences.zh: 在直径多项式有界的正整数度量上，如果总代理误差充分小，且这类簇的数目为对数级，就能以任意高的成功概率在多项式时间内得到 $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$ 近似。

sentences.en: We also prove bounded-price strictness for one compatible execution of the logarithmic-surplus construction.
sentences.zh: 我们还对对数盈余构造的一次相容执行证明有界价格严格性（bounded-price strictness）。

sentences.en: Together the recovery and payment arguments give a randomized $`(2-\sigma)`$ approximation, for an absolute σ > 0, on arbitrary finite rational metrics, both with high probability and in expectation, while opening at most k facilities on every output.
sentences.zh: 恢复论证和支付论证合在一起，在任意有限有理度量上给出随机 $`(2-\sigma)`$ 近似，其中 σ > 0 是绝对常数；该近似既以高概率成立，也在期望意义下成立，并且每个输出都至多开设 k 个设施。

sentences.en: For every fixed ε > 0, we give a deterministic polynomial-time $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$-approximation for finite rational metric k-median with specified candidate facilities, opening at most k facilities.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 ε > 0，我们为具有指定候选设施的有限有理度量 k 中位数问题给出一个确定性多项式时间 $`(1+2/e+\varepsilon)`$ 近似算法，至多开设 k 个设施。

sentences.en: Under $`P\ne NP`$, the infimum approximation factor in this model is therefore $`1+2/e`$.
sentences.zh: 因此，在 $`P\ne NP`$ 假设下，该模型中近似因子的下确界为 $`1+2/e`$。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`0\lt \rho\lt 1`$, the matrix indexed by odd vertex sets U and perfect matchings M of Kn, with entries $`|M\cap\delta(U)|-1+\rho`$, has real positive semidefinite rank $`2^{\Omega(n)}`$ as even n tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`0\lt \rho\lt 1`$，以 Kn 的奇数基数顶点集 U 和完美匹配 M 为指标、条目为 $`|M\cap\delta(U)|-1+\rho`$ 的矩阵，在偶数 n 趋于无穷时具有实半正定秩 $`2^{\Omega(n)}`$。

sentences.en: Here $`\delta(U)`$ is the edge cut of U.
sentences.zh: 这里 $`\delta(U)`$ 是 U 的边割。

sentences.en: Consequently, every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size.
sentences.zh: 因此，完美匹配多胞体的每个精确半正定提升都具有指数大小。

sentences.en: For every n ≥ 1 and $`1\le d\le n`$, we prove that a polynomial threshold function of degree at most d on the uniform Boolean cube has average sensitivity at most $`8d\sqrt n`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 n ≥ 1 和 $`1\le d\le n`$，我们证明，均匀布尔立方体上每个次数至多为 d 的多项式阈值函数，其平均敏感度至多为 $`8d\sqrt n`$。

sentences.en: This proves the asymptotic form of the Gotsman–Linial conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Gotsman–Linial 猜想的渐近形式。

sentences.en: The bound is uniform in both parameters and uses the convention $`\mathop{\mathrm{sgn}}\nolimits (0)=1`$.
sentences.zh: 该界对两个参数均一致成立，并采用约定 $`\mathop{\mathrm{sgn}}\nolimits (0)=1`$。

sentences.en: We give a deterministic algorithm that, for every finite family of explicitly represented ordinary strings, outputs a common superstring of length at most twice the optimum in time polynomial in the total encoded input size, including symbol labels.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个确定性算法，对显式表示的普通字符串的每个有限族，在关于包括符号标签在内的总编码输入大小为多项式的时间内，输出长度至多为最优值两倍的公共超串。

sentences.en: The guarantee applies to the algorithm constructed here, not the classical maximum-overlap Greedy procedure.
sentences.zh: 这一保证适用于本文构造的算法，而不适用于经典的最大重叠 Greedy 过程。

sentences.en: We prove that two-way nondeterministic finite automata cannot be complemented with a polynomial number of states independent of the alphabet.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，双向非确定性有限自动机的补自动机不能总是具有与字母表无关的多项式状态数。

sentences.en: For each n ≥ 4 we construct an n-state automaton over a finite alphabet whose complement requires at least $`\tfrac12 2^{\lfloor(n-4)/127\rfloor}-1`$ states.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 n ≥ 4，我们在一个有限字母表上构造一个具有 n 个状态的自动机，其补自动机至少需要 $`\tfrac12 2^{\lfloor(n-4)/127\rfloor}-1`$ 个状态。

sentences.en: One-way liveness on h points accepts a word of binary relations when their ordered product is nonempty.
sentences.zh: h 个点上的单向活性问题，在二元关系组成的词的有序乘积非空时接受该词。

sentences.en: For every h ≥ 2, it has a nondeterministic automaton with $`h+3`$ states and no left moves, whereas every equivalent s-state two-way deterministic automaton satisfies $`4(s+2)^2\ge2^{\lfloor(h-2)/31\rfloor}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 h ≥ 2，它都有一个具有 $`h+3`$ 个状态且没有向左移动的非确定性自动机，而每个与之等价、具有 s 个状态的双向确定性自动机都满足 $`4(s+2)^2\ge2^{\lfloor(h-2)/31\rfloor}`$。

sentences.en: Partial transition rules, stay moves, and nonaccepting infinite computations are allowed.
sentences.zh: 允许部分转移规则、原地不动以及不接受的无限计算。

sentences.en: The alphabets are finite and grow with h, so the result rules out an alphabet-independent polynomial state bound for deterministic two-way simulation, already for one-way nondeterministic sources.
sentences.zh: 这些字母表是有限的，且随 h 增大，因此该结果排除了确定性双向模拟中与字母表无关的多项式状态数界，即使被模拟的是单向非确定性自动机也不例外。

sentences.en: We give a deterministic algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform at every length n in $`O(n(\log n)^{1-10^{-13}})`$ operations.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个确定性算法，对每个长度 n，在 $`O(n(\log n)^{1-10^{-13}})`$ 次运算内计算离散 Fourier 变换。

sentences.en: The model uses exact complex arithmetic, unrestricted coefficients, specified Fourier roots, and unit-cost logarithmic-size indexing; scalar preparation and array organization are included.
sentences.zh: 该模型使用精确复数算术、不受限制的系数、指定的 Fourier 单位根以及单位代价的对数大小索引；标量准备和数组组织的代价也计入其中。

sentences.en: We construct exact nonuniform Fourier circuits of size $`o(n\log n)`$ along an unbounded sequence of lengths, counting every addition, subtraction, and scalar multiplication.
sentences.zh: 沿一个无界的长度序列，我们构造大小为 $`o(n\log n)`$ 的精确非一致 Fourier 电路，并计入每次加法、减法和标量乘法。

sentences.en: This refutes the $`\Omega(n\log n)`$ lower bound in the unrestricted complex linear-circuit model.
sentences.zh: 这否定了不受限制的复线性电路模型中的 $`\Omega(n\log n)`$ 下界。

sentences.en: The construction uses a finite tensor saving: a tensor power of some invertible nonmonomial complex matrix can be computed with fewer matrix calls than the standard tensor-axis algorithm on the same coordinates, when invertible monomial maps are allowed freely between calls.
sentences.zh: 该构造利用有限张量的运算节省：当允许在调用之间无代价地使用可逆单项映射时，某个可逆非单项复矩阵的张量幂，可以用比相同坐标上的标准张量轴算法更少的矩阵调用次数来计算。

sentences.en: We prove the simple-undirected form of the Kannan–Tetali–Vempala conjecture: the switch chain on simple undirected graphs mixes in polynomial time for every graphical degree sequence.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Kannan–Tetali–Vempala 猜想的简单无向图形式：对于每个可由图实现的度序列，简单无向图上的换边链都在多项式时间内混合。

sentences.en: For a lazy chain that proposes switches uniformly on four vertices, the total-variation mixing time at distance 1/4 is at most $`2n^8`$.
sentences.zh: 对于在四个顶点上均匀提出交换操作的惰性链，全变差距离为 1/4 时的混合时间至多为 $`2n^8`$。

sentences.en: We also give an exactly uniform sampler for every graphical labeled degree vector.
sentences.zh: 我们还为每个可由图实现的带标号度向量给出一个精确均匀采样器。

sentences.en: It uses unbiased random bits, terminates almost surely, and has expected polynomial bit running time.
sentences.zh: 它使用无偏随机位，几乎必然终止，并具有多项式的期望位运算时间。

sentences.en: We disprove the quadratic strengthening of the Sensitivity Conjecture by constructing nonconstant total Boolean functions whose block sensitivity grows faster than any constant multiple of sensitivity squared.
sentences.zh: 我们构造非常数的全定义布尔函数，使其块敏感度增长得比敏感度平方的任意常数倍都快，从而否定敏感度猜想的二次加强形式。

sentences.en: In fact, for some fixed α > 2, our examples have unbounded block sensitivity and satisfy $`\mathop{\mathrm{bs}}\nolimits (f)\ge s(f)^\alpha`$.
sentences.zh: 事实上，对于某个固定的 α > 2，我们的例子的块敏感度无界，并满足 $`\mathop{\mathrm{bs}}\nolimits (f)\ge s(f)^\alpha`$。

sentences.en: For k ≥ 4, we construct two uncolored graphs that are k-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalent exactly when a prescribed finite-domain choice system has no compatible choice.
sentences.zh: 对于 k ≥ 4，我们构造两个无色图，它们 k 维 Weisfeiler–Leman 等价，当且仅当一个指定的有限取值域的选择系统没有相容选择。

sentences.en: The system has $`k+1`$ domains for joint refinement and k for separate-coordinate refinement.
sentences.zh: 对于联合细化，该系统具有 $`k+1`$ 个取值域；对于分坐标细化，它具有 k 个取值域。

sentences.en: A successful choice is detected after two joint rounds or one separate round.
sentences.zh: 一个成功选择会在两轮联合细化或一轮分坐标细化后被检测到。

sentences.en: Applied to sparse satisfiability, the reduction gives fixed-dimension $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ time exclusions under positive-rate ETH, even for deciding equality of these early histograms.
sentences.zh: 将该归约应用于稀疏可满足性问题，在 positive-rate ETH 假设下便可排除固定维数的 $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ 时间算法，即使任务只是判断这些早期直方图是否相等也不例外。

sentences.en: We prove that deciding whether Weisfeiler–Leman refinement of an input dimension identifies a given graph is EXPTIME-complete.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，判定维数由输入指定的 Weisfeiler–Leman 细化能否识别给定图，是 EXPTIME-complete 的。

sentences.en: The input is a nonempty finite simple uncolored graph in adjacency-matrix form and a positive binary-encoded dimension.
sentences.zh: 输入是以邻接矩阵形式给出的非空有限简单无色图，以及以二进制编码的正维数。

sentences.en: Identification quantifies over every comparison graph.
sentences.zh: 识别的量词遍历每个比较图。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large fixed k, deciding whether two n-vertex graphs are k-Weisfeiler–Leman equivalent requires $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ deterministic sequential time in the worst case.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的固定 k，判定两个 n 顶点图是否 k-Weisfeiler–Leman 等价，在最坏情形下需要 $`n^{\Omega(k)}`$ 的确定性顺序时间。

sentences.en: The bound holds at every sufficiently large graph order, even for simple connected uncolored graphs of diameter at most two, without a complexity assumption.
sentences.zh: 该界在每个充分大的图阶数上都成立，即使对直径至多为二的简单连通无色图也是如此，且不需要复杂性假设。

sentences.en: Inputs are explicit adjacency matrices; the models are multitape Turing machines and sequential logarithmic-word RAMs with fixed polynomial-bit-time instructions.
sentences.zh: 输入为显式邻接矩阵；模型为多带图灵机，以及具有固定的多项式位运算时间指令、字长为对数级的顺序 RAM。

sentences.en: Both joint and separate replacement conventions are covered.
sentences.zh: 联合替换和分别替换两种约定都涵盖在内。

sentences.en: Deciding joint-update k-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence is $`\mathsf{EXPTIME}`$-complete when the two graphs are given by explicit adjacency matrices and k ≥ 2 is encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 当两个图以显式邻接矩阵给出且 k ≥ 2 以二进制编码时，判定联合更新的 k 维 Weisfeiler–Leman 等价是 $`\mathsf{EXPTIME}`$-complete 的。

sentences.en: The result holds even for connected simple uncolored graphs of equal positive order and maximum degree at most three.
sentences.zh: 该结果即使对具有相同正阶数、最大度数至多为三的连通简单无色图也成立。

sentences.en: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has a generalized regular expression of star height at most thirteen over that same alphabet.
sentences.zh: 有限字母表上的每个正则语言，在同一字母表上都有一个星高至多为十三的广义正则表达式。

sentences.en: We prove this uniform bound by representing finite monoid computations as affine updates and recovering them through twelve successive split constructions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将有限幺半群计算表示为仿射更新，并经由连续十二次分裂构造恢复这些计算，证明这一一致界。

sentences.en: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has generalized star height at most four over that same alphabet.
sentences.zh: 有限字母表上的每个正则语言，在同一字母表上的广义星高至多为四。

sentences.en: We give a complete construction using an affine correction that hides one interval product, a finite clock, and several scales for moving boundaries through periodic words.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个完整构造，使用一种隐藏一个区间乘积的仿射修正、一个有限时钟以及在周期词中移动边界所用的若干尺度。

sentences.en: Every regular language over a finite alphabet has generalized star height at most three, with complement taken in the same free monoid.
sentences.zh: 有限字母表上的每个正则语言都具有至多为三的广义星高，其中补集在同一个自由幺半群中取。

sentences.en: We express finite-monoid computations using a prefix code of word pieces.
sentences.zh: 我们使用词片段的前缀码来表示有限幺半群计算。

sentences.en: Let $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ be the $`(1,1)`$ entry of a product of n independent $`n\times n`$ matrices of variables.
sentences.zh: 令 $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ 为 n 个相互独立的 $`n\times n`$ 变量矩阵之乘积的 $`(1,1)`$ 条目。

sentences.en: Over every field of characteristic zero, every syntactically homogeneous $`\Sigma\Pi\Sigma\Pi\Sigma`$ circuit computing $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ has at least $`n^{\sqrt n/400}`$ gates for all sufficiently large n, with an absolute threshold independent of the field.
sentences.zh: 在每个特征为零的域上，对于所有充分大的 n，每个计算 $`\mathop{\mathrm{IMM}}\nolimits _{n,n}`$ 的语法齐次 $`\Sigma\Pi\Sigma\Pi\Sigma`$ 电路都至少有 $`n^{\sqrt n/400}`$ 个门，其中阈值为与域无关的绝对常数。

sentences.en: Bottom linear forms may have arbitrary support, and arbitrary finite fan-in, fan-out, and gate sharing are allowed.
sentences.zh: 底层线性形式可以具有任意支撑，且允许任意有限扇入、扇出和门共享。

sentences.en: Over every field, a block expansion gives such circuits with at most $`n^{\sqrt n+4}`$ gates for n ≥ 2.
sentences.zh: 在每个域上，当 n ≥ 2 时，分块展开给出至多具有 $`n^{\sqrt n+4}`$ 个门的此类电路。

sentences.en: Thus the gate complexity over characteristic-zero fields is $`n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}`$.
sentences.zh: 因此，特征为零的域上的门复杂度为 $`n^{\Theta(\sqrt n)}`$。

sentences.en: We prove the quasilinear-size PCP-for-PPAD conjecture of Babichenko, Papadimitriou, and Rubinstein.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Babichenko、Papadimitriou 和 Rubinstein 的准线性大小 PCP-for-PPAD 猜想。

sentences.en: There are fixed positive rational constants ε and δ and a deterministic polynomial-time reduction that transforms an End-of-Line instance of binary length N into a generalized circuit of total binary length $`N(\log N)^{O(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 存在固定的正有理常数 ε 和 δ，以及一个确定性多项式时间归约，将二进制长度为 N 的 End-of-Line 实例转换为总二进制长度为 $`N(\log N)^{O(1)}`$ 的广义电路。

sentences.en: From any rational assignment of polynomial encoding length that ε-satisfies all but a δ fraction of the gates, a solution to the original End-of-Line instance can be recovered in polynomial time, regardless of which gates fail.
sentences.zh: 对于编码长度为多项式量级、且除占比不超过 δ 的门之外 ε-满足其余所有门的任意有理赋值，无论哪些门失效，都可以在多项式时间内从中恢复原 End-of-Line 实例的一个解。

sentences.en: Such assignments always exist, with one fixed polynomial bound on their encoding length.
sentences.zh: 这样的赋值总是存在，且其编码长度由同一个固定多项式所界定。

sentences.en: We show that a fixed deterministic Turing machine with one writable tape and head can be simulated in $`O(T^{2/5}\mathop{\mathrm{polylog}}\nolimits (T+2))`$ work-space bits when a binary time cap T ≥ 2 is supplied.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当给定二进制编码的时间上限 T ≥ 2 时，一台固定的、具有一条可写带和一个读写头的确定性图灵机，可以用 $`O(T^{2/5}\mathop{\mathrm{polylog}}\nolimits (T+2))`$ 位工作空间模拟。

sentences.en: The simulator computes the finite-control and halting outcome by time T; its running time is unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 模拟器计算原机器截至时刻 T 的有限控制状态和停机结果；模拟器自身的运行时间不受限制。

sentences.en: The result allows a fixed number of read-only input heads and requires a fixed accessor that supplies every initial writable and read-only symbol within distance T of the relevant head origin in polylogarithmic space.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许固定数目的只读输入头，并要求一个固定的访问器，它在多对数空间内提供距离相应读写头初始位置至多 T 的每个初始可写符号和只读符号。

sentences.en: This improves the square-root space exponent for one-tape machines, answering Williams's question for this model.
sentences.zh: 这改进了单带机器的平方根空间指数，回答了 Williams 对这一模型提出的问题。

sentences.en: We give a uniform randomized classical algorithm for Subset Sum with bounded error and worst-case running time $`O(2^{0.49n})`$ on polynomial-bit inputs in a word-RAM model, where n is the number of input integers.
sentences.zh: 我们给出子集和问题的一个一致的随机经典算法，在 word-RAM 模型中处理多项式位长的输入时，该算法具有有界错误，最坏情形运行时间为 $`O(2^{0.49n})`$，其中 n 是输入整数的个数。

sentences.en: The time bound holds on every random execution.
sentences.zh: 该时间界在每次随机执行中都成立。

sentences.en: We give a uniform classical randomized decision algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum.
sentences.zh: 我们给出最坏情形子集和问题的一个一致的经典随机判定算法。

sentences.en: Under every fixed polynomial bound on input-integer bit length, it uses $`\mathop{\mathrm{poly}}\nolimits (n)2^{n/2}`$ time and ordinary $`O(2^{n/5})`$ writable words of $`O(n+b)`$ bits, where b is the largest input bit length.
sentences.zh: 在输入整数位长的每个固定多项式界下，它使用 $`\mathop{\mathrm{poly}}\nolimits (n)2^{n/2}`$ 时间和普通的 $`O(2^{n/5})`$ 个可写字，每个字有 $`O(n+b)`$ 位，其中 b 是最大的输入位长。

sentences.en: Both resource bounds hold on every execution.
sentences.zh: 这两个资源界在每次执行中都成立。

sentences.en: The error is one-sided: the algorithm always rejects unsolvable instances and accepts each solvable instance with probability at least 2/3.
sentences.zh: 错误是单侧的：该算法总是拒绝无解实例，并以至少 2/3 的概率接受每个有解实例。

sentences.en: For every fixed ε > 0, we give a sampling algorithm using at most $`C_\varepsilon d^\varepsilon`$ exact first-order queries on every execution for C2 potentials on ℝd with a known minimizer and Hessian between Id and $`2I_d`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 ε > 0，我们为 ℝd 上极小点已知且 Hessian 介于 Id 和 $`2I_d`$ 之间的 C2 势函数给出一个采样算法，该算法在每次执行中至多使用 $`C_\varepsilon d^\varepsilon`$ 次精确一阶查询。

sentences.en: The output has total-variation distance at most 1/10 from the target Gibbs law.
sentences.zh: 输出与目标 Gibbs 分布的全变差距离至多为 1/10。

sentences.en: Computation between queries is unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 查询之间的计算不受限制。

sentences.en: We also prove an $`\Omega(\log d)`$ query lower bound for arbitrary randomized adaptive algorithms, determining the optimal dimension exponent to be zero.
sentences.zh: 我们还对任意随机自适应算法证明了 $`\Omega(\log d)`$ 的查询下界，从而确定最优维数指数为零。

sentences.en: For every fixed A > 0, a learner that retains at most $`Ad^2`$ bits between fresh exact Gaussian linear measurements needs $`\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ measurements to estimate a uniformly random unit vector to angular error at most ϵ, for any $`0\lt \epsilon\le 1/10`$, with probability at least 2/3.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 A > 0，在各次新的精确高斯线性测量之间至多保留 $`Ad^2`$ 位的学习器，若要对任意 $`0\lt \epsilon\le 1/10`$ 以至少 2/3 的概率将一个均匀随机单位向量估计到角度误差至多为 ϵ，就需要 $`\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ 次测量。

sentences.en: The constant is absolute for $`o(d^2)`$ memory.
sentences.zh: 当内存为 $`o(d^2)`$ 时，该常数是绝对常数。

sentences.en: For a signal with density bounded by L relative to uniform probability on $`S^{d-1}`$, we bound the information in a finite message W formed from exact Gaussian measurements, conditional on an independent projection revealed only to the analyst.
sentences.zh: 对于相对于 $`S^{d-1}`$ 上均匀概率的密度以 L 为上界的信号，我们以一个仅向分析者揭示的独立投影为条件，界定由精确高斯测量形成的有限消息 W 所含的信息。

sentences.en: For explicit row counts proportional to d, the bound is $`O(H(W)/d+d+\log(2+\log L))`$.
sentences.zh: 对于与 d 成正比的显式行数，该界为 $`O(H(W)/d+d+\log(2+\log L))`$。

sentences.en: Consequently, a finite-state learner with $`o(d^2)`$ persistent bits and a deterministic sample horizon needs $`\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ fresh noiseless Gaussian measurements for constant-probability angular accuracy $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ under the uniform spherical prior.
sentences.zh: 因此，在球面均匀先验下，一个具有 $`o(d^2)`$ 个持久保留位和确定性样本期限的有限状态学习器，需要 $`\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ 次新的无噪声高斯测量，才能以常数概率达到 $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ 的角度精度。

sentences.en: For the image of a uniform cube under a spherical coordinate map, we prove that finite messages from t blocks of $`\Theta(d)`$ exact Gaussian measurements reveal only $`O_A(dt)`$ information when each message has at most $`\exp(Ad^2)`$ values, for fixed A.
sentences.zh: 对于立方体上的均匀分布在球面坐标映射下的像，我们证明：固定 A，当每条消息至多有 $`\exp(Ad^2)`$ 个取值时，来自 t 个测量块、每块含 $`\Theta(d)`$ 次精确高斯测量的有限消息仅透露 $`O_A(dt)`$ 的信息。

sentences.en: The same bound holds when each message is supplemented with a nested cell that restores the required geometric spread.
sentences.zh: 当每条消息还附带一个能恢复所需几何分散程度的嵌套单元时，同样的界仍然成立。

sentences.en: We prove moment estimates for exact random projections of finite measures whose mass is controlled on Euclidean balls, and derive positive domination by countable sums of spherical cap measures.
sentences.zh: 我们对质量在欧氏球上受到控制的有限测度，证明其精确随机投影的矩估计，并推出由可数个球冠测度之和给出的正支配。

sentences.en: For learners with $`M=o(d^2)`$ bits of memory, these estimates give three proofs that uniform-sphere average success at least 2/3 at angular accuracy $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ requires $`\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ noiseless Gaussian observations.
sentences.zh: 对于具有 $`M=o(d^2)`$ 比特内存的学习器，这些估计给出三种证明，表明要以角度精度 $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ 达到至少 2/3 的均匀球面平均成功率，需要 $`\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ 次无噪声高斯观测。

sentences.en: The three proofs keep their different stopping and accuracy costs explicit.
sentences.zh: 这三种证明均明确保留了各自不同的停止代价和精度代价。

sentences.en: Replacing the Gaussian rows used to select a finite message by independent rows increases the remaining conditional information by at most $`Cd`$, for a uniform spherical signal, message entropy at most d2, and the specified row dimensions proportional to d.
sentences.zh: 对于均匀球面信号，当消息熵至多为 d2，且指定的行维数与 d 成正比时，将用于选择有限消息的高斯行替换为独立行，会使剩余条件信息至多增加 $`Cd`$。

sentences.en: As an application, we prove that learners with $`M=o(d^2)`$ persistent bits need $`T=\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ exact observations to attain uniform-sphere angular success at least 3/5, for $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ and a deterministic finite horizon.
sentences.zh: 作为应用，我们证明：当 $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ 且时间范围为确定的有限长度时，具有 $`M=o(d^2)`$ 个持久存储比特的学习器需要 $`T=\Omega(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ 次精确观测，才能在均匀球面上达到至少 3/5 的角度估计成功率。

sentences.en: Let a finite-state streaming learner estimate a uniformly random unit vector from independent exact Gaussian linear measurements.
sentences.zh: 设一个有限状态流式学习器根据独立的精确高斯线性测量，估计一个服从均匀分布的随机单位向量。

sentences.en: We prove that $`o(d^2)`$ bits of persistent memory and angular success probability at least 2/3 require at least $`2^{-16}d\log_2(1/\epsilon)`$ samples for all sufficiently large d, uniformly for $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明：对于所有充分大的 d，若持久内存为 $`o(d^2)`$ 比特且角度估计成功概率至少为 2/3，则至少需要 $`2^{-16}d\log_2(1/\epsilon)`$ 个样本，并且此结论对 $`0\lt \epsilon\le1/10`$ 一致成立。

sentences.en: The proof conditions each batch on its observed projection and controls the resulting random residual subsphere.
sentences.zh: 证明对每一批测量以其观测到的投影为条件，并控制由此产生的随机剩余子球面。

sentences.en: We prove that the existential theory of the reals lies in the counting hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我们证明实数的存在理论属于计数层级。

sentences.en: More generally, we show that the truth of existential–universal sentences over the reals can be decided in a fixed level of the counting hierarchy, even when the integer polynomials are given by arithmetic circuits.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，我们表明，即使整系数多项式由算术电路给出，实数上的存在—全称语句的真值仍可在计数层级的某个固定层次内判定。

sentences.en: We give a uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for complete factorization over prime fields.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个在素域上进行完全因式分解的一致确定性多项式时间算法。

sentences.en: For a prime p in binary and a nonzero polynomial $`f\in\mathbf F_p[x]`$ given by its dense coefficient list, the algorithm computes the irreducible factors and their multiplicities using a number of bit operations polynomial in $`(\deg f+1)\log p`$.
sentences.zh: 对于以二进制表示的素数 p，以及以稠密系数表给出的非零多项式 $`f\in\mathbf F_p[x]`$，该算法计算其不可约因子及其重数，所用比特运算次数关于 $`(\deg f+1)\log p`$ 为多项式。

sentences.en: The proof uses the uniform Hecke zero-free theorem from the companion paper *Primitive roots for every admissible integer base*.
sentences.zh: 证明使用姊妹论文 *Primitive roots for every admissible integer base* 中的一致 Hecke 无零点定理。

sentences.en: For every degree, we prove that the number of isolated periodic orbits of a real planar polynomial vector field is bounded by a finite constant depending only on that degree.
sentences.zh: 对于每个次数，我们证明，实平面多项式向量场的孤立周期轨道数都有一个仅依赖于该次数的有限常数上界。

sentences.en: This establishes the uniform boundedness assertion in the second part of Hilbert's sixteenth problem.
sentences.zh: 这确立了 Hilbert 第十六问题第二部分中的一致有界性断言。

sentences.en: The proof uses separation of asymptotic expansions on nested complex domains and a finite-dimensional counting argument.
sentences.zh: 证明使用嵌套复区域上渐近展开的分离，以及一个有限维计数论证。

sentences.en: Every classical Liénard system $`\dot x=y-F(x)`$, $`\dot y=-x`$, with F an arbitrary real polynomial of degree at most five, has at most two geometrically distinct isolated periodic orbits, and the bound is attained.
sentences.zh: 对于每个经典 Liénard 系统 $`\dot x=y-F(x)`$、$`\dot y=-x`$，其中 F 是次数至多为五的任意实多项式，其几何上不同的孤立周期轨道至多有两条，并且这一上界可以达到。

sentences.en: This proves the degree-five case of the Lins Neto–de Melo–Pugh conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Lins Neto–de Melo–Pugh 猜想的五次情形。

sentences.en: We solve the probability-preserving form of Banach's simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem in smooth dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了光滑动力系统中 Banach 单重 Lebesgue 谱问题的保概率形式。

sentences.en: We construct a C∞ diffeomorphism of the three-torus that preserves standard volume and whose Koopman operator has simple Lebesgue spectrum on the entire mean-zero L2 space.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了三维环面上的一个 C∞ 微分同胚，它保持标准体积，且其 Koopman 算子在整个均值为零的 L2 空间上具有单重 Lebesgue 谱。

sentences.en: Every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of every finite order.
sentences.zh: 每个可逆、混合且保概率的变换都具有任意有限阶的混合性。

sentences.en: Thus Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for a single transformation has an affirmative answer.
sentences.zh: 因此，Rokhlin 关于单个变换的多重混合问题得到了肯定回答。

sentences.en: We prove that the standard sine map of the two-dimensional torus has positive metric entropy with respect to normalized area for every sufficiently large positive parameter.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于每个充分大的正参数，二维环面上的标准正弦映射相对于归一化面积测度都具有正的度量熵。

sentences.en: This gives a full parameter tail, and hence answers Sinai's positive-parameter-measure conjecture affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这给出了整个参数尾区间上的结论，从而肯定地回答了 Sinai 关于正测度参数集的猜想。

sentences.en: For a smooth strictly convex planar billiard of positive curvature, a continuous foliation of a full grazing annulus by individually invariant essential curves forces an analytic boundary and a jointly analytic collar of smooth strictly convex caustics.
sentences.zh: 对于具有正曲率的光滑严格凸平面台球，若整个掠射环域可由逐条不变的本质曲线构成连续叶状分解，则其边界必为解析的，并存在一个由光滑严格凸焦散线构成的联合解析领形邻域。

sentences.en: The physical-collar rigidity theorem proved in the companion article then implies that the table is an ellipse.
sentences.zh: 姊妹文章中证明的物理领形邻域刚性定理进而推出，该台球区域是椭圆。

sentences.en: We prove that a smooth strictly convex planar billiard with positive curvature is an ellipse whenever a full neighborhood of its boundary is continuously foliated by smooth closed convex caustics.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，具有正曲率的光滑严格凸平面台球，只要其边界的一个完整邻域可由光滑闭凸焦散线构成连续叶状分解，就必为椭圆。

sentences.en: No differentiability across the leaves is assumed.
sentences.zh: 这里不假设横跨叶片方向的可微性。

sentences.en: This resolves the near-boundary Birkhoff conjecture in the stated smooth class.
sentences.zh: 这解决了所述光滑类中的近边界 Birkhoff 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that the Hausdorff dimension of every finite real self-similar measure equals the minimum of one and its random-walk entropy rate divided by its Lyapunov exponent.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，实直线上的每个有限自相似测度的 Hausdorff 维数，都等于一与其随机游走熵率除以 Lyapunov 指数所得比值的较小者。

sentences.en: Exact overlaps are allowed, and the contraction ratios may be unequal and negative.
sentences.zh: 允许精确重叠，并且收缩比可以彼此不同，也可以为负。

sentences.en: This resolves the entropy-rate dimension conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了熵率维数猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the permanence conjecture for finite weakly reversible mass-action systems with fixed positive reaction rates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有固定正反应速率的有限弱可逆质量作用系统的永久性猜想。

sentences.en: Every positive stoichiometric compatibility class admits one compact convex forward-invariant set that every positive trajectory in that class enters in finite time, even when the class is unbounded.
sentences.zh: 每个正化学计量相容类都存在一个紧凸正向不变集，该类中的每条正轨道都会在有限时间内进入此集合，即使该类无界也如此。

sentences.en: The set depends only on the network, the rates, and the class; the entry time may depend on the initial state.
sentences.zh: 该集合仅依赖于反应网络、反应速率以及相容类；进入时间则可以依赖于初始状态。

sentences.en: Thus, after its entry time, every concentration satisfies the same positive lower and finite upper bounds throughout that class.
sentences.zh: 因此，在各自的进入时间之后，该类中的每一种浓度都满足相同的正下界和有限上界。

sentences.en: We prove the boundedness and persistence conjectures for finite weakly reversible mass-action systems with positive constant reaction rates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有正常数反应速率的有限弱可逆质量作用系统的有界性猜想和持续性猜想。

sentences.en: For every positive initial condition, the solution exists for all forward time, and every concentration remains bounded above and bounded away from zero.
sentences.zh: 对于每个正初始条件，解在所有正向时间上都存在，且每一种浓度始终有上界并与零保持正距离。

sentences.en: The bounds may depend on the initial condition, and no boundedness assumption is imposed on its stoichiometric compatibility class.
sentences.zh: 这些界可以依赖于初始条件，且不对其化学计量相容类施加有界性假设。

sentences.en: We prove that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to π is weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在每个至少有一个内角与 π 之比为无理数的非退化欧氏三角形中，单位速度台球流相对于归一化 Liouville 测度都是弱混合的。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the product of the flow with itself is ergodic.
sentences.zh: 等价地，该流与自身的乘积是遍历的。

sentences.en: We prove that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to π is ergodic for normalized area times uniform angular measure.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在每个至少有一个内角与 π 之比为无理数的非退化欧氏三角形中，单位速度台球流相对于归一化面积测度与均匀角度测度的乘积都是遍历的。

sentences.en: No genericity or Diophantine condition is required.
sentences.zh: 不需要任何一般性条件或 Diophantine 条件。

sentences.en: The flow is considered outside the null set of trajectories that hit a vertex.
sentences.zh: 所考虑的流排除了撞到顶点的轨道所构成的零测集。

sentences.en: We disprove the general C1 self-map formulation of Shub's entropy conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了 Shub 熵猜想关于一般 C1 自映射的表述。

sentences.en: We construct a noninvertible C1 self-map of a compact smooth manifold without boundary whose topological entropy is zero, while its action on second real homology has eigenvalue 2.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了无边界紧光滑流形上的一个不可逆 C1 自映射，其拓扑熵为零，而它在第二实同调群上的作用具有特征值 2。

sentences.en: Thus the topological entropy is strictly smaller than the logarithm of the homological spectral radius.
sentences.zh: 因此，其拓扑熵严格小于同调谱半径的对数。

sentences.en: We construct an ergodic invertible transformation of a standard nonatomic probability space with zero Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy that has no smooth positive-volume model.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了标准无原子概率空间上的一个遍历可逆变换，它的 Kolmogorov–Sinai 熵为零，且不存在光滑正体积模型。

sentences.en: More precisely, it is not measurably conjugate to any C∞ diffeomorphism preserving a strictly positive smooth probability density on a compact finite-dimensional manifold.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，它不与紧有限维流形上任何保持严格正的光滑概率密度的 C∞ 微分同胚可测共轭。

sentences.en: A single example excludes every finite dimension, including models on nonorientable manifolds and manifolds with smooth boundary.
sentences.zh: 这一个例子排除了所有有限维数，也包括不可定向流形和具有光滑边界的流形上的模型。

sentences.en: We give an arithmetic classification of singular and absolutely continuous unbiased Bernoulli convolutions for every parameter $`\lambda\in(0,1)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个参数 $`\lambda\in(0,1)`$，我们给出无偏 Bernoulli 卷积为奇异或绝对连续的算术分类。

sentences.en: The criterion is expressed through one-sided approximation by explicitly defined finite sets of algebraic units; it is an infinite approximation condition, not a finite membership algorithm.
sentences.zh: 该判据通过由显式定义的有限代数单位集进行的单侧逼近来表述；它是一个无穷逼近条件，而非一个有限的成员资格判定算法。

sentences.en: We also establish singular examples beyond reciprocals of Pisot numbers: singularity holds at the reciprocal of every quartic Salem number in $`(1,2)`$ and at the reciprocal of a specified non-Pisot root of an explicit degree-31 polynomial.
sentences.zh: 我们还在 Pisot 数倒数之外建立了奇异的例子：$`(1,2)`$ 中每个四次 Salem 数的倒数处都具有奇异性，并且一个显式 31 次多项式的某个指定非 Pisot 根的倒数处也具有奇异性。

sentences.en: Let T be an invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation.
sentences.zh: 设 T 是一个可逆、混合且保概率的变换。

sentences.en: For every integer n ≥ 2 and every fixed tuple of bounded measurable functions, we prove that the consecutive multiple ergodic averages of length n converge almost everywhere to the product of the integrals, as the averaging length tends to infinity through all positive integers.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 n ≥ 2 及每个固定的有界可测函数元组，我们证明，当平均长度沿所有正整数趋于无穷时，长度为 n 的连续多重遍历平均几乎处处收敛于各积分的乘积。

sentences.en: The probability space need not be standard, and no rate of mixing is required.
sentences.zh: 概率空间不必是标准空间，也不需要任何混合速率条件。

sentences.en: We prove that fourfold ergodic averages along the times $`n,2n,3n,4n`$ converge almost everywhere to the product of the integrals for every invertible, bimeasurable, mixing probability-preserving transformation and every fixed choice of bounded measurable inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于每个可逆、双向可测、混合且保概率的变换，以及每个固定选择的有界可测输入，沿时间 $`n,2n,3n,4n`$ 的四重遍历平均都几乎处处收敛于各积分的乘积。

sentences.en: Convergence holds along all positive integer averaging lengths.
sentences.zh: 该收敛对沿所有正整数取值的平均长度成立。

sentences.en: No quantitative mixing rate is assumed, and the probability space need not be standard.
sentences.zh: 这里不假设任何定量的混合速率，且概率空间不必是标准空间。

sentences.en: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation, triple ergodic averages of bounded measurable functions along any three pairwise distinct nonzero integer slopes converge almost everywhere to the product of their integrals.
sentences.zh: 对于每个可逆、混合且保概率的变换，有界可测函数沿任意三个两两不同的非零整数斜率的三重遍历平均，都几乎处处收敛于它们各自积分的乘积。

sentences.en: The slopes may be positive or negative.
sentences.zh: 这些斜率可以为正，也可以为负。

sentences.en: We prove pointwise convergence of triple ergodic averages for every invertible mixing probability preserving transformation T of an arbitrary probability space $`(X,\mathcal F,\mu)`$, with measurable inverse.
sentences.zh: 对于任意概率空间 $`(X,\mathcal F,\mu)`$ 上的每个可逆、混合且保概率、并具有可测逆映射的变换 T，我们证明了三重遍历平均的逐点收敛。

sentences.en: For every triple of bounded measurable functions $`f_1,f_2,f_3:X\to\mathbb C`$, $`\displaystyle \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N f_1(T^nx)f_2(T^{2n}x)f_3(T^{3n}x) \longrightarrow \prod_{j=1}^3\int_X f_j\,d\mu`$ for μ-almost every x as $`N\to\infty`$ through all positive integers.
sentences.zh: 对于每组三个有界可测函数 $`f_1,f_2,f_3:X\to\mathbb C`$，当 $`N\to\infty`$ 沿所有正整数取值时，对 μ-几乎处处的 x，都有 $`\displaystyle \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N f_1(T^nx)f_2(T^{2n}x)f_3(T^{3n}x) \longrightarrow \prod_{j=1}^3\int_X f_j\,d\mu`$。

sentences.en: We construct a finite translational tile in ℤ<sup>3</sup> that admits tilings but no fully periodic tiling.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ℤ<sup>3</sup> 中构造了一个有限平移铺砌块，它可以铺砌，但不存在完全周期的铺砌。

sentences.en: Its unit-cube thickening has the same property in ℝ<sup>3</sup>, even when arbitrary real translations are allowed.
sentences.zh: 将其以单位立方体加厚后，在 ℝ<sup>3</sup> 中也具有同样的性质，即使允许任意实平移也如此。

sentences.en: This gives a negative resolution of the periodic tiling conjecture in dimension three.
sentences.zh: 这在三维情形下否定了周期铺砌猜想。

sentences.en: The compact set of rank-one orthogonal projectors on ℝ<sup>4</sup>, with the Frobenius metric, cannot be covered by ten sets of strictly smaller diameter.
sentences.zh: ℝ<sup>4</sup> 上秩一正交投影算子构成的紧集，在 Frobenius 度量下，不能由十个直径严格更小的集合覆盖。

sentences.en: It therefore gives a counterexample to Borsuk's conjecture in dimension nine.
sentences.zh: 因此，它给出了九维情形下 Borsuk 猜想的一个反例。

sentences.en: We disprove Hadwiger's conjecture by constructing arbitrarily large graphs whose chromatic number exceeds their Hadwiger number.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构造色数超过 Hadwiger 数的任意大的图，否定了 Hadwiger 猜想。

sentences.en: The examples have independence number at most two, and even their ordinary fractional chromatic number exceeds their Hadwiger number.
sentences.zh: 这些例子的独立数至多为二，甚至其普通分数色数也超过其 Hadwiger 数。

sentences.en: Thus they also disprove the fractional-coloring weakening discussed by Reed and Seymour.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们也否定了 Reed 和 Seymour 所讨论的分数染色弱化版本。

sentences.en: We disprove the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture by constructing graphs whose chromatic number exceeds their Colin de Verdière invariant by more than one.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构造色数比 Colin de Verdière 不变量大超过一的图，否定了 Colin de Verdière 色数猜想。

sentences.en: The examples have independence number at most two.
sentences.zh: 这些例子的独立数至多为二。

sentences.en: In fact, their ordinary fractional chromatic number also exceeds their Colin de Verdière invariant by more than one.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们的普通分数色数也比其 Colin de Verdière 不变量大超过一。

sentences.en: We prove that every finite nonempty graph G satisfies $`\chi_{\mathrm{list}}(G)\le C h(G)`$ for an absolute integer C, where $`h(G)`$ is the largest order of a clique minor.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个有限非空图 G 都满足 $`\chi_{\mathrm{list}}(G)\le C h(G)`$，其中 C 为一个绝对整数常数，$`h(G)`$ 为完全图子式的最大阶数。

sentences.en: This resolves the Linear List Hadwiger conjecture affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了线性列表 Hadwiger 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every coloring of the Euclidean plane with five colors has a monochromatic unit-distance pair, with no regularity assumption on the color classes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，欧氏平面的每一种五色染色都存在一对同色且距离为一的点，这一结论不对各颜色类作任何正则性假设。

sentences.en: Consequently, the chromatic number of the plane is either six or seven.
sentences.zh: 因此，平面的色数不是六就是七。

sentences.en: We prove Erdős's conjecture that every set of positive integers with divergent reciprocal sum contains arithmetic progressions of every finite length.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Erdős 的猜想：每个倒数和发散的正整数集合都包含任意有限长度的等差数列。

sentences.en: More quantitatively, for every fixed k ≥ 3, we show $`\displaystyle r_k(N)\le C_kN\exp\bigl(-c_k(\log N)^{\varepsilon_k}\bigr)`$ with $`C_k,c_k,\varepsilon_k\gt 0`$, where $`r_k(N)`$ is the largest size of a subset of $`\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ with no nonconstant k-term arithmetic progression.
sentences.zh: 更定量地说，对于每个固定的 k ≥ 3，我们证明 $`\displaystyle r_k(N)\le C_kN\exp\bigl(-c_k(\log N)^{\varepsilon_k}\bigr)`$，其中 $`C_k,c_k,\varepsilon_k\gt 0`$，且 $`r_k(N)`$ 是 $`\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ 的不包含非常值 k 项等差数列的子集的最大大小。

sentences.en: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and K0 such that $`W_r(k)\gt k^{ck\lfloor\log_2 r\rfloor}`$ for every $`k\ge K_0`$ and r ≥ 2.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，存在绝对常数 c > 0 和 K0，使得对于每个 $`k\ge K_0`$ 和 r ≥ 2，都有 $`W_r(k)\gt k^{ck\lfloor\log_2 r\rfloor}`$。

sentences.en: Consequently $`W_r(k)^{1/k}\to\infty`$ for each fixed r ≥ 2, giving a quantitative positive resolution of Erdős's superexponential-growth question, including the two-color case.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于每个固定的 r ≥ 2，都有 $`W_r(k)^{1/k}\to\infty`$，从而对 Erdős 的超指数增长问题给出了定量的肯定解答，其中包括双色情形。

sentences.en: We disprove Sidorenko's conjecture with a bipartite graph on 35 vertices and 66 edges: its homomorphism density in some finite simple graph is smaller than the conjectured lower bound.
sentences.zh: 我们用一个具有 35 个顶点和 66 条边的二分图否定了 Sidorenko 猜想：它在某个有限简单图中的同态密度小于猜想所提出的下界。

sentences.en: The same connected graph also disproves the forcing conjecture: at one fixed density, asymptotically matching the edge and pattern densities does not imply quasirandomness.
sentences.zh: 同一个连通图也否定了强迫猜想：在某个固定密度下，边密度与模式密度渐近匹配并不蕴含拟随机性。
