sentences.en: For every sufficiently large prime q, we construct a finite intersecting $`(q+1)`$-partite $`(q+1)`$-uniform hypergraph with covering number $`q+1`$ and exactly $`q+1`$ nonisolated vertices in each part.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的素数 q，我们构造一个有限的相交 $`(q+1)`$ 部 $`(q+1)`$ 一致超图，其覆盖数为 $`q+1`$，且每一部恰有 $`q+1`$ 个非孤立顶点。

sentences.en: This disproves Ryser's covering conjecture, even for intersecting hypergraphs with equally sized parts.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Ryser 覆盖猜想，即使限定为各部大小相同的相交超图，该猜想也不成立。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large prime $`s\equiv2\pmod3`$ and every sufficiently large odd integer n, with the threshold depending on s, we construct an intersecting $`(s^n+1)`$-partite $`(s^n+1)`$-uniform hypergraph with covering number $`s^n+1`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分大的素数 $`s\equiv2\pmod3`$ 和每个充分大的奇整数 n，其中后者的阈值依赖于 s，我们构造一个覆盖数为 $`s^n+1`$ 的相交 $`(s^n+1)`$ 部 $`(s^n+1)`$ 一致超图。

sentences.en: This disproves Ryser's covering conjecture in its intersecting case.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Ryser 覆盖猜想的相交情形。

sentences.en: We prove Hindman's finite sums and products conjecture: for every finite coloring of the positive integers and every positive integer k, there is a k-element set whose nonempty subset sums and nonempty subset products all have the same color.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Hindman 的有限和与积猜想：对于正整数的每一种有限染色和每个正整数 k，都存在一个含 k 个元素的集合，使其所有非空子集的元素之和以及所有非空子集的元素之积都具有相同的颜色。

sentences.en: We prove the Harary–Hill conjecture: for every positive integer n, the ordinary crossing number of the complete graph Kn is $`\displaystyle \frac14\left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-2}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-3}{2}\right\rfloor.`$
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Harary–Hill 猜想：对于每个正整数 n，完全图 Kn 的普通交叉数为 $`\displaystyle \frac14\left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-2}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-3}{2}\right\rfloor.`$

sentences.en: We prove the Zarankiewicz crossing-number conjecture, resolving Turán's brickyard problem.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Zarankiewicz 交叉数猜想，从而解决了 Turán 的砖厂问题。

sentences.en: For all positive integers m, n, the ordinary crossing number of the complete bipartite graph $`K_{m,n}`$ is $`\displaystyle \left\lfloor\frac m2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{m-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor.`$
sentences.zh: 对于所有正整数 m、n，完全二分图 $`K_{m,n}`$ 的普通交叉数为 $`\displaystyle \left\lfloor\frac m2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{m-1}{2}\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac n2\right\rfloor \left\lfloor\frac{n-1}{2}\right\rfloor.`$

sentences.en: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we prove that every set of n ≥ 2 distinct points in ℝd determines at least $`c_d n^{2/d}`$ distinct distances, where $`c_d\gt 0`$ depends only on d.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 d ≥ 3，我们证明，ℝd 中每个由 n ≥ 2 个不同点组成的集合都确定了至少 $`c_d n^{2/d}`$ 个不同的距离，其中 $`c_d\gt 0`$ 仅依赖于 d。

sentences.en: This resolves the higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了高维 Erdős 不同距离猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the weak pinned Erdős distinct-distance conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了弱定点 Erdős 不同距离猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed ε > 0, all but $`o(n)`$ points of any n-point planar set determine at least $`n^{1-\varepsilon}`$ distinct nonzero distances.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 ε > 0，任意含 n 个点的平面点集中，除 $`o(n)`$ 个点以外，每个点都确定了至少 $`n^{1-\varepsilon}`$ 个不同的非零距离。

sentences.en: We prove a power saving for the planar unit-distance problem: for some absolute $`\beta\lt 4/3`$, every set of n points in the Euclidean plane determines $`O(n^\beta)`$ unordered pairs at unit distance.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了平面单位距离问题中一个幂次上的改进：存在某个绝对常数 $`\beta\lt 4/3`$，使得欧氏平面中每个含 n 个点的集合都确定了 $`O(n^\beta)`$ 对距离为一的无序点对。

sentences.en: We prove that an isomorphism of Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Coxeter systems preserves their equal-parameter Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，任意 Coxeter 系统中的 Bruhat 区间之间的同构，保持其等参数 Kazhdan–Lusztig 多项式不变。

sentences.en: This resolves the full combinatorial invariance conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了完整的组合不变性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that the chromatic quasisymmetric function of every natural unit interval graph is elementary-positive over $`\mathbb N[q]`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个自然单位区间图的色拟对称函数在 $`\mathbb N[q]`$ 上都是初等正的。

sentences.en: This resolves the elementary-positivity part of the Shareshian–Wachs conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Shareshian–Wachs 猜想中的初等正性部分。

sentences.en:
We determine the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number $`r(5,t)`$:

$`\displaystyle r(5,t)=\frac{t^4}{(\log t)^{3+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$
sentences.zh: 我们确定了非对角 Ramsey 数 $`r(5,t)`$ 的精确对数指数：$`\displaystyle r(5,t)=\frac{t^4}{(\log t)^{3+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$

sentences.en: For every fixed integer s ≥ 6, we determine the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number: $`\displaystyle r(s,t)=\frac{t^{s-1}}{(\log t)^{s-2+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 s ≥ 6，我们确定了非对角 Ramsey 数的精确对数指数：$`\displaystyle r(s,t)=\frac{t^{s-1}}{(\log t)^{s-2+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$

sentences.en: We prove that the two-color Ramsey number of the n-dimensional binary cube is at most $`C2^n`$, where C is an absolute constant.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，n 维二元立方体的双色 Ramsey 数至多为 $`C2^n`$，其中 C 是一个绝对常数。

sentences.en: This resolves positively the hypercube Ramsey conjecture of Burr and Erdős.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Burr 和 Erdős 的超立方体 Ramsey 猜想。

sentences.en: We classify finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations by a necessary and sufficient tensor condition over their coordinate fields.
sentences.zh: 我们通过坐标域上的一个充要张量条件，对有限欧氏 Ramsey 构型进行了分类。

sentences.en: The Ramsey property here concerns monochromatic congruent copies at the original scale under arbitrary finite colorings.
sentences.zh: 这里的 Ramsey 性质指，在任意有限染色下都存在原尺度的单色全等副本。

sentences.en: The criterion shows that every nonempty subtransitive set and every nonempty set of at most five points on a circle is Ramsey.
sentences.zh: 该判据表明，每个非空的 subtransitive 集合以及圆周上每个至多含五个点的非空集合都是 Ramsey 集合。

sentences.en: In particular, some Ramsey cyclic quadrilaterals are not subtransitive, disproving the necessity direction of the Leader–Russell–Walters conjectured characterization.
sentences.zh: 特别地，某些具有 Ramsey 性质的圆内接四边形并非 subtransitive，从而否定了 Leader–Russell–Walters 所猜想的刻画中的必要性方向。

sentences.en: We prove that every nonempty finite oriented graph has a vertex with at least as many vertices at directed distance two as at directed distance one.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个非空有限定向图都有一个顶点，使得从该顶点出发的有向距离为二的顶点至少与有向距离为一的顶点一样多。

sentences.en: This resolves Seymour's second neighborhood conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Seymour 的第二邻域猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every finite loopless k-edge-connected multigraph on at least two vertices, with k ≥ 1, has a spanning tree meeting each cut in at most $`C/k`$ times the size of the cut, where C is a universal constant.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个至少具有两个顶点的有限无自环 k 边连通多重图，其中 k ≥ 1，都有一棵生成树，它与每个割的交集大小至多为该割大小的 $`C/k`$ 倍，其中 C 是一个普适常数。

sentences.en: This resolves the strong thin tree conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了强薄树猜想。

sentences.en: We give a deterministic polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees.
sentences.zh: 我们给出强薄树的一个确定性多项式时间构造。

sentences.en: Given a finite k-edge-connected loopless multigraph on at least one vertex, the algorithm constructs a spanning tree meeting every cut in at most a $`C/k`$ fraction of its edges, for a universal constant C.
sentences.zh: 给定一个至少具有一个顶点的有限 k 边连通无自环多重图，该算法构造一棵生成树，它在每个割中所含的边数至多占该割边数的 $`C/k`$，其中 C 是一个普适常数。

sentences.en: The running time is polynomial in the binary input length, including when parallel-edge multiplicities are encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 运行时间关于二进制输入长度为多项式，包括平行边重数以二进制编码的情形。

sentences.en: We prove the graph-decomposition conjecture of Ascoli, He, Park, and Talagrand.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Ascoli、He、Park 和 Talagrand 的图分解猜想。

sentences.en: Every graph admits a partition into a universally bounded number of fixed edge pieces, each having ordinary containment threshold at most a universal constant times the original graph's integral expectation threshold.
sentences.zh: 每个图都可以划分为若干个固定的边片段，其数量具有一个普适上界，且每个片段的普通包含阈值至多为原图整数期望阈值的某个普适常数倍。

sentences.en: The partition is chosen before sampling the random host, and the separate embeddings of the pieces need not agree on shared vertices.
sentences.zh: 这一划分在对随机宿主图进行采样之前选定，且各片段各自的嵌入在共享顶点上不必一致。

sentences.en: We prove Talagrand's conjecture that integral and fractional expectation thresholds are within a universal constant factor, with the same covering budget.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Talagrand 的猜想：在相同的覆盖预算下，整数期望阈值与分数期望阈值相差至多一个普适常数因子。

sentences.en: We prove Talagrand's discrete-convexity conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Talagrand 的离散凸性猜想。

sentences.en: There is a universal integer k such that, whenever an arbitrary family has Bernoulli product measure at least $`1-1/k`$, the sets not contained in a union of k members admit a cover of total cost at most 1/2 at the same density.
sentences.zh: 存在一个普适整数 k，使得只要任意给定集合族的 Bernoulli 乘积测度至少为 $`1-1/k`$，那么不包含于其中 k 个成员之并的那些集合，就在相同密度下存在总成本至多为 1/2 的覆盖。

sentences.en: We prove the second Kahn–Kalai conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了第二 Kahn–Kalai 猜想。

sentences.en: For every finite simple graph H with h ≥ 1 edges and at most n vertices, the threshold for $`G(n,p)`$ to contain an ordinary copy of H is at most $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$, where C is universal.
sentences.zh: 对于每个具有 h ≥ 1 条边且至多具有 n 个顶点的有限简单图 H，$`G(n,p)`$ 包含 H 的普通副本的阈值至多为 $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$，其中 C 为一个普适常数。

sentences.en: Here $`p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)`$ is the least density at which every subgraph of H has expected copy count at least one half.
sentences.zh: 这里，$`p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)`$ 是使 H 的每个子图的期望副本数都至少为二分之一的最小密度。

sentences.en: For every integer d ≥ 3, we construct arbitrarily large finite d-dimensional simplicial complexes with uniformly bounded vertex degrees and uniform 𝔽2 coboundary expansion in every degree below d.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 d ≥ 3，我们构造任意大的有限 d 维单纯复形，它们的顶点度数一致有界，并且在每个低于 d 的次数上都具有一致的 𝔽2 余边界扩张性。

sentences.en: Together with the known graph and two-dimensional cases, this establishes the existence of bounded-degree 𝔽<sub>2</sub> coboundary expanders in every positive dimension.
sentences.zh: 结合已知的图情形和二维情形，这确立了每个正维数中有界度 𝔽<sub>2</sub> 余边界扩张复形的存在性。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we give a deterministic algorithm that constructs a simple nonbipartite d-regular Ramanujan graph on every sufficiently large even number n of vertices.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 d ≥ 3，我们给出一个确定性算法，它对每个充分大的偶数 n 都能构造一个具有该顶点数的简单非二分 d 正则 Ramanujan 图。

sentences.en: It outputs the full adjacency list in polynomially many bit operations, with an exponent that may depend on d.
sentences.zh: 它以多项式次比特运算输出完整的邻接表，其中多项式的指数可以依赖于 d。

sentences.en: Every nonconstant adjacency eigenvalue lies strictly between $`-2\sqrt{d-1}`$ and $`2\sqrt{d-1}`$.
sentences.zh: 每个对应于非常值特征向量的邻接特征值都严格位于 $`-2\sqrt{d-1}`$ 与 $`2\sqrt{d-1}`$ 之间。

sentences.en: We prove the circulant Hadamard conjecture: a real circulant Hadamard matrix has order 1 or 4.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了循环 Hadamard 猜想：实循环 Hadamard 矩阵的阶数为 1 或 4。

sentences.en: As a consequence, Barker sequences of length greater than one exist exactly at lengths 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, proving the Barker-sequence conjecture.
sentences.zh: 由此可得，长度大于一的 Barker 序列恰好在长度为 2、3、4、5、7、11、13 时存在，从而证明了 Barker 序列猜想。

sentences.en: We prove Barnette's conjecture: every finite simple cubic bipartite planar 3-vertex-connected graph has a Hamiltonian cycle.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Barnette 猜想：每个有限简单三正则二分平面 3-顶点连通图都有 Hamilton 圈。

sentences.en: We prove that every finite simple undirected graph on n vertices has an edge partition into at most $`Cn`$ simple cycles and single edges, for an absolute constant C.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于某个绝对常数 C，每个具有 n 个顶点的有限简单无向图，都可以将其边集划分为至多 $`Cn`$ 个简单圈和单边。

sentences.en: This resolves the Erdős–Gallai cycle decomposition conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Erdős–Gallai 圈分解猜想。

sentences.en: An integer polynomial is intersective if it has a root modulo every positive integer.
sentences.zh: 若一个整系数多项式对每个正整数取模都有根，则称其为 intersective。

sentences.en: For each degree k ≥ 2, we prove that there is an exponent $`c_k\gt 0`$ such that every set $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ whose differences avoid all nonzero values $`h(1),h(2),\ldots`$, where h is an intersective polynomial of degree k with positive leading coefficient, satisfies $`|A|=O_h(N^{1-c_k})`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个次数 k ≥ 2，我们证明，存在指数 $`c_k\gt 0`$，使得每个差值避开 $`h(1),h(2),\ldots`$ 中所有非零值的集合 $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ 都满足 $`|A|=O_h(N^{1-c_k})`$，其中 h 是一个次数为 k、首项系数为正的 intersective 多项式。

sentences.en: The implied constant may depend on h, but the power-saving exponent depends only on its degree.
sentences.zh: 隐含常数可以依赖于 h，但幂次改进的指数仅依赖于它的次数。

sentences.en: Let h be a fixed integer polynomial of degree at least two with positive leading coefficient, having a unit root modulo every positive integer.
sentences.zh: 设 h 是一个固定的整系数多项式，其次数至少为二、首项系数为正，且对每个正整数取模都有一个可逆元根。

sentences.en: We prove that any set $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ whose differences avoid all nonzero values $`h(p)`$ at primes satisfies $`|A|\le C_hN^{1-c_h}`$, where $`c_h\gt 0`$ and $`C_h\ge1`$ depend only on h.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个差值避开所有素数处的非零值 $`h(p)`$ 的集合 $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ 都满足 $`|A|\le C_hN^{1-c_h}`$，其中 $`c_h\gt 0`$ 和 $`C_h\ge1`$ 仅依赖于 h。

sentences.en: Thus the local unit-root condition gives a fixed power saving even when polynomial arguments are restricted to primes.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使将多项式的自变量限制为素数，该局部可逆元根条件也给出一个固定的幂次改进。

sentences.en: The proof uses the companion zero-free half-plane theorem for Dirichlet L-functions to obtain the required prime-distribution estimates.
sentences.zh: 证明使用姊妹论文中关于 Dirichlet L-函数的无零点半平面定理，以获得所需的素数分布估计。

sentences.en: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and C < ∞ such that every set $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ with no nonzero square difference satisfies $`|A|\le C N^{1-c}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，存在绝对常数 c > 0 和 C < ∞，使得每个不含非零平方数差值的集合 $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ 都满足 $`|A|\le C N^{1-c}`$。

sentences.en: This answers the fixed-power question posed by Green and Sawhney.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Green 和 Sawhney 提出的固定幂次问题。

sentences.en: There are absolute constants ε > 0 and C such that every sufficiently large even n-point set in the plane with no three collinear has at most $`Cn^{4/3-\varepsilon}`$ unordered halving pairs.
sentences.zh: 存在绝对常数 ε > 0 和 C，使得对于每个充分大的偶数 n，平面中每个具有该点数且无三点共线的点集，都至多具有 $`Cn^{4/3-\varepsilon}`$ 个无序平分点对。

sentences.en: This gives a power saving over the classical $`O(n^{4/3})`$ bound for planar halving lines.
sentences.zh: 这相较于平面平分线的经典 $`O(n^{4/3})`$ 界给出了幂次上的改进。

sentences.en: The proof is nonquantitative and does not supply explicit constants.
sentences.zh: 该证明是非定量的，不提供显式常数。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer r ≥ 4, we prove that every Kr-free graph of sufficiently large maximum degree Δ has correspondence chromatic number $`O_r(\Delta/\log\Delta)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 r ≥ 4，我们证明，每个最大度 Δ 充分大的不含 Kr 的图，其对应色数为 $`O_r(\Delta/\log\Delta)`$。

sentences.en: This resolves the Alon–Krivelevich–Sudakov coloring conjecture in the stronger correspondence-coloring form.
sentences.zh: 这以更强的对应染色形式解决了 Alon–Krivelevich–Sudakov 染色猜想。

sentences.en: The same bound, with a constant depending on F, holds when any fixed graph F is excluded as an ordinary subgraph.
sentences.zh: 当排除任意一个固定图 F 作为普通子图时，同样的界也成立，其中常数依赖于 F。

sentences.en: Ordinary and list coloring satisfy the same bounds.
sentences.zh: 普通染色和列表染色满足相同的界。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer r ≥ 4, every Kr-free graph on n vertices with average degree d ≥ 2 has an independent set of size at least $`c_r n\log d/d`$, where $`c_r\gt 0`$ depends only on r.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 r ≥ 4，每个具有 n 个顶点、平均度为 d ≥ 2 且不含 Kr 的图，都有一个大小至少为 $`c_r n\log d/d`$ 的独立集，其中 $`c_r\gt 0`$ 仅依赖于 r。

sentences.en: This proves the fixed-clique-size independence conjecture of Ajtai, Erdős, Komlós and Szemerédi.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Ajtai、Erdős、Komlós 和 Szemerédi 关于固定团大小的独立数猜想。

sentences.en: We construct in ZFC two self-dual partitional matroids on a countably infinite common ground set that admit neither a packing/covering partition nor an intersection witness.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ZFC 中构造了定义在同一个可数无穷基集上的两个自对偶分划拟阵，它们既不存在打包/覆盖划分，也不存在交性质的见证。

sentences.en: This disproves the unrestricted infinite matroid packing/covering and intersection conjectures and answers Joó's question for two partitional matroids negatively.
sentences.zh: 这否定了不加限制的无穷拟阵打包/覆盖猜想和交猜想，并否定地回答了 Joó 关于两个分划拟阵的问题。

sentences.en: The examples are neither finitary nor cofinitary.
sentences.zh: 这些例子既不是有限型的，也不是余有限型的。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer r ≥ 3, we prove that every relabeling-invariant Boolean property of simple r-uniform hypergraphs on n vertices satisfies $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits _p(f)\le C_r I_p(f)/(\log n)^{r/(r-1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 r ≥ 3，我们证明，具有 n 个顶点的简单 r 一致超图的每个在重新标号下不变的布尔性质都满足 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits _p(f)\le C_r I_p(f)/(\log n)^{r/(r-1)}`$。

sentences.en: The constant depends only on r, and the bound holds uniformly for all $`0\lt p\lt 1`$ without a monotonicity assumption.
sentences.zh: 该常数仅依赖于 r，并且该界对所有 $`0\lt p\lt 1`$ 一致成立，无须单调性假设。

sentences.en: For increasing properties, it gives the corresponding threshold-width bound with exponent $`r/(r-1)`$, proving the hypergraph threshold-width conjecture of Friedgut and Kalai.
sentences.zh: 对于递增性质，它给出了指数为 $`r/(r-1)`$ 的相应阈值宽度界，从而证明了 Friedgut 和 Kalai 的超图阈值宽度猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the Friedgut–Kalai sharp-threshold conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Friedgut–Kalai 锐阈值（sharp-threshold）猜想。

sentences.en: For every integer n ≥ 2, every nontrivial increasing family of graphs on n vertices invariant under all vertex permutations, and every $`0\lt \varepsilon\lt 1/2`$, the edge probabilities at which its probability equals ε and $`1-\varepsilon`$ differ by at most $`C\log(1/(2\varepsilon))/(\log n)^2`$, for a universal constant C.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 n ≥ 2、每个由 n 个顶点的图组成且在所有顶点置换下不变的非平凡递增族，以及每个 $`0\lt \varepsilon\lt 1/2`$，使该族概率分别等于 ε 和 $`1-\varepsilon`$ 的边概率相差至多 $`C\log(1/(2\varepsilon))/(\log n)^2`$，其中 C 是一个普适常数。

sentences.en: We prove that Maker can achieve the Snaky hexomino within 21 actual Maker moves against arbitrary legal Breaker play on the initially empty infinite square board.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在初始为空的无穷方格棋盘上，面对 Breaker 的任意合法走法，Maker 都能在实际进行的 21 次 Maker 落子之内完成 Snaky 六连方。

sentences.en: The same bound holds on a $`17\times17`$ square; in fact, Maker can confine its claims to a fixed 251-cell board.
sentences.zh: 同样的界在一个 $`17\times17`$ 方形棋盘上也成立；事实上，Maker 可以将自己占据的格子限制在一个固定的 251 格棋盘内。

sentences.en: Starting from the complete graph on n vertices, repeatedly remove the three edges of a uniformly chosen remaining triangle.
sentences.zh: 从具有 n 个顶点的完全图出发，反复均匀选取一个尚存的三角形，并删除它的三条边。

sentences.en: We prove that the number of edges left at termination, divided by n3/2, converges in L2 to $`1/(2\sqrt2)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，终止时剩余的边数除以 n3/2 后，在 L2 中收敛于 $`1/(2\sqrt2)`$。

sentences.en: This proves the triangle case of the sharp-constant conjecture of Joos and Kühn.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Joos 和 Kühn 的精确常数猜想的三角形情形。

sentences.en: In particular, the same limit holds in probability and for the normalized expectation.
sentences.zh: 特别地，依概率收敛以及归一化期望也具有相同的极限。

sentences.en: We prove that $`R(C_m,K_n)=(m-1)(n-1)+1`$ for every pair of integers $`m\ge n\ge3`$ other than $`(m,n)=(3,3)`$, for which $`R(C_3,K_3)=6`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于除 $`(m,n)=(3,3)`$ 之外的每对整数 $`m\ge n\ge3`$，都有 $`R(C_m,K_n)=(m-1)(n-1)+1`$，而在被排除的情形中有 $`R(C_3,K_3)=6`$。

sentences.en: This establishes the cycle–clique conjecture of Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau and Schelp.
sentences.zh: 这确立了 Erdős、Faudree、Rousseau 和 Schelp 的圈—团猜想。

sentences.en: The proof combines expansion in a minimal counterexample with a large-clique lemma and an optimization of paths joining clique vertices.
sentences.zh: 证明将极小反例中的扩张性与一个大团引理，以及对连接团中顶点的路径所作的优化相结合。

sentences.en: These arguments reduce the remaining cases to $`3{,}099`$ finite parameter-pattern instances, which are excluded by two exact implementations of proved inference rules.
sentences.zh: 这些论证将其余情形归结为 $`3{,}099`$ 个有限参数—模式实例，再用已证明推理规则的两套精确实现排除这些实例。

sentences.en: Complete programs and deduction traces accompany the paper.
sentences.zh: 完整程序和推导轨迹随论文一并提供。

sentences.en: We construct a fixed $`66\times66`$ binary matrix for which ordered matrix removal has no polynomial bound.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个固定的 $`66\times66`$ 二元矩阵，使其有序矩阵移除不存在多项式界。

sentences.en: This disproves the polynomial ordered binary matrix-removal conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了有序二元矩阵移除的多项式界猜想。

sentences.en: Ordered copies preserve the separate row and column orders and match both zeros and ones; removal permits changing entries in either direction.
sentences.zh: 有序副本分别保持行顺序和列顺序，并同时匹配零与一；移除过程既允许把零改成一，也允许把一改成零。

sentences.en: There are absolute constants $`\eta,c_1\gt 0`$ such that, for every sufficiently large integer n, one can choose n points in the unit square so that every triangle they determine has area at least $`c_1n^{-2+\eta}`$.
sentences.zh: 存在绝对常数 $`\eta,c_1\gt 0`$，使得对于每个充分大的整数 n，都可以在单位正方形中选取 n 个点，使它们确定的每个三角形的面积都至少为 $`c_1n^{-2+\eta}`$。

sentences.en: Thus the almost n−2 upper-bound formulation of Heilbronn's triangle problem is false.
sentences.zh: 因此，Heilbronn 三角形问题中以几乎 n−2 为上界的表述是错误的。

sentences.en: The exponent η is fixed but extremely small.
sentences.zh: 指数 η 是固定的，但极其小。

sentences.en: We disprove the Gopalan–Servedio square-root conjecture, even up to an arbitrary constant factor.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了 Gopalan–Servedio 平方根猜想，即使容许任意常数因子，该猜想仍不成立。

sentences.en: For every real C > 0, there is a nonconstant Boolean function $`f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}`$ on a finite sign cube such that $`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})\gt C\sqrt{\deg(f)}.`$
sentences.zh: 对于每个实数 C > 0，都存在有限符号立方体上的一个非常值布尔函数 $`f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}`$，使得 $`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n \widehat f(\{i\})\gt C\sqrt{\deg(f)}.`$

sentences.en: Here $`\widehat f(\{i\})`$ is the linear Fourier coefficient associated with the ith input, and $`\deg(f)`$ is the degree of the real multilinear polynomial representing f.
sentences.zh: 这里，$`\widehat f(\{i\})`$ 是与第 i 个输入关联的线性 Fourier 系数，$`\deg(f)`$ 是表示 f 的实多线性多项式的次数。

sentences.en: We prove Serre's positivity conjecture, including ramified mixed characteristic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Serre 的正性猜想，其中包括分歧混合特征情形。

sentences.en: If two nonzero finitely generated modules over a regular local ring have tensor product of finite length and complementary dimensions, then their intersection multiplicity is strictly positive.
sentences.zh: 若正则局部环上的两个非零有限生成模的张量积具有有限长度，且二者维数互补，则它们的交重数严格为正。

sentences.en: We prove Lech's multiplicity conjecture: Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity cannot decrease under a flat local homomorphism of nonzero Noetherian local rings.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Lech 的重数猜想：在非零 Noether 局部环之间的平坦局部同态下，Hilbert–Samuel 重数不会减小。

sentences.en: The result holds in arbitrary dimension, with no restrictions on the residue fields or characteristics.
sentences.zh: 该结果在任意维数中都成立，对剩余域或特征均无限制。

sentences.en: We construct a three-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local domain containing ℂ, with residue field ℂ, that has no nonzero finitely generated maximal Cohen–Macaulay module.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个包含 ℂ 且剩余域为 ℂ 的三维完备 Noether 正规局部整环，它不存在非零有限生成极大 Cohen–Macaulay 模。

sentences.en: This disproves the domain form of the small Cohen–Macaulay module conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了小 Cohen–Macaulay 模猜想的整环形式。

sentences.en: We disprove Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture by constructing a finitely presented torsion-free group G for which $`\mathbb F_2[G]`$ has nonzero zero divisors.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构造一个使 $`\mathbb F_2[G]`$ 具有非零零因子的有限展示无挠群 G，否定了 Kaplansky 的零因子猜想。

sentences.en: The group admits a finite two-dimensional classifying space.
sentences.zh: 该群具有一个有限二维分类空间。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely presented torsion-free counterexample to Kaplansky's direct finiteness conjecture over the field of two elements.
sentences.zh: 我们在二元域上构造了 Kaplansky 直接有限性猜想的一个有限展示无挠群反例。

sentences.en: The group admits a finite two-dimensional classifying complex.
sentences.zh: 该群具有一个有限二维分类复形。

sentences.en: We disprove Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture by constructing a finite field K of characteristic two, a finitely presented group G, and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构造一个特征为二的有限域 K、一个有限展示群 G，以及满足 $`ab=1`$ 但 $`ba\ne1`$ 的有限和 $`a,b\in K[G]`$，否定了 Kaplansky 的直接有限性猜想。

sentences.en: The group G is nonsofic.
sentences.zh: 群 G 不是 sofic 群。

sentences.en: The same elements define a cellular automaton on KG that is injective but not surjective, disproving Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture.
sentences.zh: 同样的元素在 KG 上定义了一个单射但非满射的元胞自动机，从而否定了 Gottschalk 的 surjunctivity 猜想。

sentences.en: We disprove the unrestricted group-ring Determinant Conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了不加限制的群环行列式猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely generated group G and a square matrix over $`\mathbb Z[G]`$ that is invertible over $`\mathbb Q[G]`$ and has Fuglede–Kadison determinant strictly between zero and one.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个有限生成群 G，以及一个在 $`\mathbb Q[G]`$ 上可逆、且 Fuglede–Kadison 行列式严格介于零与一之间的 $`\mathbb Z[G]`$ 上的方阵。

sentences.en: The logarithmic integral defining the determinant is finite.
sentences.zh: 定义该行列式的对数积分是有限的。

sentences.en: We construct a counterexample to Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture in odd characteristic.
sentences.zh: 我们在奇特征情形下构造了 Kaplansky 直接有限性猜想的一个反例。

sentences.en: For one specified odd prime p, we obtain a field K of order p4, a finitely generated group G containing torsion, and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$.
sentences.zh: 对于一个指定的奇素数 p，我们得到一个阶为 p4 的域 K、一个含挠元的有限生成群 G，以及满足 $`ab=1`$ 但 $`ba\ne1`$ 的有限和 $`a,b\in K[G]`$。

sentences.en: The same elements define a cellular automaton on KG that is injective but not surjective.
sentences.zh: 同样的元素在 KG 上定义了一个单射但非满射的元胞自动机。

sentences.en: We construct a finite-dimensional complex algebra whose finite-dimensional modules have unbounded finite projective dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个有限维复代数，其有限维模的有限投射维数无界。

sentences.en: This disproves the little finitistic-dimension conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了小有限投射维数猜想。

sentences.en: We disprove the Auslander–Reiten conjecture for Artin algebras.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了 Artin 代数的 Auslander–Reiten 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a finite-dimensional algebra Λ over $`k=\mathbb F_2(q,H_1,H_2)`$ and a finite-dimensional nonprojective left module Z such that $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ext}}\nolimits ^i_\Lambda(Z,Z)=\mathop{\mathrm{Ext}}\nolimits ^i_\Lambda(Z,\Lambda)=0`$ for every i > 0.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了 $`k=\mathbb F_2(q,H_1,H_2)`$ 上的一个有限维代数 Λ 和一个有限维非投射左模 Z，使得对每个 i > 0 都有 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ext}}\nolimits ^i_\Lambda(Z,Z)=\mathop{\mathrm{Ext}}\nolimits ^i_\Lambda(Z,\Lambda)=0`$。

sentences.en: The module is Gorenstein-projective, so the same example also disproves the Gorenstein-projective conjecture.
sentences.zh: 该模是 Gorenstein-投射模，因此同一个例子也否定了 Gorenstein-投射猜想。

sentences.en: Both counterexamples persist after every extension of k.
sentences.zh: 这两个反例在 k 的每个扩域后都仍然成立。

sentences.en: We disprove Tachikawa's second conjecture by constructing a finite-dimensional symmetric algebra over $`k=\mathbb F_2(q,H_1,H_2)`$ with a finite-dimensional nonprojective module whose self-extension groups vanish in every positive degree.
sentences.zh: 我们通过构造 $`k=\mathbb F_2(q,H_1,H_2)`$ 上的一个有限维对称代数来否定 Tachikawa 的第二猜想，该代数具有一个有限维非投射模，其自扩张群在每个正次数上都为零。

sentences.en: The associated endomorphism algebra also gives counterexamples to the classical, generalized, and strong Nakayama conjectures, the Auslander–Gorenstein conjecture, and the Wakamatsu tilting conjecture.
sentences.zh: 相应的自同态代数也给出了经典、广义和强 Nakayama 猜想、Auslander–Gorenstein 猜想以及 Wakamatsu 倾斜猜想的反例。

sentences.en: These conclusions persist after every extension of k.
sentences.zh: 这些结论在 k 的每个扩域后都仍然成立。

sentences.en: We prove the Eisenbud–Green–Harris and lex-plus-powers conjectures over every characteristic-zero field for homogeneous regular sequences of any positive length, with degrees at least two.
sentences.zh: 对于每个特征为零的域上任意正长度、各项次数至少为二的齐次正则序列，我们证明了 Eisenbud–Green–Harris 猜想和字典序加幂猜想。

sentences.en: For every homogeneous ideal containing such a sequence, the corresponding lex-plus-powers ideal has the same Hilbert function and at least as large a graded Betti number in every homological and internal degree.
sentences.zh: 对于每个包含这种序列的齐次理想，相应的字典序加幂理想具有相同的 Hilbert 函数，并且在每个同调次数和内部次数上的分次 Betti 数都至少与之一样大。

sentences.en: We prove the Eisenbud–Green–Harris conjecture over every characteristic-zero field for homogeneous regular sequences of any positive length, with degrees at least two.
sentences.zh: 对于每个特征为零的域上任意正长度、各项次数至少为二的齐次正则序列，我们证明了 Eisenbud–Green–Harris 猜想。

sentences.en: Thus every homogeneous ideal containing such a sequence has the Hilbert function of a monomial ideal containing the corresponding pure powers.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个包含这种序列的齐次理想，其 Hilbert 函数都等于一个包含相应纯幂的单项式理想的 Hilbert 函数。

sentences.en: We construct a countable division ring of characteristic zero that is algebraic over its center, generated by two elements as an algebra over that center, and infinite-dimensional over it.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个特征为零的可数除环，它在其中心上是代数的，作为其中心上的代数由两个元素生成，且在其中心上是无穷维的。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the Kurosh problem for division rings.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了除环的 Kurosh 问题。

sentences.en: We prove the numerical blockwise Alperin weight conjecture for every finite group and every prime p.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个有限群和每个素数 p 的数值形式的分块 Alperin 权猜想。

sentences.en: For each p-block B, the number of irreducible Brauer characters in B equals the number of conjugacy classes of B-weights.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 p-块 B，B 中不可约 Brauer 特征标的数目等于 B-权的共轭类数目。

sentences.en: We prove Donovan's conjecture over every algebraically closed field K of characteristic p > 0.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个特征为 p > 0 的代数闭域 K 上的 Donovan 猜想。

sentences.en: For each fixed K and bound on defect-group order, blocks of finite groups represent only finitely many K-linear Morita equivalence classes.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 K 和亏群阶数的界，有限群的块仅代表有限多个 K-线性 Morita 等价类。

sentences.en: The defect groups need not be abelian, and the result includes p = 2.
sentences.zh: 亏群不必是阿贝尔群，且该结果涵盖 p = 2 的情形。

sentences.en: We prove integral Donovan finiteness: for every prime p and positive integer M, the blocks of all finite groups with defect groups of order at most M have only finitely many Morita equivalence classes over $`W(\overline{\mathbb F}_p)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了整系数 Donovan 有限性：对于每个素数 p 和正整数 M，所有有限群中亏群阶数至多为 M 的块，在 $`W(\overline{\mathbb F}_p)`$ 上仅有有限多个 Morita 等价类。

sentences.en: The defect groups need not be abelian, and the result includes p = 2.
sentences.zh: 亏群不必是阿贝尔群，且该结果涵盖 p = 2 的情形。

sentences.en: The same bounded-defect finiteness holds over each fixed complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic zero with algebraically closed residue field of characteristic p, including ramified rings.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的特征零完备离散赋值环，只要其剩余域是特征为 p 的代数闭域，同样的亏群阶数有界时的有限性就成立，其中包括分歧环。

sentences.en: We prove the saturation conjecture for $`\mathop{\mathrm{Spin}}\nolimits (2n)`$, n ≥ 2.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Spin}}\nolimits (2n)`$ 在 n ≥ 2 时的饱和猜想。

sentences.en: If three dominant integral weights sum to an element of the root lattice, then the existence of a nonzero tensor invariant after a positive integral dilation implies the existence of one at the original weights.
sentences.zh: 如果三个支配整权的和属于根格，那么将它们放大一个正整数倍后存在非零张量不变量，就蕴含在原权处也存在非零张量不变量。

sentences.en: For every positive integer n other than 2, 4, and 9, we prove that some irreducible complex representation of Sn has a tensor square containing every irreducible representation.
sentences.zh: 对于除 2、4 和 9 以外的每个正整数 n，我们证明了 Sn 存在某个不可约复表示，其张量平方包含每个不可约表示。

sentences.en: This resolves the tensor square conjecture for symmetric groups affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了对称群的张量平方猜想。

sentences.en: For every staircase partition, we prove that the tensor square of the corresponding irreducible complex representation of the symmetric group contains every irreducible representation of that group.
sentences.zh: 对于每个阶梯分拆，我们证明了相应的对称群不可约复表示的张量平方包含该群的每个不可约表示。

sentences.en: This proves Saxl's conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Saxl 猜想。

sentences.en: We give an explicit colored-graph characterization of the finite nonempty lattices that occur as full congruence lattices of finite algebras, and prove that deciding this representation property is undecidable.
sentences.zh: 对于能够作为有限代数的完整同余格出现的有限非空格，我们给出了一个明确的着色图刻画，并证明判定这一表示性质是不可判定的。

sentences.en: In particular, the finite lattice representation problem has a negative answer.
sentences.zh: 特别地，有限格表示问题的答案是否定的。

sentences.en: We also prove that recognition of full subgroup intervals in finite groups is undecidable.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了识别有限群中的完整子群区间是不可判定的。

sentences.en: We give a negative solution to the finite lattice representation problem.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了有限格表示问题的否定解答。

sentences.en: We prove that there is a finite nonempty lattice that is not the full congruence lattice of any finite nonempty algebra of any finite signature.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了存在一个有限非空格，它不是任何有限运算型的任何有限非空代数的完整同余格。

sentences.en: We prove the ℓ1-Bass conjecture for every discrete group.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个离散群的 ℓ1-Bass 猜想。

sentences.en: The Hattori–Stallings trace of every idempotent matrix over the complex ℓ1 group algebra is supported on finitely many conjugacy classes of finite-order elements.
sentences.zh: 复 ℓ1 群代数上的每个幂等矩阵的 Hattori–Stallings 迹都支撑在有限多个有限阶元素的共轭类上。

sentences.en: We prove the complex group-ring Bass trace conjecture for every discrete group: the Hattori–Stallings trace of a finitely generated projective module over its complex group ring is supported on conjugacy classes of finite-order elements.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个离散群的复群环 Bass 迹猜想：其复群环上的有限生成投射模的 Hattori–Stallings 迹支撑在有限阶元素的共轭类上。

sentences.en: As a consequence, for every torsion-free group G and every commutative unital domain R of characteristic zero, the only idempotents in $`RG`$ are 0 and 1.
sentences.zh: 由此可得，对于每个无挠群 G 和每个特征零的含幺交换整环 R，$`RG`$ 中仅有的幂等元为 0 和 1。

sentences.en: This proves Kaplansky's idempotent conjecture in characteristic zero.
sentences.zh: 这证明了特征零情形下的 Kaplansky 幂等元猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the finite case of the Benson–Etingof–Ostrik conjecture: every finite symmetric tensor category over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p > 0 admits a k-linear exact faithful strong symmetric monoidal functor to a finite higher Verlinde category $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ver}}\nolimits _{p^n}(k)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Benson–Etingof–Ostrik 猜想的有限情形：特征为 p > 0 的代数闭域 k 上的每个有限对称张量范畴，都存在一个到有限高阶 Verlinde 范畴 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ver}}\nolimits _{p^n}(k)`$ 的 k-线性、正合、忠实的强对称幺半函子。

sentences.en: The result includes characteristic two, and the level n may depend on the category.
sentences.zh: 该结果涵盖特征为二的情形，且层级 n 可以依赖于该范畴。

sentences.en: We construct a two-dimensional ramified regular local ring A of mixed characteristic $`(0,5)`$ for which $`K_5(A)\to K_5(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ has a nonzero kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个混合特征为 $`(0,5)`$ 的二维分歧正则局部环 A，使得 $`K_5(A)\to K_5(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ 具有非零核。

sentences.en: This disproves Gersten's conjecture in its unrestricted integral form.
sentences.zh: 这否定了不加限制的整系数形式的 Gersten 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a two-dimensional ramified regular local ring A in mixed characteristic $`(0,5)`$ for which the integral map $`K_3(A)\to K_3(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ has nonzero kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个混合特征为 $`(0,5)`$ 的二维分歧正则局部环 A，使得整系数映射 $`K_3(A)\to K_3(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ 具有非零核。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the unrestricted integral Gersten conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这对不加限制的整系数 Gersten 猜想给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: We prove the sixth-symmetric-power case of Foulkes' conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Foulkes 猜想的六次对称幂情形。

sentences.en: This gives a quadratic stabilization bound independent of $`\dim V`$.
sentences.zh: 这给出了一个与 $`\dim V`$ 无关的二次稳定化界。

sentences.en: We prove that stationary random walks on critical spherical FK–Ising planar maps converge to Liouville Brownian motion on the ordinary unit-area $`\sqrt3`$-quantum sphere, using the geometric and electrical results of the spectral companion.
sentences.zh: 利用谱问题姊妹论文中的几何和电学结果，我们证明了临界球面 FK–Ising 平面地图上的平稳随机游走收敛于通常的单位面积 $`\sqrt3`$-量子球面上的 Liouville 布朗运动。

sentences.en: The walk chooses uniformly among all incident half-edges, retaining loops and multiple edges.
sentences.zh: 该游走从所有关联的半边中均匀选取，保留自环和重边。

sentences.en: With the corner measure as the stationary law, the deterministic time acceleration is exactly the number of map edges.
sentences.zh: 以角测度作为平稳分布时，确定性的时间加速因子恰好等于地图的边数。

sentences.en: For any deterministic metric scale giving the metric-measure limit, convergence retains that same surface and any fixed finite number of conditionally independent walks with their time parameters.
sentences.zh: 对于任何产生度量测度极限的确定性度量尺度，该收敛都保留同一个曲面，以及任意固定有限个条件独立的游走及其时间参数。

sentences.en: Using the conformal and metric-measure companion results and the stated Brownian/Liouville quantum gravity inputs, we prove spectral convergence for critical spherical FK–Ising maps to Liouville Brownian motion on the ordinary unit-area $`\sqrt3`$-quantum sphere.
sentences.zh: 利用关于共形和度量测度的姊妹论文结果，以及文中陈述的布朗运动/Liouville 量子引力输入结果，我们证明了临界球面 FK–Ising 地图到通常的单位面积 $`\sqrt3`$-量子球面上的 Liouville 布朗运动的谱收敛。

sentences.en: The discrete walk has total attempt rate one, uses every map edge including loops and multiplicities, and has the corner measure as its stationary law.
sentences.zh: 离散游走的总尝试速率为一，使用地图的每条边，包括自环并计入重数，且以角测度作为平稳分布。

sentences.en: Accelerating time by the number of map edges gives joint convergence of the metric-measure space, all ordered eigenvalues with multiplicities and padding, and the heat trace locally uniformly at strictly positive times.
sentences.zh: 将时间加速地图边数倍，可得到度量测度空间、计入重数并作补齐的全部有序特征值，以及热迹的联合收敛，其中热迹在严格正的时间上局部一致收敛。

sentences.en: The conductivity and clock constant are one in these conventions.
sentences.zh: 在这些约定下，电导率和时钟常数均为一。

sentences.en: We prove that stationary random walk on a planar map sampled with weight equal to its number of spanning trees converges to Liouville Brownian motion on the unit-area $`\sqrt2`$-Liouville quantum sphere.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了以生成树数目为权重抽取的平面地图上的平稳随机游走，收敛于单位面积 $`\sqrt2`$-Liouville 量子球面上的 Liouville 布朗运动。

sentences.en: The convergence retains the conditional path law jointly with the measured metric space.
sentences.zh: 该收敛联合保留条件路径分布与带测度的度量空间。

sentences.en: The walk chooses uniformly among all incident half-edges and starts from the stationary degree measure.
sentences.zh: 该游走从所有关联的半边中均匀选取，并从平稳的度数测度出发。

sentences.en: For total attempt rate one and the continuum Dirichlet form with factor 1/2, the time acceleration is exactly the number of map edges.
sentences.zh: 当总尝试速率为一，且连续 Dirichlet 型带有因子 1/2 时，时间加速因子恰好等于地图的边数。

sentences.en: The result uses the companion contour and metric limits for this same ensemble.
sentences.zh: 该结果使用了同一系综在姊妹论文中的轮廓极限和度量极限。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`0\lt q\lt 4`$, we prove joint convergence of spherical Fortuin–Kasteleyn planar maps in their flag-triangle uniformization to the corresponding unit-area Liouville quantum gravity sphere decorated by an independent conformal loop ensemble.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`0\lt q\lt 4`$，我们证明了球面 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 平面地图在其 flag 三角形单值化下，联合收敛于由一个独立共形环系综装饰的相应单位面积 Liouville 量子引力球面。

sentences.en: The convergence includes the area measure, deterministically rescaled graph distances between all vertex pairs, and the full nested interface collection, with interfaces converging uniformly up to reparameterization.
sentences.zh: 该收敛包括面积测度、经确定性重标度的所有顶点对之间的图距离，以及完整的嵌套界面族，其中界面在允许重新参数化的意义下一致收敛。

sentences.en: We construct the field and area law of the unit-area critical Liouville quantum sphere as a limit of ordinary subcritical quantum spheres, and equip it with its critical intrinsic metric.
sentences.zh: 我们将单位面积临界 Liouville 量子球面的场与面积分布构造为通常的次临界量子球面的极限，并为其赋予临界内蕴度量。

sentences.en: We then prove that spherical Fortuin–Kasteleyn planar maps at q = 4, embedded by their equilateral flag uniformizations, converge jointly to this sphere decorated by an independent nested conformal loop ensemble CLE4.
sentences.zh: 随后我们证明，通过等边 flag 单值化嵌入的 q = 4 时的球面 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 平面地图，联合收敛于由独立嵌套共形环系综 CLE4 装饰的这个球面。

sentences.en: With deterministic distance normalization, the convergence includes the area measure, the full embedded distance function, and every macroscopic interface through all positive integer edge counts.
sentences.zh: 在确定性距离归一化下，该收敛包括面积测度、完整的嵌入距离函数以及每个宏观界面，并沿所有正整数边数成立。

sentences.en: We resolve the finite spherical cases of Gwynne and Miller's graph-metric conjecture for critical Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps at each fixed $`q\in(0,4)`$ and for uniform spanning-tree-decorated maps.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了 Gwynne 和 Miller 的图度量猜想在每个固定 $`q\in(0,4)`$ 时的临界 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 地图以及均匀生成树装饰地图的有限球面情形。

sentences.en: After deterministic rescaling of graph distances, these maps, equipped with the vertex probability measure proportional to degree, converge in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law to their ordinary unit-area Liouville quantum gravity spheres.
sentences.zh: 对图距离作确定性重标度后，这些配备了与度数成正比的顶点概率测度的地图，在 Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov 意义下依分布收敛于各自通常的单位面积 Liouville 量子引力球面。

sentences.en: Distances use every primal edge, and convergence holds through all positive integer edge counts.
sentences.zh: 距离使用原图的每条边，且该收敛沿所有正整数边数成立。

sentences.en: We prove the finite-volume continuum-random-tree prediction for critical Fortuin–Kasteleyn planar maps at every fixed q > 4.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 q > 4，我们证明了临界 Fortuin–Kasteleyn 平面地图的有限体积连续随机树预测。

sentences.en: After rescaling graph distances by a constant times n−1/2, an n-edge map with normalized degree measure converges to the Brownian continuum random tree in the Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov topology.
sentences.zh: 将图距离乘以一个常数再乘以 n−1/2 进行重标度后，带有归一化度数测度的 n 条边的地图在 Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov 拓扑下收敛于布朗连续随机树。

sentences.en: The convergence holds through all positive integer sizes.
sentences.zh: 该收敛沿所有正整数规模成立。

sentences.en: We prove that planar first-passage percolation with independent identically distributed nonnegative nonatomic edge weights has almost surely no doubly infinite geodesic, provided the minimum of four independent weights has finite second moment.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，若平面首达渗流的边权独立同分布、非负且无原子，并且四个独立边权的最小值具有有限二阶矩，则几乎必然不存在双向无穷测地线。

sentences.en: This resolves the planar no-bigeodesics conjecture under that moment assumption.
sentences.zh: 这在该矩条件下解决了平面情形不存在双向无穷测地线的猜想。

sentences.en: The conclusion rules out all bigeodesics simultaneously, without any regularity assumption on the limit shape.
sentences.zh: 该结论同时排除了所有双向无穷测地线，而无需对极限形状作任何正则性假设。

sentences.en: We prove that the limit shape of undirected nearest-neighbor first-passage percolation on ℤ2 with independent exponential edge weights is strictly convex and has a C1 boundary.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，在边权为独立指数随机变量的 ℤ2 上，无向最近邻首达渗流的极限形状严格凸，并具有 C1 边界。

sentences.en: This resolves the strict convexity and differentiability conjectures for the planar exponential model.
sentences.zh: 这解决了平面指数模型的严格凸性和可微性猜想。

sentences.en: More generally, we prove differentiability of the time-constant norm for every Gamma edge-weight law with positive shape and rate.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于每个形状参数和速率参数均为正的 Gamma 边权分布，我们证明了时间常数范数的可微性。

sentences.en: We prove that nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond and site percolation on ℤ<sup>3</sup> have no infinite cluster at their respective critical parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 ℤ<sup>3</sup> 上的最近邻 Bernoulli 键渗流和点渗流在各自的临界参数处都不存在无穷簇。

sentences.en: The proof combines a finite connection inequality for independent hyperedges with a finite-scale extension estimate and an adaptive exploration.
sentences.zh: 证明将独立超边的有限连接不等式、有限尺度的延拓估计与自适应探索相结合。

sentences.en: We prove that critical Bernoulli bond percolation has no infinite cluster on any infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph with critical probability less than one.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，在任何临界概率小于一的无穷、连通、局部有限的准传递图上，临界 Bernoulli 键渗流都不存在无穷簇。

sentences.en: This resolves the bond form of the criticality conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Benjamini 和 Schramm 的临界性猜想的键渗流形式。

sentences.en: We prove the bond-percolation nonuniqueness conjecture of Benjamini and Schramm: every infinite connected, locally finite, nonamenable quasi-transitive graph has a nonempty interval of parameters for which Bernoulli bond percolation almost surely has infinitely many infinite clusters.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Benjamini 和 Schramm 的键渗流非唯一性猜想：每个无穷、连通、局部有限、非可均的准传递图都存在一个非空参数区间，使得 Bernoulli 键渗流几乎必然有无穷多个无穷簇。

sentences.en: We also prove Hutchcroft's stronger operator-threshold conjecture, establishing $`p_c\lt p_{2\to2}\le p_u`$.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了 Hutchcroft 更强的算子阈值猜想，建立了 $`p_c\lt p_{2\to2}\le p_u`$。

sentences.en: We construct a canonical interacting massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional nearest-neighbor $`O(3)`$ model with unit-length spins, no external field, and no topological term.
sentences.zh: 对于自旋长度为一、无外场且无拓扑项的二维最近邻 $`O(3)`$ 模型，我们构造了一个典范的、具有相互作用的有质量连续极限。

sentences.en: Normalized by susceptibility and second-moment correlation length, the limit exists as the bare coupling tends to infinity through all positive real values, without selecting subsequences.
sentences.zh: 以磁化率和二阶矩关联长度归一化后，当裸耦合沿所有正实数值趋于无穷时，该极限存在，无需选取子列。

sentences.en: The limiting fields satisfy the Osterwalder–Schrader axioms and have a nonzero connected four-point correlation on separated time supports.
sentences.zh: 极限场满足 Osterwalder–Schrader 公理，且在彼此分离的时间支撑上具有非零的连通四点关联。

sentences.en: Their reconstructed theory has a unique vacuum, a nonzero vacuum complement, and a positive Hamiltonian gap on that entire complement.
sentences.zh: 由它们重构的理论具有唯一真空、非零的真空补空间，以及在整个补空间上的正 Hamilton 算子谱隙。

sentences.en: We consider the continuum spin field constructed from the nearest-neighbor two-dimensional $`O(3)`$ model by the fixed prescription of the companion paper.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑按照姊妹论文的固定方案从二维最近邻 $`O(3)`$ 模型构造的连续自旋场。

sentences.en: We prove that its vector two-point spectral measure has a positive atom corresponding to the lowest mass, separated by a positive gap from all remaining mass support.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，其向量二点谱测度具有一个权重为正且对应于最低质量的原子，且该原子与其余所有质量支撑之间相隔一个正间隙。

sentences.en: For the nearest-neighbor $`O(4)`$ model on the square lattice at inverse temperature β, we prove the exact low-temperature asymptotic $`\displaystyle m_{\mathrm{lat}}(\beta)\sim 32\exp(\pi/4-1/2)\sqrt\beta\,\exp(-\pi\beta) \qquad (\beta\to\infty).`$
sentences.zh: 对于逆温度为 β 的方格上的最近邻 $`O(4)`$ 模型，我们证明了精确的低温渐近式 $`\displaystyle m_{\mathrm{lat}}(\beta)\sim 32\exp(\pi/4-1/2)\sqrt\beta\,\exp(-\pi\beta) \qquad (\beta\to\infty).`$

sentences.en: Here the mass is the gap of the full Osterwalder–Schrader transfer operator, including rotation-invariant local-observable sectors, in units of one original lattice time step.
sentences.zh: 其中，质量是完整 Osterwalder–Schrader 转移算子的谱隙，包括旋转不变的局部可观测量扇区，并以原始晶格的一个时间步为单位。

sentences.en: We prove sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional nearest-neighbor $`O(4)`$ model.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了二维最近邻 $`O(4)`$ 模型的最优质量界。

sentences.en: For all sufficiently large inverse couplings β, the full transfer gap, including rotation-invariant local-observable sectors, is bounded above and below by positive multiples of $`\sqrt\beta e^{-\pi\beta}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于所有充分大的逆耦合常数 β，包括旋转不变的局部可观测量扇区在内的完整转移谱隙，其上下界均为 $`\sqrt\beta e^{-\pi\beta}`$ 的正常数倍。

sentences.en: We also prove that the model has a unique periodic local limit and a positive full gap at every finite β > 0, resolving the all-temperature lattice mass-generation conjecture for this periodic state.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了，该模型在每个有限的 β > 0 处都具有唯一的周期局部极限和正的完整谱隙，从而解决了这一周期态的全温度晶格质量生成猜想。

sentences.en: Under the stated cutoff scaling, the mass bounds are uniform in independently fixed physical units.
sentences.zh: 在所述截断标度下，这些质量界在独立固定的物理单位中是一致的。

sentences.en: A continuum spectral interpretation requires separate convergence hypotheses for the transfer semigroup and the block observables.
sentences.zh: 连续极限的谱解释需要另外对转移半群和块可观测量作收敛假设。

sentences.en: We prove exponential decay of two-point correlations for the classical nearest-neighbor $`O(n)`$ model on the square lattice, for every n ≥ 3 and every finite positive inverse temperature.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 n ≥ 3 和每个有限正逆温度，我们证明了方格上的经典最近邻 $`O(n)`$ 模型的二点关联指数衰减。

sentences.en: The estimate is uniform over finite free-boundary subgraphs and bounded nonnegative edge strengths.
sentences.zh: 该估计对于有限自由边界子图和有界非负边强度是一致的。

sentences.en: This resolves positively the all-temperature exponential spin-decay conjecture for these models.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了这些模型的全温度自旋指数衰减猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the critical logarithmic correction for the nearest-neighbor cosine XY model on the square lattice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了方格上最近邻余弦 XY 模型的临界对数修正。

sentences.en: Let $`C_{b_c}(r)`$ be the two-point correlation at critical inverse temperature, obtained by taking the free-box thermodynamic limit while the two sites remain r lattice steps apart along a coordinate axis.
sentences.zh: 令 $`C_{b_c}(r)`$ 为临界逆温度处的二点关联，它通过取自由边界方盒的热力学极限得到，而两个格点沿某个坐标轴始终相隔 r 个晶格步长。

sentences.en:
Then

$`\displaystyle C_{b_c}(r)=B_{\mathrm{XY}}r^{-1/4}(\log r)^{1/8}(1+o(1)), \qquad B_{\mathrm{XY}}\in(0,\infty),`$

as $`r\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 则当 $`r\to\infty`$ 时，有 $`\displaystyle C_{b_c}(r)=B_{\mathrm{XY}}r^{-1/4}(\log r)^{1/8}(1+o(1)), \qquad B_{\mathrm{XY}}\in(0,\infty),`$。

sentences.en: Assuming the stated critical-height, local-renormalization, and spin-field inputs from the companion papers, we determine the center magnetization of the planar XY model in a square with aligned boundary spins at its mass-defined critical threshold.
sentences.zh: 假设姊妹论文中所述的临界高度、局部重整化和自旋场输入结果成立，我们确定了平面 XY 模型在由质量定义的临界阈值处，在边界自旋对齐的正方形中的中心磁化强度。

sentences.en: As $`n\to\infty`$, the magnetization is $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}n^{-1/8}(\log n)^{1/16}(1+o(1))`$, where $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}`$ is a finite, strictly positive model-specific constant.
sentences.zh: 当 $`n\to\infty`$ 时，磁化强度为 $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}n^{-1/8}(\log n)^{1/16}(1+o(1))`$，其中 $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}`$ 是依赖于具体模型的有限严格正常数。

sentences.en: Using the companion critical Bessel-height and pin-limit theorems, we prove that at the mass-defined critical inverse temperature of the nearest-neighbor XY model on the square lattice, the spin field on a square with boundary angles fixed to zero converges along the full sequence to the full-variance imaginary exponential of a zero-Dirichlet Gaussian free field with stiffness $`2/\pi`$.
sentences.zh: 利用姊妹论文中的临界 Bessel 高度定理和钉扎极限定理，我们证明了，在方格上最近邻 XY 模型的由质量定义的临界逆温度处，边界角固定为零的正方形上的自旋场沿整个序列收敛于刚度为 $`2/\pi`$ 的零 Dirichlet 高斯自由场的全方差虚指数。

sentences.en: The normalization uses the exact center magnetization and the lattice Green-function factor.
sentences.zh: 归一化使用精确的中心磁化强度和晶格 Green 函数因子。

sentences.en: Convergence holds in law in $`H^{-3}_{\mathrm{loc}}((-1,1)^2)`$; all mixed moments and joint laws of fields smeared against smooth compactly supported test functions in $`(-1,1)^2`$ converge as well.
sentences.zh: 该收敛在 $`H^{-3}_{\mathrm{loc}}((-1,1)^2)`$ 中依分布成立；将场与 $`(-1,1)^2`$ 中的光滑紧支撑测试函数配对后，所有混合矩和联合分布也都收敛。

sentences.en: We prove the Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless essential singularity for the correlation length of the nearest-neighbor cosine XY model on the square lattice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了方格上最近邻余弦 XY 模型关联长度的 Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless 本性奇点。

sentences.en: Let $`m(b)`$ be the mass obtained by taking first the free-box thermodynamic limit and then the separation limit along a coordinate axis.
sentences.zh: 令 $`m(b)`$ 为先取自由边界方盒的热力学极限，再沿某个坐标轴取间距极限所得到的质量。

sentences.en: As the inverse temperature b approaches bc from the massive side, $`\displaystyle \sqrt{b_c-b}\log\frac{1}{m(b)} \longrightarrow A_{\mathrm{XY}},`$ where $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}`$ is a finite, strictly positive model-specific constant.
sentences.zh: 当逆温度 b 从有质量一侧趋近 bc 时，有 $`\displaystyle \sqrt{b_c-b}\log\frac{1}{m(b)} \longrightarrow A_{\mathrm{XY}},`$，其中 $`A_{\mathrm{XY}}`$ 是依赖于具体模型的有限严格正常数。

sentences.en: For the ordinary nearest-neighbor XY model on the square lattice, we prove the Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless prediction that the critical spin-correlation exponent is 1/4.
sentences.zh: 对于方格上的通常最近邻 XY 模型，我们证明了临界自旋关联指数为 1/4 的 Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless 预测。

sentences.en: More precisely, at the mass-defined critical inverse temperature, the infinite-volume correlation is $`n^{-1/4+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，在由质量定义的临界逆温度处，无限体积关联为 $`n^{-1/4+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: The infinite-volume limit through free square boxes is taken before the separation limit.
sentences.zh: 先沿自由边界正方盒取无限体积极限，再取间距极限。

sentences.en: We prove Gaussian scaling limits for the two-dimensional discrete Gaussian height model throughout its rough phase, including the physical roughening threshold, for every finite square-symmetric interaction set containing the nearest neighbors.
sentences.zh: 对于每个包含最近邻且具有正方形对称性的有限相互作用集合，我们证明了二维离散高斯高度模型在整个粗糙相内的高斯标度极限，包括物理粗糙化阈值处。

sentences.en: After the natural lattice normalization, the critical effective temperature has the universal value $`8\pi`$.
sentences.zh: 在自然的晶格归一化之后，临界有效温度具有普适值 $`8\pi`$。

sentences.en: For the ordinary nearest-neighbor Villain and XY models at sufficiently low fixed temperatures, we also prove that their Green-function-normalized spin fields converge to the imaginary exponential of a Dirichlet Gaussian free field.
sentences.zh: 对于处在充分低的固定温度下的通常最近邻 Villain 和 XY 模型，我们还证明了，它们经 Green 函数归一化的自旋场收敛于 Dirichlet 高斯自由场的虚指数。

sentences.en: For every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove that the zero-field Gaussian Ising Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free energy, centered by its expectation and divided by its standard deviation, converges in distribution to a nondegenerate law as the system size tends to infinity through all integers.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 β > 1，我们证明了零场高斯 Ising Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 自由能减去其期望再除以其标准差后，在系统规模沿所有整数趋于无穷时依分布收敛于一个非退化分布。

sentences.en: We also prove that its variance divided by n1/3 converges to a finite positive constant.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了，其方差除以 n1/3 后收敛于一个有限正常数。

sentences.en: For the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove that the standard deviation of the log partition function is $`n^{1/6+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 β > 1 下的零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型，我们证明了对数配分函数的标准差为 $`n^{1/6+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: The same exponent describes its typical centered absolute fluctuations, establishing the predicted one-sixth exponent in this regime.
sentences.zh: 同一指数也描述了其典型的中心化绝对涨落，从而确立了这一区域内所预测的六分之一指数。

sentences.en: For the planar Ising model with bonds $`J_e=1+\varepsilon\xi_e`$, where the ξe have any fixed bounded, nondegenerate, mean-zero iid law, we prove quenched chordal SLE3 convergence for sufficiently small ε > 0.
sentences.zh: 对于键为 $`J_e=1+\varepsilon\xi_e`$ 的平面 Ising 模型，其中 ξe 独立同分布，且共同分布为任意固定的有界、非退化、均值为零的分布，我们证明了在 ε > 0 充分小时，淬火弦 SLE3 收敛成立。

sentences.en: The temperature is the spontaneous-magnetization threshold.
sentences.zh: 温度取为自发磁化阈值。

sentences.en: Convergence holds in probability over environments for the full oriented curve law in deterministic Jordan-domain approximations.
sentences.zh: 在确定性的 Jordan 区域逼近中，完整有向曲线分布的收敛对环境依概率成立。

sentences.en: We prove quenched chordal SLE<sub>3</sub> convergence for the planar Ising model with sufficiently weak independent symmetric two-valued ferromagnetic bonds.
sentences.zh: 对于具有充分弱的独立、对称、二值铁磁键的平面 Ising 模型，我们证明了淬火弦 SLE<sub>3</sub> 收敛。

sentences.en: The temperature is the critical point defined by spontaneous magnetization.
sentences.zh: 温度取为由自发磁化定义的临界点。

sentences.en: Convergence holds in probability over environments for the full oriented curve law in deterministic Jordan-domain approximations.
sentences.zh: 在确定性的 Jordan 区域逼近中，完整有向曲线分布的收敛对环境依概率成立。

sentences.en: Assuming the stated deterministic critical-reference estimates, we prove that the relative second moment of the quenched critical spin correlation in the square-lattice Ising model with independent fair bonds $`1\pm\varepsilon`$ grows as $`(\log r)^{1/4+o(1)}`$ for each sufficiently small fixed ε > 0.
sentences.zh: 假设所述的确定性临界参照估计成立，我们证明了，对于每个充分小的固定 ε > 0，具有独立等概率键 $`1\pm\varepsilon`$ 的方格 Ising 模型中，淬火临界自旋关联的相对二阶矩按 $`(\log r)^{1/4+o(1)}`$ 增长。

sentences.en: The correlation is evaluated at the physical critical temperature, with the thermodynamic limit taken before the disorder moments and the large-distance limit.
sentences.zh: 该关联在物理临界温度处计算，并先取热力学极限，再取无序矩和长距离极限。

sentences.en: We prove conformal universality of mixed bulk spin and energy correlations for the square-lattice Ising model with sufficiently small, square-symmetric, finite-range even multispin perturbations of either sign.
sentences.zh: 对于受到充分小、具有正方形对称性、有限程且可取任一符号的偶数自旋多体扰动的方格 Ising 模型，我们证明了体内自旋与能量混合关联的共形普适性。

sentences.en: One critical-temperature branch and two field normalizations apply in every bounded simply connected C2 Jordan domain with free, plus, or minus boundary conditions, and in the periodic thermodynamic plane state.
sentences.zh: 同一个临界温度分支和两个场归一化适用于每个带自由、全正或全负边界条件的有界单连通 C2 Jordan 区域，也适用于周期热力学平面态。

sentences.en: Energies are centered in their actual states.
sentences.zh: 能量在其实际状态下作中心化。

sentences.en: We prove that every sufficiently small, square-symmetric finite-range perturbation of the planar Ising contour energy has a domain-independent inverse temperature at which its spin interface converges to chordal SLE<sub>3</sub>.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，平面 Ising 轮廓能量的每个充分小、具有正方形对称性的有限程扰动，都存在一个与区域无关的逆温度，使其自旋界面收敛于弦 SLE<sub>3</sub>。

sentences.en: The result allows interactions of either sign, arbitrary admissible exterior contours, and uniformly approximated Jordan domains.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许任一符号的相互作用、任意容许的外部轮廓，以及一致逼近的 Jordan 区域。

sentences.en: Convergence holds for the full oriented curve law in uniform distance modulo increasing reparametrization.
sentences.zh: 完整有向曲线分布在模去递增重新参数化的一致距离下收敛。

sentences.en: We prove pointwise comparison and finite stopping-band approximation theorems for the critical nearest-neighbor Ising model on the square lattice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了方格上临界最近邻 Ising 模型的逐点比较定理和有限停止带逼近定理。

sentences.en: Arbitrary common pinned spins are allowed in the comparison: the likelihood ratio is controlled by a zero-field FK connection probability on the graph with those vertices deleted.
sentences.zh: 比较允许任意共同钉扎的自旋：似然比由删去这些顶点后的图上的零场 FK 连接概率控制。

sentences.en: For an interface exploration across a band of fixed positive width, finitely many regular signed barriers approximate every good conditional target law in total variation, uniformly over bounded observables and sufficiently fine meshes.
sentences.zh: 对于穿过固定正宽度带状区域的界面探索，有限多个带符号的正则屏障可在全变差意义下逼近每个良好的条件目标分布，且这种逼近对有界可观测量和充分细的网格是一致的。

sentences.en: For every fixed degree d ≥ 3, we prove fixed-energy GOE universality for the adjacency matrix of a uniformly random simple labelled d-regular graph with independent uniform diagonal disorder.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定度数 d ≥ 3，我们证明了均匀随机的简单有标号 d-正则图的邻接矩阵在加入独立且均匀分布的对角无序后具有固定能量 GOE 普适性。

sentences.en: The disorder strength is positive, sufficiently small, and fixed as the graph grows.
sentences.zh: 无序强度为正且充分小，并在图增长时保持固定。

sentences.en: At each fixed energy in a compact subinterval of the clean spectral band, the full microscopic eigenvalue point process converges to the GOE bulk process after rescaling by the positive density of states of the corresponding infinite-tree operator.
sentences.zh: 对于无序为零时的谱带的某个紧子区间内的每个固定能量，以相应无穷树算子的态密度（其值为正）进行重标度后，完整的微观特征值点过程收敛于 GOE 体内过程。

sentences.en: The permitted disorder strength depends on the degree and the distance from the clean spectral edges.
sentences.zh: 所允许的无序强度依赖于度数以及到无序为零时的谱边缘的距离。

sentences.en: We prove the fixed-degree bulk-universality conjecture for random regular graphs.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了随机正则图的固定度数体内普适性猜想。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3 and every fixed energy in the open Kesten–McKay bulk, the unfolded eigenvalue point process of the adjacency matrix of a uniform simple labelled d-regular graph converges to the GOE bulk process.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 d ≥ 3 以及开 Kesten–McKay 谱体内的每个固定能量，均匀简单有标号 d-正则图的邻接矩阵的展平特征值点过程收敛于 GOE 体内过程。

sentences.en: The convergence holds along all admissible graph sizes, without additional conditioning.
sentences.zh: 该收敛沿所有容许的图规模成立，无需附加条件化。

sentences.en: We prove a directional zero–one law for uniformly elliptic nearest-neighbor random walks in stationary, ergodic, finite-range-dependent environments on ℤd, d ≥ 3.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 ℤd（d ≥ 3）上平稳、遍历、有限程相关环境中的一致椭圆最近邻随机游走的方向零一律。

sentences.en: For every fixed nonzero real direction, the probability of escape in that direction, averaged over the environment, is either zero or one.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的非零实方向，在该方向逃逸的概率对环境平均后要么为零，要么为一。

sentences.en: Finite-range dependence is imposed on the full transition rows: collections of rows at distance greater than a fixed range are independent, including collections indexed by infinite deterministic sets.
sentences.zh: 有限程相关条件施加于完整的转移行：相隔距离超过某个固定范围的行集合彼此独立，包括以无穷确定性集合为指标的行集合。

sentences.en: We prove the directional zero–one conjecture for nearest-neighbor random walks in independent and identically distributed strictly elliptic environments on ℤd, d ≥ 3: the probability of escape in each fixed nonzero real direction is zero or one.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 ℤd（d ≥ 3）上独立同分布的严格椭圆环境中最近邻随机游走的方向零一律猜想：沿每个固定的非零实方向逃逸的概率要么为零，要么为一。

sentences.en: Only strict positivity of the transition probabilities is required; no uniform lower bound or moment assumption is imposed.
sentences.zh: 只要求转移概率严格为正；不施加一致下界或矩假设。

sentences.en: We prove that almost-sure transience in a fixed direction implies a deterministic limiting velocity with positive projection in that direction for nearest-neighbor random walks in independent and identically distributed uniformly elliptic environments on ℤd, d ≥ 2.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，对于 ℤd（d ≥ 2）上独立同分布的一致椭圆环境中的最近邻随机游走，沿某个固定方向几乎必然具有暂态性，蕴含存在一个确定性的极限速度，且该速度在此方向上的投影为正。

sentences.en: This resolves the ballisticity conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了弹道性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the Mézard–Parisi hierarchical cavity formula for diluted even-arity Ising models in the Panchenko–Talagrand class.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Panchenko–Talagrand 类中稀释偶数元 Ising 模型的 Mézard–Parisi 分层空腔公式。

sentences.en: This resolves the variational equality conjecture for that class: the limiting pressure equals the infimum of the trial functional over all finite hierarchy depths and trial laws.
sentences.zh: 这解决了该类模型的变分等式猜想：极限压强等于试探泛函对所有有限层次深度及试探分布取的下确界。

sentences.en: Only first moments of the interaction and external field are required.
sentences.zh: 只要求相互作用和外场具有一阶矩。

sentences.en: We determine the limiting free energy of the Ising perceptron with independent Gaussian patterns for every bounded Borel log-potential, at every fixed positive temperature and pattern density.
sentences.zh: 对于每个有界 Borel 对数势，在每个固定的正温度和正模式密度下，我们确定了具有独立高斯模式的 Ising 感知机的极限自由能。

sentences.en: We give an explicit variational formula for the limit and prove convergence in expectation and probability.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了该极限的显式变分公式，并证明了期望收敛与依概率收敛。

sentences.en: We prove a sharp feasibility threshold and limiting gap and force laws for the spherical perceptron with margin −1 and quadratic penalty.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了间隔为 −1 且采用二次惩罚的球面感知机的可行性的锐阈值（sharp feasibility threshold），以及极限间隙分布和力分布。

sentences.en: The limits are taken successively in system size, inverse temperature, and density approaching the threshold from above.
sentences.zh: 依次对系统规模、逆温度，以及从上方趋近阈值的密度取极限。

sentences.en: They agree for Gaussian coordinates and for the equal mixture of centered Gaussian coordinates with variances $`1-\varepsilon`$ and $`1+\varepsilon`$, for every sufficiently small fixed ε.
sentences.zh: 对于每个充分小的固定 ε，高斯坐标与方差分别为 $`1-\varepsilon`$ 和 $`1+\varepsilon`$ 的零均值高斯坐标的等权混合所得到的这些极限一致。

sentences.en:
The contact-removed gap cumulative law and the mean-one force cumulative law satisfy

$`\displaystyle G_J(u)=u^{1-\gamma+o(1)},\qquad F_J(s)=s^{1+\theta+o(1)},`$

as $`u\downarrow0`$ and $`s\downarrow0`$, with $`\gamma=(2+\theta)^{-1}`$, $`0.4126930\lt \gamma\lt 0.4126934`$, and $`0.4231063\lt \theta\lt 0.4231088`$.
sentences.zh: 去除接触部分后的间隙累积分布与均值为一的力累积分布在 $`u\downarrow0`$ 和 $`s\downarrow0`$ 时满足 $`\displaystyle G_J(u)=u^{1-\gamma+o(1)},\qquad F_J(s)=s^{1+\theta+o(1)},`$，其中 $`\gamma=(2+\theta)^{-1}`$、$`0.4126930\lt \gamma\lt 0.4126934`$ 且 $`0.4231063\lt \theta\lt 0.4231088`$。

sentences.en: A finite numerical certificate for these exponent intervals, together with its mathematical error bounds, is included.
sentences.zh: 文中包含这些指数区间的一个有限数值证书及其数学误差界。

sentences.en: We determine the limiting free energy of a spherical perceptron with a bounded continuous activation and a bi-orthogonally invariant disorder matrix.
sentences.zh: 我们确定了具有有界连续激活函数和双正交不变无序矩阵的球面感知机的极限自由能。

sentences.en: The singular values may have any compact limiting distribution, provided there are no outliers.
sentences.zh: 只要不存在离群值，奇异值可以具有任意紧支撑极限分布。

sentences.en: We give an explicit variational formula for this limit.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了这一极限的显式变分公式。

sentences.en: We prove an exact variational formula for the limiting pressure of the spherical random perceptron with an arbitrary bounded continuous single-pattern potential.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有任意有界连续单模式势的球面随机感知机的极限压强的精确变分公式。

sentences.en: The formula holds at every fixed positive density and inverse temperature, with convergence in expectation and in probability.
sentences.zh: 该公式对每个固定正密度和正逆温度成立，且收敛在期望意义和依概率意义下成立。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`1\le q\lt 4`$, critical square-lattice random-cluster Dobrushin interfaces converge as ordered curves to chordal $`\mathop{\mathrm{SLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$, where $`\kappa(q)=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$, confirming the Rohde–Schramm prediction in this parameter range.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`1\le q\lt 4`$，临界方格随机簇 Dobrushin 界面作为有序曲线收敛于弦 $`\mathop{\mathrm{SLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$，其中 $`\kappa(q)=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$，从而证实了这一参数范围内的 Rohde–Schramm 预测。

sentences.en: This holds in every bounded Jordan domain under uniform marked boundary approximation.
sentences.zh: 这在每个有界 Jordan 区域中，在带标记边界的一致逼近下成立。

sentences.en: The complete nested plane loop collections converge to whole-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{CLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$ in a spherical matching topology retaining multiplicities and traversals.
sentences.zh: 完整的嵌套平面环族在保留重数和遍历方式的球面匹配拓扑中收敛于全平面 $`\mathop{\mathrm{CLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$。

sentences.en: At q = 1 we obtain Cardy's formula for square-lattice bond percolation with free boundary edges.
sentences.zh: 当 q = 1 时，我们得到了具有自由边界边的方格键渗流的 Cardy 公式。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`0\lt q\lt 1`$, we prove that the Dobrushin interface of the square-lattice random-cluster model at its self-dual parameter converges to chordal SLEκ, where $`\kappa=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)\in(6,8)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`0\lt q\lt 1`$，我们证明了方格随机簇模型在其自对偶参数处的 Dobrushin 界面收敛于弦 SLEκ，其中 $`\kappa=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)\in(6,8)`$。

sentences.en: The approximating domains are simple closed nearest-neighbor lattice polygons with distinct marked vertices, whose marked boundary parametrizations converge uniformly to those of a bounded smooth Jordan domain.
sentences.zh: 逼近区域是带有不同标记顶点的简单闭合最近邻晶格多边形，其带标记边界参数化一致收敛于某个有界光滑 Jordan 区域的相应参数化。

sentences.en: Convergence holds along the full mesh sequence in the uniform metric on oriented curves modulo increasing reparametrization.
sentences.zh: 沿整个网格序列，收敛在模去递增重新参数化的有向曲线一致度量中成立。

sentences.en: The proof combines finite connection comparisons below one, localization in irregular tiled disks, and a boundary observable that determines the limiting Loewner driver.
sentences.zh: 证明结合了参数小于一时的有限连接比较、不规则铺砌圆盘中的局部化，以及一个确定极限 Loewner 驱动函数的边界可观测量。

sentences.en: We prove that critical FK–Ising interfaces with sufficiently weak, symmetric, independent two-valued bond disorder converge to chordal SLE<sub>16/3</sub>.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，具有充分弱的、对称的、独立二值键无序的临界 FK–Ising 界面收敛于弦 SLE<sub>16/3</sub>。

sentences.en: The disorder strength is fixed as the mesh tends to zero, and convergence of the conditional curve laws holds in probability over the environment.
sentences.zh: 网格尺度趋于零时，无序强度保持固定，且条件曲线分布的收敛对环境依概率成立。

sentences.en: We prove convergence of thermal FK–Ising interfaces, for every fixed nonzero mass of either sign, on uniformly angle-bounded isoradial lattices in bounded simply connected domains.
sentences.zh: 对于任一符号的每个固定非零质量，我们证明了有界单连通区域中满足一致角度界条件（uniformly angle-bounded）的等半径晶格上的热 FK–Ising 界面的收敛。

sentences.en: The limit is independent of the lattice and the admissible domain approximation.
sentences.zh: 该极限与晶格及容许的区域逼近无关。

sentences.en: For positive mass it is the unique massive SLE$`_{16/3}`$ law with locally finite-energy drift prescribed by a massive boundary value problem; negative mass follows by duality and reversal.
sentences.zh: 对于正质量，它是唯一的有质量 SLE$`_{16/3}`$ 分布，其局部有限能量漂移由一个有质量边值问题指定；负质量情形由对偶性和反向得到。

sentences.en: The theorem also allows Carathéodory approximations whose diameters diverge.
sentences.zh: 该定理还允许直径发散的 Carathéodory 逼近。

sentences.en: We prove that the rescaled counting measure of a critical square-lattice Fortuin–Kasteleyn Dobrushin interface in the unit square converges to the Minkowski-content measure of its Schramm–Loewner limit, for every fixed cluster weight $`1\le q\lt 4`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定簇权重 $`1\le q\lt 4`$，我们证明了单位正方形中临界方格 Fortuin–Kasteleyn Dobrushin 界面的重标度计数测度，收敛于其 Schramm–Loewner 极限的 Minkowski 含量测度。

sentences.en: A single deterministic constant times the predicted power of the mesh gives the normalization.
sentences.zh: 用同一个确定性常数乘以网格尺度的所预测幂次，便得到归一化因子。

sentences.en: Convergence is joint with the ordered curve and includes the total mass, giving the scaling limit of the interface's total number of steps.
sentences.zh: 该收敛与有序曲线的收敛联合成立，并包括总质量，从而给出界面总步数的标度极限。

sentences.en: For every fixed $`1\le q\le4`$, critical square-lattice random-cluster Dobrushin interfaces converge to chordal $`\mathop{\mathrm{SLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$, where $`\kappa(q)=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$, and the complete nested plane loop collections converge to whole-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{CLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`1\le q\le4`$，临界方格随机簇 Dobrushin 界面收敛于弦 $`\mathop{\mathrm{SLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$，其中 $`\kappa(q)=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$，而完整的嵌套平面环族收敛于全平面 $`\mathop{\mathrm{CLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$。

sentences.en: The results hold under uniform marked Jordan boundary approximation and retain loop multiplicities and traversals.
sentences.zh: 这些结果在带标记 Jordan 边界的一致逼近下成立，并保留环的重数和遍历方式。

sentences.en: At q = 1 we obtain Cardy's formula for square-lattice bond percolation with free boundary edges.
sentences.zh: 当 q = 1 时，我们得到了具有自由边界边的方格键渗流的 Cardy 公式。

sentences.en: Taking Cardy's crossing formula for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation as an input, we prove a universal joint limit for the near-critical crossing thresholds of rational polygonal quadrilaterals under the monotone coupling.
sentences.zh: 以临界 Poisson–Voronoi 渗流的 Cardy 穿越公式作为输入结果，我们证明了在单调耦合下，有理多边形四边区域的近临界穿越阈值存在普适联合极限。

sentences.en: Conditional on the Poisson tessellation, the threshold law converges in probability over tessellations to the same law as on the triangular lattice.
sentences.zh: 以 Poisson 剖分为条件，阈值分布对剖分依概率收敛于与三角格情形相同的分布。

sentences.en: Each model is normalized by its own expected number of color-pivotal sites for a unit-square crossing.
sentences.zh: 每个模型均以其自身单位正方形穿越事件的颜色枢纽点数的期望进行归一化。

sentences.en: Taking Cardy's conformal crossing formula for critical planar Poisson–Voronoi percolation in every bounded Jordan quadrilateral as an input, we prove that the expected number of color-pivotal cells for a unit-square crossing is asymptotic to a positive constant times $`\varepsilon ^{-3/4}`$, where the point intensity is $`\varepsilon ^{-2}`$.
sentences.zh: 以每个有界 Jordan 四边形中临界平面 Poisson–Voronoi 渗流的 Cardy 共形穿越公式作为输入结果，我们证明了单位正方形穿越事件的颜色枢纽胞腔数的期望，渐近等于一个正常数乘以 $`\varepsilon ^{-3/4}`$，其中点强度为 $`\varepsilon ^{-2}`$。

sentences.en: No rate of convergence in Cardy's formula is required.
sentences.zh: 不要求 Cardy 公式中的收敛具有任何速率。

sentences.en: We prove Cardy's formula for annealed crossing probabilities in critical planar Poisson–Voronoi percolation in every bounded Jordan quadrilateral.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个有界 Jordan 四边形中临界平面 Poisson–Voronoi 渗流的退火穿越概率满足 Cardy 公式。

sentences.en: This proves the annealed crossing-probability form of the conformal-invariance conjecture for this model.
sentences.zh: 这证明了该模型共形不变性猜想的退火穿越概率形式。

sentences.en: We prove that the height function of the square-lattice six-vertex model with weights $`a=b=1`$ and $`0\lt c\le2`$, in the plane state obtained from balanced tori, converges to a multiple of the Gaussian free field.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，权重为 $`a=b=1`$ 和 $`0\lt c\le2`$ 的方格六顶点模型，在由平衡环面得到的平面态中，其高度函数收敛于高斯自由场的一个倍数。

sentences.en: For unit height jumps and Green kernel $`-(2\pi)^{-1}\log|x-y|`$, the squared multiplier is $`1/\arcsin(c/2)`$.
sentences.zh: 当高度跳跃为单位长度且 Green 核为 $`-(2\pi)^{-1}\log|x-y|`$ 时，该倍数的平方为 $`1/\arcsin(c/2)`$。

sentences.en: We prove that the complete double-dimer loop ensemble for the Temperleyan square lattice in the upper half-plane converges to nested CLE<sub>4</sub>.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了上半平面中 Temperleyan 方格的完整双二聚体环系综收敛于嵌套 CLE<sub>4</sub>。

sentences.en: The convergence holds along the full mesh limit and matches every macroscopic loop as an unparametrized curve.
sentences.zh: 该收敛沿完整的网格极限成立，并将每个宏观环作为无参数曲线进行匹配。

sentences.en: This resolves the half-plane Temperleyan form of the double-dimer CLE<sub>4</sub> scaling-limit conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了双二聚体 CLE<sub>4</sub> 标度极限猜想的半平面 Temperleyan 形式。

sentences.en: We prove joint functional convergence of the stationary and quench autocorrelations of zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics at inverse temperature β = 1, with the same random limit for Gaussian and Rademacher couplings.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了逆温度 β = 1 下零场 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 热浴动力学的平稳自相关与骤冷自相关的联合函数收敛，其中高斯耦合和 Rademacher 耦合具有相同的随机极限。

sentences.en: Each site has a rate-one clock, mean spin autocorrelations are multiplied by n1/3, and waiting times and lags are measured in units n2/3.
sentences.zh: 每个格点配有速率为一的时钟，平均自旋自相关乘以 n1/3，而等待时间和滞后时间以 n2/3 为单位度量。

sentences.en: The quench starts from independent fair spins, and convergence is uniform on compact sets of positive waiting times and lags.
sentences.zh: 骤冷从独立等概率自旋出发，且收敛在正等待时间和正滞后时间的紧集上一致成立。

sentences.en: The quench limit is selected by these initial states and relaxes to the stationary limiting autocorrelation as the waiting time tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 骤冷极限由这些初态选定，并在等待时间趋于无穷时弛豫至平稳极限自相关。

sentences.en: We prove that the stationary spin autocorrelation of the zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at inverse temperature β = 1 has a common functional scaling limit for Gaussian and Rademacher couplings.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，在逆温度 β = 1 处，零场 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型的平稳自旋自相关对于高斯耦合与 Rademacher 耦合具有共同的函数标度极限。

sentences.en: With rate-one heat-bath clocks at every site, time is scaled by n2/3 and the mean spin autocorrelation is multiplied by n1/3.
sentences.zh: 当每个格点的热浴时钟速率为一时，时间按 n2/3 缩放，而平均自旋自相关乘以 n1/3。

sentences.en: The functions converge in law uniformly on compact positive-time intervals.
sentences.zh: 这些函数在正时间的紧区间上一致收敛的拓扑下依分布收敛。

sentences.en: Their limiting law is not a point mass: it retains sample-to-sample randomness, and its functions decay to zero at large times.
sentences.zh: 它们的极限分布不是单点质量：它保留了样本之间的随机性，且其函数在长时间下衰减至零。

sentences.en: For every fixed inverse temperature $`0\lt \beta\lt 1`$, we prove that the unscaled spectral gap of single-site heat-bath dynamics for the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model is bounded away from zero with probability tending to one over the disorder.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 $`0\lt \beta\lt 1`$，我们证明了，零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型的单点热浴动力学未经缩放的谱隙，以对无序趋于一的概率具有远离零的下界。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the Gibbs law satisfies a dimension-free Poincaré inequality for all functions.
sentences.zh: 等价地，Gibbs 分布对所有函数满足一个与维数无关的 Poincaré 不等式。

sentences.en: We prove worst-case total-variation cutoff for the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics at every fixed inverse temperature $`0\leq\beta\lt 1`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 $`0\leq\beta\lt 1`$，我们证明了零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 热浴动力学在最坏情形下的全变差截断现象。

sentences.en: With rate-one refresh at each spin, the cutoff location is $`\log n/(2\lambda(\beta))`$ for a positive deterministic rate $`\lambda(\beta)`$.
sentences.zh: 当每个自旋以速率一刷新时，截断位置为 $`\log n/(2\lambda(\beta))`$，其中 $`\lambda(\beta)`$ 是一个正的确定性速率。

sentences.en: The location for uniformly chosen single-site update attempts is n times as large.
sentences.zh: 对于均匀选取单点进行更新尝试的情形，截断位置为前者的 n 倍。

sentences.en: Convergence is in probability over the disorder.
sentences.zh: 收敛对无序依概率成立。

sentences.en: At the critical inverse temperature β = 1, we prove slow mixing for zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick heat-bath dynamics from typical equilibrium configurations held fixed as initial states.
sentences.zh: 在临界逆温度 β = 1 处，我们证明了，零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 热浴动力学从固定为初态的典型平衡构型出发时混合缓慢。

sentences.en: For every deterministic sequence $`t_n=o(n^{2/3})`$ in rate-one-per-site time, the Gibbs mass of initial states whose time-tn total-variation distance from equilibrium exceeds 1/4 tends to one in probability over the disorder.
sentences.zh: 对于以每点速率一的时间为单位的每个确定性序列 $`t_n=o(n^{2/3})`$，在时刻 tn 与平衡态的全变差距离超过 1/4 的那些初态，其 Gibbs 质量对无序依概率趋于一。

sentences.en: The same statement holds for every deterministic integer sequence $`k_n=o(n^{5/3})`$ of uniform-site update attempts.
sentences.zh: 同一结论对均匀选点更新尝试次数的每个确定性整数序列 $`k_n=o(n^{5/3})`$ 成立。

sentences.en: At every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove a stretched-exponential obstruction to mixing for the zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model from typical equilibrium configurations held fixed as initial states.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 β > 1，我们证明了，零场 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型从固定为初态的典型平衡构型出发时，存在一个拉伸指数尺度的混合障碍。

sentences.en: The Gibbs mass of states whose total-variation distance from equilibrium at time $`\exp(n^{1/10000})`$ exceeds 1/4 tends to one in probability over the disorder.
sentences.zh: 在时刻 $`\exp(n^{1/10000})`$ 与平衡态的全变差距离超过 1/4 的那些状态，其 Gibbs 质量对无序依概率趋于一。

sentences.en: This holds for rate-one-per-site heat-bath dynamics and after the same stated number of discrete update attempts.
sentences.zh: 这对每点速率一的热浴动力学成立，也对经过所述相同次数的离散更新尝试后的情形成立。

sentences.en: For every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove subexponential mixing for rate-one-per-site heat-bath dynamics in the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model from a typical equilibrium configuration.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定逆温度 β > 1，我们证明了，零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型中每点速率一的热浴动力学从典型平衡构型出发时，在次指数时间内混合。

sentences.en: If one Gibbs-sampled configuration is held fixed as the initial state, its total-variation distance from equilibrium is at most 1/4 by time $`\exp(n^{1-1/40000000})`$, with joint probability tending to one over the disorder and the sampled state.
sentences.zh: 若将按 Gibbs 分布抽取的一个构型固定为初态，则它与平衡态的全变差距离至迟在时刻 $`\exp(n^{1-1/40000000})`$ 降至 1/4 或以下，且这一事件对无序和所抽状态的联合概率趋于一。

sentences.en: At the critical inverse temperature β = 1, we determine the worst-start total-variation mixing exponent for single-site heat-bath dynamics in the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model.
sentences.zh: 在临界逆温度 β = 1 处，我们确定了零场高斯 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型的单点热浴动力学从最坏初态出发时的全变差混合指数。

sentences.en: The mixing time is $`n^{2/3+o(1)}`$ when every site has rate one, or $`n^{5/3+o(1)}`$ attempted uniform-site updates, in probability over the disorder.
sentences.zh: 当每个格点速率为一时，混合时间为 $`n^{2/3+o(1)}`$，或等价地需要 $`n^{5/3+o(1)}`$ 次均匀选点的更新尝试，这些结论对无序依概率成立。
