sentences.en: We construct a stable radial pair potential in three dimensions whose canonical free energy has a strict downward derivative jump at one common finite positive inverse temperature throughout an open interval of positive densities.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个三维稳定径向对势，在一个正密度的开区间内，它的正则系综自由能均在同一个有限正逆温度处具有严格向下的导数跳跃。

sentences.en: The potential has a divergent repulsive core, a nontrivial attractive interval, and an integrable tail satisfying $`\phi(r)=o(r^{-3})`$.
sentences.zh: 该势具有发散的排斥核、一个非平凡吸引区间，以及满足 $`\phi(r)=o(r^{-3})`$ 的可积尾部。

sentences.en: Its free-cube canonical free energy is finite at every positive inverse temperature and density.
sentences.zh: 它的自由边界立方体正则系综自由能在每个正逆温度和正密度处均有限。

sentences.en: We construct a bounded, continuous, stable radial pair potential in three dimensions with $`|\phi(r)|\le Cr^{-3-1/32}`$ for r ≥ 1.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个三维有界、连续、稳定的径向对势，当 r ≥ 1 时满足 $`|\phi(r)|\le Cr^{-3-1/32}`$。

sentences.en: Throughout an open interval of positive densities, its canonical thermodynamic free energy is finite at every positive inverse temperature and has a strict downward derivative jump at one common finite positive inverse temperature.
sentences.zh: 在一个正密度的开区间内，它的正则系综热力学自由能在每个正逆温度处均有限，并在同一个有限正逆温度处具有严格向下的导数跳跃。

sentences.en: We establish the exact Kesten–Stigum reconstruction threshold for the ferromagnetic four-state Potts broadcast model on every regular d-ary tree with d ≥ 2 and every Poisson Galton–Watson tree of mean d > 0.
sentences.zh: 我们对每棵满足 d ≥ 2 的正则 d 叉树，以及每棵均值为 d > 0 的 Poisson Galton–Watson 树，建立了铁磁四态 Potts 广播模型的精确 Kesten–Stigum 重构阈值。

sentences.en: Reconstruction occurs exactly when $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$; we prove nonreconstruction at and below the threshold, including equality.
sentences.zh: 重构恰在 $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$ 时发生；我们证明了在阈值处及其以下均不可重构，包括等号情形。

sentences.en: In the Poisson model the whole tree is observed and the reconstruction advantage is averaged without conditioning on survival.
sentences.zh: 在 Poisson 模型中，整棵树均被观测，且重构优势在不以存活为条件的情况下取平均。

sentences.en: The proof uses reproducible exact-arithmetic verification of polynomial inequalities.
sentences.zh: 证明使用了对多项式不等式的可复现精确算术验证。

sentences.en: For the ferromagnetic four-state broadcast model with $`0\lt \lambda\lt 1`$, we prove that reconstruction on a bounded-degree deterministic rooted tree occurs exactly when its L3 capacity with edge resistances $`\lambda^{-2|e|}`$ is positive.
sentences.zh: 对于满足 $`0\lt \lambda\lt 1`$ 的铁磁四态广播模型，我们证明了，在度数有界的确定性有根树上，重构恰在该树以 $`\lambda^{-2|e|}`$ 为边电阻的 L3 容量为正时发生。

sentences.en: This gives an exact criterion without regularity or growth-rate assumptions on the tree, including at the exponential critical boundary.
sentences.zh: 这给出了一个不要求树满足正则性或增长率假设的精确判据，包括指数临界边界处。

sentences.en: We determine the exact reconstruction threshold for the symmetric three-state broadcast process on every regular b-ary tree, b ≥ 2, and every observed Poisson Galton–Watson tree of mean d > 1.
sentences.zh: 我们确定了对称三态广播过程在每棵正则 b 叉树（b ≥ 2）以及每棵被观测的、均值为 d > 1 的 Poisson Galton–Watson 树上的精确重构阈值。

sentences.en: Reconstruction occurs exactly when $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$, with d = b in the regular model; there is non-reconstruction at equality for either sign of the channel parameter.
sentences.zh: 重构恰在 $`d\lambda^2\gt 1`$ 时发生，其中正则模型中 d = b；对于信道参数的任一符号，等号处均不可重构。

sentences.en: The Poisson advantage is averaged over trees and spins without conditioning on survival.
sentences.zh: Poisson 模型的优势对树和自旋取平均，而不以存活为条件。

sentences.en: This resolves the all-degree three-state regular-tree prediction.
sentences.zh: 这解决了所有度数下的三态正则树预测。

sentences.en: Combining the Poisson theorem with known tree-to-graph and algorithmic results gives the exact weak-recovery threshold for the symmetric three-community sparse stochastic block model with independent uniform labels, fixed within- and between-community rates $`a,b\gt 0`$, and mean degree $`(a+2b)/3\gt 1`$: recovery is possible exactly when $`(a-b)^2\gt 3(a+2b)`$.
sentences.zh: 将 Poisson 定理与已知的从树到图的结果及算法结果相结合，可得对称三社群稀疏随机块模型的精确弱恢复阈值，其中标签独立且均匀，社群内与社群间的速率固定为 $`a,b\gt 0`$，平均度为 $`(a+2b)/3\gt 1`$：恰在 $`(a-b)^2\gt 3(a+2b)`$ 时可实现恢复。

sentences.en: Above this threshold it is achievable in $`O(n\log n)`$ time; at or below it, weak recovery is information-theoretically impossible.
sentences.zh: 高于该阈值时，可在 $`O(n\log n)`$ 时间内实现恢复；在该阈值处或低于该阈值时，弱恢复在信息论意义下不可能。

sentences.en: For each $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$, we construct a deterministic Hausdorff gauge that almost surely assigns positive finite measure to every nontrivial compact positive-time segment of chordal Schramm–Loewner evolution.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$，我们构造了一个确定性的 Hausdorff 规范函数，它几乎必然为弦 Schramm–Loewner 演化的每个非平凡的正时间紧致段赋予正且有限的测度。

sentences.en: This answers Schramm's Hausdorff-measure existence problem in this parameter range.
sentences.zh: 这回答了该参数范围内 Schramm 的 Hausdorff 测度存在性问题。

sentences.en: The entire trace has finite expected gauge measure in each bounded box.
sentences.zh: 整条迹在每个有界盒子中的规范测度具有有限期望。

sentences.en: For each fixed $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$, let $`d=1+\kappa/8`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$，令 $`d=1+\kappa/8`$。

sentences.en: The gauge $`h(r)=r^d(\log\log(1/r))^{(2-d)/2}`$ at sufficiently small radii almost surely gives positive finite Hausdorff measure to every nontrivial positive-time compact segment of chordal SLEκ.
sentences.zh: 在充分小的半径处由 $`h(r)=r^d(\log\log(1/r))^{(2-d)/2}`$ 给出的规范函数 几乎必然为弦 SLEκ 的每个非平凡的正时间紧致段赋予正且有限的 Hausdorff 测度。

sentences.en: This gives an explicit solution to Schramm's Hausdorff-measure problem in this parameter range.
sentences.zh: 这给出了该参数范围内 Schramm 的 Hausdorff 测度问题的显式解答。

sentences.en: The entire trace has finite expected measure in every bounded disk.
sentences.zh: 整条迹在每个有界圆盘中的测度具有有限期望。

sentences.en: The exponent-one iterated-logarithm gauge suggested by Schramm is not sigma-finite on any such segment.
sentences.zh: Schramm 所提出的指数为一的迭代对数规范函数，在任何这样的段上都不产生 sigma-有限测度。

sentences.en: We prove that the free uniform spanning forest is a factor of IID on every infinite connected locally finite simple unweighted graph.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，在每个无穷、连通、局部有限的简单无权图上，自由均匀生成森林都是 IID 的因子。

sentences.en: One Borel rule works for all such graphs and uses no root, answering affirmatively the general factor question for unimodular random graphs.
sentences.zh: 同一个 Borel 规则适用于所有这样的图，且不使用根，从而肯定地回答了幺模随机图的一般因子问题。

sentences.en: We also show that every translation-invariant strongly Rayleigh process indexed by a countable group is a factor of IID, including invariant determinantal processes with Hermitian positive-contraction kernels.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了，以可数群为指标的每个平移不变强 Rayleigh 过程都是 IID 的因子，其中包括具有 Hermitian 正收缩算子核的不变行列式过程。

sentences.en: This group-action conclusion requires no amenability.
sentences.zh: 这一群作用结论不要求 可均性。

sentences.en: We prove a Gaussian free field scaling limit for weighted integer Lipschitz heights on the triangular lattice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三角格上加权整数 Lipschitz 高度的高斯自由场标度极限。

sentences.en: With zero boundary values and a factor x for each edge on which the height changes, the field converges after division by a positive constant depending only on x to the zero-Dirichlet Gaussian free field, for every fixed $`x\in[1/\sqrt2,1]`$.
sentences.zh: 在边界值为零、且每条高度发生变化的边都带有因子 x 的情况下，对于每个固定的 $`x\in[1/\sqrt2,1]`$，该场除以一个仅依赖于 x 的正常数后，收敛于零 Dirichlet 高斯自由场。

sentences.en: The convergence holds as a random distribution on every bounded C2 Jordan domain under inside lattice approximations with uniformly convergent boundary parametrizations.
sentences.zh: 在从内部作晶格逼近且边界参数化一致收敛的条件下，该收敛在每个有界 C2 Jordan 区域上作为随机广义函数成立。

sentences.en: This includes the uniform height model and the predicted critical endpoint.
sentences.zh: 这涵盖了均匀高度模型以及所预测的临界端点。

sentences.en: We prove that the centered uniform odd integer height function on triangular-lattice approximations of a smooth simply connected domain, with neighboring differences zero or two and boundary values +1 and −1 on two arcs, converges to a universal multiple of the Dirichlet Gaussian free field.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了，在光滑单连通区域的三角格逼近上，相邻高度之差为零或二、两段边界弧上的边界值分别为 +1 和 −1 的均匀奇整数高度函数，在中心化后收敛于 Dirichlet 高斯自由场的一个普适倍数。

sentences.en: This resolves the field part of Schramm's Problem 2.2.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Schramm 问题 2.2 中关于场的部分。

sentences.en: We give an absolutely convergent finite-volume formula for the normalization.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了归一化的一个绝对收敛的有限体积公式。

sentences.en: The proof combines reflection positivity, a spectral sum rule, and boundary comparison with Gaussian moment identities.
sentences.zh: 证明结合了反射正性、一个谱求和规则、边界比较以及高斯矩恒等式。

sentences.en: We prove the Gaussian free field and SLE$`_4`$ scaling limits for uniformly sampled real nearest-neighbor Lipschitz heights on the triangular lattice, resolving Schramm's Problem 2.3.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三角格上均匀抽样的实值最近邻 Lipschitz 高度的高斯自由场与 SLE$`_4`$ 标度极限，从而解决了 Schramm 问题 2.3。

sentences.en: On approximations of smooth simply connected domains, the centered height field converges as a random distribution to a multiple of the Dirichlet Gaussian free field.
sentences.zh: 在光滑单连通区域的逼近上，中心化高度场作为随机广义函数收敛于 Dirichlet 高斯自由场的一个倍数。

sentences.en: At one tuned two-arc boundary amplitude, the zero-height interface converges in uniform curve distance to chordal SLE$`_4`$.
sentences.zh: 在某个经调定的两弧边界幅度下，零高度界面在曲线的一致距离下收敛于弦 SLE$`_4`$。

sentences.en: We identify the relation between the field variance and the boundary height in terms of an implicit stationary tangent-flux coefficient.
sentences.zh: 我们以一个隐式的平稳切向通量系数确定了场方差与边界高度之间的关系。

sentences.en: For each fixed point on the critical Ashkin–Teller line, including the four-state Potts endpoint, we prove the conjectured joint scaling limit of the height and both current-cluster collections in every bounded Jordan domain, for every admissible polygonal approximation.
sentences.zh: 对于临界 Ashkin–Teller 线上的每个固定点，包括四态 Potts 端点，我们证明了在每个有界 Jordan 区域内、对每个容许的多边形逼近，高度与两个电流簇集合均具有所猜想的联合标度极限。

sentences.en: The height converges to a Gaussian free field with the predicted coupling constant, and the clusters converge to canonical recursive two-valued local sets of that same field.
sentences.zh: 高度收敛于具有所预测耦合常数的高斯自由场，而这些簇收敛于同一个场的典范递归二值局部集。

sentences.en: The joint limit includes all nesting depths and the distinguished wired boundary cluster.
sentences.zh: 该联合极限包括所有嵌套深度以及指定的 wired 边界簇。

sentences.en: We determine the limiting pressure of an Ising spin glass with Haar orthogonal eigenvectors, a compact limiting spectral law, and no asymptotic outliers, at every fixed temperature.
sentences.zh: 在每个固定温度下，我们确定了具有服从 Haar 分布的正交特征向量、紧支撑极限谱分布且无渐近离群值的 Ising 自旋玻璃的极限压强。

sentences.en: The pressure converges in expectation and almost surely to a variational formula.
sentences.zh: 压强在期望意义下且几乎必然地收敛于一个变分公式。

sentences.en: We also give the limiting pressure with deterministic external fields whose empirical laws converge in first-moment transport distance, and derive a formula for the zero-field ground-state energy by taking temperature to zero.
sentences.zh: 我们还给出了带有确定性外场时的极限压强，其中外场的经验分布在一阶矩输运距离下收敛，并通过令温度趋于零推导了零场基态能量的公式。

sentences.en: For every fixed integer k ≥ 3, random k-SAT with independent uniformly signed clauses on distinct variables, sampled with replacement, has a finite positive limiting satisfiability threshold.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定整数 k ≥ 3，由不同变量上的符号均匀且彼此独立的子句通过有放回抽样组成的随机 k-SAT，具有有限正的极限可满足性阈值。

sentences.en: We credit Gaia Carenini [[5]](https://eccc.weizmann.ac.il/report/2026/229/) with priority for resolving the satisfiability conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们承认 Gaia Carenini [[5]](https://eccc.weizmann.ac.il/report/2026/229/) 在解决可满足性猜想方面具有优先权。

sentences.en: This paper gives an alternative proof, using concentration of a capped last satisfiable index and a comparison between different system sizes.
sentences.zh: 本文利用设有上限的最后可满足索引的集中性，以及不同系统规模之间的比较，给出了另一种证明。

sentences.en: For random 3-SAT on n Boolean variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses on three distinct variables sampled with replacement, we prove that the first unsatisfiable prefix has variance $`\Theta(n)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于 n 个布尔变量上的随机 3-SAT，其子句使用三个不同变量，彼此独立且符号均匀，并以有放回方式抽样，我们证明了首个不可满足前缀的方差为 $`\Theta(n)`$。

sentences.en: The upper bound removes the logarithmic loss in the earlier variance estimate; the matching lower bound follows from Wilson's transition-width theorem.
sentences.zh: 该上界消除了此前方差估计中的对数损失；与之匹配的下界由 Wilson 的转变宽度定理得到。

sentences.en: Let Hn be the index of the first unsatisfiable prefix in random k-SAT on n variables, with independent uniformly signed clauses using k distinct variables and sampled with replacement.
sentences.zh: 令 Hn 为 n 个变量上的随机 k-SAT 中首个不可满足前缀的索引，其中子句使用 k 个不同变量，彼此独立且符号均匀，并以有放回方式抽样。

sentences.en: For every fixed k ≥ 4, we prove $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits (H_n)=\Theta_k(n)`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的 k ≥ 4，我们证明了 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits (H_n)=\Theta_k(n)`$。

sentences.en: For k = 3, the variance is bounded below by a positive multiple of n and above by a constant multiple of $`n\log n`$; the companion paper on random 3-SAT sharpens this to $`\Theta(n)`$.
sentences.zh: 当 k = 3 时，方差的下界为 n 的一个正倍数，上界为 $`n\log n`$ 的一个常数倍；关于随机 3-SAT 的姊妹论文将其改进为 $`\Theta(n)`$。

sentences.en: The same upper bounds proved here hold after clipping at any fixed positive multiple of n.
sentences.zh: 在任意固定的 n 的正倍数处作截断后，本文证明的相同上界仍然成立。

sentences.en: The limiting satisfiability threshold of uniform random 3-SAT is a computable real.
sentences.zh: 均匀随机 3-SAT 的极限可满足性阈值是可计算实数。

sentences.en: We credit Gaia Carenini [[4]](https://eccc.weizmann.ac.il/report/2026/229/) with priority for resolving the satisfiability conjecture, which establishes the threshold's existence.
sentences.zh: 我们承认 Gaia Carenini [[4]](https://eccc.weizmann.ac.il/report/2026/229/) 享有解决可满足性猜想的优先权，该猜想的解决确立了这一阈值的存在性。

sentences.en: We prove that one finite deterministic machine can approximate it to any prescribed accuracy.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一台有限的确定性机器就能以任意指定精度逼近它。

sentences.en: A deletion estimate gives explicit lower certificates, while a finite hierarchical approximation of the soft pressure gives upper certificates at every larger rational density.
sentences.zh: 一个删除估计给出了显式的下界证书，而软压强的有限分层逼近则在每个更大的有理密度处给出上界证书。

sentences.en: A fair search through these certificates halts without requiring a computable rate of finite-size convergence.
sentences.zh: 对这些证书进行公平搜索会停机，而无需有限尺寸收敛的可计算速率。

sentences.en: For every integer d ≥ 3 and inverse temperature β ≥ 0, the free zero-field ferromagnetic Ising measure on the infinite d-regular tree is a factor of IID exactly when $`\tanh\beta\le(d-1)^{-1/2}`$.
sentences.zh: 对每个整数 d ≥ 3 和逆温度 β ≥ 0，无限 d-正则树上的自由边界零场铁磁 Ising 测度是 IID 的因子，当且仅当 $`\tanh\beta\le(d-1)^{-1/2}`$。

sentences.en: We prove the positive implication, including equality, resolving the conjecture of Nam, Sly and Zhang; the strict converse is known.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了包含等号情形的正向蕴含，解决了 Nam、Sly 和 Zhang 的猜想；严格反向结论是已知的。

sentences.en: The spin factor can be chosen to commute with every tree automorphism on every label input.
sentences.zh: 可以选择自旋因子，使它在每个标号输入上都与每个树自同构交换。

sentences.en: We prove critical diameter-tail exponents −2 for unrooted honeycomb polygons and −2/3 for length-weighted polygons, together with a truncated second-length-moment bound of exponent 2/3.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，无根蜂窝格多边形的临界直径尾指数为 −2，按长度加权的多边形的临界直径尾指数为 −2/3，并给出指数为 2/3 的截断长度二阶矩界。

sentences.en: Consequently, polygons conditioned to have length at least n have diameter $`n^{3/4+o(1)}`$ in probability under either weight.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这两种权重中的任一种下，以长度至少为 n 为条件的多边形，其直径在概率意义下为 $`n^{3/4+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: Critical self-avoiding walks between prescribed, macroscopically separated boundary ports of a regular honeycomb hexagon have length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$ in probability, where R is the scale of the hexagon.
sentences.zh: 在正蜂窝格六边形中，连接指定且在宏观上彼此分离的边界端口的临界自回避游走，其长度在概率意义下为 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$，其中 R 是该六边形的尺度。

sentences.en: We prove the corresponding statements for half-plane arches, parallel cuts and nonparallel pure cuts.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了半平面拱、平行割和非平行纯割的相应结论。

sentences.en: The half-plane law also has mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 半平面分布下的平均长度也为 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: A separate strip argument gives endpoint mean laws on one density-one set of heights and in an aligned, critically weighted mixture of all even heights in a macroscopic interval.
sentences.zh: 另一个条带论证在一个密度为一的高度集合上，以及一个宏观区间内所有偶数高度的对齐临界加权混合中，给出了端点平均律。

sentences.en: We determine the growth exponent, at every fixed positive loop fugacity, of the critical honeycomb partition function for disjoint polygons separating two prescribed markers on a balanced cylinder.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定的正闭环逸度，我们确定了平衡圆柱上分隔两个指定标记的互不相交多边形的临界蜂窝格配分函数的增长指数。

sentences.en: At fugacity two the cylinder exponent is 1/6; the corresponding planar nesting exponent and middle-strip nesting exponent are 1/12.
sentences.zh: 逸度为二时，圆柱指数为 1/6；相应的平面嵌套指数和中部条带嵌套指数均为 1/12。

sentences.en: For uniform self-avoiding walks of every sufficiently large integer length on the honeycomb lattice, we prove diameter exponent 3/4 and simultaneous local-mass and covering exponent 4/3, with arbitrary positive exponent slack and arbitrary polynomial failure probability.
sentences.zh: 对于蜂窝格上每个充分大的整数长度的均匀自回避游走，我们证明了直径指数为 3/4，并同时证明了局部质量指数和覆盖指数为 4/3，允许任意正的指数余量和任意多项式阶的失败概率。

sentences.en: At the critical activity and loop fugacity two, we prove a 1/6 partition exponent for disjoint honeycomb polygons separating opposite marks on a balanced infinite cylinder, and a 1/12 planar nesting exponent.
sentences.zh: 在临界活度和闭环逸度为二时，我们证明，平衡无限圆柱上分隔相对标记的互不相交蜂窝格多边形的配分指数为 1/6，平面嵌套指数为 1/12。

sentences.en: For ordered first-exit chords in a regular hexagon of side R, with both boundary ports summed and diameter at least $`R/10`$, the finite critical partition is $`R^{3/4+o(1)}`$ and the normalized mean length is $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对于边长为 R 的正六边形中有序的首次退出弦，对两个边界端口均求和并要求直径至少为 $`R/10`$ 时，有限临界配分和为 $`R^{3/4+o(1)}`$，归一化平均长度为 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: A separate two-bond estimate on tilted cylinders with controlled site proportions bounds the length-square mass of planar polygons of diameter at most H, modulo translations, by $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 对格点比例受控的倾斜圆柱进行的一个单独的双键估计表明，模去平移后，直径至多为 H 的平面多边形按长度平方加权的质量以 $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$ 为上界。

sentences.en: We prove a logarithmic window of critical honeycomb bridge lengths: summed through height $`2h(\log h)^{1/64}`$, bridges of lengths between $`h^{4/3}(\log h)^{-1/8}`$ and $`2h^{4/3}(\log h)^{1/2}`$ have mass at least $`h^{3/4}(\log h)^{-C}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了临界蜂窝格桥长度的一个对数窗口：对高度直至 $`2h(\log h)^{1/64}`$ 求和时，长度介于 $`h^{4/3}(\log h)^{-1/8}`$ 和 $`2h^{4/3}(\log h)^{1/2}`$ 之间的桥的质量至少为 $`h^{3/4}(\log h)^{-C}`$。

sentences.en: At the critical honeycomb vertex activity, the squared-length mass of simple polygons of diameter at most H, counted modulo translations, is at most $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 在蜂窝格的临界顶点活度下，模去平移计数后，直径至多为 H 的简单多边形按长度平方加权的质量至多为 $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: We also prove a quantitative two-mark cylinder estimate and a polynomial one-arc bound uniform even for arbitrarily unequal marked intervals.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了一个定量的双标记圆柱估计，以及一个即使对任意不等的标记区间也一致成立的多项式单弧界。

sentences.en: We prove that critical honeycomb bridges crossing a strip of width R have mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$, with the same exponent after confinement to a fixed multiple of the strip width.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，穿过宽度为 R 的条带的临界蜂窝格桥，其平均长度为 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$；即使将其限制在条带宽度的某个固定倍数之内，指数也相同。

sentences.en: The initial boundary port is fixed, the terminal port is summed, and all finite lengths receive their critical weights.
sentences.zh: 起始边界端口固定，终止端口参与求和，所有有限长度均赋予其临界权重。

sentences.en: The bridge mass is comparable to R−1/4; the half-plane arch kernel at endpoint separation m is comparable to m−5/4.
sentences.zh: 桥的质量与 R−1/4 可比；端点间距为 m 时的半平面拱核与 m−5/4 可比。

sentences.en: We prove that, under the all-length critical measure, a honeycomb bridge crossing a strip of h layers, with its initial port fixed and its terminal port free, has mean length $`h^{4/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在涵盖所有长度的临界测度下，穿过 h 层条带、起始端口固定且终止端口自由的蜂窝格桥，其平均长度为 $`h^{4/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: We also obtain central visit probability $`R^{-2/3+o(1)}`$ and mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$ for macroscopic free-boundary chords in a regular hexagon.
sentences.zh: 对于正六边形中的宏观自由边界弦，我们还得到中心访问概率 $`R^{-2/3+o(1)}`$ 和平均长度 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: For critical honeycomb self-avoiding walk, we prove spatial exponent 3/4 for the infinite irreducible-bridge law and for bridges of every sufficiently large compatible even length.
sentences.zh: 对于临界蜂窝格自回避游走，我们证明，无限不可约桥分布以及每个充分大的相容偶数长度的桥，其空间指数均为 3/4。

sentences.en: We establish the corresponding thermal laws at every large discount scale, including all positive length and spatial moments.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个大的折扣尺度上确立了相应的热分布规律，包括所有正阶长度矩和空间矩。

sentences.en: For unrestricted uniform walks, the endpoint lower law holds on a common set of lengths of natural density one.
sentences.zh: 对于不受限制的均匀游走，端点下界律在一个共同的自然密度为一的长度集合上成立。

sentences.en: We also determine the near-critical exponential correlation scale and small-force free-energy exponent, and prove spatial local lower bounds that permit conditioning on a prescribed terminal vertex.
sentences.zh: 我们还确定了近临界指数关联尺度和小外力自由能指数，并证明了允许以指定终止顶点为条件的空间局部下界。

sentences.en: At the critical weight of the regular honeycomb lattice, the total weight of self-avoiding paths crossing a strip of height N is comparable to N−1/4.
sentences.zh: 在正蜂窝格的临界权重下，穿过高度为 N 的条带的自回避路径的总权重与 N−1/4 可比。

sentences.en: The first horizontal-displacement moment of return paths is comparable to N3/4.
sentences.zh: 返回路径的水平位移一阶矩与 N3/4 可比。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform bound for critical honeycomb polygons through two axial marks on a periodic staircase.
sentences.zh: 我们对经过周期性阶梯上两个轴向标记的临界蜂窝格多边形证明了一个一致界。

sentences.en: The bound retains an explicit power of the ratio between the period and the marked separation.
sentences.zh: 该界保留了周期与标记间距之比的一个显式幂次。

sentences.en: We also prove sharp finite strip estimates: bridge mass of order h−1/4, first-length mass at most $`Ch^{13/12}`$, and mass at least $`ch^{-1/4}`$ on bridges with length at least $`ch^{4/3}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了最优的有限条带估计：桥的质量为 h−1/4 阶，按长度一次方加权的质量至多为 $`Ch^{13/12}`$，而长度至少为 $`ch^{4/3}`$ 的桥的质量至少为 $`ch^{-1/4}`$。

sentences.en: At the critical honeycomb fugacity, self-avoiding port-to-port chords in an equilateral lattice triangle of side R, summed over both boundary endpoints and restricted to diameter at least $`R/100`$, have partition sum comparable to R3/4 and mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 在蜂窝格临界逸度下，边长为 R 的等边格点三角形中连接端口的自回避弦，对两个边界端点均求和并限制直径至少为 $`R/100`$ 时，其配分和与 R3/4 可比，平均长度为 $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$。

sentences.en: We also determine the amplitude selected by two vacuum caps on a cylinder of circumference N and prove that it grows as $`N^{1/6+o(1)}`$.
sentences.zh: 我们还确定了周长为 N 的圆柱上由两个真空封帽选取的振幅，并证明其按 $`N^{1/6+o(1)}`$ 增长。

sentences.en: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards mixes in $`\Theta(d)`$ complete shuffles.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对 $`2^d`$ 张牌进行 Thorp 洗牌，在 $`\Theta(d)`$ 次完整洗牌后达到混合。

sentences.en: The full permutation law after $`1600d`$ shuffles converges to uniform in total variation as $`d\to\infty`$, uniformly over the initial deck, while a support count gives a lower bound of $`2d-O(1)`$.
sentences.zh: 在 $`1600d`$ 次洗牌后，当 $`d\to\infty`$ 时，整个置换的分布在全变差意义下收敛到均匀分布，且这一收敛关于初始牌序一致成立，而支撑计数给出下界 $`2d-O(1)`$。

sentences.en: For the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards, we prove that the worst-start total-variation distance after $`32800d`$ physical shuffles tends to zero as $`d\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 对于 $`2^d`$ 张牌的 Thorp 洗牌，我们证明，在 $`32800d`$ 次实际洗牌后，最坏初始状态下的全变差距离在 $`d\to\infty`$ 时趋于零。

sentences.en: Combining our fixed-list estimate with the companion Fourier transfer improves this bound to $`512d`$ shuffles.
sentences.zh: 将我们的固定列表估计与配套的 Fourier 转移结合，可将这一界改进为 $`512d`$ 次洗牌。

sentences.en: These results follow from bounds on partially observed permutation laws in random coordinate frames.
sentences.zh: 这些结果由随机坐标标架下部分观测的置换分布的界推出。

sentences.en: We show how information about partial permutations controls full permutation laws.
sentences.zh: 我们说明了部分置换的信息如何控制整个置换的分布。

sentences.en: Let n tend to infinity through multiples of eight.
sentences.zh: 令 n 沿八的倍数趋于无穷。

sentences.en: If the images of a uniformly chosen $`7n/8`$ labels approach the uniform injection law in average total variation, and the sign mean tends to zero, then the product of two independent permutations with the given law converges to uniform on Sn.
sentences.zh: 如果均匀选取的 $`7n/8`$ 个标号的像在平均全变差意义下趋近于均匀单射分布，且符号的均值趋于零，那么两个具有给定分布的独立置换的乘积收敛到 Sn 上的均匀分布。

sentences.en: We bound the information remaining after paths of specified cards in the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ cards have been observed.
sentences.zh: 我们对 $`n=2^d`$ 张牌的 Thorp 洗牌中观测指定牌的路径后剩余的信息给出界。

sentences.en: After a fixed number of deterministic coordinate sweeps, the joint endpoint law of further cards is close to uniform on the available positions, on average over the observed paths, provided a fixed positive fraction of labels lies outside both lists.
sentences.zh: 经过固定次数的确定性坐标扫描后，只要两份列表之外仍有固定正比例的标号，则对所观测的路径取平均时，其他牌的联合终点分布接近可用位置上的均匀分布。

sentences.en: Combined with a Fourier transfer, these bounds give full-deck mixing after $`2048d`$ physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 结合 Fourier 转移，这些界给出在 $`2048d`$ 次实际洗牌后整副牌达到混合的结论。

sentences.en: Fix half the labels in a Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ positions and reveal their complete trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在 $`2^d`$ 个位置的 Thorp 洗牌中，固定一半标号并揭示它们的完整轨迹。

sentences.en: We prove that, after an explicit absolute number of coordinate sweeps, the conditional permutation of the remaining labels approaches uniform in expected total variation as $`d\to\infty`$, uniformly in the initial layout.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，经过某个显式绝对常数次数的坐标扫描后，剩余标号的条件置换在 $`d\to\infty`$ 时按期望全变差趋近于均匀分布，且关于初始排列一致成立。

sentences.en: The resulting constructions give full-deck mixing in a constant multiple of d physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 由此得到的构造使整副牌在 d 的一个常数倍次数的实际洗牌后达到混合。

sentences.en: For $`N=2^d`$ cards, we prove that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle brings the full permutation law to total-variation distance tending to zero from uniform.
sentences.zh: 对于 $`N=2^d`$ 张牌，我们证明，经过某个绝对常数次数的 Thorp 洗牌坐标扫描后，整个置换的分布与均匀分布之间的全变差距离趋于零。

sentences.en: The mixing time therefore has optimal order $`\Theta(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 因此，以实际洗牌次数计，混合时间具有最优阶 $`\Theta(\log N)`$。

sentences.en: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`N=2^d`$ labeled cards has full-permutation total-variation mixing time $`\Theta(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对 $`N=2^d`$ 张带标号的牌进行 Thorp 洗牌，以实际洗牌次数计，整个置换的全变差混合时间为 $`\Theta(\log N)`$。

sentences.en: An absolute number of coordinate sweeps suffices for the upper bound.
sentences.zh: 某个绝对常数次数的坐标扫描就足以得到该上界。

sentences.en: We prove that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ positions brings the full permutation to total-variation distance at most $`\frac12n^{-5}`$ from uniform, uniformly over the initial deck.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对 $`n=2^d`$ 个位置的 Thorp 洗牌进行某个绝对常数次数的坐标扫描后，整个置换与均匀分布之间的全变差距离至多为 $`\frac12n^{-5}`$，且关于初始牌序一致成立。

sentences.en: Thus $`O(d)`$ physical shuffles suffice, which is optimal in order.
sentences.zh: 因此，$`O(d)`$ 次实际洗牌就足够了，这在阶的意义下是最优的。

sentences.en: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`n=2^d`$ cards mixes in $`\Theta(d)`$ physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`n=2^d`$ 张牌的 Thorp 洗牌在 $`\Theta(d)`$ 次实际洗牌后达到混合。

sentences.en: After a sufficiently large fixed number of coordinate sweeps, the total-variation distance of the full permutation from uniform tends to zero as $`d\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 经过充分大的固定次数的坐标扫描后，整个置换与均匀分布之间的全变差距离在 $`d\to\infty`$ 时趋于零。

sentences.en: We prove that a fixed number of coordinate sweeps of the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards makes the squared L2 distance of the full permutation density from uniform tend to zero as $`d\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对 $`2^d`$ 张牌进行固定次数的 Thorp 洗牌坐标扫描后，整个置换密度与均匀分布之间的 L2 距离的平方在 $`d\to\infty`$ 时趋于零。

sentences.en: In particular, the total-variation mixing time is $`\Theta(d)`$ physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 特别地，全变差混合时间为 $`\Theta(d)`$ 次实际洗牌。

sentences.en: For coordinate sweeps with near-uniform line laws and line sizes among powers of two in a suitable fixed interval, we prove a Schatten-moment bound after conditioning on any feasible collection of prescribed card trajectories.
sentences.zh: 对于各条线上的分布接近均匀分布、且线大小取自某个合适的固定区间内二的幂的坐标扫描，我们证明，在以任意可行的指定牌轨迹集为条件后，有一个 Schatten 矩界。

sentences.en: An analytic transfer to binary sweeps then shows that a fixed number of sweeps mixes the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards in $`O(d)`$ physical steps, matching the order of the support lower bound.
sentences.zh: 随后，通过到二元扫描的解析转移可知，固定次数的扫描就能使 $`2^d`$ 张牌的 Thorp 洗牌在 $`O(d)`$ 个实际步骤后达到混合，与支撑下界的阶相匹配。

sentences.en: We prove a permanent inequality with exponent strictly below two for laws on S4 sufficiently close to uniform and with exactly uniform coordinate marginals.
sentences.zh: 对于 S4 上充分接近均匀分布且各坐标边缘分布恰为均匀分布的分布，我们证明了一个指数严格小于二的积和式不等式。

sentences.en: Applied to a four-row recursion, it shows that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps brings the full permutation of the Thorp shuffle on $`N=2^d`$ cards to total-variation distance tending to zero from uniform as $`N\to\infty`$.
sentences.zh: 将其应用于一个四行递推，可知对 $`N=2^d`$ 张牌进行某个绝对常数次数的 Thorp 洗牌坐标扫描后，整个置换与均匀分布之间的全变差距离在 $`N\to\infty`$ 时趋于零。

sentences.en: Thus the mixing time has the optimal order $`O(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles.
sentences.zh: 因此，以实际洗牌次数计，混合时间具有最优阶 $`O(\log N)`$。

sentences.en: Let An be a symmetric $`n\times n`$ matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent uniform signs.
sentences.zh: 设 An 为一个对称 $`n\times n`$ 矩阵，其对角线及其上方的元素是独立且均匀的正负号。

sentences.en:
We prove

$`\displaystyle \Pr(\det A_n=0)=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)^n.`$
sentences.zh: 我们证明 $`\displaystyle \Pr(\det A_n=0)=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)^n.`$。

sentences.en: Let An be a symmetric random matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent signs, equal to 1 with fixed probability $`p\in(0,1)\setminus\{1/2\}`$.
sentences.zh: 设 An 为一个对称随机矩阵，其对角线及其上方的元素是独立的正负号，以固定概率 $`p\in(0,1)\setminus\{1/2\}`$ 等于 1。

sentences.en: We prove that $`\mathbb P(\det A_n=0)=(p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 $`\mathbb P(\det A_n=0)=(p^2+(1-p)^2+o(1))^n`$。

sentences.en: The rate is attained by the event that two rows agree.
sentences.zh: 两行相同这一事件达到了该速率。

sentences.en: Assuming the continuum hypothesis, we construct an abstract elementary class with Löwenheim–Skolem number ℵ<sub>0</sub> that is categorical in every sufficiently large cardinal but has at least two nonisomorphic models of cardinality $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$.
sentences.zh: 假设连续统假设成立，我们构造了一个 Löwenheim–Skolem 数为 ℵ<sub>0</sub> 的抽象初等类，它在每个充分大的基数上都是范畴的，但在基数 $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$ 上至少有两个不同构的模型。

sentences.en: Thus categoricity does not transfer down to the proposed bound $`\beth_{(2^{\aleph_0})^+}`$, which equals $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$ under CH.
sentences.zh: 因此，范畴性不能向下转移到所提出的界 $`\beth_{(2^{\aleph_0})^+}`$，该界在 CH 下等于 $`\beth_{\omega_2}`$。

sentences.en: Consequently, if ZFC is consistent, the prescribed-threshold form of Shelah's categoricity conjecture is not provable in ZFC.
sentences.zh: 从而，如果 ZFC 是相容的，那么 Shelah 范畴性猜想的指定阈值形式在 ZFC 中不可证。

sentences.en: We prove Shelah's eventual categoricity conjecture for abstract elementary classes in ZFC.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ZFC 中证明了抽象初等类的 Shelah 最终范畴性猜想。

sentences.en: For each infinite bound on the Löwenheim–Skolem number there is a uniform threshold such that categoricity in any one cardinal at or above that threshold implies categoricity in every cardinal at or above the same threshold.
sentences.zh: 对于 Löwenheim–Skolem 数的每个无穷界，都存在一个一致阈值，使得在任意一个不小于该阈值的基数上的范畴性，都蕴含在每个不小于同一阈值的基数上的范畴性。

sentences.en: We prove that every order automorphism of the full partial order of Turing degrees is the identity, resolving the rigidity conjecture for the Turing degrees positively.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，Turing 度的完整偏序的每个序自同构都是恒等映射，从而肯定地解决了 Turing 度的刚性猜想。

sentences.en: Every recursively enumerable set of natural-number tuples has a polynomial Diophantine representation with exactly one complete auxiliary tuple for each member.
sentences.zh: 每个自然数元组的递归可枚举集合都有一个多项式丢番图表示，使其每个成员都恰好对应一个完整的辅助元组。

sentences.en: This proves the single-fold conjecture and, consequently, the finite-fold conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这证明了单重猜想，并由此证明了有限重猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time on unordered finite structures, confirming the noncapture conjecture of Blass, Gurevich and Shelah.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，带计数的无选择多项式时间不能刻画无序有限结构上的多项式时间，从而证实了 Blass、Gurevich 和 Shelah 的不能刻画猜想。

sentences.en: A linear-consistency query over 𝔽<sub>3</sub> in a fixed binary vocabulary is decidable in polynomial time but not in the full counting formalism.
sentences.zh: 固定二元词汇中的一个 𝔽<sub>3</sub> 上的线性相容性查询可以在多项式时间内判定，却不能在完整的计数形式体系中判定。

sentences.en: We prove that witnessed symmetric choice strictly increases the expressive power of choiceless polynomial time with counting.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，有见证的对称选择严格增强了带计数的无选择多项式时间的表达能力。

sentences.en: A fixed sentence with one witnessed-choice occurrence defines a Boolean query on every finite input that is not definable in the original counting formalism.
sentences.zh: 一个仅含一次有见证选择的固定句子，在每个有限输入上定义了一个布尔查询，而该查询无法在原来的计数形式体系中定义。

sentences.en: We prove that the Partition Principle does not imply the Axiom of Choice: if ZF is consistent, then so is ZF with the Partition Principle, Choice for ordinal-indexed families, and the negation of the Axiom of Choice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，划分原理不蕴含选择公理：如果 ZF 是相容的，那么 ZF 加上划分原理、序数索引族的选择公理以及选择公理的否定，也仍然相容。

sentences.en: Separately, over every countable transitive model of ZFC, we construct a transitive symmetric model of this theory with the same ordinals and no new countable sequences of ground elements.
sentences.zh: 另外，在每个 ZFC 的可数传递模型之上，我们构造了该理论的一个传递对称模型，它具有相同的序数，且不添加由基模型元素构成的新的可数序列。

sentences.en: We prove that every weakly β-normalizing pure type system is strongly β-normalizing.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个弱 β-正规化的纯类型系统都是强 β-正规化的。

sentences.en: Both properties quantify over all legal expressions in all valid contexts, and reduction acts inside type annotations.
sentences.zh: 这两个性质的量词均遍及所有有效上下文中的所有合法表达式，且归约作用于类型标注内部。

sentences.en: No functionality hypothesis is required.
sentences.zh: 不需要 functionality 假设。

sentences.en: This resolves the β-Barendregt–Geuvers–Klop conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 β-Barendregt–Geuvers–Klop 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every hyperbolic group whose boundary is homeomorphic to the two-sphere admits a proper cocompact isometric action on hyperbolic three-space with finite kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个边界同胚于二维球面的双曲群，都在三维双曲空间上具有核有限的固有、余紧等距作用。

sentences.en: This resolves Cannon's conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Cannon 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that the infinite, ordinarily finitely presented periodic Steinberg group $`\Gamma=\mathop{\mathrm{St}}\nolimits _{12}(R)`$ of a companion paper is residually finite.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，配套论文中的无限、按通常意义有限展示的周期 Steinberg 群 $`\Gamma=\mathop{\mathrm{St}}\nolimits _{12}(R)`$ 是剩余有限的。

sentences.en: Its finite-index subgroup $`G=\ker(\Gamma\to\mathop{\mathrm{St}}\nolimits _{12}(\mathbb F_2))`$ is infinite, ordinarily finitely presented, and residually finite, and every element of G has finite 2-power order.
sentences.zh: 它的有限指数子群 $`G=\ker(\Gamma\to\mathop{\mathrm{St}}\nolimits _{12}(\mathbb F_2))`$ 是无限、按通常意义有限展示且剩余有限的，并且 G 的每个元素的阶均为有限的 2 的幂。

sentences.en: The orders of its elements are unbounded.
sentences.zh: 其元素的阶无界。

sentences.en: Phases of long words in the companion's graded algebra allow finite degree truncations to detect all elements of Γ, including the central kernel.
sentences.zh: 配套论文的分次代数中长字的相位，使有限次数截断能够检测 Γ 的所有元素，包括中心核中的元素。

sentences.en: We construct an infinite group with an ordinary finite presentation in which every element has finite order, answering the finitely presented Burnside question negatively.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个具有通常意义下的有限展示的无限群，其中每个元素的阶都有限，从而否定地回答了有限展示的 Burnside 问题。

sentences.en: We also construct an infinite-dimensional finitely presented nonunital nil associative algebra over 𝔽<sub>2</sub> that is Jacobson radical but not nilpotent.
sentences.zh: 我们还构造了一个 𝔽<sub>2</sub> 上无限维、有限展示、无单位元且每个元素均幂零的结合代数，它是 Jacobson 根代数，但不是幂零代数。

sentences.en: Its unitization is finitely presented, algebraic, and infinite-dimensional.
sentences.zh: 其添幺代数是有限展示、代数性的，且是无限维的。

sentences.en: These algebras answer the finitely presented nil- and radical-algebra nilpotence questions and the finite-presentation version of Kurosh's algebraic finiteness question negatively.
sentences.zh: 这些代数否定地回答了有限展示的每个元素均幂零的代数及根代数的幂零性问题，以及 Kurosh 代数性有限性问题的有限展示版本。

sentences.en: We prove that Thompson's group F is nonamenable.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，Thompson 群 F 是非可均的。

sentences.en: This confirms Geoghegan's conjecture and resolves the amenability problem for F.
sentences.zh: 这证实了 Geoghegan 猜想，并解决了 F 的可均性问题。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely generated residually finite group of integral cohomological dimension two and geometric dimension three, disproving the Eilenberg–Ganea conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个整系数上同调维数为二、几何维数为三的有限生成剩余有限群，从而否证了 Eilenberg–Ganea 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove the Boone–Higman conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Boone–Higman 猜想。

sentences.en: A finitely generated group has decidable word problem if and only if it embeds in a finitely presented simple group.
sentences.zh: 一个有限生成群的字问题可判定，当且仅当它可以嵌入一个有限展示单群。

sentences.en: Every finitely generated group with decidable word problem embeds in a simple group of type F∞.
sentences.zh: 每个字问题可判定的有限生成群都可以嵌入一个 F∞ 型单群。

sentences.en: This resolves the higher-finiteness strengthening of the Boone–Higman conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Boone–Higman 猜想在更高阶有限性方面的加强形式。

sentences.en: We construct a single group of type F∞ containing every finitely presented group.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个包含每个有限展示群的单一的 F∞ 型群。

sentences.en: Its finitely generated subgroups, up to isomorphism, are exactly the finitely generated recursively presented groups.
sentences.zh: 它的有限生成子群在同构意义下恰好是所有有限生成递归展示群。

sentences.en: This answers the F∞ form of the higher-dimensional Higman embedding question.
sentences.zh: 这回答了高维 Higman 嵌入问题的 F∞ 形式。

sentences.en: We prove that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary representation.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一个离散群是可均的，当且仅当它在复 Hilbert 空间上的每个一致有界表示都相似于一个酉表示。

sentences.en: This resolves Dixmier's unitarizability problem affirmatively for discrete groups.
sentences.zh: 这对离散群肯定地解决了 Dixmier 的可酉化问题。

sentences.en: A countable discrete group is amenable if and only if it is strongly Ulam stable: every sufficiently accurate unitary almost representation, on any complex Hilbert space, is uniformly close in operator norm to a genuine representation on the same space.
sentences.zh: 一个可数离散群是可均的，当且仅当它是强 Ulam 稳定的：在任意复 Hilbert 空间上，每个充分精确的酉几乎表示都在算子范数下一致接近同一空间上的一个真正的表示。

sentences.en: We prove the converse to Kazhdan's amenable stability theorem, answering the question of Burger, Ozawa, and Thom.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Kazhdan 可均稳定性定理的逆命题，回答了 Burger、Ozawa 和 Thom 的问题。

sentences.en: The inclusion of infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces is essential.
sentences.zh: 将无限维 Hilbert 空间包括在内是必要的。

sentences.en: We construct a torsion-free word-hyperbolic group that is not residually finite, answering the residual-finiteness question for hyperbolic groups negatively.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个并非剩余有限的无挠字双曲群，从而否定地回答了双曲群的剩余有限性问题。

sentences.en: We construct an infinite finitely presented simple amenable group, giving a positive answer to the finite-presentation existence question for simple amenable groups.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个无限的有限展示可均单群，从而肯定地回答了可均单群的有限展示存在性问题。

sentences.en: We prove that the standard Salvetti complex of every Artin group with finitely many standard generators is aspherical.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个具有有限个标准生成元的 Artin 群的标准 Salvetti 复形都是非球面的。

sentences.en: This resolves the Artin $`K(\pi,1)`$ conjecture in finite rank.
sentences.zh: 这解决了有限秩情形的 Artin $`K(\pi,1)`$ 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct an Artin group on 116 generators that admits no proper, cocompact isometric action on a nonempty proper CAT(0) space.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个有 116 个生成元的 Artin 群，它在任何非空固有 CAT(0) 空间上都不具有固有、余紧的等距作用。

sentences.en: This refutes the CAT(0) conjecture for Artin groups.
sentences.zh: 这否证了 Artin 群的 CAT(0) 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every intersection of parabolic subgroups of any finite-rank Artin group, with arbitrary finite or infinite Coxeter labels, is parabolic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于任意具有任意有限或无限 Coxeter 标号的有限秩 Artin 群，其抛物子群的任意交仍为抛物子群。

sentences.en: This resolves the Parabolic Intersection Conjecture affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了抛物子群交猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every finitely generated group quasi-isometric to a finitely generated virtually polycyclic group is virtually polycyclic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个与某个有限生成的几乎多循环群拟等距的有限生成群，也都是几乎多循环的。

sentences.en: This resolves the lattice-recognition conjecture of Eskin, Fisher and Whyte, which allows the ambient solvable Lie group in the conclusion to differ from the one in the hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Eskin、Fisher 和 Whyte 的格识别猜想，该猜想允许结论中的环境可解 Lie 群与假设中的不同。

sentences.en: Every finite nonsingular system of equations over an arbitrary group has a simultaneous solution in an overgroup.
sentences.zh: 任意群上的每个有限非奇异方程组，都在某个包含该群的群中有公共解。

sentences.en: This proves Howie's conjecture on nonsingular systems.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Howie 关于非奇异方程组的猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that no free product of a nontrivial group with an infinite cyclic group is normally generated by one element.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，任何非平凡群与无限循环群的自由积，都不能由一个元素正规生成。

sentences.en: This resolves the Kervaire conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Kervaire 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a hyperbolic group with a finite classifying space that admits no geometric action on a proper complete CAT(0) space.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个具有有限分类空间的双曲群，它在固有完备 CAT(0) 空间上不具有几何作用。

sentences.en: Consequently, a finite aspherical simplicial complex with a linear combinatorial disk-filling inequality need not have a finite locally CAT(0) homotopy model, and hence need not have a finite locally CAT(−1) model.
sentences.zh: 因此，满足组合圆盘填充的线性不等式的有限非球面单纯复形，不一定具有有限的局部 CAT(0) 同伦模型，从而也不一定具有有限的局部 CAT(−1) 模型。

sentences.en: Here metric models carry geodesic length metrics inducing the given complex topology.
sentences.zh: 这里的度量模型带有诱导给定复形拓扑的测地长度度量。

sentences.en: We prove Gersten's conjecture: every finitely generated one-relator group containing no subgroup isomorphic to a Baumslag–Solitar group $`\mathop{\mathrm{BS}}\nolimits (m,n)`$, for nonzero integers m, n, is word-hyperbolic.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Gersten 猜想：每个有限生成单关系群，只要不包含任何同构于非零整数 m、n 所对应的 Baumslag–Solitar 群 $`\mathop{\mathrm{BS}}\nolimits (m,n)`$ 的子群，就是字双曲的。

sentences.en: We prove that every word-hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个字双曲单关系群都是几乎紧致特殊的。

sentences.en: Combined with the work of Kielak–Linton, this resolves Wise's virtual free-by-cyclic conjecture for hyperbolic one-relator groups: every such group is virtually free-by-cyclic, with the free kernel allowed to have infinite rank.
sentences.zh: 结合 Kielak–Linton 的工作，这解决了 Wise 关于双曲单关系群几乎为 free-by-cyclic 群的猜想：每个这样的群都几乎为 free-by-cyclic 群，其中允许自由核的秩为无穷。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely generated group with two essentially free probability-measure-preserving actions of different costs.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个有限生成群，它具有两个代价不同的本质自由的保概率测度作用。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to Gaboriau's general fixed-price problem.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了 Gaboriau 的一般固定代价问题。

sentences.en: The group is an amalgam of a free group of rank 100 with a direct product.
sentences.zh: 该群是一个秩为 100 的自由群与一个直积的融合积。

sentences.en: Its Bernoulli action has cost bounded away from one, whereas finite height extensions have costs tending to one.
sentences.zh: 它的 Bernoulli 作用的代价与一保持正距离，而有限高度扩张的代价趋于一。

sentences.en: Under the stated energy, decay, and trapping hypotheses, we prove the sharp charged spacetime Penrose upper-area inequality for one-ended three-dimensional initial data with source-free electric and magnetic fields.
sentences.zh: 在所述能量、衰减及捕获假设下，我们对具有无源电场和磁场的单端三维初始数据，证明了最优的带电时空 Penrose 面积上界不等式。

sentences.en: The theorem allows arbitrary second fundamental form, nonzero ADM momentum, and disconnected boundary.
sentences.zh: 该定理允许任意第二基本形式、非零 ADM 动量及不连通边界。

sentences.en: Writing m for invariant ADM mass, Q for total charge magnitude, and rA for the minimum-enclosing-area radius, the bound is m ≥ Q and $`r_A\le m+\sqrt{m^2-Q^2}`$.
sentences.zh: 以 m 表示不变 ADM 质量、Q 表示总荷量的大小、rA 表示最小包围面积半径，则相应的界为 m ≥ Q 及 $`r_A\le m+\sqrt{m^2-Q^2}`$。

sentences.en: The polynomial mass bound $`m\ge(r_A+Q^2/r_A)/2`$ is asserted only when $`r_A\gt Q`$.
sentences.zh: 仅在 $`r_A\gt Q`$ 时，才断言多项式质量界 $`m\ge(r_A+Q^2/r_A)/2`$ 成立。

sentences.en: When m > Q, equality under the stated connected, outermost, outer-area-minimizing future-horizon hypotheses identifies the original data as a smooth spacelike slice of dyonic Reissner–Nordström, including smooth attachment at the future horizon.
sentences.zh: 当 m > Q 时，在所述连通、最外层、外侧面积极小的未来视界假设下，等号成立可将原始数据识别为带电磁双荷的 Reissner–Nordström 时空的一个光滑类空切片，包括在未来视界处的光滑拼接。

sentences.en: Using the companion neutral spacetime Penrose theorem exactly at its stated strong-decay, future-trapped, positive-area, and future-timelike scope, we prove the sharp purely electric upper-area inequality in every spatial dimension n ≥ 4 for one-ended charged data satisfying the charged dominant energy condition and $`\mathop{\mathrm{div}}\nolimits _g E=0`$, with the specified decay, integrability, and finite-flux assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们严格在配套的中性时空 Penrose 定理所声明的强衰减、未来捕获、正面积及未来类时范围内使用该定理，证明了每个空间维数 n ≥ 4 中的最优纯电面积上界不等式，适用于满足带电主导能量条件和 $`\mathop{\mathrm{div}}\nolimits _g E=0`$，并满足指定衰减、可积性及有限通量假设的单端带电数据。

sentences.en: The data may have arbitrary interior topology and ADM momentum, with a future or past trapping sign chosen independently on each boundary component.
sentences.zh: 这些数据可以具有任意内部拓扑和 ADM 动量，且可以在每个边界分支上独立选择未来或过去的捕获符号。

sentences.en: Positive enclosing area and strict ADM timelikeness are conclusions.
sentences.zh: 包围面积为正以及 ADM 严格类时性是结论。

sentences.en: The polynomial mass rearrangement is asserted only when the $`(n-2)`$nd power of the enclosing-area radius exceeds $`|Q|`$.
sentences.zh: 仅在包围面积半径的 $`(n-2)`$ 次幂超过 $`|Q|`$ 时，才断言多项式质量重排式成立。

sentences.en: When $`m\gt |Q|`$, equality under the stated connected, outermost, outer-area-minimizing future-horizon hypotheses recovers the original metric, second fundamental form, and electric field as a global spacelike slice of a Reissner–Nordström–Tangherlini exterior.
sentences.zh: 当 $`m\gt |Q|`$ 时，在所述连通、最外层、外侧面积极小的未来视界假设下，等号成立可将原始度量、第二基本形式及电场恢复为 Reissner–Nordström–Tangherlini 外部区域的一个整体类空切片。

sentences.en: The equality classification includes only slices whose induced magnetic two-form vanishes.
sentences.zh: 等号情形的分类仅包括诱导磁二形式为零的切片。

sentences.en: We prove sharp spacetime Penrose inequalities for invariant ADM mass and minimum enclosing area in three and four spatial dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维和四维空间中关于不变 ADM 质量和最小包围面积的最优时空 Penrose 不等式。

sentences.en: Under their respective designated-end conventions, the neutral numerical results allow arbitrary second fundamental form, nonzero momentum, disconnected weakly future trapped boundary, and finitely many ends.
sentences.zh: 在各自指定端的约定下，中性情形的数值结论允许任意第二基本形式、非零动量、不连通的弱未来捕获边界以及有限多个端。

sentences.en: Under the stated horizon hypotheses, equality for the neutral inequalities reconstructs the original exterior data as spacelike slices of Schwarzschild spacetime in three dimensions and Schwarzschild–Tangherlini spacetime in four; the four-dimensional equality theorem concerns a connected, one-ended exterior.
sentences.zh: 在所述视界假设下，中性不等式中的等号可将原始外部数据重构为三维情形中 Schwarzschild 时空、四维情形中 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 时空的类空切片；四维等号定理涉及连通的单端外部区域。

sentences.en: We also prove a three-dimensional electric–magnetic charged upper-area inequality for one-ended data with nonzero momentum, with separate purely electric rest-frame corollaries allowing finitely many ends.
sentences.zh: 我们还对具有非零动量的单端数据证明了一个三维电磁带电面积上界不等式，并分别给出了允许有限多个端的纯电静止参考系推论。

sentences.en: Finally, for each fixed transverse-traceless seed and prescribed decaying solution branch, we prove a local Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter inequality.
sentences.zh: 最后，对于每个固定的横向无迹种子和指定的衰减解分支，我们证明了一个局部 Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter 不等式。

sentences.en:
We prove the sharp Kerr–Newman Penrose inequality

$`\displaystyle m^2\ge \frac{A}{16\pi}+\frac{Q^2}{2} +\frac{\pi(Q^4+4J^2)}{A}.`$
sentences.zh: 我们证明了最优的 Kerr–Newman Penrose 不等式 $`\displaystyle m^2\ge \frac{A}{16\pi}+\frac{Q^2}{2} +\frac{\pi(Q^4+4J^2)}{A}.`$

sentences.en: Here $`Q^2=Q_e^2+Q_b^2`$, and J is the conserved total angular momentum, including its electromagnetic contribution.
sentences.zh: 这里 $`Q^2=Q_e^2+Q_b^2`$，且 J 是守恒的总角动量，包括其电磁贡献。

sentences.en: The result applies to smooth axisymmetric electrovacuum exteriors in the stated one-ended topological and decay class, with a connected outermost, outer-area-minimizing future marginally outer trapped boundary, Coulomb electromagnetic asymptotics, zero ADM momentum, and the explicitly assumed physical-area condition $`A\ge4\pi\sqrt{Q^4+4J^2}`$.
sentences.zh: 该结果适用于所述单端拓扑及衰减类别中的光滑轴对称电磁真空外部区域，其边界连通、处于最外层、外侧面积极小且为未来边缘外捕获边界，具有 Coulomb 电磁渐近行为、零 ADM 动量，并满足显式假设的物理面积条件 $`A\ge4\pi\sqrt{Q^4+4J^2}`$。

sentences.en: No maximality assumption is made.
sentences.zh: 不作极大性假设。

sentences.en: On the strict area branch, equality within this class characterizes the original data as an admissible spacelike exterior slice of a subextremal dyonic Kerr–Newman spacetime, with the boundary mapped smoothly to a future-horizon cross-section or the bifurcation sphere.
sentences.zh: 在严格面积分支上，该类别内的等号刻画了原始数据为一个次极端的带电磁双荷 Kerr–Newman 时空的容许类空外部切片，且边界光滑地映射到一个未来视界截面或分岔球面。

sentences.en: We construct smooth axisymmetric electrovacuum exteriors that violate the Kerr–Newman Penrose inequality when J is the bare gravitational ADM angular momentum and the electromagnetic fields have only $`O(r^{-2})`$ decay, allowing angularly varying leading tails.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了光滑轴对称电磁真空外部区域，当 J 是裸引力 ADM 角动量、而电磁场仅具有 $`O(r^{-2})`$ 衰减且允许首项尾部随角度变化时，这些外部区域违反 Kerr–Newman Penrose 不等式。

sentences.en: The examples have zero total electric and magnetic charge even though both electromagnetic fields are nonzero.
sentences.zh: 这些例子的总电荷和总磁荷均为零，尽管电场和磁场都非零。

sentences.en: They have a connected outermost, outer-area-minimizing future marginally outer trapped boundary and lie strictly on the physical area branch.
sentences.zh: 它们具有连通、最外层、外侧面积极小的未来边缘外捕获边界，并且严格位于物理面积分支上。

sentences.en: We also obtain equality examples whose original data admit no Kerr–Newman spacelike realization with the corresponding mass, angular momentum, and charges.
sentences.zh: 我们还得到一些等号成立的例子，其原始数据不能在具有相应质量、角动量及电磁荷的 Kerr–Newman 时空中实现为类空切片。

sentences.en: These counterexamples do not refute formulations using conserved total angular momentum with its electromagnetic correction or stronger Coulomb asymptotics.
sentences.zh: 这些反例并未否证采用包含电磁修正的守恒总角动量或更强 Coulomb 渐近行为的表述。

sentences.en: We prove the spacetime Penrose Inequality for smooth three-dimensional initial-data exteriors with one spherical asymptotically anti-de Sitter end, satisfying the stated decay and integrability assumptions, the dominant energy condition, and a compact weakly future outer trapped boundary.
sentences.zh: 我们对具有一个球面渐近 anti-de Sitter 端的光滑三维初始数据外部区域证明了时空 Penrose 不等式，这些区域满足所述衰减及可积性假设、主导能量条件，并具有紧致的弱未来外捕获边界。

sentences.en: We assume that the hyperbolic metric four-flux is future timelike; its Lorentz norm is the mass, and the area is the infimum over full enclosing cuts.
sentences.zh: 我们假设双曲度量四通量为未来类时；其 Lorentz 范数就是质量，而面积是对完整包围截面所取的下确界。

sentences.en: On the connected outermost, outer area-minimizing horizon subclass, equality characterizes the original data as a spacelike hypersurface in Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter spacetime with matching metric mass.
sentences.zh: 在连通、最外层、外侧面积极小的视界子类中，等号刻画了原始数据为具有相匹配度量质量的 Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter 时空中的一个类空超曲面。

sentences.en: No maximality, evolution, or auxiliary solvability assumption is used.
sentences.zh: 不使用极大性、演化或辅助可解性假设。

sentences.en: We prove the sharp Penrose inequality for three-dimensional maximal asymptotically hyperbolic initial data with spherical conformal infinity.
sentences.zh: 我们对具有球面共形无穷远的三维极大渐近双曲初始数据，证明了最优的 Penrose 不等式。

sentences.en: Under the dominant energy condition, the stated decay and integrability assumptions, and a future-timelike mass covector, the invariant mass is bounded below by the Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter mass associated with the minimum enclosing area of a weakly future outer-trapped boundary.
sentences.zh: 在主导能量条件、所述衰减及可积性假设，以及质量余向量为未来类时的条件下，不变质量以下述 Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter 质量为下界：该质量与弱未来外捕获边界的最小包围面积相对应。

sentences.en: The boundary may be disconnected, and no restriction is imposed on the compact topology.
sentences.zh: 边界可以不连通，且不对紧致部分的拓扑施加任何限制。

sentences.en: We prove the asymptotically hyperbolic Penrose inequality for sufficiently small maximal vacuum conformal perturbations of a positive-mass Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter exterior, for every fixed decaying transverse-traceless seed and every solution branch satisfying the stated decay and mass assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们对正质量 Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter 外部区域的充分小的极大真空共形扰动证明了渐近双曲 Penrose 不等式，这对每个固定的衰减横向无迹种子及每个满足所述衰减和质量假设的解分支都成立。

sentences.en: The bound uses the area of the marginally outer trapped boundary itself; it requires neither outermostness nor outer area-minimization, and no bulk-versus-boundary domination condition.
sentences.zh: 该界使用边缘外捕获边界本身的面积；既不要求其为最外层，也不要求其外侧面积极小，更不要求体积项与边界项之间的支配条件。

sentences.en: For sufficiently small positive parameters, equality holds for radial seeds and the inequality is strict otherwise.
sentences.zh: 对于充分小的正参数，径向种子使等号成立，否则不等式严格成立。

sentences.en: We prove the sharp spacetime Penrose inequality for smooth one-ended initial-data exteriors in every spatial dimension n ≥ 3, under the dominant energy condition, weak future trapping, the stated differentiated decay and positive enclosing area.
sentences.zh: 在主导能量条件、弱未来捕获条件、所述带导数的衰减条件及正包围面积条件下，我们对每个空间维数 n ≥ 3 中的光滑单端初始数据外部区域，证明了最优的时空 Penrose 不等式。

sentences.en: These hypotheses force the ADM energy-momentum to be future timelike.
sentences.zh: 这些假设迫使 ADM 能量动量为未来类时。

sentences.en: Area is the infimum over full enclosing cuts in the original metric.
sentences.zh: 面积是在原始度量中对完整包围截面所取的下确界。

sentences.en: In dimensions three and four, two metric derivatives and one tensor derivative suffice, and both positive enclosing area and future timelikeness follow from the hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 在三维和四维中，度量的二阶导数和张量的一阶导数就已足够，且包围面积为正和未来类时性均由假设推出。

sentences.en: We give a detailed conformal-flow proof of the numerical Riemannian Penrose inequality in every dimension n ≥ 3 for complete asymptotically flat exteriors with nonnegative scalar curvature and full compact frontiers that are outer minimizing and locally perimeter minimizing.
sentences.zh: 我们给出了每个维数 n ≥ 3 中数值形式的 Riemann Penrose 不等式的详细共形流证明，适用于标量曲率非负、完整紧致边界既在外侧极小又局部周长极小的完备渐近平坦外部区域。

sentences.en: The metric extends smoothly through the possibly singular frontier; neither spin nor frontier connectedness is assumed.
sentences.zh: 度量光滑地延伸穿过可能奇异的边界；既不假设自旋性，也不假设边界连通。

sentences.en: The proof follows the conformal-flow approach of Bray, Bray–Lee, and Bi–Zhu.
sentences.zh: 该证明沿用了 Bray、Bray–Lee 和 Bi–Zhu 的共形流方法。

sentences.en: Equality in the spacetime Penrose inequality identifies the original initial data as a spacelike slice of a Schwarzschild–Tangherlini exterior, smoothly attached to its horizon, under the stated outermostness and decay hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 在所述最外层及衰减假设下，时空 Penrose 不等式中的等号将原始初始数据识别为 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 外部区域的一个类空切片，且该切片在其视界处光滑拼接。

sentences.en: We prove this in every spatial dimension n ≥ 3 for a strong-decay exterior class and for weaker decay in dimensions three and four.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个空间维数 n ≥ 3 中对一个强衰减外部区域类别证明了这一结论，并在三维和四维中对较弱衰减也证明了它。

sentences.en: In dimension three the finite-component theorem forces a single spherical horizon and gives qualitative strictness for disconnected boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在三维中，有限分支定理迫使视界为单个球面，并对不连通边界给出定性的严格不等式。

sentences.en: We construct graph and conformal deformations of trapped initial-data exteriors in three and four spatial dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们在三维和四维空间中构造了捕获初始数据外部区域的图像变形和共形变形。

sentences.en: The resulting metrics have nonnegative scalar curvature, strictly negative inner mean curvature, a lower bound protecting every enclosing cut, and an arbitrarily small upper error in ADM energy.
sentences.zh: 所得度量具有非负标量曲率、严格为负的内侧平均曲率、保障每个包围截面的下界，以及任意小的 ADM 能量上侧误差。

sentences.en: We also give a direct four-dimensional maximal vacuum construction that retains a noncompact decaying second fundamental form.
sentences.zh: 我们还给出了一个直接的四维极大真空构造，它保留了一个支撑非紧的衰减第二基本形式。

sentences.en: These constructions give boundary routes to the corresponding numerical Penrose inequalities.
sentences.zh: 这些构造给出了通向相应数值形式的 Penrose 不等式的边界方法。

sentences.en: We replace a three-dimensional Cha–Khuri–Sakovich hyperboloidal end by an asymptotically flat end while preserving the dominant energy condition and each fixed compact interior.
sentences.zh: 我们将三维 Cha–Khuri–Sakovich 双曲面端替换为渐近平坦端，同时保留主导能量条件和每个固定的紧致内部区域。

sentences.en: For strictly future-timelike CKS initial-data charge, the replacements lose asymptotically no enclosing area and their ADM masses tend to the invariant Bondi mass.
sentences.zh: 当 CKS 初始数据荷严格为未来类时时，这些替换渐近地不损失包围面积，且其 ADM 质量趋于不变 Bondi 质量。

sentences.en: Combining this construction with the companion numerical spacetime Penrose theorem yields the sharp Bondi bound for possibly disconnected weakly future trapped boundaries in this class.
sentences.zh: 将这一构造与配套的数值形式的时空 Penrose 定理相结合，可得到这一类别中可能不连通的弱未来捕获边界的最优 Bondi 界。

sentences.en: Horizon-regular Schwarzschild exteriors attain equality at every positive mass.
sentences.zh: 在视界处正则的 Schwarzschild 外部区域对每个正质量都达到等号。

sentences.en: For each fixed dimension d ≥ 3 and each fixed sufficiently small positive disorder strength, we prove that the Anderson operator on ℤd with independent uniform site potentials almost surely has purely absolutely continuous spectrum with nonzero weight on an open energy interval.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定维数 d ≥ 3 和每个固定且充分小的正无序强度，我们证明，ℤd 上具有独立均匀格点势的 Anderson 算子几乎必然在一个开能量区间上具有权重非零的纯绝对连续谱。

sentences.en: The interval may depend on d but is independent of the disorder strength.
sentences.zh: 该区间可以依赖于 d，但与无序强度无关。

sentences.en: This settles the purely absolutely continuous energy-range question in Simon's Problem 1 for this model.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Simon 第 1 个问题中关于该模型的纯绝对连续能量范围的问题。

sentences.en: For each fixed positive disorder strength, we prove that the nearest-neighbor Anderson operator on the square lattice with independent uniform site potentials almost surely has pure-point spectral type throughout its spectrum.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的正无序强度，我们证明，方格上具有独立均匀格点势的最近邻 Anderson 算子几乎必然在其整个谱上都具有纯点谱型。

sentences.en: This resolves the pure-point assertion of the two-dimensional Anderson localization conjecture for the uniform single-site law.
sentences.zh: 这解决了均匀单格点分布情形下二维 Anderson 局域化猜想的纯点谱断言。

sentences.en: We classify all equality cases in the sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequality for every finite matrix size and $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们对每个有限矩阵大小和 $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$，分类了最优一维 Lieb–Thirring 不等式中的所有等号情形。

sentences.en: For measurable Hermitian positive semidefinite potentials W with $`\int_\mathbb R\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$, equality holds precisely for direct sums, in one constant unitary basis, of scalar one-bound-state solitons and zero channels.
sentences.zh: 对于满足 $`\int_\mathbb R\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$ 的可测 Hermitian 半正定势 W，等号恰好在下述情形成立：在同一个不随位置变化的酉基下，势为标量单束缚态孤子与零通道的直和。

sentences.en: The nonzero solitons may have independent scales and centers.
sentences.zh: 非零孤子的尺度和中心可以彼此独立。

sentences.en: We prove the sharp one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring inequality for every finite matrix size and every exponent $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了每个有限矩阵大小和每个指数 $`1/2\lt \gamma\lt 3/2`$ 的最优一维 Lieb–Thirring 不等式。

sentences.en: The optimal constant is the scalar one-bound-state constant, independently of the matrix size.
sentences.zh: 最优常数就是标量单束缚态常数，与矩阵大小无关。

sentences.en: The inequality bounds the full sum of negative eigenvalue moments for every measurable Hermitian positive semidefinite potential W satisfying $`\int_\mathbb R\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$.
sentences.zh: 对于每个满足 $`\int_\mathbb R\mathop{\mathrm{tr}}\nolimits (W^{\gamma+1/2})\lt \infty`$ 的可测 Hermitian 半正定势 W，该不等式给出了全部负特征值矩之和的界。

sentences.en: The matrices may have arbitrary rank and need not commute at different points.
sentences.zh: 这些矩阵的秩可以任意，且不同点处的矩阵不必交换。

sentences.en: We resolve affirmatively the remaining cases of the scalar one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring conjecture: for every $`\frac12\lt \gamma\lt \frac32`$, the optimal constant is the one-bound-state constant.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定地解决了标量一维 Lieb–Thirring 猜想的剩余情形：对每个 $`\frac12\lt \gamma\lt \frac32`$，最优常数都是单束缚态常数。

sentences.en: The estimate holds for every nonnegative potential in $`L^{\gamma+1/2}(\mathbb R)`$, with all negative eigenvalues included.
sentences.zh: 该估计对 $`L^{\gamma+1/2}(\mathbb R)`$ 中的每个非负势均成立，并包括所有负特征值。

sentences.en: We prove that a molecule with M fixed nuclei of real charges at least one and total nuclear charge Z strictly binds at most $`Z+CM`$ electrons, where C is universal.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，具有 M 个固定原子核、各核实电荷至少为一且总核电荷为 Z 的分子，至多严格束缚 $`Z+CM`$ 个电子，其中 C 是普适常数。

sentences.en: The result holds for the full nonrelativistic Coulomb Hamiltonian with two spin states and arbitrary distinct nuclear positions.
sentences.zh: 该结果适用于具有两个自旋态及任意互异核位置的完整非相对论 Coulomb Hamilton 算子。

sentences.en: For neutral atoms with integer nuclear charge Z ≥ 1, the first ionization energy and, for every ground state, the radius outside which one half of an electron remains are each bounded above and below by positive universal constants.
sentences.zh: 对于整数核电荷 Z ≥ 1 的中性原子，第一电离能，以及每个基态下其外侧剩余半个电子的半径，都分别以正的普适常数为上界和下界。

sentences.en: We prove the energy part of the generalized ionization conjecture for full nonrelativistic Coulomb atoms with two electron spin states.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有两个电子自旋态的完整非相对论 Coulomb 原子的广义电离猜想中的能量部分。

sentences.en: The energy needed to remove m electrons is asymptotic to $`a_{\mathrm{TF}}m^{7/3}`$ whenever $`m\to\infty`$ and $`Z/m\to\infty`$, with the Thomas–Fermi constant in atomic units.
sentences.zh: 只要 $`m\to\infty`$ 且 $`Z/m\to\infty`$，移走 m 个电子所需的能量就渐近等于 $`a_{\mathrm{TF}}m^{7/3}`$，其中采用原子单位制下的 Thomas–Fermi 常数。

sentences.en: We also obtain both conjectured iterated limits.
sentences.zh: 我们还得到了所猜想的两个迭代极限。

sentences.en: We prove the radius part of the generalized ionization conjecture for neutral nonrelativistic Coulomb atoms with two spin states.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有两个自旋态的中性非相对论 Coulomb 原子的广义电离猜想中的半径部分。

sentences.en: For every choice of ground states, the upper and lower large-nuclear-charge limits of the radius defined by an expected exterior electron mass m are both asymptotic to $`(81\pi^2/2)^{1/3}m^{-1/3}`$ as m tends to infinity.
sentences.zh: 对于基态的每一种选择，由外部电子密度的期望积分量 m 定义的半径，其在核电荷趋于无穷时的上极限和下极限，在 m 趋于无穷时都渐近等于 $`(81\pi^2/2)^{1/3}m^{-1/3}`$。

sentences.en: For each fixed rotating subextremal Kerr background with mass M > 0 and rotation $`0\lt |\mathfrak a|\lt M`$, we prove that the smooth vacuum data near its complete two-ended bridge whose full maximal globally hyperbolic development admits a future $`C^0\cap W^{1,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}`$ extension form a meagre set in the weighted smooth topology.
sentences.zh: 对于每个质量为 M > 0、旋转参数为 $`0\lt |\mathfrak a|\lt M`$ 的固定旋转次极端 Kerr 背景，我们证明，在其完整双端桥附近，使整个极大全局双曲发展具有未来 $`C^0\cap W^{1,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}`$ 延拓的光滑真空数据，在加权光滑拓扑中构成第一纲集。

sentences.en: The extension metric is continuous and nondegenerate, and its weak connection is locally square-integrable.
sentences.zh: 延拓度量是连续且非退化的，其弱联络局部平方可积。

sentences.en: The neighborhood requires smallness of only the tenth weighted seminorm, while the topology tests every finite order.
sentences.zh: 该邻域仅要求第十个加权半范数足够小，而拓扑则检验每个有限阶。

sentences.en: For each fixed Kerr spacetime with mass M > 0 and rotation $`0\lt \mathfrak a\lt M`$, we prove that a dense Gδ set of nearby smooth, complete two-ended vacuum data has a maximal globally hyperbolic development with no future C1 extension.
sentences.zh: 对于每个质量为 M > 0、旋转参数为 $`0\lt \mathfrak a\lt M`$ 的固定 Kerr 时空，我们证明，附近的光滑完备双端真空数据的一个稠密 Gδ 集，其极大全局双曲发展没有未来 C1 延拓。

sentences.en: The neighborhood and genericity are defined in a weighted smooth topology, and ambient extensions may be nonvacuum.
sentences.zh: 邻域和一般性是在加权光滑拓扑中定义的，而环境延拓可以是真空以外的。

sentences.en: For every fixed rotating subextremal Kerr bridge, we prove that smooth vacuum data admitting a C2 future extension of their full maximal globally hyperbolic development form a meagre set in a neighborhood defined by one finite-order seminorm.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的旋转次极端 Kerr 桥，我们证明，在由一个有限阶半范数定义的邻域中，使整个极大全局双曲发展具有 C2 未来延拓的光滑真空数据构成第一纲集。

sentences.en: The topology allows arbitrary symbol-bounded asymptotically flat tails and imposes no symmetry.
sentences.zh: 该拓扑允许任意满足符号界的渐近平坦尾部，且不施加任何对称性条件。

sentences.en: We prove an entropy area law for the unique ground state of a finite-range Hamiltonian on any finite induced subgraph of the square lattice.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了方格的任意有限诱导子图上的有限程 Hamilton 算子的唯一基态所满足的熵面积律。

sentences.en: A lower bound on the spectral gap of the full Hamiltonian and fixed bounds on the local dimension, interaction range, and interaction strength suffice.
sentences.zh: 只需完整 Hamilton 算子的谱隙下界，以及局部维数、相互作用范围和相互作用强度的固定界。

sentences.en: For every set of sites, its entanglement entropy is bounded by a constant times the number of edges crossing its boundary, independently of the size and shape of the domain.
sentences.zh: 对于每个格点集合，其纠缠熵以穿过其边界的边数的一个常数倍为界，与区域的大小和形状无关。

sentences.en: We prove that the unique ground state of a uniformly gapped nearest-neighbor Hamiltonian on an $`L\times L`$ square lattice admits a projected entangled-pair state approximation with bond dimension polynomial in L and global vector error at most L−1 after normalization.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，$`L\times L`$ 方格上具有一致谱隙的最近邻 Hamilton 算子的唯一基态，具有一个投影纠缠对态近似，其键维数关于 L 为多项式，且归一化后的全局向量误差至多为 L−1。

sentences.en: Only the gap of the full Hamiltonian is assumed.
sentences.zh: 仅假设完整 Hamilton 算子的谱隙。

sentences.en: The result is an existence theorem, with constants uniform over Hamiltonians of fixed local dimension, interaction strength, and gap.
sentences.zh: 该结果是一个存在性定理，其中的常数对于局部维数、相互作用强度和谱隙固定的 Hamilton 算子一致成立。

sentences.en: We prove that the maximum number of mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in ℂ<sup>6</sup> is three, resolving Zauner's dimension-six MUB conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，ℂ<sup>6</sup> 中相互无偏的标准正交基的最大数目为三，从而解决了 Zauner 的六维 MUB 猜想。

sentences.en: The upper bound is computer-assisted: under the stated binary64 arithmetic and compiler conditions, a complete execution of the documented verification pipeline excludes four arbitrary complex bases.
sentences.zh: 该上界的证明由计算机辅助完成：在所述 binary64 算术及编译器条件下，完整执行有文档说明的验证流程，就能排除四个任意的复基。

sentences.en: We prove the Fourier-vanishing conjecture of Matolcsi, Ruzsa, and Weiner: every complex Hadamard matrix of order six outside Tao's cubic equivalence class has a vanishing character sum at every permutation of $`(1,1,1,-1,-1,-1)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Matolcsi、Ruzsa 和 Weiner 的 Fourier 消失猜想：每个不属于 Tao 的 cubic 等价类的六阶复 Hadamard 矩阵，其特征标和在 $`(1,1,1,-1,-1,-1)`$ 的每个置换处都为零。

sentences.en: We also give an exact certificate excluding seven mutually unbiased bases in ℂ<sup>6</sup>; by Weiner's completion theorem, this yields an upper bound of five.
sentences.zh: 我们还给出了一个排除 ℂ<sup>6</sup> 中七个相互无偏基的精确证书；由 Weiner 的补全定理，这给出了五的上界。

sentences.en: Both certificates use only integer and rational arithmetic, and the complete verifier is included.
sentences.zh: 这两个证书都仅使用整数和有理数算术，并附有完整的验证程序。

sentences.en: We prove Bose–Einstein condensation at positive temperature in the three-dimensional dilute hard-sphere gas.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维稀薄硬球气体在正温度下的 Bose–Einstein 凝聚。

sentences.en: For each fixed exclusion distance and every sufficiently small fixed density, there is a strictly positive temperature, independent of the volume, at which the exact canonical Gibbs state has a positive condensate fraction in the thermodynamic limit.
sentences.zh: 对于每个固定的排斥距离和每个充分小的固定密度，都存在一个与体积无关的严格正温度，使该温度下精确的正则 Gibbs 态在热力学极限中具有正的凝聚比例。

sentences.en: The condensate occupies the constant orbital.
sentences.zh: 凝聚体占据常数轨道。

sentences.en: We prove the full scaled Bogoliubov momentum distribution for the depleted particles in the three-dimensional hard-sphere Bose gas at zero temperature.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了零温下三维硬球 Bose 气体中耗尽粒子的完整标度化 Bogoliubov 动量分布。

sentences.en: The thermodynamic limit is taken at each fixed density before the dilute limit, uniformly over all pure and mixed ground states.
sentences.zh: 在取稀薄极限之前，先在每个固定密度下取热力学极限，且关于所有纯基态和混合基态一致成立。

sentences.en: All thermodynamic accumulation values have the same dilute asymptotic: the limiting nonzero-momentum occupation measure has total mass $`8/(3\sqrt\pi)`$, giving the depletion fraction $`\frac{8}{3\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\rho a^3}+o(\sqrt{\rho a^3})`$ for density ρ and hard-sphere exclusion distance a.
sentences.zh: 所有热力学聚值都具有相同的稀薄渐近行为：极限非零动量占据测度的总质量为 $`8/(3\sqrt\pi)`$，从而在密度为 ρ、硬球排斥距离为 a 时给出耗尽比例 $`\frac{8}{3\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\rho a^3}+o(\sqrt{\rho a^3})`$。

sentences.en: We prove the Bogoliubov quantum-depletion asymptotic for the ground state of a three-dimensional Bose gas with a fixed bounded, nonnegative, radial interaction of finite range and positive scattering length a.
sentences.zh: 对于具有固定的有界、非负、径向、有限程相互作用且散射长度 a 为正的三维 Bose 气体，我们证明了其基态的 Bogoliubov 量子耗尽渐近式。

sentences.en: The thermodynamic limit is taken at each fixed density ρ before the dilute limit.
sentences.zh: 在取稀薄极限之前，先在每个固定密度 ρ 下取热力学极限。

sentences.en: Every thermodynamic accumulation value of the fraction outside the constant mode is $`\frac{8}{3\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\rho a^3}+o(\sqrt{\rho a^3})`$ as $`\rho\downarrow0`$.
sentences.zh: 当 $`\rho\downarrow0`$ 时，常数模之外的粒子比例的每个热力学聚值均为 $`\frac{8}{3\sqrt\pi}\sqrt{\rho a^3}+o(\sqrt{\rho a^3})`$。

sentences.en: The assertion is uniform over ground-state density matrices and does not require the occupation to have a unique thermodynamic limit.
sentences.zh: 该断言关于基态密度矩阵一致成立，且不要求占据数具有唯一的热力学极限。

sentences.en: For each fixed bounded measurable, nonnegative, radial interaction of finite range in three dimensions that is not zero almost everywhere, we prove a positive lower bound on the constant-orbital condensate fraction that is uniform over all sufficiently small densities and all temperatures between zero and the square of the density.
sentences.zh: 对三维中每个固定的、有界可测、非负、径向、有限作用程且并非几乎处处为零的相互作用，我们证明常数轨道凝聚比例有一个正下界，该下界对所有充分小的密度以及零与密度平方之间的所有温度一致成立。

sentences.en: The interaction and density remain fixed in the thermodynamic limit.
sentences.zh: 取热力学极限时，相互作用和密度保持固定。

sentences.en: We prove Bose–Einstein condensation in every ground state of a dilute three-dimensional hard-sphere Bose gas.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，稀薄三维硬球 Bose 气体的每个基态都发生 Bose–Einstein 凝聚。

sentences.en: At every sufficiently small fixed gas parameter, the constant orbital contains a positive fraction of the particles in the thermodynamic limit.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分小的固定气体参数，在热力学极限中，常数轨道包含占总粒子数正比例的粒子。

sentences.en: The fraction can be chosen independently of the gas parameter, and the conclusion holds for arbitrary complex ground states.
sentences.zh: 该比例可以选得与气体参数无关，且结论对任意复值基态成立。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform positive spectral gap for the pure antiferromagnetic spin-one Heisenberg chain on even periodic rings, establishing the positive even-periodic formulation of the spin-one Haldane conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，偶数长度周期环上的纯反铁磁自旋一 Heisenberg 链具有一致的正谱隙，从而确立自旋一 Haldane 猜想的正能隙偶数长度周期版本。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform spectral gap for odd open spin-one antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chains with the same fixed magnetic field at both endpoints.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，两端施加相同固定磁场的奇数长度开放自旋一反铁磁 Heisenberg 链具有一致谱隙。

sentences.en: The field $`h=3/5`$ gives a gap greater than $`\log(10)/392`$ on every chain of $`2L+1`$ sites with L ≥ 960.
sentences.zh: 磁场 $`h=3/5`$ 使每条具有 $`2L+1`$ 个格点且 L ≥ 960 的链的谱隙都大于 $`\log(10)/392`$。

sentences.en: Tasaki's index theorem then gives index −1 for every subsequential local limit of these boundary-selected ground states.
sentences.zh: 随后，Tasaki 的指标定理给出，这些由边界选定的基态的每个子序列局部极限的指标均为 −1。

sentences.en: We prove that the fermionic Laughlin V1 Hamiltonian at filling 1/3 on expanding round spheres retains a unique ground state and a uniform spectral gap under sufficiently weak bounded real scalar one-body potentials projected to the lowest Landau level.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在不断扩大的圆球面上，填充率为 1/3 的费米型 Laughlin V1 Hamiltonian 在投影到最低 Landau 能级的、充分弱的有界实标量单体势作用下，仍保有唯一基态和一致谱隙。

sentences.en: With coefficient one for each pair projector and Laughlin flux $`q=3(N-1)`$, the gap and perturbation threshold are uniform for all sufficiently large particle numbers and all potential profiles of supremum norm at most one.
sentences.zh: 当每个粒子对投影算子的系数为一、Laughlin 通量为 $`q=3(N-1)`$ 时，该谱隙和微扰阈值对所有充分大的粒子数以及上确界范数至多为一的所有势函数轮廓一致成立。

sentences.en: The result uses the uniform unperturbed Fock-space gap and gives existential constants.
sentences.zh: 该结果使用未扰动 Fock 空间上的一致谱隙，并给出常数的存在性。

sentences.en: We prove the spherical fermionic Laughlin spectral-gap conjecture for the full V1 interaction.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了完整 V1 相互作用下的球面费米型 Laughlin 谱隙猜想。

sentences.en: With coefficient one for each pair projector, the gap above the Laughlin state at filling 1/3 on the round sphere is at least 1/25 for all sufficiently large systems.
sentences.zh: 当每个粒子对投影算子的系数为一时，对所有充分大的系统，圆球面上填充率为 1/3 的 Laughlin 态上方的谱隙至少为 1/25。

sentences.en: More generally, $`H_Q^2\ge\gamma H_Q`$ for some fixed $`\gamma\gt 1/25`$ on the entire lowest-Landau-level Fock space for all sufficiently large flux Q, independently of particle number.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，存在某个固定的 $`\gamma\gt 1/25`$，使得对所有充分大的通量 Q，整个最低 Landau 能级 Fock 空间上均有 $`H_Q^2\ge\gamma H_Q`$，且与粒子数无关。

sentences.en: For every finite N ≥ 2, we prove that undeformed $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (N)`$ BFSS matrix quantum mechanics has exactly one normalizable zero-energy state after removing the center of mass.
sentences.zh: 对每个有限的 N ≥ 2，我们证明，未形变的 $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (N)`$ BFSS 矩阵量子力学在去除质心后恰有一个可归一化的零能态。

sentences.en: This establishes the threshold-bound-state conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这确立了阈值束缚态猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that the relative $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (2)`$ BFSS Hamiltonian has infinitely many positive eigenvalues tending to infinity, with square-integrable eigenvectors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，相对 $`\mathop{\mathrm{SU}}\nolimits (2)`$ BFSS Hamiltonian 具有无穷多个趋于无穷大的正特征值，并具有平方可积的特征向量。

sentences.en: The operator is defined by closing the gauge-invariant supercharge form.
sentences.zh: 该算子通过对规范不变的超荷型取闭包来定义。

sentences.en: This refutes, at N = 2, the exclusion of normalizable positive-energy states stated in the original BFSS paper.
sentences.zh: 这在 N = 2 时反驳了 BFSS 原始论文中关于不存在可归一化正能态的论断。

sentences.en: We prove Bloch's T3/2 law for the spontaneous magnetization of three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnets at every fixed positive quantum spin.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对每个固定的正量子自旋，三维量子 Heisenberg 铁磁体的自发磁化强度满足 Bloch 的 T3/2 定律。

sentences.en: The result holds for every nonnegative symmetric finite-range interaction whose support generates ℤ<sup>3</sup>, including spatially anisotropic couplings.
sentences.zh: 该结果对支集生成 ℤ<sup>3</sup> 的每个非负对称有限作用程相互作用成立，包括空间各向异性的耦合。

sentences.en: The leading magnetization deficit has the exact coefficient determined by the determinant of the quadratic one-magnon dispersion.
sentences.zh: 磁化强度亏损的主项具有由二次单磁振子色散的行列式所确定的精确系数。

sentences.en: The thermodynamic limit is taken before the right field derivative at zero, and the low-temperature limit is taken last.
sentences.zh: 先取热力学极限，再取零场处关于磁场的右导数，最后取低温极限。

sentences.en: We prove the first lattice correction to Bloch's law for the three-dimensional nearest-neighbor quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet at every fixed spin $`S=\tfrac12,1,\tfrac32,\ldots`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对每个固定自旋 $`S=\tfrac12,1,\tfrac32,\ldots`$，三维最近邻量子 Heisenberg 铁磁体的 Bloch 定律具有首个晶格修正项。

sentences.en: The spontaneous-magnetization deficit agrees with the full ideal-magnon density up to $`o(\beta^{-5/2})`$.
sentences.zh: 自发磁化强度亏损与完整理想磁振子密度之差为 $`o(\beta^{-5/2})`$。

sentences.en: In addition to the leading Bloch term, this gives the correction $`3\zeta(5/2)(\beta S)^{-5/2}/(128\pi^{3/2})`$.
sentences.zh: 除 Bloch 主项之外，这给出了修正项 $`3\zeta(5/2)(\beta S)^{-5/2}/(128\pi^{3/2})`$。

sentences.en: The magnetization is the right derivative at zero field of the thermodynamic pressure; the volume limit precedes the field derivative, and the low-temperature limit is taken last.
sentences.zh: 磁化强度是热力学压强在零场处关于磁场的右导数；先取体积极限，再取磁场导数，最后取低温极限。

sentences.en: We prove the spherical magnetization law for the three-dimensional nearest-neighbor isotropic quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet at every fixed positive quantum spin and every sufficiently low fixed positive temperature.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对每个固定的正量子自旋以及每个充分低的固定正温度，三维最近邻各向同性量子 Heisenberg 铁磁体满足球面磁化分布律。

sentences.en: As the even periodic cubes grow, the symmetric zero-field magnetization converges in moments to a uniform direction with a deterministic positive magnitude.
sentences.zh: 随着偶数边长周期立方体增大，对称的零场磁化强度依矩收敛到方向均匀分布、大小为确定正常数的极限。

sentences.en: This magnitude equals the right derivative at zero field of the infinite-volume pressure.
sentences.zh: 这一大小等于无限体积压强在零场处关于磁场的右导数。

sentences.en: The law is expressed through self-adjoint linear combinations of the spin components and requires no joint measurement of noncommuting observables.
sentences.zh: 该分布律通过自旋分量的自伴线性组合表述，无须对不对易的可观测量进行联合测量。

sentences.en: For every dimension d ≥ 3 and every spin $`S\in\{\frac12,1,\frac32,\ldots\}`$, we prove that the nearest-neighbor isotropic quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet has a translation-invariant, spontaneously magnetized equilibrium state at every sufficiently low positive temperature.
sentences.zh: 对每个维数 d ≥ 3 和每个自旋 $`S\in\{\frac12,1,\frac32,\ldots\}`$，我们证明，最近邻各向同性量子 Heisenberg 铁磁体在每个充分低的正温度下都具有平移不变且自发磁化的平衡态。

sentences.en: The same state satisfies the KMS condition for the zero-field dynamics and has magnetization at least $`S/4`$.
sentences.zh: 同一状态满足零场动力学的 KMS 条件，且磁化强度至少为 $`S/4`$。

sentences.en: This resolves the low-temperature ordering problem in the spontaneous-magnetization formulation.
sentences.zh: 这解决了以自发磁化表述的低温有序问题。

sentences.en: We construct an entangled state on $`\mathbb C^{10}\otimes\mathbb C^{10}`$ with zero distillable secret key for the local-instrument protocols specified here.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $`\mathbb C^{10}\otimes\mathbb C^{10}`$ 上构造了一个纠缠态，对于本文指定的局部量子仪器协议，其可蒸馏秘密密钥为零。

sentences.en: They allow joint processing of all copies and unlimited two-way public communication, with the input as the only shared private resource and an eavesdropper holding a purification and the complete public record.
sentences.zh: 这些协议允许联合处理全部副本以及无限制的双向公开通信，其中输入是唯一共享的私有资源，而窃听者持有一个纯化及全部公开记录。

sentences.en: The construction also disproves the unrestricted two-map PPT-composition conjecture.
sentences.zh: 该构造还反驳了不加限制的两个映射的 PPT 复合猜想。

sentences.en: A separate trace-preserving PPT channel on $`M_{21}(\mathbb C)`$ has a square that is not entanglement breaking.
sentences.zh: 另外，$`M_{21}(\mathbb C)`$ 上存在一个保迹 PPT 信道，其平方不是纠缠破坏信道。

sentences.en: We prove the entropy photon-number inequality for two independent bosonic inputs with finite mean energy, for every finite number of modes.
sentences.zh: 对每个有限的模式数，我们证明了两个独立、平均能量有限的玻色输入的熵光子数不等式。
