sentences.en: This resolves the entropy photon-number conjecture in this finite-energy setting while allowing arbitrary entanglement among the modes within either input.
sentences.zh: 这解决了有限能量情形下的熵光子数猜想，同时允许任一输入内部的各模式之间存在任意纠缠。

sentences.en: As a consequence, we determine the exact minimum output entropy at fixed input entropy for every finite tensor power of an identical thermal attenuator, over finite-energy inputs that may be entangled across modes.
sentences.zh: 作为推论，对同一个热衰减信道的每个有限张量幂，我们在允许模式间纠缠的有限能量输入中，确定了固定输入熵时的精确最小输出熵。

sentences.en: We also obtain the exact classical capacity region of the degraded two-receiver pure-loss bosonic broadcast channel under a mean photon constraint.
sentences.zh: 我们还得到，平均光子数约束下退化的双接收者纯损耗玻色广播信道的精确经典容量区域。

sentences.en: We prove that constant-depth quantum circuits with arbitrary one-qubit and unbounded-arity Toffoli gates cannot compute parity with any fixed positive worst-case advantage using polynomially many qubits.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，由任意单量子比特门和元数无界的 Toffoli 门组成的常数深度量子电路，在仅使用多项式数量量子比特时，无法以任何固定的正最坏情形优势计算奇偶性。

sentences.en: Ancillas start in zero, only one output qubit is measured, and all final garbage is unrestricted.
sentences.zh: 辅助量子比特初始为零，只测量一个输出量子比特，所有最终垃圾信息均不受限制。

sentences.en: This resolves Moore's parity conjecture in the measured-output model.
sentences.zh: 这解决了测量输出模型中的 Moore 奇偶性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that constant-depth quantum circuits with arbitrary one-qubit gates and unbounded-arity Toffoli gates cannot compute parity with any fixed positive worst-case advantage using polynomially many total qubits.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，由任意单量子比特门和元数无界的 Toffoli 门组成的常数深度量子电路，在量子比特总数为多项式数量时，无法以任何固定的正最坏情形优势计算奇偶性。

sentences.en: Ancillary qubits are initialized to $`|0\rangle`$, one output qubit is measured, and all other final registers may be discarded without restriction.
sentences.zh: 辅助量子比特初始化为 $`|0\rangle`$，测量一个输出量子比特，其他所有最终寄存器均可不受限制地丢弃。

sentences.en: This resolves Moore's parity conjecture in the measured-output model.
sentences.zh: 这解决了测量输出模型中的 Moore 奇偶性猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that approximating the electronic Coulomb spectral infimum in three-dimensional space is QMA-hard when positive integer nuclear charges are encoded in binary.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，当正整数核电荷采用二进制编码时，近似三维空间中电子 Coulomb 谱的下确界是 QMA 困难的。

sentences.en: The nuclei have distinct rational positions, the electron number is unary, and the energy is minimized over all antisymmetric continuum states and spin sectors.
sentences.zh: 各原子核位于互不相同的有理坐标位置，电子数采用一进制编码，能量在所有反对称连续空间状态与自旋扇区上取最小值。

sentences.en: A deterministic classical polynomial-time reduction produces instances with threshold separation at least one.
sentences.zh: 一个确定性的经典多项式时间归约生成阈值间隔至少为一的实例。

sentences.en: The nuclear charges may be exponentially large, but every output has polynomial bit length.
sentences.zh: 核电荷可以达到指数级大小，但每个输出的比特长度均为多项式量级。

sentences.en: We prove that approximating the electronic ground-energy infimum for clamped unit-charge nuclei is QMA-hard on the full spinful fermionic continuum space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在完整的带自旋费米子连续空间上，近似固定单位电荷原子核的电子基态能量下确界是 QMA 困难的。

sentences.en: A deterministic classical polynomial-time reduction produces polynomially many nuclei at distinct rational positions and polynomially many electrons, with polynomial rational bit lengths and threshold separation at least one.
sentences.zh: 一个确定性的经典多项式时间归约生成多项式数量的原子核和电子，其中原子核处于互不相同的有理坐标位置，有理数的比特长度为多项式量级，且阈值间隔至少为一。

sentences.en: No orbital basis, magnetic field, or additional external potential is supplied, and no binding assumption is imposed.
sentences.zh: 输入中不提供轨道基、磁场或附加外势，也不施加束缚假设。

sentences.en: We determine the unassisted classical capacity of every qubit generalized amplitude-damping channel, for all damping strengths and thermal occupations.
sentences.zh: 我们对所有阻尼强度和热占据数，确定每个量子比特广义振幅阻尼信道的无辅助经典容量。

sentences.en: It equals the one-shot Holevo capacity and is given by a one-variable maximum.
sentences.zh: 它等于单次 Holevo 容量，并由一个单变量最大值给出。

sentences.en: A binary pure-state ensemble attains the one-use optimum, and its independent products attain the optimum at every block length.
sentences.zh: 一个二元纯态系综达到单次使用时的最优值，其独立乘积则在每个块长度上达到最优值。

sentences.en: We also prove that one-shot Holevo capacity, minimum output entropy, and regularized unassisted classical capacity are additive under tensor product with every finite-dimensional completely positive trace-preserving partner channel.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，单次 Holevo 容量、最小输出熵以及正则化的无辅助经典容量，在与每个有限维完全正保迹信道作张量积时均具有可加性。

sentences.en: For every finite two-player game with entangled value v < 1, we prove exponential decay for the probability of winning at least a $`v+\delta`$ fraction of k independent repetitions, uniformly over all finite-dimensional joint strategies.
sentences.zh: 对每个纠缠值为 v < 1 的有限双人博弈，我们证明，在 k 次独立重复中赢得至少 $`v+\delta`$ 比例的概率呈指数衰减，且这一结论对所有有限维联合策略一致成立。

sentences.en: The result allows arbitrary correlated question distributions and holds for every $`0\lt \delta\lt 1-v`$ and k ≥ 1.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许任意相关的问题分布，并对每个 $`0\lt \delta\lt 1-v`$ 以及 k ≥ 1 成立。

sentences.en: Its universal rate is proportional to $`\delta^5/(1+\log(|\mathcal A||\mathcal B|))`$, where $`\mathcal A,\mathcal B`$ are the answer alphabets.
sentences.zh: 其普适速率正比于 $`\delta^5/(1+\log(|\mathcal A||\mathcal B|))`$，其中 $`\mathcal A,\mathcal B`$ 为回答字母表。

sentences.en: For each fixed question distribution, we also obtain an explicit cubic rate in δ.
sentences.zh: 对每个固定的问题分布，我们还得到关于 δ 的一个显式三次速率。

sentences.en: We construct a finite three-electron Coulomb molecule whose spin-summed ground-state density cannot be reproduced by any ground-state ensemble of noninteracting electrons in a single real, spin-independent local potential in $`L^{3/2}(\mathbf R^3)+L^\infty(\mathbf R^3)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个有限的三电子 Coulomb 分子，其对自旋求和后的基态密度，无法由处于任何单一的、属于 $`L^{3/2}(\mathbf R^3)+L^\infty(\mathbf R^3)`$ 的实值且自旋无关局部势中的无相互作用电子的任何基态系综复现。

sentences.en: The molecule has two equal positive integer nuclear charges, specified by an exact finite nonnumerical formula.
sentences.zh: 该分子具有两个相等的正整数核电荷，它们由一个精确、有限、非数值的公式指定。

sentences.en: We give a polynomial-time uniform quantum circuit family that outputs the complete prime factorization of every integer N ≥ 2 with probability one.
sentences.zh: 我们给出一个多项式时间一致的量子电路族，它以概率一输出每个整数 N ≥ 2 的完整素因子分解。

sentences.en: A fixed finite set of bounded-arity gates suffices, and both the gate count and the number of qubits have polynomial worst-case bounds in the input length.
sentences.zh: 只需一个固定的、由有界元数门组成的有限门集，门数和量子比特数均具有关于输入长度的多项式最坏情形上界。

sentences.en: Every simple unitary strongly rational vertex operator algebra generates a completely rational conformal net.
sentences.zh: 每个单、酉、强有理的顶点算子代数都生成一个完全有理的共形网。

sentences.en: All its simple grading-restricted modules are unitarizable, its canonical fusion forms are positive, and the Carpi–Weiner–Xu functor gives a braided unitary tensor equivalence from its grading-restricted finite-length module category onto the finite-index sectors of the net.
sentences.zh: 它的所有单的分次受限模均可酉化，其典范融合形式为正，且 Carpi–Weiner–Xu 函子给出从其分次受限有限长度模范畴到该网的有限指标扇区的编织酉张量等价。

sentences.en: Gui's extension theorems then identify normalized irreducible finite-index local extensions of these nets with simple CFT-type conformal extensions of the vertex operator algebras.
sentences.zh: 随后，Gui 的扩张定理将这些网的归一化不可约有限指标局部扩张，与相应顶点算子代数的单 CFT 型共形扩张相对应。

sentences.en: We prove that the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) approaches the ground-state energy per spin of the Gaussian zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model when system size tends to infinity first and circuit depth then increases.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，先令系统大小趋于无穷，再增加电路深度时，量子近似优化算法（QAOA）趋近于高斯零场 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型的每自旋基态能量。

sentences.en: For every accuracy, some finite depth and deterministic angles, independent of system size and disorder, achieve that accuracy in the limiting expected energy per spin using the standard cost Hamiltonian and transverse-field mixer.
sentences.zh: 对每个精度要求，都存在某个有限深度和一组与系统大小及无序无关的确定性角度，使用标准代价 Hamiltonian 和横场混合器，使极限中的每自旋期望能量达到该精度。

sentences.en: This proves the eventual Parisi-optimality conjecture of Basso, Farhi, Marwaha, Villalonga, and Zhou in its fixed-parameter thermodynamic formulation.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Basso、Farhi、Marwaha、Villalonga 和 Zhou 的最终 Parisi 最优性猜想的固定参数热力学版本。

sentences.en: We give no quantitative bound on the required depth or efficient angle-selection procedure.
sentences.zh: 我们未给出所需深度的定量界，也未给出高效的角度选择程序。

sentences.en: We prove that every admissible integrable minimizer of the zero-temperature Parisi functional for the pure, zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model has full relative Stieltjes support on $`[0,1)`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，纯零场 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick 模型的零温 Parisi 泛函的每个容许可积极小元，在 $`[0,1)`$ 上均具有完整的相对 Stieltjes 支集。

sentences.en: Thus its support has no gaps at any overlap scale below one.
sentences.zh: 因此，其支集在低于一的任何重叠尺度上都没有空隙。

sentences.en: We use the covariance normalization $`\xi(t)=t^2/2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们采用协方差归一化 $`\xi(t)=t^2/2`$。

sentences.en: We prove that scale symmetry implies local conformal symmetry for a class of four-dimensional unitary, positive-energy quantum field theories with a Poincaré- and scale-invariant vacuum.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对一类具有 Poincaré 不变及尺度不变真空的四维酉正能量量子场论，尺度对称性蕴含局部共形对称性。

sentences.en: The class has a discrete, bounded-below spectrum of scaling dimensions with finite multiplicities, and each original field has finite scaling support.
sentences.zh: 这一类理论的标度维数谱离散、有下界且重数有限，每个原始场都具有有限的标度支集。

sentences.en: The original fields and their adjoints have compatible affiliated realizations in a causally commuting bounded local net, and a physical local dilatation current generates scale transformations through its local Ward identities.
sentences.zh: 原始场及其伴随在一个因果对易的有界局部网中具有相容的 affiliated 实现，而一个物理的局部伸缩流通过其局部 Ward 恒等式生成尺度变换。

sentences.en: The operational framework admits sharply localized reconstructed fields after their joint products and compatible affiliated realizations in the same net have been established.
sentences.zh: 在重构场的联合乘积以及在同一网中的相容 affiliated 实现得到确立后，这一操作框架允许严格局域化的重构场。

sentences.en: Under these hypotheses, the stress tensor admits a symmetric, conserved, traceless improvement with unchanged translation and Lorentz charges.
sentences.zh: 在这些假设下，应力张量容许一个对称、守恒、无迹的改进，且平移荷和 Lorentz 荷保持不变。

sentences.en: The corresponding conformal currents satisfy unbroken local Ward identities on the physical field algebra.
sentences.zh: 相应的共形流在物理场代数上满足未破缺的局部 Ward 恒等式。

sentences.en: The conclusion is local; integration to a global conformal action on the whole bounded net remains a separate question.
sentences.zh: 这一结论是局部的；将其积分为整个有界网上的全局共形作用，仍是一个独立问题。

sentences.en: We give a positive answer to the constant-error formulation of the Aaronson–Kuperberg unitary synthesis problem.
sentences.zh: 我们对 Aaronson–Kuperberg 酉算子合成问题的常数误差版本给出肯定回答。

sentences.en: For every n, a quantum oracle circuit generated in polynomial time from n alone can approximate the channel of every n-qubit unitary to full diamond-norm error at most 1/2, after a suitable Boolean oracle is chosen.
sentences.zh: 对每个 n，仅由 n 在多项式时间内生成的一个量子预言机电路，在选定适当的布尔预言机后，能够逼近每个 n 量子比特酉算子所对应的信道，使完整钻石范数误差至多为 1/2。

sentences.en: Using the fixed gates $`H,T,T^\dagger,\mathrm{CNOT}`$, the circuit has polynomially many qubits, elementary gates, and oracle calls, and its oracle queries have polynomial length.
sentences.zh: 该电路使用固定门 $`H,T,T^\dagger,\mathrm{CNOT}`$，其量子比特数、基本门数及预言机调用次数均为多项式数量，且预言机查询的长度为多项式量级。

sentences.en: The oracle may depend on the target unitary; the theorem does not give an efficient classical procedure for constructing it.
sentences.zh: 预言机可以依赖于目标酉算子；该定理未给出构造这一预言机的高效经典程序。

sentences.en: We construct total Boolean functions with a nearly quartic separation between bounded-error randomized and quantum query complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们构造全定义布尔函数，使其有界错误随机查询复杂度与量子查询复杂度之间具有近四次的分离。

sentences.en: Writing these complexities as $`\mathrm R(f)`$ and $`\mathrm Q(f)`$, the examples rule out every universal bound $`\mathrm R(f)=O((1+\mathrm Q(f))^\alpha)`$ with α < 4.
sentences.zh: 将这两种复杂度记作 $`\mathrm R(f)`$ 和 $`\mathrm Q(f)`$，这些例子排除了所有满足 α < 4 的普适界 $`\mathrm R(f)=O((1+\mathrm Q(f))^\alpha)`$。

sentences.en: Thus the known quartic upper bound has the optimal exponent, disproving the conjectured cubic bound.
sentences.zh: 因此，已知四次上界具有最优指数，从而反驳了所猜想的三次界。

sentences.en: Both complexities count worst-case bit queries with error at most 1/3 on every input.
sentences.zh: 两种复杂度均计算最坏情形下的比特查询次数，并要求每个输入上的错误概率至多为 1/3。

sentences.en: We disprove rational injectivity of the coefficient-free reduced Baum–Connes assembly map for torsion-free groups.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳了无挠群的无系数约化 Baum–Connes 装配映射的有理单射性。

sentences.en: Specifically, we construct a finitely generated torsion-free discrete group whose degree-zero assembly map has a kernel class of infinite order.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们构造一个有限生成的无挠离散群，其零次装配映射的核中含有一个无限阶类。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely generated torsion-free discrete group whose reduced group C∗-algebra contains a projection other than zero and the identity.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个有限生成的无挠离散群，其约化群 C∗ 代数包含不同于零和单位元的投影。

sentences.en: This disproves the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这反驳了 Kadison–Kaplansky 投影猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely generated discrete group whose reduced group C∗-algebra contains a projection of irrational canonical trace.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个有限生成的离散群，其约化群 C∗ 代数含有一个典范迹为无理数的投影。

sentences.en: Its K0-class lies outside the image of the coefficient-free reduced Baum–Connes assembly map.
sentences.zh: 它的 K0 类不在无系数约化 Baum–Connes 装配映射的像中。

sentences.en: This disproves the coefficient-free reduced Baum–Connes conjecture for countable discrete groups.
sentences.zh: 这反驳了可数离散群的无系数约化 Baum–Connes 猜想。

sentences.en: We prove arithmetic exhaustion for bifinite correspondences between arbitrarily scalar-twisted group factors of ICC groups commensurable with property-$`(T)`$ lattices over characteristic-zero local fields and twisted group factors of arbitrary countable ICC groups.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于与特征零局部域上的具有性质 $`(T)`$ 的格可公度的 ICC 群，其任意标量扭曲群因子与任意可数 ICC 群的扭曲群因子之间的双有限对应满足算术穷尽性。

sentences.en: Every such correspondence is a closed summand of a finite direct sum of models obtained from actual finite-index subgroup isomorphisms and finite-dimensional projective representations of the matched cocycle ratio.
sentences.zh: 每个这样的对应，都是由实际的有限指数子群同构以及匹配余循环之比的有限维射影表示所构造的模型的某个有限直和的闭直和项。

sentences.en: The proof includes reducible products, mixed real and finite places, and quaternionic and Cayley rank-one factors.
sentences.zh: 证明涵盖可约乘积、实位点与有限位点的混合，以及四元数和 Cayley 秩一因子。

sentences.en: We prove stable canonical recovery for scalar-twisted group factors of ICC groups commensurable with property-$`(T)`$ lattices over characteristic-zero local fields.
sentences.zh: 对于与特征零局部域上具有性质 $`(T)`$ 的格可公度的 ICC 群的标量扭曲群因子，我们证明稳定典范恢复定理。

sentences.en: Every specified stable isomorphism to a scalar-twisted factor of any countably infinite ICC group recovers the group, the cocycle up to a normalized cochain, and equal amplification scales, with an implementing partial isometry in the given matrix corners.
sentences.zh: 每个给定的、到任意可数无限 ICC 群的标量扭曲因子的稳定同构，都恢复出群、在归一化余链变换意义下的余循环，以及相等的放大尺度，并在给定的矩阵角代数中给出实现该同构的部分等距算子。

sentences.en: We compute the arithmetic correspondence subcategory for arbitrary countable ICC groups, including all bounded maps, summands, conjugates, and Connes fusion, and combine it with the companion's arithmetic exhaustion theorem.
sentences.zh: 我们对任意可数 ICC 群计算算术对应子范畴，包括全部有界映射、直和项、共轭及 Connes 融合，并将其与姊妹论文中的算术穷尽定理结合。

sentences.en: Multiplication also recovers arbitrary finite-index factor neighbors, with the exact projective condition on the matched cocycle ratio.
sentences.zh: 乘法还恢复任意有限指标的相邻因子，并给出匹配余循环之比所满足的精确射影条件。

sentences.en: We solve the free group factor isomorphism problem affirmatively by proving that $`L(\mathbb F_2)`$ and $`L(\mathbb F_3)`$ are isomorphic as tracial von Neumann algebras.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 $`L(\mathbb F_2)`$ 与 $`L(\mathbb F_3)`$ 作为带迹 von Neumann 代数同构，从而肯定地解决自由群因子的同构问题。

sentences.en: The classical free group factor alternative then implies that all interpolated free group factors, including $`L(\mathbb F_\infty)`$, are isomorphic and have fundamental group $`\mathbb R_{\gt 0}`$.
sentences.zh: 随后，经典的自由群因子二择一定理推出，所有插值自由群因子，包括 $`L(\mathbb F_\infty)`$，均彼此同构，且基本群为 $`\mathbb R_{\gt 0}`$。

sentences.en: We prove that every bounded complex-linear unital algebra homomorphism from a unital complex C∗-algebra into the bounded operators on an arbitrary Hilbert space is similar to a $`*`$-homomorphism.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，从任一有单位元的复 C∗ 代数到任意 Hilbert 空间上的有界算子代数的每个有界、复线性、保单位元代数同态，都相似于一个 $`*`$ 同态。

sentences.en: This resolves Kadison's similarity conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Kadison 相似性猜想。

sentences.en: We also obtain one universal hyperreflexivity constant for all unital von Neumann algebras on arbitrary complex Hilbert spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们还为任意复 Hilbert 空间上的所有有单位元 von Neumann 代数得到一个普适的超自反性常数。

sentences.en: We prove that sufficiently close unital von Neumann algebras are conjugate by a unitary arbitrarily close to the identity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，充分接近的有单位元 von Neumann 代数可由一个任意接近恒等算子的酉算子共轭。

sentences.en: The tolerance depends only on the prescribed distance of that unitary from the identity, uniformly over all algebras, representations, and Hilbert spaces.
sentences.zh: 允许的误差只依赖于预先指定的该酉算子与恒等算子之间的距离，并且对所有代数、表示和 Hilbert 空间一致。

sentences.en: This resolves the strong Kadison–Kastler conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了强 Kadison–Kastler 猜想。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to the unrestricted small-spatial-embedding problem for one-sided near inclusions of von Neumann algebras.
sentences.zh: 我们对 von Neumann 代数单侧近包含的不受限制的小空间嵌入问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: On separable complex Hilbert spaces, we construct pairs of unital von Neumann algebras with common identity whose one-sided gaps tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 在可分复 Hilbert 空间上，我们构造具有相同单位元的有单位元 von Neumann 代数对，使其单侧间隙趋于零。

sentences.en: Spatial embeddings of the source into the target exist, but every implementing unitary stays a fixed positive distance from the identity.
sentences.zh: 从源代数到目标代数的空间嵌入存在，但实现这些嵌入的每个酉算子与恒等算子之间的距离都保持在某个固定正下界之上。

sentences.en: The obstruction therefore concerns small implementing unitaries, rather than the existence of spatial embeddings.
sentences.zh: 因此，该障碍涉及的是接近恒等算子的实现酉算子，而非空间嵌入的存在性。

sentences.en: We disprove the separable C∗-algebraic spatial form of the Kadison–Kastler conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳 Kadison–Kastler 猜想的可分 C∗ 代数空间形式。

sentences.en: For every ε > 0, we construct unital, norm-separable C∗-algebras on a common separable complex Hilbert space, with the same identity and Kadison–Kastler distance less than ε, that are not conjugate by any unitary.
sentences.zh: 对每个 ε > 0，我们在同一可分复 Hilbert 空间上构造有单位元、范数可分的 C∗ 代数，使它们具有相同单位元，Kadison–Kastler 距离小于 ε，但不能由任何酉算子共轭。

sentences.en: The two algebras have the same von Neumann closure.
sentences.zh: 这两个代数具有相同的 von Neumann 闭包。

sentences.en: We prove that every inclusion $`N\subset M`$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals and a faithful normal conditional expectation contains an expected amenable subalgebra $`P\subset N`$ such that $`P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)`$, where $`c(M)`$ denotes the continuous core of M.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个具有可分预对偶及忠实正规条件期望的 von Neumann 代数包含关系 $`N\subset M`$，都包含一个带条件期望的可均子代数 $`P\subset N`$，使得 $`P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)`$，其中 $`c(M)`$ 表示 M 的连续核。

sentences.en: This resolves the relative bicentralizer conjecture in this setting.
sentences.zh: 这解决了此情形下的相对双中心化子猜想。

sentences.en: We prove a bounded spectral recovery theorem for a von Neumann algebra with a faithful normal state whose centralizer consists only of scalars.
sentences.zh: 对具有一个忠实正规态且该态的中心化子仅由标量组成的 von Neumann 代数，我们证明一个有界谱恢复定理。

sentences.en: A positive averaged squared norm for an arbitrary bounded Hilbert-space operator on shrinking modular spectral bands can be recovered on uniformly bounded algebra elements with shrinking spectral support.
sentences.zh: 任意有界 Hilbert 空间算子在收缩的模谱带上所具有的范数平方的正平均值，可以在谱支集收缩且一致有界的代数元素上恢复。

sentences.en: We apply this theorem to spectral intertwining rigidity and obtain an alternative proof of bicentralizer triviality for type III<sub>1</sub> factors with separable predual.
sentences.zh: 我们将该定理应用于谱交织刚性，并得到可分预对偶的 III<sub>1</sub> 型因子之双中心化子平凡性的另一证明。

sentences.en: Every action of a countable discrete amenable group on a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite complex C<sup>∗</sup>-algebra that is already Jiang–Su stable absorbs the trivial action on the Jiang–Su algebra up to cocycle conjugacy.
sentences.zh: 可数离散可均群在一个已经 Jiang–Su 稳定的单、可分、有单位元、无限维、核、稳定有限的复 C<sup>∗</sup> 代数上的每个作用，都在余循环共轭意义下吸收 Jiang–Su 代数上的平凡作用。

sentences.en: No restriction is imposed on the action on the tracial-state simplex.
sentences.zh: 对迹态单纯形上的作用不作任何限制。

sentences.en: This proves the unital, stably finite case of Szabó's Conjecture A on automatic equivariant Jiang–Su stability.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Szabó 关于自动等变 Jiang–Su 稳定性的猜想 A 的有单位元稳定有限情形。

sentences.en: We prove that strict comparison in the extended-functional sense implies Jiang–Su absorption for separable simple nuclear non-elementary C∗-algebras.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于可分、单、核、非初等的 C∗ 代数，扩展泛函意义下的严格比较蕴含 Jiang–Su 吸收性。

sentences.en: This resolves the corresponding implication of the Toms–Winter regularity problem, including nonunital algebras and allowing unbounded traces.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Toms–Winter 正则性问题中的相应蕴含关系，涵盖无单位元代数并允许无界迹。

sentences.en: More generally, every separable nuclear C∗-algebra whose Cuntz semigroup is almost unperforated and fully almost divisible absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，每个 Cuntz 半群几乎无孔且完全几乎可除的可分核 C∗ 代数都吸收 Jiang–Su 代数。

sentences.en: For separable nuclear C∗-algebras with no nonzero elementary ideal subquotients, finite nuclear dimension is equivalent to Jiang–Su stability.
sentences.zh: 对于没有非零初等理想子商的可分核 C∗ 代数，有限核维数与 Jiang–Su 稳定性等价。

sentences.en: More generally, $`\dim_{\mathrm{nuc}}(A_0\otimes\mathcal Z)\le1`$ for every separable nuclear A0.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对每个可分核代数 A0，都有 $`\dim_{\mathrm{nuc}}(A_0\otimes\mathcal Z)\le1`$。

sentences.en: This proves Robert and Tikuisis's Conjecture (C1) and the nuclear-dimension equivalence in the nonsimple Toms–Winter regularity question.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Robert 和 Tikuisis 的猜想 (C1)，以及非单 Toms–Winter 正则性问题中的核维数等价关系。

sentences.en: For a simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional, nuclear, stably finite C∗-algebra with traces, real rank zero of the uniform tracial ultrapower of its uniform tracial completion implies uniform property Γ.
sentences.zh: 对于一个具有迹的单、可分、有单位元、无限维、核、稳定有限的 C∗ 代数，其一致迹完备化的一致迹超幂的实秩为零，蕴含一致性质 Γ。

sentences.en: This answers Problem XXI of Schafhauser, Tikuisis and White affirmatively.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地回答了 Schafhauser、Tikuisis 和 White 的问题 XXI。

sentences.en: Independently, strict comparison implies Jiang–Su absorption for simple, separable, unital, infinite-dimensional nuclear algebras, resolving the unital Toms–Winter conjecture.
sentences.zh: 独立地，对于单、可分、有单位元、无限维核代数，严格比较蕴含 Jiang–Su 吸收性，从而解决有单位元情形的 Toms–Winter 猜想。

sentences.en: Under comparison tested on traces of finite target rank, we also obtain uniform property Γ and absorption for simple, separable, nuclear, stably projectionless algebras whose densely finite traces are all bounded and have a nonempty compact normalized base.
sentences.zh: 在通过有限目标秩的迹检验的比较条件下，对于稠密有限迹均有界且具有非空紧归一化基的单、可分、核、稳定无投影代数，我们还得到一致性质 Γ 和吸收性。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding problem.
sentences.zh: 我们对 Kirchberg 的范数超幂嵌入问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct an explicit separable unital full group C∗-algebra that admits no unital embedding into Bω, for any nonzero unital nuclear C∗-algebra B and any free ultrafilter ω on ℕ.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个显式的可分有单位元满群 C∗ 代数，使得对任意非零有单位元核 C∗ 代数 B 以及 ℕ 上的任意自由超滤子 ω，它都不容许到 Bω 的保单位元嵌入。

sentences.en: In particular, it does not embed unitally into $`\mathcal O_2^\omega`$.
sentences.zh: 特别地，它不能保单位元地嵌入 $`\mathcal O_2^\omega`$。

sentences.en: For every irrational angle, we construct a continuous nonnegative circle weight with exactly one zero and logarithmic integral $`-\infty`$ whose weighted rotation has no nontrivial invariant projection in the associated hyperfinite type II<sub>1</sub> factor.
sentences.zh: 对每个无理角，我们构造一个恰有一个零点且对数积分为 $`-\infty`$ 的连续非负圆周权函数，使其加权旋转在相应的超有限 II<sub>1</sub> 型因子中没有非平凡不变投影。

sentences.en: This answers negatively the question of Zhu, Fang, and Shi, with the angle prescribed in advance.
sentences.zh: 这在角度预先指定的情况下，否定地回答了 Zhu、Fang 和 Shi 的问题。

sentences.en: The resulting operator is nonzero and norm-quasinilpotent.
sentences.zh: 所得算子非零且为范数拟幂零算子。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to the hyperinvariant-subspace problem by constructing, on every infinite-dimensional separable complex Hilbert space, a nonzero bounded norm-quasinilpotent operator with no nonzero proper closed hyperinvariant subspace.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个无限维可分复 Hilbert 空间上构造一个非零有界范数拟幂零算子，使其没有非零真闭超不变子空间，从而对超不变子空间问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: Its commutant is a proper strongly closed unital transitive complex operator algebra.
sentences.zh: 其交换子代数是一个真、强闭、有单位元、传递的复算子代数。

sentences.en: We refute Kaplansky's quasitrace conjecture by constructing a separable unital complex C∗-algebra that admits normalized 2-quasitraces but has no tracial state.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个容许归一化 2-拟迹却没有迹态的可分有单位元复 C∗ 代数，从而反驳 Kaplansky 拟迹猜想。

sentences.en: As a consequence, we show that the minimal tensor product of two unital simple stably finite complex C∗-algebras can be properly infinite, even when one factor is the reduced free-group algebra $`C_r^*(\mathbb F_2)`$.
sentences.zh: 作为推论，我们表明，两个有单位元、单、稳定有限的复 C∗ 代数的最小张量积可以是真无限的，即使其中一个因子是约化自由群代数 $`C_r^*(\mathbb F_2)`$ 也是如此。

sentences.en: We prove that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with values in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，复 von Neumann 代数上每个取值于该代数自身、次数至少为二的有界 Hochschild 余循环，都具有有界原像。

sentences.en: Together with the established degree-one inner-derivation theorem, this resolves the Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture positively.
sentences.zh: 结合已经确立的一次内导子定理，这肯定地解决了 Kadison–Ringrose 上同调猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every type II<sub>1</sub> factor with separable predual is generated by one operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个具有可分预对偶的 II<sub>1</sub> 型因子，都由一个算子生成，等价地，由两个自伴算子生成。

sentences.en: Combined with the established direct-integral reduction to this case, this gives an affirmative solution of the generator problem for von Neumann algebras with separable predual.
sentences.zh: 结合已经确立的将一般情况归约到此情形的直积分归约，这肯定地解决了具有可分预对偶的 von Neumann 代数的生成元问题。

sentences.en: We construct in ZFC a unital infinite-dimensional simple complex C∗-algebra with a faithful tracial state whose nonzero irreducible representations are all unitarily equivalent.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ZFC 中构造一个具有忠实迹态的有单位元、无限维、单复 C∗ 代数，其所有非零不可约表示都酉等价。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to Naimark's problem without additional set-theoretic assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这在不添加集合论假设的情况下，对 Naimark 问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We answer the finite-entropy equality question for microstates and nonmicrostates free entropy negatively.
sentences.zh: 我们对微态自由熵与非微态自由熵的有限熵相等问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct a bounded self-adjoint tuple X in a von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state such that $`-\infty\lt \chi(X)\leq\chi^*(X)-\tfrac12\lt \infty`$.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个具有忠实正规迹态的 von Neumann 代数中构造一个有界自伴元组 X，使得 $`-\infty\lt \chi(X)\leq\chi^*(X)-\tfrac12\lt \infty`$。

sentences.en: Here χ is the original microstates entropy with an operator-norm cutoff and a limsup over matrix sizes.
sentences.zh: 这里，χ 是原始的微态熵，使用算子范数截断并对矩阵大小取上极限。

sentences.en: The counterexample uses a large but fixed number of variables.
sentences.zh: 该反例使用数量较大但固定的变量。

sentences.en: We prove the Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion: for every free ultrafilter on ℕ, a nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra if and only if its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Kirchberg–Rørdam 特征标判据：对 ℕ 上的每个自由超滤子，一个非零有单位元可分复 C∗ 代数吸收 Jiang–Su 代数，当且仅当其范数中心序列代数没有特征标。

sentences.en: We also prove that the infinite minimal tensor power of every nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra without characters is $`\mathcal Z`$-stable and contains a unital copy of $`\mathcal Z`$.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，每个没有特征标的非零有单位元可分复 C∗ 代数的无限最小张量幂都是 $`\mathcal Z`$ 稳定的，并包含一个 $`\mathcal Z`$ 的保单位元副本。

sentences.en: We prove the approximation-paving conjecture of Popa and Vaes for every maximal abelian subalgebra of a complex von Neumann algebra.
sentences.zh: 我们对复 von Neumann 代数的每个极大交换子代数证明了 Popa 和 Vaes 的逼近铺砌猜想。

sentences.en: For each $`0\lt \varepsilon\lt 1`$, every self-adjoint operator is a strong limit of self-adjoint operators of norm at most three times its norm, each admitting a norm paving with error at most ε times the approximant's own norm.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $`0\lt \varepsilon\lt 1`$，每个自伴算子都是一族范数至多为其范数三倍的自伴算子的强极限，且每个逼近算子都容许误差至多为其自身范数的 ε 倍的范数铺砌。

sentences.en: The number of projections is at most $`C\varepsilon^{-6}`$ for a universal constant C.
sentences.zh: 投影数量至多为 $`C\varepsilon^{-6}`$，其中 C 为一个普适常数。

sentences.en: No separability or conditional-expectation hypothesis is required.
sentences.zh: 无须可分性或条件期望假设。

sentences.en: We prove the quadratic strong-operator paving conjecture of Popa and Vaes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Popa 和 Vaes 的二次强算子铺砌猜想。

sentences.en: For every $`0\lt \varepsilon \lt 1`$, every self-adjoint element of a von Neumann algebra admits strong-operator paving over each maximal abelian subalgebra with at most $`5\times10^8\varepsilon ^{-2}`$ projections.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $`0\lt \varepsilon \lt 1`$，von Neumann 代数的每个自伴元素，都容许相对于每个极大交换子代数的、使用至多 $`5\times10^8\varepsilon ^{-2}`$ 个投影的强算子铺砌。

sentences.en: The bound is uniform over representations and requires no separability or conditional-expectation assumption.
sentences.zh: 该上界对所有表示一致成立，无须可分性或条件期望假设。

sentences.en: We prove that the canonical topological cone of all extended lower-semicontinuous tracial weights determines a separable nuclear C∗-algebra after tensoring with the Razak–Jacelon algebra and the compact operators, answering Robert's trace-cone classification question positively.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，所有扩展下半连续迹权组成的典范拓扑锥，决定了可分核 C∗ 代数与 Razak–Jacelon 代数及紧算子代数取张量积后的代数，从而肯定地回答了 Robert 的迹锥分类问题。

sentences.en: The isomorphism realizes the prescribed cone map, with arbitrary ideal structure and without a density assumption on the finite domains of the weights.
sentences.zh: 该同构实现预先指定的锥映射，允许任意理想结构，且无须对各权取有限值的定义域作稠密性假设。

sentences.en: We prove that, in sufficiently large smash powers, an $`MU`$-null restriction to a finite pointed subcomplex becomes stably null on the entire union of products with a fixed positive proportion of restricted factors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在充分大的 smash 幂中，若到某个有限带基点子复形的限制在 $`MU`$ 意义下为零，则它在受限制因子占某个固定正比例的各乘积的整个并集上稳定零伦。

sentences.en: This coherent vanishing theorem yields boundary-preserving compression of cube-valued maps on every compact metrizable input space.
sentences.zh: 这一相干消失定理给出每个紧可度量输入空间上的立方体值映射的保边界压缩。

sentences.en: When the torus slot bundle embeds continuously into a trivial bundle of rank less than twice the source rank, the compression places a positive proportion of slots on their boundaries in arbitrarily large powers and fixes every original boundary slot exactly.
sentences.zh: 当环面槽位丛连续嵌入一个秩小于源丛秩两倍的平凡丛时，该压缩在任意大的幂中，将正比例的槽位置于各自边界上，并精确固定每个原始边界槽位。

sentences.en: An example at equality shows that the strict rank inequality cannot be removed.
sentences.zh: 等号情形的一个例子表明，这个严格的秩不等式不能去掉。

sentences.en: We prove the integer-action case of the Phillips–Toms conjecture: for every minimal homeomorphism of an infinite compact metrizable space, the radius of comparison of its crossed product equals one half of its mean dimension, including equality at infinity.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Phillips–Toms 猜想的整数群作用情形：对无限紧可度量空间的每个极小同胚，其交叉积的比较半径等于其平均维数的一半，包括两者同为无穷的情形。

sentences.en: For these systems, zero mean dimension and the small boundary property are equivalent to Jiang–Su stability and to finite nuclear dimension of the crossed product; in this case its nuclear dimension is at most one.
sentences.zh: 对这些系统，零平均维数、小边界性质、交叉积的 Jiang–Su 稳定性以及交叉积的有限核维数这四个条件彼此等价；在此情形下，其核维数至多为一。

sentences.en: We prove that every complex C∗-algebra in which each positive element is properly infinite is strongly purely infinite.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个正元素均为真无限的复 C∗ 代数都是强纯无限的。

sentences.en: This answers the ordinary-to-strong part of Kirchberg–Rørdam's comparison question.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Kirchberg–Rørdam 比较问题中从普通性质到强性质的部分。

sentences.en: For exact algebras, we also prove that proper infiniteness of one fixed finite amplification of every positive element implies proper infiniteness of each positive element.
sentences.zh: 对于正合代数，我们还证明，若存在同一个固定的有限放大倍数，使每个正元素在该放大下均为真无限，则每个正元素均为真无限。

sentences.en: Consequently, every separable nuclear algebra with this fixed-amplification property absorbs $`\mathcal O_\infty`$, without assumptions of unitality or simplicity.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个具有这一固定放大性质的可分核代数都吸收 $`\mathcal O_\infty`$，无须有单位元性或单性假设。

sentences.en: We prove the Hilbert–Smith conjecture in every finite dimension: every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected Hausdorff second-countable finite-dimensional topological manifold without boundary is a Lie group.
sentences.zh: 我们证明每个有限维数中的 Hilbert–Smith 猜想：每个忠实且联合连续地作用于连通、Hausdorff、第二可数、有限维、无边界拓扑流形的局部紧、第二可数 Hausdorff 群都是 Lie 群。

sentences.en: We disprove the four-dimensional disc embedding conjecture without a fundamental-group hypothesis, even when no homotopy classes or output framings are prescribed.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳不对基本群作假设的四维圆盘嵌入猜想，即使不预先指定同伦类或输出标架也是如此。

sentences.en: We construct a compact oriented smooth four-manifold containing finitely many disc maps with framed algebraic dual spheres whose boundary circles bound no disjoint locally flat discs.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个紧致定向光滑四维流形，其中包含有限个带有加标架的代数对偶球面的圆盘映射，而它们的边界圆不能围成互不相交的局部平坦圆盘。

sentences.en: Consequently, the free group on two generators is not good in the sense of Freedman–Quinn, and neither is any group containing it as a subgroup.
sentences.zh: 因此，二生成元自由群在 Freedman–Quinn 意义下不是好群，任何包含它作为子群的群也都不是好群。

sentences.en: We disprove the unrestricted four-dimensional disk-embedding conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳不受限制的四维圆盘嵌入猜想。

sentences.en: We construct immersed disks in a compact oriented smooth four-manifold with framed algebraic dual spheres satisfying the usual equivariant intersection and reduced self-intersection conditions, but with no pairwise disjoint locally flat replacements that preserve the boundary maps and induced normal framings.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个紧致定向光滑四维流形中构造浸入圆盘及带标架的代数对偶球面，它们满足通常的等变相交条件和约化自相交条件，但不存在保留边界映射及诱导法标架的、两两不交且局部平坦的替代圆盘。

sentences.en: The obstruction holds even when the replacement disks' relative homotopy classes are not prescribed.
sentences.zh: 即使不预先指定替代圆盘的相对同伦类，这一障碍仍然成立。

sentences.en: We construct a finitely presented integral Poincaré duality group of dimension four that has a finite classifying space but is not the fundamental group of any closed aspherical topological four-manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个有限展示的四维整系数 Poincaré 对偶群，它具有有限分类空间，却不是任何闭非球面拓扑四维流形的基本群。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to Wall's manifold-realization question in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 这对 Wall 的流形实现问题在四维情形下给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We prove the purely cosmetic surgery conjecture for knots in the three-sphere.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了三维球面中纽结的 purely cosmetic Dehn 手术猜想。

sentences.en: Distinct Dehn surgery slopes on a nontrivial smooth knot never give orientation-preservingly homeomorphic manifolds.
sentences.zh: 非平凡光滑纽结上不同的 Dehn 手术斜率，绝不会给出保定向同胚的流形。

sentences.en: We construct a uniformly discrete bounded-geometry space whose maximal coarse assembly map has an infinite-order element in its kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个一致离散、有界几何的空间，其极大粗装配映射的核中含有一个无限阶元素。

sentences.en: The space is a coarse disjoint union of finite connected graphs of uniformly bounded degree, so maximal coarse assembly need not be rationally injective even for such graph unions.
sentences.zh: 该空间是度数一致有界的有限连通图的粗不交并，因此，即使对这样的图并集，极大粗装配映射也不必有理单射。

sentences.en: We disprove the coarse Novikov conjecture: ordinary coarse assembly need not be rationally injective for uniformly discrete spaces of bounded geometry.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳粗 Novikov 猜想：对于有界几何的一致离散空间，普通粗装配映射不必有理单射。

sentences.en: We construct a coarse disjoint union of finite graphs of uniformly bounded degree and an infinite-order class in its degree-one coarse K-homology whose image under ordinary coarse assembly in the K-theory of the reduced, locally compact Roe algebra vanishes.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个度数一致有界的有限图的粗不交并，以及其一次粗 K-同调中的一个无限阶类，使该类经普通粗装配映射在约化局部紧 Roe 代数的 K-理论中的像为零。

sentences.en: For every nonnegative integer n, we construct a Smith–Toda complex $`V(n)`$ at some prime p depending on n.
sentences.zh: 对每个非负整数 n，我们在某个依赖于 n 的素数 p 处构造一个 Smith–Toda 复形 $`V(n)`$。

sentences.en: It is a finite p-local spectrum whose Brown–Peterson homology is $`\mathrm{BP}_*/(p,v_1,\ldots,v_n)`$ with its canonical comodule structure and generator in degree zero.
sentences.zh: 它是一个有限 p 局部谱，其 Brown–Peterson 同调为 $`\mathrm{BP}_*/(p,v_1,\ldots,v_n)`$，配备典范余模结构，生成元位于零次。

sentences.en: Each listed generator is killed to its first power.
sentences.zh: 每个列出的生成元均在一次幂处就被消去。

sentences.en: We construct a Smith–Toda complex $`V(4)`$ at the prime 1009.
sentences.zh: 我们在素数 1009 处构造一个 Smith–Toda 复形 $`V(4)`$。

sentences.en: It is an ordinary finite 1009-local spectrum whose Brown–Peterson homology is $`BP_*/(1009,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)`$, with its canonical comodule structure and generator in degree zero.
sentences.zh: 它是一个普通的有限 1009 局部谱，其 Brown–Peterson 同调为 $`BP_*/(1009,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)`$，配备典范余模结构，生成元位于零次。

sentences.en: We solve the Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three for the standard Kervaire classes in the mod-three Adams spectral sequence.
sentences.zh: 我们解决模三 Adams 谱序列中标准 Kervaire 类在素数三处的 Kervaire 不变量问题。

sentences.en: These classes survive precisely at indices 0, 2, and 3, and each surviving detection coset contains an element of additive order three.
sentences.zh: 这些类恰在指标 0、2 和 3 处存活，且每个存活的检测陪集中都含有一个加法阶为三的元素。

sentences.en: In particular, there is an order-three Kervaire element in stem 322.
sentences.zh: 特别地，在第 322 个稳定茎中存在一个三阶 Kervaire 元素。

sentences.en: We prove Quillen's conjecture for all finite groups and all primes.
sentences.zh: 我们对所有有限群及所有素数证明了 Quillen 猜想。

sentences.en: More precisely, if a finite group G has trivial largest normal p-subgroup $`O_p(G)`$, then the poset of nontrivial elementary abelian p-subgroups of G has nonzero augmented reduced rational homology.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，若有限群 G 的最大正规 p 子群 $`O_p(G)`$ 平凡，则 G 的非平凡初等交换 p 子群组成的偏序集具有非零的增广约化有理同调。

sentences.en: This establishes the stronger rational-homology form of the conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这确立了该猜想更强的有理同调形式。

sentences.en: We classify the prime and radical ideals of the Lubin–Tate deformation ring invariant under an open Morava stabilizer subgroup, at every prime and positive height.
sentences.zh: 对每个素数及每个正高度，我们分类了 Lubin–Tate 形变环中在某个开 Morava 稳定子子群作用下不变的素理想与根理想。

sentences.en: This proves Chai's invariant-ideal conjecture in the standard finite-residue-field formulation.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Chai 的不变理想猜想的标准有限剩余域版本。

sentences.en: It also proves the Hovey–Strickland conjecture: the dualizable $`K(n)`$-local category has exactly $`n+2`$ thick tensor ideals, and its Balmer spectrum is a chain of $`n+1`$ points.
sentences.zh: 这也证明了 Hovey–Strickland 猜想：可对偶化的 $`K(n)`$ 局部范畴恰有 $`n+2`$ 个厚张量理想，其 Balmer 谱是一条含 $`n+1`$ 个点的链。

sentences.en: We prove the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara–Henry convention: its weak globular infinity-groupoids recover the homotopy theory of spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们对 Ara–Henry 约定下的每个 Grothendieck coherator 证明 Grothendieck 同伦假说：它的弱球状无穷群胚恢复空间的同伦理论。

sentences.en: We also resolve Henry's pushout conjecture, showing that elementary expansions preserve components and all homotopy groups of cellular infinity-groupoids.
sentences.zh: 我们还解决 Henry 的推出猜想，证明初等扩张保持胞腔无穷群胚的分支以及所有同伦群。

sentences.en: We prove that the homotopy groups of the $`K(n)`$-local sphere are finitely generated ℤp-modules in every integer degree, for every prime p and positive height n.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对每个素数 p 及正高度 n，$`K(n)`$ 局部球谱在每个整数次数上的同伦群都是有限生成的 ℤp 模。

sentences.en: Equivalently, the same conclusion holds after $`K(n)`$-localizing any finite p-local spectrum.
sentences.zh: 等价地，对任意有限 p 局部谱作 $`K(n)`$ 局部化后，同一结论仍然成立。

sentences.en: This answers the degreewise finiteness question of Hovey and Hovey–Strickland.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Hovey 以及 Hovey–Strickland 的逐次有限性问题。

sentences.en: For a finite p-group G and a subgroup H, we prove that the optimal chromatic fixed-point loss equals the shortest length of a subnormal chain from H to G with cyclic quotients.
sentences.zh: 对有限 p 群 G 及其子群 H，我们证明，取不动点时的最优 chromatic 损失等于从 H 到 G 的、各商群均为循环群的次正规链的最短长度。

sentences.en: The equality holds at every prime and every nonnegative height, resolving positively the equality proposed by Kuhn and Lloyd.
sentences.zh: 该等式在每个素数和每个非负高度处成立，从而肯定地解决 Kuhn 和 Lloyd 所提出的等式问题。

sentences.en: We prove the four-dimensional Singer conjecture: the L2-Betti numbers of the universal cover of a closed connected aspherical topological four-manifold vanish outside degree two.
sentences.zh: 我们证明四维 Singer 猜想：闭、连通、非球面拓扑四维流形的万有覆盖的 L2 Betti 数在二次以外均为零。

sentences.en: More generally, the same vanishing holds for finite connected aspherical integral Poincaré complexes of formal dimension four, including nonorientable ones.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，对于形式维数为四的有限连通非球面整系数 Poincaré 复形，包括不可定向者，同样的消失结论也成立。

sentences.en: We prove Curtis's conjecture: in every positive degree, the mod-two stable Hurewicz image of the sphere is spanned by the images of η, ν, σ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes that exist.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Curtis 猜想：在每个正次数上，球面的模二稳定 Hurewicz 像由 η、ν、σ 以及存在的 Kervaire 不变量为一的类的像所张成。

sentences.en: Consequently, Eccles's conjecture holds for every sphere Sn with n > 0.
sentences.zh: 因此，Eccles 猜想对每个满足 n > 0 的球面 Sn 成立。

sentences.en: We prove the higher-dimensional Thomason model-structure conjecture of Ara and Maltsiniotis.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Ara 和 Maltsiniotis 的高维 Thomason 模型结构猜想。

sentences.en: For every $`1\le n\le\infty`$, the category of small strict globular n-categories admits a proper combinatorial model structure that is Quillen equivalent to simplicial sets.
sentences.zh: 对每个 $`1\le n\le\infty`$，小严格球状 n 范畴组成的范畴容许一个固有组合模型结构，且该结构与单纯集 Quillen 等价。

sentences.en: Its weak equivalences and fibrations are detected by the twice-extended Street nerve $`\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$, and the Quillen equivalence is given by $`c_n\mathrm{Sd}^2\dashv\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$.
sentences.zh: 其弱等价和纤维化由两次扩张的 Street 神经 $`\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$ 检测，Quillen 等价由 $`c_n\mathrm{Sd}^2\dashv\mathrm{Ex}^2N_n`$ 给出。

sentences.en: Thus strict higher categories model the homotopy theory of spaces in every positive finite dimension and in dimension ω.
sentences.zh: 因此，严格高阶范畴在每个正有限维数以及维数 ω 中，都给出空间同伦理论的模型。

sentences.en: For every n ≥ 1 and prime $`p\gt n+1`$, we construct a $`2^n`$-stage ordered filtration of $`L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge`$ with the classical chromatic-splitting cofibers.
sentences.zh: 对每个 n ≥ 1 和素数 $`p\gt n+1`$，我们构造 $`L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p^\wedge`$ 的一个 $`2^n`$ 阶段有序滤过，其余纤维为经典 chromatic 分裂中的余纤维。

sentences.en: The map from the first stage to the target is the canonical localization unit.
sentences.zh: 从第一阶段到目标的映射是典范局部化单位映射。

sentences.en: For every prime p ≥ 5, we construct an explicit eight-stage filtration of $`L_2L_{K(3)}\mathbb S_p^\wedge`$ by the local-sphere layers in the height-three chromatic-splitting pattern.
sentences.zh: 对每个素数 p ≥ 5，我们利用高度三的 chromatic 分裂模式中的局部球谱层，构造 $`L_2L_{K(3)}\mathbb S_p^\wedge`$ 的一个显式八阶段滤过。

sentences.en: The map from its first stage to the overlap is the canonical unit, and two signed fracture formulas identify all attachments for the chosen local maps and compatibility homotopy.
sentences.zh: 从其第一阶段到交叠对象的映射是典范单位映射，且两个带符号的断裂公式确定所选局部映射与相容同伦的所有粘接映射。

sentences.en: A companion canonical-map theorem further implies that the first height-one attachment is nonzero.
sentences.zh: 一个配套的典范映射定理进一步推出，第一个高度一的粘接映射非零。

sentences.en: For every prime p ≥ 5, the canonical map $`L_0L_{K(3)}S\to L_0L_{K(2)}L_{K(3)}S`$ for the sphere spectrum S is nonzero on π−3.
sentences.zh: 对每个素数 p ≥ 5，球谱 S 的典范映射 $`L_0L_{K(3)}S\to L_0L_{K(2)}L_{K(3)}S`$ 在 π−3 上非零。

sentences.en: Consequently, the height-three strong chromatic splitting formula is false in this range, even as an equivalence of underlying $`E(2)`$-local spectra without specified summand maps.
sentences.zh: 因此，高度三的强 chromatic 分裂公式在此范围内是错误的，即使仅将其理解为不指定直和项映射的底层 $`E(2)`$ 局部谱之间的等价也是如此。

sentences.en: At the prime three and height three, the chromatic overlap cannot be constructed from the rational, height-one, and height-two local spheres by finitely many sums, shifts, cofibers, and retracts in the category of $`E(2)`$-local modules over the derived 3-complete sphere.
sentences.zh: 在素数三和高度三处，chromatic 交叠对象无法在导出 3-完备球谱上的 $`E(2)`$ 局部模范畴中，通过有限次取和、平移、取余纤维及取缩回对象的操作，从有理局部球谱、高度一局部球谱和高度二局部球谱构造出来。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the ordinary finite-assembly question for chromatic overlaps.
sentences.zh: 这对 chromatic 交叠对象的普通有限装配问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: For the derived p-completion of the sphere, the canonical weak chromatic splitting map has no homotopy retraction at height p for every prime p ≥ 5, and at height $`p+1`$ for every prime p ≥ 7.
sentences.zh: 对于球谱的导出 p 完备化，对每个素数 p ≥ 5，在高度 p 处，以及对每个素数 p ≥ 7，在高度 $`p+1`$ 处，典范弱 chromatic 分裂映射均不存在同伦意义下的缩回映射。

sentences.en: The classical sphere product $`\beta_1^{(p-1)^2}`$ gives a nonzero kernel class in both ranges.
sentences.zh: 经典的球谱乘积 $`\beta_1^{(p-1)^2}`$ 在这两个范围内都给出一个非零核类。

sentences.en: We disprove the Hahn–Wilson conjecture at height two.
sentences.zh: 我们反驳高度二处的 Hahn–Wilson 猜想。

sentences.en: For every sufficiently large prime p, we construct a connective p-complete spectrum X of exact fp-type two outside the ordinary thick subcategory generated by the specified standard form of $`\mathrm{BP}\langle2\rangle_p^\wedge`$.
sentences.zh: 对每个充分大的素数 p，我们构造一个 fp 型恰为二的连通 p 完备谱 X，它不属于由所指定的标准形式 $`\mathrm{BP}\langle2\rangle_p^\wedge`$ 生成的普通厚子范畴。

sentences.en: The same spectrum satisfies both localization comparisons $`L_2^fX\simeq L_2X`$ and $`L_{T(2)}X\simeq L_{K(2)}X`$.
sentences.zh: 同一谱满足两个局部化比较关系 $`L_2^fX\simeq L_2X`$ 和 $`L_{T(2)}X\simeq L_{K(2)}X`$。

sentences.en: We construct closed connected aspherical topological four-manifolds that are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, disproving the homeomorphism-existence formulation of the Borel conjecture in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 我们构造同伦等价却不同胚的闭连通非球面拓扑四维流形，从而反驳四维 Borel 猜想关于同胚存在性的表述。

sentences.en: Their common fundamental group is word-hyperbolic.
sentences.zh: 它们共同的基本群是字双曲群。

sentences.en: One of the manifolds also has a self-homotopy equivalence not homotopic to a homeomorphism.
sentences.zh: 其中一个流形还具有一个与任何同胚都不同伦的自同伦等价。

sentences.en: We give a negative answer to Wall's finite $`D(2)`$ problem.
sentences.zh: 我们对 Wall 的有限 $`D(2)`$ 问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex satisfying the $`D(2)`$ finiteness condition but not homotopy equivalent to any finite CW complex of dimension at most two.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个满足 $`D(2)`$ 有限性条件的有限连通三维 CW 复形，它却不与任何维数至多为二的有限 CW 复形同伦等价。

sentences.en: The example has infinite fundamental group.
sentences.zh: 该例子的基本群是无限群。

sentences.en: Every surjective isometry between the unit spheres of real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry, giving an affirmative solution to Tingley's problem.
sentences.zh: 实 Banach 空间单位球面之间的每个满射等距映射，都唯一地延拓为一个满射实线性等距映射，从而肯定地解决 Tingley 问题。

sentences.en: If distances between different radii are not preserved, we realize the positive maximal defect in a possibly enlarged pair of Banach spaces.
sentences.zh: 若不同半径之间的距离不被保持，我们就在一对可能经过扩大的 Banach 空间中实现正的最大缺陷。

sentences.en: We then align extremal chords using common supports and Darbo's fixed-point theorem and obtain a contradiction from support and convexity estimates.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们利用共同支撑和 Darbo 不动点定理对齐极值弦，并由支撑估计与凸性估计导出矛盾。

sentences.en: The separable quotient problem asks whether every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a separable infinite-dimensional quotient.
sentences.zh: 可分商问题询问，是否每个无限维 Banach 空间都有一个可分无限维商空间。

sentences.en: We prove that this statement is independent of ZFC, relative to the consistency of ZFC with a measurable cardinal.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，相对于 ZFC 加上一个可测基数的一致性，这一命题独立于 ZFC。

sentences.en: This holds over both the real and complex fields.
sentences.zh: 该结论在实数域与复数域上均成立。

sentences.en: For spaces of norm density ℵ<sub>1</sub>, we obtain independence relative to the consistency of ZFC alone.
sentences.zh: 对于范数密度为 ℵ<sub>1</sub> 的空间，我们得到仅相对于 ZFC 自身一致性的独立性结果。

sentences.en: There are separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic.
sentences.zh: 存在全局双 Lipschitz 等价却不线性同构的可分实 Banach 空间。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the separable Banach-space Lipschitz-isomorphism problem.
sentences.zh: 这对可分 Banach 空间的 Lipschitz 同构问题给出否定回答。

sentences.en: We construct a separable real Banach space Z that contains no linear copy of c0, yet is bi-Lipschitz equivalent to $`Z\oplus_\infty c_0`$.
sentences.zh: 我们构造一个可分实 Banach 空间 Z，它不包含 c0 的任何线性副本，却与 $`Z\oplus_\infty c_0`$ 双 Lipschitz 等价。

sentences.en: The same space contains a bi-Lipschitz image of every separable metric space.
sentences.zh: 同一空间包含每个可分度量空间的一个双 Lipschitz 像。

sentences.en: We give a direct proof of the sharp constant-two numerical-range inequality for matrix-valued polynomials in all finite base and coefficient dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们对所有有限的底空间维数和系数维数，给出矩阵值多项式的最优常数为二的数值域不等式的直接证明。

sentences.en: This resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture in its matrix formulation, including matrices whose numerical ranges are points or line segments.
sentences.zh: 这解决了完全 Crouzeix 猜想的矩阵表述，涵盖数值域为点或线段的矩阵。

sentences.en: We resolve the complete Crouzeix conjecture by proving the sharp constant-two numerical-range inequality for every bounded operator on a complex Hilbert space and every matrix-valued polynomial.
sentences.zh: 我们对复 Hilbert 空间上的每个有界算子和每个矩阵值多项式证明了最优常数为二的数值域不等式，从而解决了完全 Crouzeix 猜想。

sentences.en: No separability assumption is needed.
sentences.zh: 无需可分性假设。

sentences.en: The closure of the numerical range is a complete 2-spectral set, and the bound extends to finite matrix-valued functions holomorphic near that closure.
sentences.zh: 数值域的闭包是一个完全 2-谱集，而且该界可推广到在此闭包附近全纯的有限矩阵值函数。

sentences.en: For a finite matrix and a bounded convex domain containing its numerical range with regular real-analytic Jordan boundary, the optimal similarity making its conformal disk image contractive is attained with condition number at most two.
sentences.zh: 对于一个有限矩阵及一个包含其数值域、具有正则实解析 Jordan 边界的有界凸域，使其保形圆盘像成为压缩算子的最优相似变换可以取到，且条件数至多为二。

sentences.en: For the similar matrix, one continuous positive boundary density of mass the identity represents the evaluation of every matrix-valued function holomorphic near the closed domain.
sentences.zh: 对于相似变换后的矩阵，存在一个总质量为恒等算子的连续正边界密度，可表示在闭域附近全纯的每个矩阵值函数的求值。

sentences.en: We prove the cotype–cotype conjecture under the ordinary approximation property.
sentences.zh: 我们在通常的逼近性质假设下证明了余型—余型猜想。

sentences.en: A nonzero real Banach space with this property is K-convex if and only if both the space and its dual have finite Rademacher cotype, possibly with different exponents.
sentences.zh: 具有这一性质的非零实 Banach 空间是 K-凸的，当且仅当该空间及其对偶都具有有限 Rademacher 余型，二者的指数可以不同。

sentences.en: We prove that every real Banach space with Markov type p > 1 is superreflexive.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个具有 Markov 型 p > 1 的实 Banach 空间都是超自反的。

sentences.en: Together with the known converse, this characterizes superreflexivity by nontrivial Markov type.
sentences.zh: 结合已知的逆命题，这通过非平凡 Markov 型刻画了超自反性。

sentences.en: This answers Naor's question: every real Banach space with nontrivial Markov type admits an equivalent uniformly smooth norm.
sentences.zh: 这回答了 Naor 的问题：每个具有非平凡 Markov 型的实 Banach 空间都具有一个等价的一致光滑范数。

sentences.en: Every nonexpansive selfmap of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a real reflexive Banach space has a fixed point.
sentences.zh: 实自反 Banach 空间的非空闭有界凸子集上的每个非扩张自映射都有不动点。

sentences.en: This resolves the reflexive-space fixed point problem for the given norm.
sentences.zh: 这解决了给定范数下自反空间的不动点问题。

sentences.en: We disprove Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了 Pietsch 关于度量熵的与维数无关的对偶性猜想。

sentences.en: For every proposed pair of universal constants, we construct origin-symmetric convex bodies that violate the corresponding covering-entropy inequality, already when the covering body is a cube.
sentences.zh: 对于每一对所提出的普适常数，我们都构造出关于原点对称的凸体，使其违反相应的覆盖熵不等式，即使覆盖体是立方体时也已如此。

sentences.en: We construct a countable uniformly discrete metric space whose real Lipschitz-free space has the approximation property but fails the bounded approximation property, answering Kalton's question negatively.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个可数的一致离散度量空间，其实 Lipschitz 自由空间具有逼近性质，却不具有有界逼近性质，从而否定地回答了 Kalton 的问题。

sentences.en: The identity can be approximated on every compact set by finite-rank operators, but no uniform bound on their norms is possible.
sentences.zh: 恒等算子可以在每个紧集上由有限秩算子逼近，但这些算子的范数不可能具有一致上界。

sentences.en: We construct a separable reflexive real Banach space whose given norm is asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex but which admits no asymptotically uniformly convex equivalent norm.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个可分自反实 Banach 空间，其给定范数是渐近中点一致凸的，但它不具有任何渐近一致凸的等价范数。

sentences.en: Its averaged midpoint modulus is at least $`\sqrt{1+t^2/12}-1`$, and the countably branching diamond of depth k has distortion at least $`\sqrt{1+k/12}`$ in this space.
sentences.zh: 其平均中点模至少为 $`\sqrt{1+t^2/12}-1`$，而深度为 k 的可数分支菱形图在该空间中的畸变至少为 $`\sqrt{1+k/12}`$。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the reflexive diamond converse for asymptotic uniform convexifiability.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了渐近一致可凸化性的自反菱形图逆命题。

sentences.en: For a real segment-forest dual with unbounded finite component heights and the real infinite-height coordinate predual, we bound the tail of an arbitrary displacement in a symmetric lens by $`2\sqrt{R^2-\|x\|^2}`$, where R is the lens radius and x is its finitely supported center.
sentences.zh: 对于各分量高度有限但无统一上界的实 segment-forest 对偶空间，以及实无限高度坐标预对偶空间，我们证明对称透镜中任意位移的尾部以 $`2\sqrt{R^2-\|x\|^2}`$ 为上界，其中 R 是透镜半径，x 是其具有有限支撑的中心。

sentences.en: Both given norms are asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex, although neither space admits an equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm.
sentences.zh: 这两个给定范数都是渐近中点一致凸的，尽管这两个空间都不具有等价的渐近一致凸范数。

sentences.en: The finite-height forest dual is reflexive.
sentences.zh: 有限高度森林的对偶空间是自反的。

sentences.en: We derive quantitative distortion bounds for countably branching diamond graphs from midpoint estimates and direct tree energies.
sentences.zh: 我们由中点估计和直接的树能量推导出可数分支菱形图的定量畸变界。

sentences.en: In the dual of a finite-height segment forest, every distortion-D embedding of the depth-k diamond satisfies $`D^2\ge1+k/4`$.
sentences.zh: 在有限高度 segment-forest 的对偶空间中，深度为 k 的菱形图的每个畸变为 D 的嵌入都满足 $`D^2\ge1+k/4`$。

sentences.en: The same bound holds in the infinite-height coordinate predual.
sentences.zh: 同样的界在无限高度坐标预对偶空间中也成立。

sentences.en: We also obtain power-type distortion bounds for path-cost and recursive tree norms.
sentences.zh: 我们还对路径代价范数和递归树范数得到了幂型畸变界。

sentences.en: For an infinite-dimensional real subspace of L1 whose unit ball is totally bounded in measure and whose norm has the Daugavet property, we compute the averaged midpoint and one-sided asymptotic moduli at every unit center.
sentences.zh: 对于 L1 的一个无限维实子空间，若其单位球在依测度收敛的拓扑下全有界，且其范数具有 Daugavet 性质，我们计算了以每个单位向量为中心的平均中点模和单侧渐近模。

sentences.en: They are $`\max\{t/2,t-1\}`$ and $`\max\{0,t-2\}`$, respectively.
The same weak-neighborhood geometry excludes every equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm.
sentences.zh: 同样的弱邻域几何排除了所有等价的渐近一致凸范数。

sentences.en: A quantitative realization of the Kadets–Werner construction supplies a space with both hypotheses.
sentences.zh: Kadets–Werner 构造的一种定量实现给出了一个同时满足这两个假设的空间。

sentences.en: Four real Banach spaces defined by bounded tree potentials satisfy the averaged asymptotic midpoint bound $`\widehat\delta(t)\ge\sqrt{1+t^2/4}-1`$ for $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, while none admits an asymptotically uniformly convex (AUC) renorming.
sentences.zh: 由有界树势定义的四个实 Banach 空间在 $`0\lt t\lt 1`$ 时满足平均渐近中点界 $`\widehat\delta(t)\ge\sqrt{1+t^2/4}-1`$，但它们都不具有渐近一致凸（AUC）的重赋范。

sentences.en: On finite-height trees, the globally constrained norm equals the least additive cost of a Hilbert vector and root paths.
sentences.zh: 在有限高度树上，具有全局约束的范数等于一个 Hilbert 向量与根路径的最小可加代价。

sentences.en: The quadratic path and segment-start outer Hilbert sums are reflexive and asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex, and admit no equivalent AUC norm.
sentences.zh: 二次路径和 segment-start 的外 Hilbert 和都是自反且渐近中点一致凸的，并且不具有等价的 AUC 范数。

sentences.en: For a countably branching tree, the closed real L1 spans of products of independent exponential or Gaussian-square multipliers along its paths have positive averaged asymptotic midpoint moduli and admit no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm.
sentences.zh: 对于一棵可数分支树，沿其路径的独立指数乘子或高斯平方乘子的乘积在实 L1 中生成的闭线性空间具有正的平均渐近中点模，且不具有任何等价的渐近一致凸范数。

sentences.en: The renorming obstruction holds for every positive nonconstant mean-one multiplier with finite second moment.
sentences.zh: 这一重赋范障碍对于每个具有有限二阶矩、均值为一、非恒定的正乘子都成立。

sentences.en: We study tree norms computed by two least nonnegative fields whose difference is the vector.
sentences.zh: 我们研究由两个最小非负场计算的树范数，这两个场之差就是该向量。

sentences.en: For Euclidean child aggregation, two root-sum spaces have an averaged asymptotic midpoint modulus of at least $`t^3/128`$ for $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, including a reflexive joining-root space.
sentences.zh: 对于子节点的欧氏聚合，两个 root-sum 空间在 $`0\lt t\lt 1`$ 时具有至少为 $`t^3/128`$ 的平均渐近中点模，其中包括一个自反的 joining-root 空间。

sentences.en: A reflexive construction with a fixed zero root also satisfies a homogeneous cubic estimate.
sentences.zh: 一个根固定为零的自反构造也满足齐次三次估计。

sentences.en: These spaces admit no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm.
sentences.zh: 这些空间不具有等价的渐近一致凸范数。

sentences.en: We also obtain sixth-power and cubic estimates when the aggregation exponent depends on the height of a finite component.
sentences.zh: 当聚合指数依赖于有限分量的高度时，我们还得到了六次幂估计和三次估计。

sentences.en: We prove that the real Banach space ℓ1 has metric Markov cotype two, answering a question of Mendel and Naor.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，实 Banach 空间 ℓ1 具有度量 Markov 余型二，从而回答了 Mendel 和 Naor 的一个问题。

sentences.en: As a consequence, every Lipschitz map from an arbitrary subset of a real Hilbert space into ℓ1 extends to the whole Hilbert space with a universal multiplicative loss in its Lipschitz constant, resolving Ball's extension problem for this target.
sentences.zh: 由此，从实 Hilbert 空间任意子集到 ℓ1 的每个 Lipschitz 映射都可以延拓到整个 Hilbert 空间，且其 Lipschitz 常数只损失一个普适的乘法因子，从而解决了以此为目标空间的 Ball 延拓问题。

sentences.en: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into Euclidean four-space, without an orientability assumption.
sentences.zh: 每个带 Riemann 度量的闭光滑曲面都具有到四维欧氏空间的光滑等距浸入，无需可定向性假设。

sentences.en: This resolves the closed-surface form of the classical four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem.
sentences.zh: 这解决了经典四维等距浸入问题的闭曲面形式。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth positive-definite Riemannian metric on $`(-1,1)^2`$ that agrees with the Euclidean metric to every order at the origin, yet no neighborhood of the origin admits a smooth isometric immersion into Euclidean three-space.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $`(-1,1)^2`$ 上构造了一个光滑正定 Riemann 度量，它在原点处与欧氏度量的各阶导数都相同，但原点的任何邻域都不具有到三维欧氏空间的光滑等距浸入。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the unrestricted smooth local isometric realization problem for surfaces.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了曲面在不加限制情形下的光滑局部等距实现问题。

sentences.en: We prove the integral scalar-curvature inequality proposed by Gromov.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Gromov 提出的标量曲率积分不等式。

sentences.en: For every dimension n ≥ 3, there is a constant $`a_n\gt 0`$, depending only on n, such that $`\displaystyle \int_M(\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g^-)^{n/2}\,dV_g\ge a_n\|M\|`$ for every closed connected oriented smooth n-manifold M and every smooth Riemannian metric g.
sentences.zh: 对于每个维数 n ≥ 3，都存在一个仅依赖于 n 的常数 $`a_n\gt 0`$，使得对每个闭连通定向光滑 n 维流形 M 及每个光滑 Riemann 度量 g，都有 $`\displaystyle \int_M(\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g^-)^{n/2}\,dV_g\ge a_n\|M\|`$。

sentences.en: Here $`\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g^-:=\max\{0,-\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g\}`$, and $`\|M\|`$ is real simplicial volume.
sentences.zh: 这里 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g^-:=\max\{0,-\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits _g\}`$，而 $`\|M\|`$ 是实单纯体积。

sentences.en: The proof uses the nonnegative-scalar-curvature vanishing theorem of the companion paper on rational inessentiality.
sentences.zh: 证明使用了关于有理非本质性的配套论文中的非负标量曲率消失定理。

sentences.en: We prove that every closed connected oriented smooth manifold admitting strictly positive scalar curvature is rationally inessential: its rational fundamental class maps to zero under the classifying map.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个容许严格正标量曲率的闭连通定向光滑流形都是有理非本质的：它的有理基本类在分类映射下映为零。

sentences.en: No spin or fundamental-group hypothesis is needed, and there is no upper dimension bound.
sentences.zh: 无需自旋结构或基本群假设，也没有维数上界。

sentences.en: This proves the Gromov–Lawson aspherical conjecture; moreover, every nonnegative-scalar-curvature metric on a closed aspherical manifold is flat.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Gromov–Lawson 非球面猜想；此外，闭非球面流形上的每个非负标量曲率度量都是平坦的。

sentences.en: We also show that every closed oriented smooth manifold of positive dimension with nonnegative scalar curvature has zero real simplicial volume, proving the qualitative vanishing consequence of Gromov's conjectural comparison.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明，每个具有非负标量曲率的正维闭定向光滑流形的实单纯体积都为零，从而证明了 Gromov 猜想中的比较关系所蕴含的定性消失结论。

sentences.en: For every n ≥ 4, a complete connected smooth Riemannian n-manifold without boundary satisfying $`-4\Delta+\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits \ge1`$ as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most $`n-2`$ whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only in terms of n.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 n ≥ 4，若一个完备连通光滑无边界 Riemann n 维流形以二次型不等式的意义满足 $`-4\Delta+\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits \ge1`$，则它具有到一个维数至多为 $`n-2`$ 的单纯复形的连续映射，其每个完整纤维的直径都有仅依赖于 n 的上界。

sentences.en: The bound is measured in the original metric.
sentences.zh: 该界是在原始度量下测量的。

sentences.en: This extends the uniform Urysohn width theorem from a pointwise scalar-curvature lower bound to a spectral lower bound.
sentences.zh: 这将一致 Urysohn 宽度定理从逐点的标量曲率下界推广到了谱下界。

sentences.en: Every connected complete smooth Riemannian three-manifold without boundary satisfying $`-4\Delta+\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits \ge\lambda\gt 0`$ as a quadratic-form inequality admits a continuous map to a graph whose entire fibers have diameter at most $`500/\sqrt\lambda`$ in the original metric.
sentences.zh: 每个以二次型不等式的意义满足 $`-4\Delta+\mathop{\mathrm{Scal}}\nolimits \ge\lambda\gt 0`$ 的连通完备光滑无边界三维 Riemann 流形，都具有到一个图的连续映射，其每个完整纤维在原始度量下的直径至多为 $`500/\sqrt\lambda`$。

sentences.en: No orientability, spin, compactness, or bounded-geometry assumption is required.
sentences.zh: 无需可定向性、自旋结构、紧致性或有界几何假设。

sentences.en: We prove the quantitative continuous form of Gromov's scalar-curvature conjecture in every dimension n ≥ 4.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个维数 n ≥ 4 中证明了 Gromov 标量曲率猜想的定量连续形式。

sentences.en: Every complete connected smooth boundaryless n-manifold with scalar curvature at least one admits a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension at most $`n-2`$ whose entire fibers have diameter bounded only in terms of n.
sentences.zh: 每个标量曲率至少为一的完备连通光滑无边界 n 维流形，都具有到一个维数至多为 $`n-2`$ 的单纯复形的连续映射，其每个完整纤维的直径都有仅依赖于 n 的上界。

sentences.en: We also obtain the continuous macroscopic-dimension conclusion for universal covers of closed manifolds with positive scalar curvature in every dimension n ≥ 2.
sentences.zh: 我们还在每个维数 n ≥ 2 中，对具有正标量曲率的闭流形的万有覆盖得到了连续的宏观维数结论。

sentences.en: We resolve the generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetric conjecture in every dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个维数中解决了广义 Cartan–Hadamard 等周猜想。

sentences.en: In a complete simply connected smooth manifold with sectional curvature at most κ ≤ 0, every finite-volume set of finite ambient perimeter has perimeter at least that of the equal-volume ball in curvature κ.
sentences.zh: 在截面曲率至多为 κ ≤ 0 的完备单连通光滑流形中，每个在环境空间中具有有限周长的有限体积集合，其周长至少等于曲率为 κ 的空间中同体积球的周长。

sentences.en: For bounded positive-volume sets, equality in the Euclidean comparison holds precisely when the set agrees up to null sets with an open region isometric, with its induced metric, to a round Euclidean ball.
sentences.zh: 对于有界的正体积集合，欧氏比较中的等号成立，当且仅当该集合在相差零测集的意义下等于一个开区域，且该区域带上诱导度量后与一个欧氏圆球等距。

sentences.en: Every compactly supported integral n-cycle, n ≥ 2, in a proper CAT(0) space bounds a compactly supported integral current with the sharp Euclidean mass bound.
sentences.zh: 在固有 CAT(0) 空间中，每个具有紧支撑的整 n 维闭链（n ≥ 2）都是一个具有紧支撑的整流的边界，并且该整流满足最优的欧氏质量界。

sentences.en: The theorem allows arbitrary integer multiplicities and unrestricted ambient dimension.
sentences.zh: 该定理允许任意整数重数，并且对环境维数不作限制。

sentences.en: In particular, we prove the Euclidean Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetric conjecture in dimensions at least three.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们在至少三维时证明了欧氏 Cartan–Hadamard 等周猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every complete connected noncompact Kähler manifold with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature is biholomorphic to complex Euclidean space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，每个具有严格正全纯双截面曲率的完备连通非紧 Kähler 流形都双全纯于复欧氏空间。

sentences.en: This resolves Yau's uniformization conjecture positively in every complex dimension.
sentences.zh: 这在每个复维数中肯定地解决了 Yau 的单值化猜想。

sentences.en: For every closed connected smooth Riemannian manifold of dimension at least three with strictly negative sectional curvature, we prove that normalized Liouville measure has maximal entropy for the unit-speed geodesic flow if and only if the metric is locally symmetric.
sentences.zh: 对于每个维数至少为三、具有严格负截面曲率的闭连通光滑 Riemann 流形，我们证明，归一化的 Liouville 测度是单位速率测地流的最大熵测度，当且仅当该度量局部对称。

sentences.en: This resolves Katok's entropy rigidity conjecture positively in these dimensions, including all rank-one symmetric types at arbitrary scale.
sentences.zh: 这在这些维数中肯定地解决了 Katok 的熵刚性猜想，其中包括任意尺度下的所有秩一对称类型。

sentences.en: We disprove the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了不加限制的邻近 Lagrangian 猜想。

sentences.en: For some sufficiently large even integer N, we construct a closed exact smoothly embedded Lagrangian in $`T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1})`$ that is diffeomorphic to the base but is not Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section.
sentences.zh: 对于某个充分大的偶整数 N，我们在 $`T^*(S^9\times S^{N-1})`$ 中构造了一个闭的、正合的光滑嵌入 Lagrangian 子流形，它与底空间微分同胚，但不与零截面 Hamilton 同痕。

sentences.en: Every smooth normalized positive triple of closed two-forms on a closed connected oriented four-manifold admits a smooth deformation, with each cohomology class fixed, to a hyperkähler triple.
sentences.zh: 在闭连通定向四维流形上，每个由闭二形式组成的光滑归一化正三元组，都可以在各个上同调类保持固定的条件下光滑形变为一个超 Kähler 三元组。

sentences.en: This resolves Donaldson's hypersymplectic deformation conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这解决了 Donaldson 的 hypersymplectic 形变猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that every smooth almost complex structure on a closed four-manifold which is tamed by a symplectic form is compatible with a symplectic form.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，闭四维流形上每个受某个辛形式驯服的光滑殆复结构，都与某个辛形式相容。

sentences.en: This gives a positive solution to Donaldson's tamed-to-compatible conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这肯定地解决了 Donaldson 的从驯服到相容猜想。

sentences.en: We prove that, for all integers n ≥ 3 and k ≥ 1 and all positive real capacities $`R_1,\ldots,R_k`$, the closed standard symplectic $`2n`$-balls of these capacities embed disjointly into the interior of a ball of capacity R > 0 if and only if $`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^k R_i^n\lt R^n, \qquad R_i+R_j\lt R\quad(i\ne j).`$
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于所有整数 n ≥ 3 和 k ≥ 1，以及所有正实容量 $`R_1,\ldots,R_k`$，具有这些容量的闭标准辛 $`2n`$ 维球可以彼此不交地嵌入一个容量为 R > 0 的球的内部，当且仅当 $`\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^k R_i^n\lt R^n, \qquad R_i+R_j\lt R\quad(i\ne j).`$

sentences.en: Capacity is π times the squared Euclidean radius, and each embedding is defined on a neighborhood of its closed source ball.
sentences.zh: 容量等于欧氏半径平方的 π 倍，且每个嵌入都定义在其闭源球的一个邻域上。

sentences.en: This proves Siegel and Yao's Conjecture A.
sentences.zh: 这证明了 Siegel 和 Yao 的猜想 A。

sentences.en: We prove the metric Blaschke conjecture: every connected closed smooth Riemannian manifold of positive dimension whose global injectivity radius equals its diameter is, up to scale, a standard compact rank-one symmetric space.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了度量 Blaschke 猜想：每个整体单射半径等于直径的正维连通闭光滑 Riemann 流形，在相差一个尺度因子的意义下，都是一个标准的紧秩一对称空间。

sentences.en: We resolve the sphere case of the closed-geodesic infinitude problem: every smooth Riemannian metric on the standard sphere Sn, n ≥ 2, has infinitely many prime closed geodesics with pairwise distinct images.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了闭测地线无穷性问题的球面情形：标准球面 Sn（n ≥ 2）上的每个光滑 Riemann 度量都有无穷多条像两两不同的素闭测地线。

sentences.en: The two-sphere case is classical; the result in higher dimensions includes degenerate metrics.
sentences.zh: 二维球面的情形是经典结果；高维结果包括退化度量。

sentences.en: Using finite covers and theorems of Perelman and Rademacher–Taimanov, we also obtain the same conclusion for every smooth Riemannian metric on a nonempty closed smooth three-manifold.
sentences.zh: 利用有限覆盖以及 Perelman 和 Rademacher–Taimanov 的定理，我们还对非空闭光滑三维流形上的每个光滑 Riemann 度量得到了相同结论。

sentences.en: The singular set of every stationary integral m-varifold in an open Euclidean set has Hausdorff dimension at most $`m-1`$, in every positive dimension and codimension.
sentences.zh: 在每个正维数和正余维数下，欧氏开集中每个平稳整 m 维 varifold 的奇异集的 Hausdorff 维数都至多为 $`m-1`$。

sentences.en: This sharp bound proves the Euclidean singular-set conjecture recorded by Brena, Decio, and De Lellis.
sentences.zh: 这一最优界证明了 Brena、Decio 和 De Lellis 记载的欧氏奇异集猜想。

sentences.en: We resolve the almost-everywhere regularity conjecture of Brena, Decio, and De Lellis for stationary integral varifolds of arbitrary positive dimension and codimension in Euclidean open sets.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了 Brena、Decio 和 De Lellis 关于欧氏开集中任意正维数和正余维数的平稳整 varifold 的几乎处处正则性猜想。

sentences.en: The singular set has zero measure in the dimension of the varifold: near almost every support point, the varifold is a constant positive integer multiple of a smooth embedded minimal submanifold.
sentences.zh: 奇异集在 varifold 的维数下具有零测度：在几乎每个支撑点附近，该 varifold 都是一个光滑嵌入极小子流形的恒定正整数倍。

sentences.en: The corresponding statement also holds on round spheres.
sentences.zh: 相应的结论在圆球面上也成立。

sentences.en: We disprove the stable Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points with examples in fixed real dimension twenty-two.
sentences.zh: 我们用实维数固定为二十二的例子，否定了非退化 Hamilton 不动点数的稳定 Morse 下界。

sentences.en: For every integer m ≥ 1, we construct a simply connected closed Kähler manifold with stable Morse number $`80+1968m`$ and a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism with exactly $`80+1952m`$ fixed points, all nondegenerate and with contractible orbit loops.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 m ≥ 1，我们都构造了一个稳定 Morse 数为 $`80+1968m`$ 的单连通闭 Kähler 流形，以及一个恰有 $`80+1952m`$ 个不动点的 Hamilton 微分同胚，其中所有不动点均非退化，且轨道环均可缩。

sentences.en: The deficit is therefore unbounded, and the fixed-point count is at most 127/128 of the stable Morse number.
sentences.zh: 因此，缺额没有上界，且不动点数至多为稳定 Morse 数的 127/128。

sentences.en: We construct a simply connected closed Kähler manifold of real dimension 3332 and minimal Chern number one whose Hamiltonian fixed-point count attains the cyclic integral Floer bound while falling below the stable Morse number.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个实维数为 3332、最小 Chern 数为一的单连通闭 Kähler 流形，其 Hamilton 不动点数达到循环整系数 Floer 下界，同时又小于稳定 Morse 数。

sentences.en: The Hamiltonian diffeomorphism has exactly $`1\,872\,232`$ fixed points, all nondegenerate and with contractible orbit loops, whereas the stable Morse number is $`1\,872\,264`$.
sentences.zh: 该 Hamilton 微分同胚恰有 $`1\,872\,232`$ 个不动点，所有不动点均非退化且轨道环均可缩，而稳定 Morse 数为 $`1\,872\,264`$。

sentences.en: Thus the stronger stable Morse bound fails by exactly 32, even when the cyclic integral bound is sharp.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使循环整系数下界能够达到，较强的稳定 Morse 下界仍会恰好差 32 而失效。

sentences.en: We disprove the stable Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points by constructing a simply connected closed Kähler manifold with sixteen fewer fixed points than its stable Morse number.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个单连通闭 Kähler 流形，其不动点数比稳定 Morse 数少十六，从而否定了非退化 Hamilton 不动点数的稳定 Morse 下界。

sentences.en: All the corresponding periodic orbits are contractible.
sentences.zh: 所有对应的周期轨道都是可缩的。

sentences.en: The construction combines a Hamiltonian involution with integral homology torsion at two different primes; its proof uses finite-dimensional Morse theory and complex blowups.
sentences.zh: 该构造将一个 Hamilton 对合与整系数同调在两个不同素数处的挠性结合起来；其证明使用有限维 Morse 理论和复爆破。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth one-periodic Hamiltonian on a closed symplectic twelve-manifold whose time-one map has fewer fixed points than the manifold's ordinary Morse number.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个闭辛十二维流形上构造了一个光滑的周期为一的 Hamilton 函数，其时间一映射的不动点数小于该流形的通常 Morse 数。

sentences.en: Every fixed point is nondegenerate and has a contractible Hamiltonian trajectory.
sentences.zh: 每个不动点均非退化，且具有可缩的 Hamilton 轨迹。

sentences.en: This disproves the Morse-number form of the Arnold conjecture.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Arnold 猜想的 Morse 数形式。

sentences.en: The deficit can be arbitrarily large among twelve-dimensional examples.
sentences.zh: 在十二维例子中，缺额可以任意大。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold with exactly three fixed points, at least one of which is degenerate.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了复二次超曲面三维簇的一个光滑 Hamilton 微分同胚，它恰有三个不动点，其中至少一个是退化的。

sentences.en: The critical number and the unit-inclusive rational cup length of this manifold are both four.
sentences.zh: 该流形的临界数和包含单位元的有理系数杯积长度都为四。

sentences.en: Thus the example disproves the unrestricted critical-number and rational cup-length forms of the Arnold conjecture.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个例子否定了 Arnold 猜想在不加限制情形下的临界数形式和有理系数杯积长度形式。

sentences.en: We prove that a closed Einstein four-manifold with positive Einstein constant, nonnegative sectional curvature, and a zero-curvature plane has universal Riemannian cover isometric to a product of two round two-spheres.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一个具有正 Einstein 常数、非负截面曲率以及一个零曲率二平面的闭 Einstein 四维流形，其 Riemann 万有覆盖等距于两个圆二维球面的乘积。

sentences.en: Under the normalization $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ric}}\nolimits =3g`$, both spheres have radius $`1/\sqrt3`$.
sentences.zh: 在归一化 $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ric}}\nolimits =3g`$ 下，两个球面的半径都为 $`1/\sqrt3`$。

sentences.en: The proof extends coupled estimates for the two Weyl curvature blocks to the boundary of the sectional-curvature cone and determines their equality case.
sentences.zh: 证明将两个 Weyl 曲率块的耦合估计推广到截面曲率锥的边界，并确定了其等号情形。

sentences.en: We prove a universal, scale-invariant L2 gap for the trace-free Ricci tensor on simply connected closed four-manifolds with nonnegative sectional curvature.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于具有非负截面曲率的单连通闭四维流形，其无迹 Ricci 张量存在一个普适的、尺度不变的 L2 间隙。

sentences.en: If the trace-free Ricci energy is sufficiently small, the manifold is diffeomorphic to S4, $`\mathbb{CP}^2`$, or $`S^2\times S^2`$.
sentences.zh: 如果无迹 Ricci 能量充分小，则该流形微分同胚于 S4、$`\mathbb{CP}^2`$ 或 $`S^2\times S^2`$。

sentences.en: The proof uses the classification of positive-Einstein, nonnegatively curved four-manifolds supplied by the companion zero-plane rigidity theorem, stated explicitly as the classification premise of our result.
sentences.zh: 证明使用了配套的零平面刚性定理所提供的正 Einstein 常数、非负曲率四维流形的分类，我们将其明确陈述为结果的分类前提。

sentences.en: No auxiliary curvature, volume, diameter, injectivity-radius, or Sobolev bound is required.
sentences.zh: 无需额外的曲率、体积、直径、单射半径或 Sobolev 界。

sentences.en: The conclusion concerns the smooth manifold, not an isometry of the original metric.
sentences.zh: 结论涉及光滑流形，而非原始度量的等距性。

sentences.en: We prove the classification conjecture for connected smooth closed Einstein four-manifolds with strictly positive sectional curvature.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了具有严格正截面曲率的连通光滑闭 Einstein 四维流形的分类猜想。

sentences.en: Up to positive scaling and isometry, every such manifold is the round four-sphere, the complex projective plane with its Fubini–Study metric, or real projective four-space with its round metric.
sentences.zh: 在相差正尺度变换和等距映射的意义下，每个这样的流形都是圆四维球面、带 Fubini–Study 度量的复射影平面，或带圆度量的实四维射影空间。

sentences.en: No orientability assumption is needed.
sentences.zh: 无需可定向性假设。

sentences.en: We prove the Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of unit round spheres: in every dimension m ≥ 2, a closed connected minimal immersion with non-totally-geodesic image has volume at least the smallest m-dimensional minimal Clifford product.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了单位圆球面中极小超曲面的 Solomon–Yau 最小体积猜想：在每个维数 m ≥ 2 中，一个像非全测地的闭连通极小浸入，其体积至少等于体积最小的 m 维极小 Clifford 乘积的体积。

sentences.en: Volume is measured on the domain, so covering multiplicities are included.
sentences.zh: 体积是在定义域上测量的，因此计入覆盖重数。

sentences.en: We prove that a nonzero real Laplace eigenfunction with eigenvalue λ > 0 on a fixed smooth closed connected Riemannian surface has nodal length at most $`C\sqrt\lambda`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在一个固定的、带 Riemann 度量的光滑闭连通曲面上，特征值为 λ > 0 的非零实 Laplace 特征函数的结点集长度至多为 $`C\sqrt\lambda`$。

sentences.en: Together with the known lower bound, this proves Yau's conjecture in this setting.
sentences.zh: 结合已知的下界，这证明了该情形下的 Yau 猜想。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth metric on the three-sphere, arbitrarily close to the round metric in the smooth topology, and a smooth metric on $`S^2\times\mathbb T^2`$ for which sequences of exact real Laplace eigenfunctions have unbounded nodal measure divided by the square root of the eigenvalue.
sentences.zh: 我们在三维球面上构造了一个在光滑拓扑下任意接近圆度量的光滑度量，并在 $`S^2\times\mathbb T^2`$ 上构造了一个光滑度量，使得相应的精确的实 Laplace 特征函数序列的结点集测度除以特征值平方根所得的比值无界。

sentences.en: Each sequence belongs to one fixed metric.
sentences.zh: 每个序列都对应于一个固定的度量。

sentences.en: Thus the upper-bound part of Yau's nodal conjecture fails for smooth metrics in dimensions three and four.
sentences.zh: 因此，Yau 结点集猜想的上界部分在三维和四维的光滑度量情形下不成立。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth Riemannian metric on $`S^4\times S^1`$ and a sequence of real Laplace eigenfunctions whose nodal four-volume grows faster than $`\lambda^{1/2+\epsilon_0}`$ for one fixed $`\epsilon_0\gt 0`$.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $`S^4\times S^1`$ 上构造了一个光滑 Riemann 度量和一列实 Laplace 特征函数，对于某个固定的 $`\epsilon_0\gt 0`$，它们的结点集四维体积增长得比 $`\lambda^{1/2+\epsilon_0}`$ 更快。

sentences.en: This disproves the smooth upper-bound assertion in Yau's nodal-set conjecture and the proposed bound with an arbitrarily small positive power loss.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Yau 结点集猜想中光滑情形的上界断言，以及所提出的允许任意小正幂损失的界。

sentences.en: We disprove the scalar-curvature extension conjecture in its unrestricted all-dimensions form.
sentences.zh: 我们否定了标量曲率延拓猜想在不加限制、涵盖所有维数时的形式。

sentences.en: In sufficiently high dimension, we construct a Ricci flow on a closed manifold whose scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded while full curvature diverges at a finite maximal time.
sentences.zh: 在充分高的维数中，我们在一个闭流形上构造了 Ricci 流，其标量曲率始终一致有界，而完整曲率在一个有限的最大存在时刻发散。

sentences.en: In one fixed sufficiently high dimension, the examples have two-sided power-law curvature blowup with arbitrarily large exponents.
sentences.zh: 在某个固定的充分高维数中，这些例子的曲率爆破具有双侧幂律界，且指数可以任意大。
