sentences.en: We prove that a smooth Ricci flow on a closed real four-manifold extends on the same manifold through every finite time at which its scalar curvature remains uniformly bounded.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，闭实四维流形上的光滑 Ricci 流，可以在同一流形上延拓经过每一个标量曲率始终一致有界的有限时刻。

sentences.en: This resolves the scalar-curvature extension problem in dimension four.
sentences.zh: 这解决了四维的标量曲率延拓问题。

sentences.en: We prove a sequential elliptic inequality for the renormalized Einstein–Hilbert functional on a fixed finite tree of four-dimensional Ricci-flat spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们对一个由四维 Ricci 平坦空间组成的固定有限树上的重整化 Einstein–Hilbert 泛函，证明了一个序列式椭圆不等式。

sentences.en: As the joining lengths diverge and the scale-neutral weighted Ricci error M tends to zero, the functional satisfies $`E=o(M)`$.
sentences.zh: 当连接长度趋于无穷且尺度中性的加权 Ricci 误差 M 趋于零时，该泛函满足 $`E=o(M)`$。

sentences.en: The root end has decay exponent greater than one, and every joined quotient group is nontrivial.
sentences.zh: 根端的衰减指数大于一，且每个参与连接的商群都非平凡。

sentences.en: We also prove the multivariable path-selection theorem for asymptotic expansions used to obtain this estimate.
sentences.zh: 我们还证明了用于获得这一估计的渐近展开多变量路径选择定理。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth Kähler metric in the Fubini–Study class of $`\mathbb{CP}^{10}`$ whose Calabi flow develops unbounded scalar curvature in finite time.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $`\mathbb{CP}^{10}`$ 的 Fubini–Study 类中构造了一个光滑 Kähler 度量，其 Calabi 流在有限时间内产生无界的标量曲率。

sentences.en: This disproves Chen's smooth long-time existence conjecture, even in a class containing a constant-scalar-curvature metric.
sentences.zh: 这否定了 Chen 的光滑长时间存在性猜想，即使在一个包含常标量曲率度量的类中也如此。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth nonquadratic entire graph in dimension ten that solves the classical affine maximal equation and has positive-definite Hessian everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们在十维中构造了一个定义于整个空间的光滑非二次函数的图像，该函数满足经典仿射极大方程，且 Hessian 处处正定。

sentences.en: This gives a smooth counterexample to the entire-graph affine Bernstein assertion in dimension ten.
sentences.zh: 这给出了十维中针对全空间函数图像的仿射 Bernstein 断言的一个光滑反例。

sentences.en: Hessian positivity is pointwise; no global uniform lower bound or completeness of the Berwald–Blaschke metric is asserted.
sentences.zh: Hessian 的正定性是逐点的；我们并未断言存在全局一致下界，也未断言 Berwald–Blaschke 度量完备。

sentences.en: We prove the Euclidean-complete affine Bernstein conjecture in dimensions three through nine: a smooth locally uniformly convex affine maximal graph is an elliptic paraboloid whenever its induced Euclidean metric is complete.
sentences.zh: 我们在三至九维中证明了欧氏完备的仿射 Bernstein 猜想：一个光滑、局部一致凸的仿射极大图像，只要其诱导欧氏度量完备，就必为椭圆抛物面。

sentences.en: The same conclusion holds, without an initial graph assumption, for connected smooth open (noncompact and without boundary) affine-complete locally uniformly convex immersed hypersurfaces that are classically affine maximal in these dimensions.
sentences.zh: 在这些维数中，对于连通光滑开（非紧且无边界）、仿射完备、局部一致凸且在经典意义下仿射极大的浸入超曲面，即使不预先假定其为函数的图像，也有相同结论。

sentences.en: We prove the isoperimetric conjecture for the cubic flat three-torus and classify all minimizers, including the equality cases at the transition volumes $`4\pi/81`$ and $`1/\pi`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了立方平坦三维环面的等周猜想，并分类了所有极小化区域，包括转变体积 $`4\pi/81`$ 和 $`1/\pi`$ 处的等号情形。

sentences.en: The minimizing regions are balls, circular tubes about shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements.
sentences.zh: 极小化区域为球、围绕最短闭测地线的圆管、坐标板层及其补集。

sentences.en: We prove that, at each singular point of the first singular time of the mean-curvature flow of a smooth compact connected embedded surface without boundary in ℝ<sup>3</sup>, all fixed-center rescalings converge locally smoothly on compact negative-time intervals to one multiplicity-one homothetic self-shrinker flow.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于 ℝ<sup>3</sup> 中一个光滑紧连通无边界嵌入曲面的平均曲率流，在其首次奇异时刻的每个奇异点处，所有固定中心的重标度都在紧的负时间区间上局部光滑收敛到同一个重数为一的位似自收缩流。

sentences.en: The limit is unique in the original ambient coordinates, including its position and axes.
sentences.zh: 极限在原始环境坐标中是唯一的，包括其位置和各轴。

sentences.en: No mean-convexity assumption or prescribed tangent model is required.
sentences.zh: 无需平均曲率凸性假设，也无需预先指定切流模型。

sentences.en: For every integer n ≥ 2 and κ ∈ ℝ, we prove that a complete separable metric space is an n-dimensional Alexandrov space of curvature at least κ if and only if, with reference measure $`\mathcal H^n`$, it is a full-support $`\mathrm{RCD}((n-1)\kappa,n)`$ space whose distributional sectional curvature is at least κ in Gigli's original global test classes.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 n ≥ 2 和 κ ∈ ℝ，我们证明，一个完备可分度量空间是曲率至少为 κ 的 n 维 Alexandrov 空间，当且仅当以 $`\mathcal H^n`$ 为参考测度时，它是一个具有全支撑的 $`\mathrm{RCD}((n-1)\kappa,n)`$ 空间，且其分布意义下的截面曲率在 Gigli 原始的全局测试类中至少为 κ。

sentences.en: This resolves Gigli's characterization conjecture in dimensions at least two.
sentences.zh: 这在至少二维时解决了 Gigli 的刻画猜想。

sentences.en: On a full-support $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,N)`$ space with $`1\lt N\lt \infty`$, we prove that a bounded globally Lipschitz function whose distributional Hessian is bounded above by a bounded continuous function satisfies the corresponding second-derivative inequality along every minimizing geodesic.
sentences.zh: 在满足 $`1\lt N\lt \infty`$、具有全支撑的 $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,N)`$ 空间上，我们证明，若一个有界的全局 Lipschitz 函数的分布 Hessian 以某个有界连续函数为上界，则它沿每条极小测地线都满足相应的二阶导数不等式。

sentences.en: We resolve the regular-point bi-Lipschitz conjecture in the noncollapsed setting.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了非塌缩情形下正则点的双 Lipschitz 猜想。

sentences.en: For every integer n ≥ 2 and every real K, every regular point of a noncollapsed $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,n)`$ space has an open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz homeomorphic to an open subset of ℝn.
sentences.zh: 对于每个整数 n ≥ 2 和每个实数 K，非塌缩 $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,n)`$ 空间的每个正则点都有一个开邻域，与 ℝn 的某个开子集双 Lipschitz 同胚。

sentences.en: The bi-Lipschitz constant depends only on n, and the neighborhood uses the restricted ambient distance.
sentences.zh: 双 Lipschitz 常数仅依赖于 n，且该邻域使用环境距离的限制。

sentences.en: We construct a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold that admits a smooth Riemannian metric without conjugate points but admits no smooth Riemannian metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个闭连通可定向光滑三维流形，它容许无共轭点的光滑 Riemann 度量，却不容许任何非正截面曲率的光滑 Riemann 度量。

sentences.en: We construct a contractible domain in complex dimension three with a complete Kähler metric whose real sectional curvatures lie between two finite negative constants.
sentences.zh: 我们在复维数三中构造了一个可缩域，它具有完备 Kähler 度量，且其实截面曲率介于两个有限负常数之间。

sentences.en: It admits no bounded holomorphic map to ℂ<sup>3</sup> with nowhere-vanishing Jacobian and is therefore not biholomorphic to a bounded domain.
sentences.zh: 它不容许到 ℂ<sup>3</sup> 的、Jacobian 处处非零的有界全纯映射，因此不双全纯于任何有界域。

sentences.en: This gives a negative answer to the negatively pinched Kähler uniformization question.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了负曲率双侧夹逼下的 Kähler 单值化问题。

sentences.en: We construct, in some sufficiently large fixed finite complex dimension m, a domain in ℂm diffeomorphic to $`\mathbb R^{2m}`$ that admits a complete Kähler metric with real sectional curvature at most −1 and has only constant bounded holomorphic functions.
sentences.zh: 在某个固定的充分大的有限复维数 m 中，我们构造了 ℂm 中一个与 $`\mathbb R^{2m}`$ 微分同胚的域，它具有实截面曲率至多为 −1 的完备 Kähler 度量，且所有有界全纯函数都是常数。

sentences.en: Its sectional curvatures are unbounded below.
sentences.zh: 其截面曲率没有下界。

sentences.en: The construction gives a negative answer to the one-sided bounded-holomorphic-function question.
sentences.zh: 这一构造否定地回答了单侧曲率界下的有界全纯函数问题。

sentences.en: We prove that weak Ma–Trudinger–Wang curvature on a smooth, connected, compact Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two without boundary implies convexity of every tangent injectivity domain, resolving Villani's conjecture in this setting.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在维数至少为二的光滑连通紧无边界 Riemann 流形上，弱 Ma–Trudinger–Wang 曲率条件蕴含每个切空间中的单射域都为凸集，从而解决了该情形下 Villani 的猜想。

sentences.en: Conjugate cut points are allowed.
sentences.zh: 允许存在共轭割点。

sentences.en: More generally, every ordinary subgradient of a squared-distance cost potential is a minimizing velocity with a global supporting mountain.
sentences.zh: 更一般地，平方距离代价势的每个通常次梯度都是一个具有全局 supporting mountain 的极小化速度向量。

sentences.en: No density hypothesis is used.
sentences.zh: 不使用任何密度假设。

sentences.en: We prove that the weak Ma–Trudinger–Wang condition on a fixed smooth connected compact boundaryless Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two implies a common Hölder estimate for optimal transport maps and their inverses over the entire class of probability densities with fixed positive upper and lower bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在一个固定的、维数至少为二的光滑连通紧无边界 Riemann 流形上，弱 Ma–Trudinger–Wang 条件蕴含：对于具有固定正上下界的整个概率密度类，最优输运映射及其逆映射都满足一个共同的 Hölder 估计。

sentences.en: The maps have homeomorphic representatives, conjugate cut points are allowed, and no density regularity is assumed.
sentences.zh: 这些映射具有同胚代表，允许存在共轭割点，且不假设密度具有正则性。

sentences.en: For some even n ≥ 8 and integer k ≥ 2, we construct a complete smooth metric on ℝn with nonnegative Ricci curvature whose space of real harmonic functions of pointwise polynomial growth at most k has dimension larger than the Euclidean harmonic-polynomial dimension.
sentences.zh: 对于某个偶数 n ≥ 8 和整数 k ≥ 2，我们在 ℝn 上构造了一个具有非负 Ricci 曲率的完备光滑度量，其逐点多项式增长次数至多为 k 的实调和函数空间的维数，大于欧氏空间中相应调和多项式空间的维数。

sentences.en: The metric is Euclidean near the origin, has asymptotic volume ratio strictly between zero and one, and has nonunique tangent cones at infinity.
sentences.zh: 该度量在原点附近是欧氏的，渐近体积比严格介于零和一之间，且在无穷远处的切锥不唯一。

sentences.en: This answers the integer-degree form of Yau's dimension comparison question in the negative.
sentences.zh: 这否定地回答了 Yau 维数比较问题的整数次数形式。

sentences.en: For every $`4/9\lt v\lt 1`$ and $`1\lt c\lt 9v/4`$, all sufficiently large integers k admit a complete smooth metric on ℝ3 with nonnegative Ricci curvature, asymptotic volume ratio v, and at least $`c(k+1)^2`$ linearly independent real harmonic functions of pointwise growth at most k.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 $`4/9\lt v\lt 1`$ 和 $`1\lt c\lt 9v/4`$，以及所有充分大的整数 k，ℝ3 上都存在一个完备光滑度量，它具有非负 Ricci 曲率、渐近体积比 v，以及至少 $`c(k+1)^2`$ 个线性无关的、逐点增长次数至多为 k 的实调和函数。

sentences.en: This answers Yau's integer-degree dimension comparison question negatively in dimension three, with a fixed-factor excess over the Euclidean count.
sentences.zh: 这在三维中否定地回答了 Yau 的整数次数维数比较问题，且相对于欧氏计数有一个固定因子的超出量。

sentences.en: For each $`1\lt c\lt 9/4`$, these metrics can be chosen arbitrarily close to the Euclidean metric in global bi-Lipschitz distance.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 $`1\lt c\lt 9/4`$，这些度量在全局双 Lipschitz 距离下可以选得任意接近欧氏度量。

sentences.en: The metric may depend on k.
sentences.zh: 该度量可以依赖于 k。

sentences.en: We prove global existence and uniqueness for arbitrary smooth admissible initial data in the three-dimensional, one-species relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system.
sentences.zh: 对于三维单物种相对论性 Vlasov–Maxwell 系统，我们证明了任意光滑容许初值下的整体存在性和唯一性。

sentences.en: The particle density is initially compactly supported, and the electromagnetic fields have finite energy and bounded derivatives of all orders.
sentences.zh: 粒子密度初始时具有紧支撑，电磁场具有有限能量且各阶导数均有界。

sentences.en: The solution remains smooth on every finite time interval.
sentences.zh: 解在每个有限时间区间上始终光滑。

sentences.en: This resolves the large-data global classical regularity problem for this model, without size or symmetry restrictions on the data.
sentences.zh: 这解决了该模型的大初值整体经典正则性问题，对初值的大小或对称性不作限制。

sentences.en: We prove nonuniqueness for the three-dimensional periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation among global entropy solutions satisfying exact local conservation of mass, momentum, and kinetic energy.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在满足质量、动量和动能的精确局部守恒的整体熵解中，三维周期硬球 Boltzmann 方程的解不唯一。

sentences.en: We construct one nonnegative initial density with bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, and absolute entropy that gives rise to two distinct such solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们构造了一个非负初始密度，它具有有界速度支撑、有限质量、有限能量和有限绝对熵，并产生两个不同的上述解。

sentences.en: Both are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gain and loss terms are integrable with every polynomial velocity weight on every bounded time interval.
sentences.zh: 这两个解在 L1 中都强连续，且其碰撞增益项和损失项在每个有界时间区间上乘以任意多项式速度权重后都可积。

sentences.en: We prove nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation by constructing two distinct global renormalized solutions with the same nonnegative initial density on $`\mathbb T^3\times\mathbb R^3`$.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $`\mathbb T^3\times\mathbb R^3`$ 上构造了具有相同非负初始密度的两个不同的整体重整化解，从而证明周期硬球 Boltzmann 方程的解不唯一。

sentences.en: This density has bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, and absolute entropy.
sentences.zh: 该密度具有有界速度支撑、有限质量、有限能量和有限绝对熵。

sentences.en: Both solutions conserve local mass and total momentum and satisfy the global energy and entropy-dissipation inequalities.
sentences.zh: 两个解都保持局部质量和总动量守恒，并满足整体能量不等式和熵耗散不等式。

sentences.en: On a common initial interval, they are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gains and losses are integrable.
sentences.zh: 在一个共同的初始时间区间上，它们在 L1 中强连续，且其碰撞增益项和损失项可积。

sentences.en: We derive the nonlinear Boltzmann equation from a grand-canonical Newtonian gas with initial pair exclusion.
sentences.zh: 我们从一个具有初始粒子对排除条件的巨正则 Newton 气体推导非线性 Boltzmann 方程。

sentences.en: We treat stable, finite-range radial potentials that are C2 except for an allowed repulsive singularity at the origin, and C1 initial probability densities with spatially summable Gaussian bounds on the density and its spatial gradient.
sentences.zh: 我们处理稳定的有限作用范围径向势，它们除了在原点处允许有一个排斥奇点以外均为 C2，并处理 C1 初始概率密度，该密度及其空间梯度满足在空间上可求和的高斯界。

sentences.en: All fixed-order rescaled factorial marginals converge in L1, uniformly throughout every finite interval on which the classical kinetic solution has a uniform Gaussian bound.
sentences.zh: 所有固定阶的重标度阶乘边缘分布都在 L1 中收敛，且该收敛在经典动理学解具有一致高斯界的每个有限区间上是一致的。

sentences.en: The result allows attractive wells and dynamically formed clusters, without restrictions on the differential scattering cross-section.
sentences.zh: 该结果允许吸引势阱和动力学过程中形成的团簇，且对微分散射截面不作限制。

sentences.en: We prove a finite-dimensional central limit theorem away from equilibrium for a deterministic grand-canonical hard-sphere gas in three dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们对三维确定性巨正则硬球气体证明了远离平衡态的有限维中心极限定理。

sentences.en: The initial probability density is smooth, with spatially summable Gaussian velocity bounds on the density and its spatial gradient.
sentences.zh: 初始概率密度是光滑的，且该密度及其空间梯度满足在空间上可求和的速度高斯界。

sentences.en: The limit holds on every finite interval on which the classical Boltzmann solution has uniform Gaussian velocity decay.
sentences.zh: 该极限在经典 Boltzmann 解具有一致的速度高斯衰减的每个有限区间上成立。

sentences.en: The empirical measure is centered by its exact microscopic expectation.
sentences.zh: 经验测度以其精确的微观期望为中心化项。

sentences.en: Its fluctuations converge to the Gaussian solution of the linear fluctuating Boltzmann equation.
sentences.zh: 其涨落收敛到线性涨落 Boltzmann 方程的高斯解。

sentences.en: We prove that zero-frequency boundary measurements on any nonempty open boundary patch determine both a smooth Riemannian metric and a smooth unitary connection on the trivial Hermitian rank-two bundle over a compact connected smooth manifold of dimension at least three with smooth boundary.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在一个具有光滑边界、维数至少为三的紧连通光滑流形上，任意非空开边界片上的零频边界测量都可以同时确定一个光滑 Riemann 度量，以及平凡 Hermite 秩二丛上的一个光滑酉联络。

sentences.en: Both inputs and observations are restricted to the same patch.
sentences.zh: 输入和观测都限制在同一个边界片上。

sentences.en: The metric and connection are determined up to a diffeomorphism and a unitary gauge that restrict to the identity on the measured patch.
sentences.zh: 度量和联络的确定只差一个微分同胚和一个酉规范变换，且它们在被测边界片上的限制均为恒等。

sentences.en: We resolve the smooth anisotropic Calderón uniqueness problem with arbitrary same-patch measurements.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了在任意同一边界片上进行测量的光滑各向异性 Calderón 唯一性问题。

sentences.en: A smooth Riemannian metric on a compact connected manifold of dimension at least three is determined, up to a diffeomorphism fixing the measured patch, by its zero-frequency Dirichlet-to-Neumann energy form with both input and observation on any nonempty open boundary patch.
sentences.zh: 维数至少为三的紧连通流形上的一个光滑 Riemann 度量，可以由其零频 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 能量形式确定，唯一的自由度是固定被测边界片的微分同胚，其中输入和观测都位于任意一个非空开边界片上。

sentences.en: We construct two distinct uniformly positive bounded measurable scalar conductivities on a ball in ℝ<sup>3</sup> with the same full Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ℝ<sup>3</sup> 的一个球上构造了两个不同的一致正、有界可测的标量电导率，它们具有相同的完整 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 算子。

sentences.en: Both conductivities equal one near the boundary.
sentences.zh: 两个电导率在边界附近都等于一。

sentences.en: This gives nonuniqueness in the scalar Calderón problem at bounded measurable regularity.
sentences.zh: 这给出了标量 Calderón 问题在有界可测正则性下的非唯一性。

sentences.en: We prove the interior regularity assertion of the planar Mumford–Shah conjecture for reduced absolute minimizers with bounded fidelity data.
sentences.zh: 我们对具有有界保真数据的约化绝对极小化子，证明了平面 Mumford–Shah 猜想的内部正则性断言。

sentences.en: Every interior point of the closed discontinuity set has a neighborhood consisting of a $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ arc, an arc ending at that point, or three such arcs meeting at 120 degrees.
sentences.zh: 闭不连续集中每个位于定义域内部的点都有一个邻域，其中该集合由一条 $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ 弧、一条以该点为端点的弧，或三条以 120 度相交的此类弧组成。

sentences.en: Only finitely many global connected components meet any relatively compact open set.
sentences.zh: 与任意相对紧开集相交的全局连通分支只有有限多个。

sentences.en: We prove that seven is the critical dimension for the one-phase Bernoulli problem: every nonzero one-homogeneous global minimizer in dimensions at most six is flat, while a nonflat one-homogeneous global minimizer exists in dimension seven.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，七是单相 Bernoulli 问题的临界维数：在至多六维时，每个非零的一次齐次全局极小化子都是平坦的，而在七维中存在一个非平坦的一次齐次全局极小化子。

sentences.en: It follows that the interior free boundary of a local minimizer is smooth in dimensions at most six.
sentences.zh: 由此可知，在至多六维时，局部极小化子的内部自由边界是光滑的。

sentences.en: In dimension n ≥ 7, its singular set has Hausdorff dimension at most $`n-7`$, and this bound is sharp.
sentences.zh: 在维数 n ≥ 7 中，其奇异集的 Hausdorff 维数至多为 $`n-7`$，且该界是最优的。

sentences.en: In dimension seven, the singular set is locally finite.
sentences.zh: 在七维中，奇异集局部有限。

sentences.en: We resolve the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem for $`1\le p\le2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了 $`1\le p\le2`$ 时的三维 Ball–Evans 逼近问题。

sentences.en: Every $`W^{1,p}`$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ<sup>3</sup> is a strong $`W^{1,p}`$ limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
sentences.zh: ℝ<sup>3</sup> 中任意有界域之间的每个 $`W^{1,p}`$ 同胚，都是映满同一目标域的光滑微分同胚的强 $`W^{1,p}`$ 极限。

sentences.en: We resolve the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem for every finite p > 2.
sentences.zh: 我们对每个有限的 p > 2 解决了三维 Ball–Evans 逼近问题。

sentences.en: Every $`W^{1,p}`$ homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ<sup>3</sup> can be approximated strongly in $`W^{1,p}`$ by smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
sentences.zh: ℝ<sup>3</sup> 中任意有界域之间的每个 $`W^{1,p}`$ 同胚，都可以在 $`W^{1,p}`$ 中由映满同一目标域的光滑微分同胚强逼近。

sentences.en: We prove the strict hot spots conjecture for smooth bounded simply connected planar domains.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了光滑有界单连通平面域的严格热点猜想。

sentences.en: More precisely, every nonzero eigenfunction for the first positive Neumann eigenvalue has nonvanishing gradient in the interior, so all its global maxima and minima lie on the boundary.
sentences.zh: 更确切地说，第一个正 Neumann 特征值对应的每个非零特征函数在内部的梯度都不消失，因此它的所有全局极大值点和极小值点都位于边界上。

sentences.en: This holds even when the eigenvalue is multiple.
sentences.zh: 即使该特征值是多重的，这一结论也成立。

sentences.en: We prove the subcritical Hénon–Lane–Emden conjecture: for every dimension n ≥ 2, positive powers p, q, and real weights A, B, the system has no strictly positive entire solution when $`(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)\gt n-2`$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了次临界 Hénon–Lane–Emden 猜想：对于每个维数 n ≥ 2、正幂指数 p、q 以及实权重 A、B，当 $`(n+A)/(p+1)+(n+B)/(q+1)\gt n-2`$ 时，该系统不存在严格正的整解。

sentences.en: Solutions need only be continuous at the origin and classical elsewhere, without a condition at infinity.
sentences.zh: 解只需在原点连续，并在其他地方是经典解，无需无穷远处的条件。

sentences.en: For n ≥ 3 and $`A,B\gt -2`$, combining this result with the radial existence theorem of Bidaut-Véron and Giacomini proves Phan's Conjecture C in full: a positive radial entire solution exists whenever the strict inequality fails.
sentences.zh: 对于 n ≥ 3 和 $`A,B\gt -2`$，将这一结果与 Bidaut-Véron 和 Giacomini 的径向存在性定理结合，就完整地证明了 Phan 的猜想 C：只要严格不等式不成立，就存在一个正的径向整解。

sentences.en: We prove stable self-similar finite-time blowup for a supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the twelve-dimensional torus.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，十二维环面上的一个超临界散焦非线性 Schrödinger 方程存在稳定的自相似有限时间爆破。

sentences.en: For a sufficiently large odd power, the blowup initial data contain a nonempty open set in a high Sobolev space.
sentences.zh: 对于一个充分大的奇数幂指数，产生爆破的初值包含一个高阶 Sobolev 空间中的非空开集。

sentences.en: As a consequence, Gaussian Fourier initial data of arbitrarily high Sobolev regularity can have positive probability of finite-time blowup.
sentences.zh: 由此，具有任意高 Sobolev 正则性的高斯 Fourier 初值可以以正概率发生有限时间爆破。

sentences.en: We prove that the full static displacement-to-traction map uniquely determines both real smooth Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ3, provided μ > 0 and $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$ on the closure.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在 ℝ3 中每个有界连通光滑域上，只要在闭包上有 μ > 0 和 $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$，完整的静态位移到牵引力映射就唯一确定两个实光滑 Lamé 模量。

sentences.en: This resolves the smooth three-dimensional isotropic elastic Calderón uniqueness problem under these positivity assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这在这些正性假设下解决了光滑三维各向同性弹性 Calderón 唯一性问题。

sentences.en: We construct a smooth compactly supported probability density on ℝ<sup>3</sup>, with a smooth compactly supported square root, for which the three-marginal Coulomb transport minimum is not attained by any pair of measure-preserving Borel maps.
sentences.zh: 我们在 ℝ<sup>3</sup> 上构造了一个具有光滑紧支撑平方根的光滑紧支撑概率密度，使得三边缘 Coulomb 输运的最小值无法由任何一对保测 Borel 映射达到。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the Monge and Kantorovich infima agree: we construct preserving maps whose costs approach the Kantorovich minimum.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，Monge 和 Kantorovich 下确界相等：我们构造了代价趋近于 Kantorovich 最小值的保测映射。

sentences.en: For every d ≥ 2 and s > 0, we also construct a smooth identical marginal with the same nonattainment and equality-of-infima properties for the inverse-power interaction $`\sum_{i\lt j}|x_i-x_j|^{-s}`$ on ℝd.
sentences.zh: 对于每个 d ≥ 2 和 s > 0，我们还构造了一个光滑的共同边缘分布，使得 ℝd 上的反幂相互作用 $`\sum_{i\lt j}|x_i-x_j|^{-s}`$ 也具有同样的最小值无法取到且下确界相等的性质。

sentences.en: For the uniform probability measure ρ on a compact convex body in ℝd, d ≥ 2, quadratic optimal transport maps are one-third Hölder continuous in $`L^2(\rho)`$ with respect to the target's 2-Wasserstein distance.
sentences.zh: 对于 ℝd（d ≥ 2）中一个紧凸体上的均匀概率测度 ρ，二次代价最优输运映射在 $`L^2(\rho)`$ 中关于目标测度的 2-Wasserstein 距离是三分之一阶 Hölder 连续的。

sentences.en: The constant is uniform over all targets supported in a fixed compact set, and the exponent is optimal.
sentences.zh: 对于支撑包含在一个固定紧集中的所有目标测度，该常数是一致的，且该指数是最优的。

sentences.en: A three-atom family on a fixed cube disproves Letrouit's conjectured uniform square-root estimate.
sentences.zh: 固定立方体上的一个三原子测度族否定了 Letrouit 猜想中的一致平方根估计。

sentences.en: We resolve De Giorgi's conjecture positively in dimension eight: every entire C2 solution $`u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)`$ of $`\Delta u=u^3-u`$ with an everywhere positive directional derivative is a planar heteroclinic.
sentences.zh: 我们在八维中肯定地解决了 De Giorgi 猜想：$`\Delta u=u^3-u`$ 的每个具有某个处处为正的方向导数的 C2 整解 $`u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)`$，都是一个平面异宿解。

sentences.en: We prove that every stable solution $`v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]`$ of this equation is a constant well or a planar heteroclinic, without an energy-growth assumption.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，该方程的每个稳定解 $`v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]`$ 都是一个取值于势阱的常数解或平面异宿解，无需能量增长假设。

sentences.en: We realize finite reciprocal affine instruction maps by smooth incompressible shear flows on a flat three-torus.
sentences.zh: 我们通过平坦三维环面上的光滑不可压缩剪切流，实现有限组 reciprocal 仿射指令映射。

sentences.en: Applied to a reversible one-head recorder with a finite transition table, this gives a complete machine-to-fluid construction: a fixed particle enters a fixed open strip exactly when a given machine halts, with zero initial velocity, zero pressure, and a solenoidal mean-zero force that is periodic after initialization.
sentences.zh: 将其应用于具有有限转移表的可逆单头记录器，就得到一个完整的机器到流体构造：一个固定粒子进入一个固定开条带，当且仅当给定机器停机，其中初速度为零、压强为零，而外力无散、均值为零，且在初始化之后是周期的。

sentences.en: The construction acts on full closed rectangles and controls every intermediate trajectory.
sentences.zh: 该构造作用于整个闭矩形，并控制每一条中间轨迹。

sentences.en: Separate heights resolve overlap between sources and targets, and an endpoint-size estimate controls all excursions independently of the reciprocal scaling factor.
sentences.zh: 不同高度消除了源与目标之间的重叠，而一个端点大小估计控制了所有偏移，且与 reciprocal 缩放因子无关。

sentences.en: We construct smooth external forces for incompressible Navier–Stokes flow on a fixed flat three-torus at any fixed positive computable viscosity, from zero initial velocity, such that a fixed particle enters a fixed open set exactly when a prescribed Turing machine halts.
sentences.zh: 在任意固定的正可计算黏性系数下，我们为固定平坦三维环面上从零初速度开始的不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 流构造光滑外力，使得一个固定粒子进入一个固定开集，当且仅当指定的 Turing 机停机。

sentences.en: Every mixed derivative of the force and velocity is bounded and square-integrable in time in spatial supremum norm.
sentences.zh: 外力和速度的每个混合导数都有界，并且以空间上确界范数计关于时间平方可积。

sentences.en: The construction uses the machine's ordinary instructions, records their history in a third coordinate, and compensates for finer spatial gates by longer time steps.
sentences.zh: 该构造使用机器的通常指令，在第三个坐标中记录指令历史，并通过更长的时间步补偿更精细的空间门。

sentences.en: At every fixed positive computable viscosity, we construct smooth mean-zero forces on the flat three-torus that become stationary after time one and make a fixed particle, initially in a fluid at rest, enter a fixed open set exactly when a prescribed Turing machine halts.
sentences.zh: 在每个固定的正可计算黏性系数下，我们在平坦三维环面上构造光滑的零均值外力，它们在时刻一之后变为定常，并使一个初始位于静止流体中的固定粒子进入一个固定开集，当且仅当指定的 Turing 机停机。

sentences.en: The force has bounded derivatives of every order and a finite effective description.
sentences.zh: 该外力的各阶导数均有界，且具有有限的有效描述。

sentences.en: A reversible recording table is realized on whole planar rectangles by Hamiltonian motions, then driven by a mean-zero spatial clock.
sentences.zh: 一个可逆记录表通过 Hamilton 运动在整个平面矩形上实现，然后由一个均值为零的空间时钟驱动。

sentences.en: Separate choices give periodic forcing from time zero or a force whose derivatives are square-integrable in time.
sentences.zh: 通过不同选择，可以得到从时刻零起就周期的外力，或各阶导数关于时间平方可积的外力。

sentences.en: We construct smooth solenoidal mean-zero forces, periodic from time zero, for which a fixed particle on a flat three-torus reaches a fixed open strip exactly when a given machine halts.
sentences.zh: 我们构造从时刻零起就周期的光滑无散零均值外力，使得平坦三维环面上的一个固定粒子到达一个固定开条带，当且仅当给定机器停机。

sentences.en: The initial fluid velocity and the pressure are zero.
sentences.zh: 初始流体速度和压强均为零。

sentences.en: We also realize positive diagonal maps on coding sheets by incompressible shears, with explicit normal compensation for changes of planar area, and reciprocal maps on whole boxes of positive thickness.
sentences.zh: 我们还通过不可压缩剪切，在编码片上实现正对角映射，并对平面面积变化给出显式的法向补偿，同时在具有正厚度的整个长方体上实现 reciprocal 映射。

sentences.en: Complete local inverses, initialization rules, and intermediate trajectory bounds connect these geometric constructions to finite computations.
sentences.zh: 完整的局部逆、初始化规则和中间轨迹界，将这些几何构造与有限计算联系起来。

sentences.en: Finite prefix instructions may change area and erase information.
sentences.zh: 有限前缀指令可以改变面积并擦除信息。

sentences.en: We give explicit history processors and smooth incompressible motions that retain that information and realize every instruction on its full domain.
sentences.zh: 我们给出显式的历史处理器和光滑不可压缩运动，它们保留这些信息，并在每条指令的整个定义域上实现该指令。

sentences.en: A first application assigns each machine and finite input a smooth mean-zero force on the flat unit three-torus, at any fixed positive computable viscosity.
sentences.zh: 第一个应用在任意固定的正可计算黏性系数下，为每台机器及其有限输入指定平坦单位三维环面上的一个光滑零均值外力。

sentences.en: The solution starts from rest; a fixed particle enters a fixed open strip exactly when the machine halts.
sentences.zh: 解从静止状态出发；一个固定粒子进入一个固定开条带，当且仅当机器停机。

sentences.en: The force repeats with period one after an initial loading interval.
sentences.zh: 经过一个初始加载区间后，该外力以一为周期重复。

sentences.en: We then prove alternative realizations using full boxes, normal compensation, invariant planes, and a spatial clock.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们证明了使用整个长方体、法向补偿、不变平面和空间时钟的其他实现。

sentences.en: The constructions specify their initialization, comparison class, derivative bounds, and continuous-time observation.
sentences.zh: 这些构造明确指定了其初始化、比较类、导数界以及连续时间观测。

sentences.en: Exact formulas and effective cutoffs provide finite descriptions of the fields and all their derivatives.
sentences.zh: 精确公式和有效截断给出了这些场及其所有导数的有限描述。

sentences.en: At any fixed positive computable viscosity, smooth forces can make a fixed fluid particle detect the halting of an arbitrary machine, starting from rest, while every mixed derivative of the force and velocity decreases faster than every inverse power of time.
sentences.zh: 在任意固定的正可计算黏性系数下，光滑外力可以使一个从静止状态出发的固定流体粒子检测任意机器是否停机，同时外力和速度的每个混合导数都比时间的任意负幂衰减得更快。

sentences.en: We give three complete memory constructions: compact moving curls, alternating fractional coordinates, and a periodic lattice on the flat three-torus.
sentences.zh: 我们给出三个完整的记忆构造：具有紧支撑的移动旋度场、交替的分数坐标，以及平坦三维环面上的周期格点。

sentences.en: Each machine step takes one unit of physical time.
sentences.zh: 机器的每一步都耗费一个单位的物理时间。

sentences.en: The constructions retain earlier records at separated spatial scales and use an exact open detector with a shrinking signal.
sentences.zh: 这些构造在相互分离的空间尺度上保留先前记录，并使用一个具有收缩信号的精确开集探测器。

sentences.en: We construct smooth forces for three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes flow, from rest at any fixed positive computable viscosity, whose velocity field detects whether a prescribed machine halts.
sentences.zh: 我们为三维不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 流构造光滑外力，该流在任意固定的正可计算黏性系数下从静止状态出发，且其速度场能够检测指定机器是否停机。

sentences.en: On the unit flat torus, a pointwise test of the third velocity component uses successively shorter stirring intervals in a fixed spatial region.
sentences.zh: 在单位平坦环面上，对第三个速度分量的逐点检验，在固定空间区域内使用依次缩短的搅拌区间。

sentences.en: On $`\mathbb R^2\times\mathbb T`$, an integral test uses an expanding array of translation regions and a force with globally bounded mixed derivatives.
sentences.zh: 在 $`\mathbb R^2\times\mathbb T`$ 上，积分检验使用一个不断扩展的平移区域阵列，以及一个各混合导数全局有界的外力。

sentences.en: The vertical velocity solves an advection–diffusion equation: short bursts control its pointwise error in the first construction, and a moving cutoff controls the total escaped mass in the second.
sentences.zh: 竖直速度满足一个平流扩散方程：短促脉冲在第一个构造中控制其逐点误差，而移动截断在第二个构造中控制逸出的总质量。

sentences.en: We construct smooth forces of fixed compact spatial support for three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes flow from rest whose particle at the origin detects halting by entering a fixed half-space.
sentences.zh: 我们为从静止状态出发的三维不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 流构造具有固定紧空间支撑的光滑外力，使其位于原点的粒子通过进入一个固定半空间来检测停机。

sentences.en: Every mixed derivative of the force and velocity decays at rate $`O((1+t)^{-1-j})`$ for time order j.
sentences.zh: 外力和速度的每个时间阶数为 j 的混合导数，都以 $`O((1+t)^{-1-j})`$ 的速率衰减。

sentences.en: Three scalar potentials lift a coded rectangle, perform its instruction, and lower its image; an unbounded logarithmic clock supplies the decay.
sentences.zh: 三个标量势将一个编码矩形抬起、执行其指令，再将其像降下；一个无界的对数时钟提供衰减。

sentences.en: We also realize area-changing prefix instructions on an invariant torus plane, and construct a planar Hamiltonian processor admitting periodic forcing, stationary forcing after startup, and a velocity-field detector through a companion diffusion theorem.
sentences.zh: 我们还在一个不变环面平面上实现改变面积的前缀指令，并构造一个平面 Hamilton 处理器，它容许周期外力、启动后定常的外力，以及通过一个配套扩散定理得到的速度场探测器。

sentences.en: We realize finite positive diagonal affine maps of determinant one by effective smooth incompressible flows on neighborhoods of entire closed rational solid boxes.
sentences.zh: 我们通过整个闭有理实心长方体的邻域上的有效光滑不可压缩流，实现有限组行列式为一的正对角仿射映射。

sentences.en: The source and target families are each disjoint, but may overlap each other.
sentences.zh: 源族和目标族各自两两不交，但两族之间可以重叠。

sentences.en: The construction uses localized curls, evacuation to storage and obstacle detours.
sentences.zh: 该构造使用局部化旋度场、撤离至存储区以及绕开障碍的路径。

sentences.en: A balanced three-stack recorder then assigns every machine and finite input a smooth Navier–Stokes force with one compact spatial support, periodic after a loading interval, at any fixed positive computable viscosity.
sentences.zh: 随后，一个平衡的三栈记录器在任意固定的正可计算黏性系数下，为每台机器及其有限输入指定一个光滑 Navier–Stokes 外力，它具有一个紧空间支撑，并在一个加载区间之后是周期的。

sentences.en: The fluid starts at rest, and one fixed particle enters one fixed open cube exactly when the machine halts.
sentences.zh: 流体从静止状态出发，且一个固定粒子进入一个固定开立方体，当且仅当机器停机。

sentences.en: Further constructions give fixed torus charts, periodicity from time zero, alternative history guards and bounded or slab observers.
sentences.zh: 进一步的构造给出了固定的环面坐标图、从时刻零开始的周期性、其他历史保护机制，以及有界或板层型观测器。

sentences.en: Onto slow clocks yield separate decaying forces.
sentences.zh: 满射的慢时钟分别产生衰减外力。

sentences.en: Each construction includes an all-time observation proof, effective derivative bounds and a stated pressure comparison class.
sentences.zh: 每个构造都包括全时间观测证明、有效的导数界，以及明确给出的压强比较类。

sentences.en: We prove a uniform interior $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ estimate for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3.
sentences.zh: 我们在每个维数 d ≥ 3 中，对有界无穷调和函数证明了一致的内部 $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ 估计。

sentences.en: For some $`\alpha_d\in(0,1/3]`$ depending only on the dimension, the gradient's supremum norm and αd-Hölder seminorm on B1/2 are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on B1.
sentences.zh: 对于某个仅依赖于维数的 $`\alpha_d\in(0,1/3]`$，梯度在 B1/2 上的上确界范数和 αd-Hölder 半范数，都以一个依赖于维数的常数乘以函数在 B1 上的振幅为上界。

sentences.en: The exponent is not explicit, and no endpoint or boundary regularity claim is made.
sentences.zh: 该指数不是显式的，且不作任何端点或边界正则性的断言。

sentences.en: In particular, infinity-harmonic functions are locally C1 on every open subset of ℝd, for d ≥ 3.
sentences.zh: 特别地，当 d ≥ 3 时，无穷调和函数在 ℝd 的每个开子集上都是局部 C1 的。
